attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: local_language_code
attributes.description: Primary local language code for the country using IETF BCP 47 format (e.g., de-DE, ja-JP, fr-FR). Drives Informed Consent Form (ICF) translation requirements and eCRF localization in Clinpal and Medidata Rave.
attributes.references: IETF BCP 47; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Clinpal; Medidata Rave

attributes.name: local_regulatory_reference_number
attributes.description: Country-specific regulatory reference or dossier number assigned by the national competent authority upon CTA/IND submission or approval (e.g., EudraCT number for EU, IND number for US, CTN for Australia). Stored in Veeva Vault.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; TGA CTN; Health Canada; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: country_name
attributes.description: Full English name of the country as defined by ISO 3166-1 (e.g., United States, Germany, Japan). Used for display in regulatory submissions, reports, and dashboards.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; FDA; EMA; PMDA

attributes.name: national_registry_number
attributes.description: Country-specific clinical trial registry number assigned by the national registry (e.g., ISRCTN, UMIN for Japan, CTRI for India). Distinct from EudraCT and ClinicalTrials.gov identifiers. Required for WHO ICTRP compliance.
attributes.references: WHO ICTRP; ICMJE; ISO 14155; Health Canada

attributes.name: planned_enrollment_target
attributes.description: Target number of subjects planned to be enrolled in this country as defined in the study protocol and country feasibility assessment. Drives enrollment forecasting and country-level resource allocation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM; Oracle Siebel CTMS; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: planned_screen_count
attributes.description: Planned number of subjects to be screened in this country, derived from the planned enrollment target and the assumed screen failure rate. Used for site capacity planning and patient recruitment forecasting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: planned_site_count
attributes.description: Number of investigative sites planned to be activated in this country as defined in the study feasibility assessment and country-level enrollment plan. Used for resource planning and site activation tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: regulatory_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a regulatory hold (e.g., FDA Clinical Hold under 21 CFR 312.42, or equivalent national authority hold) is currently in effect for this country, preventing or suspending subject enrollment.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312.42; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 35; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: regulatory_hold_lift_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory hold was lifted by the national authority, allowing enrollment to resume. Null if the hold is still in effect.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312.42; EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: regulatory_hold_reason
attributes.description: Narrative description of the reason for the regulatory hold in this country, as communicated by the national regulatory authority. Populated only when regulatory_hold_flag is True.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312.42; EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: regulatory_hold_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory hold was imposed by the national authority in this country. Used for regulatory timeline impact analysis and sponsor reporting.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312.42; EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: screen_failure_rate_assumption
attributes.description: Assumed proportion of screened subjects expected to fail screening criteria in this country, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.3000 = 30%). Used in enrollment forecasting models to derive planned_screen_count from planned_enrollment_target.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; SAS Drug Development

attributes.name: subject_data_transfer_allowed
attributes.business_glossary_term: Subject Data Cross-Border Transfer Allowed Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether subject-level clinical data collected in this country may be transferred cross-border to the sponsor or CRO data systems under applicable data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR Chapter V adequacy decisions, SCCs).
attributes.references: GDPR Chapter V; HIPAA; EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2)

tag_set.value: Subject Data Cross-Border Transfer Allowed Flag

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this study-country record was most recently modified, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports ALCOA+ data integrity principles and change audit trail requirements per 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

products.name: investigational_product
products.description: Master record for the investigational medicinal product (IMP) or device used in a clinical study. Captures IMP name, INN (International Nonproprietary Name), drug code, formulation, dosage form, route of administration, strength, manufacturer, IND/IMPD
products.reference: WHO-DD / IND / IMPD / CDISC SDTM EX Domain

attributes.name: investigational_product_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the investigational medicinal product (IMP) or investigational device record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for this master resource entity.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM IG

attributes.name: country_registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.country_registration. Business justification: An investigational product may have existing country registrations (approved comparators, reference products).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: imp_tmf_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: The Investigational Medicinal Product Dossier (IMPD) / Investigator's Brochure is a DIA TMF Zone 4 essential document.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: ind_application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.ind_application. Business justification: An investigational product is authorized for clinical use under a specific IND/IMPD.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: nda_bla_application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.nda_bla_application. Business justification: For late-phase trials, the investigational product is the subject of an NDA/BLA.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: active_substance
attributes.description: Name of the active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) or active substance in the investigational product. May differ from the INN for novel compounds. Used in IMPD/IND CMC sections, pharmacovigilance, and SDTM datasets.
attributes.references: ICH Q6A; FDA CMC Guidance; EMA IMPD Guideline; WHO INN

attributes.name: cas_number
attributes.description: Chemical Abstracts Service (CAS) Registry Number uniquely identifying the active substance chemical structure. Used in regulatory submissions, safety data sheets, and cross-referencing with pharmacological databases.
attributes.references: CAS Registry; FDA CMC Guidance; EMA IMPD Guideline

attributes.name: controlled_substance_schedule
attributes.description: DEA controlled substance schedule classification for the investigational product (e.g., Schedule II, Schedule IV) or 'not_controlled' if not a controlled substance.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1308; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the investigational product master record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11, ALCOA+ principles, and GCP compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ Principles; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: investigational_product_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative description of the investigational product including its therapeutic purpose, background, and any additional context not captured in structured fields. Used in protocol background sections and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA IND Guidance; EMA IMPD Guideline

attributes.name: development_phase
attributes.description: Current clinical development phase of the investigational product at the time of record creation or last update (e.g., Phase 1, Phase 2, Phase 3). Informs regulatory strategy, risk classification, and portfolio management.
attributes.references: ICH E8; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA Clinical Trials Regulation

attributes.name: dosage_form
attributes.description: Physical form of the investigational product as administered to subjects (e.g., tablet, capsule, solution for injection, lyophilized powder). Captured per CDISC SDTM EX domain and referenced in supply chain and pharmacy management.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX Domain; FDA Dosage Form Terminology; WHO Pharmaceutical Preparations

attributes.name: ema_product_number
attributes.description: EMA-assigned product number for the investigational product as registered in the EU Clinical Trials Information System (CTIS) or EudraCT. Required for EU regulatory submissions and EU CTR 536/2014 compliance.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; EMA CTIS; EudraCT

attributes.name: first_in_human_date
attributes.description: Date on which the investigational product was first administered to a human subject in any clinical study. Key milestone for regulatory timelines, development history, and portfolio analytics.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA IND Guidance; EMA IMPD Guideline

attributes.name: formulation
attributes.description: Qualitative description of the investigational product formulation including excipients, vehicle, and any special formulation characteristics (e.g., 'immediate-release tablet with microcrystalline cellulose', 'sterile aqueous solution pH 7.4').
attributes.references: ICH Q8; FDA CMC Guidance; EMA IMPD Guideline

attributes.name: imp_code
attributes.description: Sponsor-assigned internal drug or device code uniquely identifying the investigational product across all studies (e.g., ABC-1234). Serves as the externally-known business identifier referenced in protocols, supply chain, and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); EU CTR 536/2014; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: impd_version
attributes.description: Version number of the current Investigational Medicinal Product Dossier (IMPD) or IND on file with the regulatory authority for this product. Tracked in Veeva Vault for regulatory submission management and amendment history.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; EMA IMPD Guideline; Veeva Vault RIM

attributes.name: ind_submission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the IND application (FDA) or equivalent regulatory authorization application was first submitted for this investigational product. Tracked in Veeva Vault for regulatory milestone reporting.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312; FDA IND Guidance; Veeva Vault RIM

attributes.name: investigational_product_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the investigational product master record (e.g., active for ongoing studies, discontinued if development halted, superseded if replaced by a new formulation). Drives supply chain and regulatory workflow decisions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Medidata Rave RTSM; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: is_blinded
attributes.description: Indicates whether the investigational product is used in a blinded (masked) study design (True) or open-label (False). Drives blinding and unblinding procedures in Medidata Rave RTSM and the source system randomization configuration.
attributes.references: ICH E9; ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs

attributes.name: is_comparator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product record represents a comparator (active control or placebo) rather than the primary investigational product (True = comparator). Enables differentiation of IMP vs. comparator in supply chain, SDTM, and safety reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); EU CTR 536/2014; CDISC SDTM EX Domain

attributes.name: is_placebo
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product record represents a placebo (True) rather than an active investigational product or comparator. Used in RTSM randomization configuration, supply chain, and SDTM EX domain coding.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC SDTM EX Domain; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Name of the pharmaceutical manufacturer or contract manufacturing organization (CMO) responsible for producing the investigational product. Referenced in the IMPD/IND CMC section and supply chain records in the source system
attributes.references: ICH Q7 GMP; FDA 21 CFR Part 211; EMA GMP Guidelines; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: manufacturer_site
attributes.description: Physical site or facility name and location where the investigational product is manufactured. Required for regulatory submissions (IND/IMPD) and GMP compliance tracking. Distinct from the manufacturer legal entity name.
attributes.references: ICH Q7 GMP; FDA 21 CFR Part 211; EMA GMP Guidelines

attributes.name: mechanism_of_action
attributes.description: Pharmacological mechanism by which the investigational product exerts its therapeutic effect (e.g., selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor, PD-1 checkpoint inhibitor). Captured in the IND/IMPD and referenced in the protocol background section.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA IND Guidance; EMA IMPD Guideline

attributes.name: ndc_number
attributes.description: FDA-assigned National Drug Code (NDC) number for the investigational product, if applicable. Used for US regulatory submissions, pharmacy dispensing records, and drug accountability tracking. May be absent for novel compounds not yet assigned an NDC.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 207; FDA NDC Directory

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes or comments regarding the investigational product record, such as special handling instructions, known stability issues, or interim regulatory communications. Captured by data management or regulatory affairs teams.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ Principles; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: packaging_description
attributes.description: Description of the primary and secondary packaging configuration for the investigational product (e.g., 'blister pack of 10 tablets in a carton', 'single-use vial 10 mL in a kit'). Referenced in supply chain, pharmacy, and RTSM kit configuration.
attributes.references: ICH Q8; FDA 21 CFR Part 211.94; EMA IMPD Guideline; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: Classification of the investigational product by modality type (e.g., small molecule, biologic, gene therapy, medical device). Drives regulatory pathway selection, storage requirements, and supply chain handling.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Parts 312/812; EMA Guideline on IMP; ICH Q6A/Q6B

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_status
attributes.description: Current regulatory approval status of the investigational product (e.g., approved for a different indication, purely investigational, withdrawn from market). Informs regulatory strategy, labeling requirements, and comparator sourcing decisions.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA Regulation (EC) No 726/2004; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: retest_period_months
attributes.description: Period in months after which the investigational product must be retested before continued use, applicable to active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and certain formulations. Distinct from shelf life; used in supply chain and QC planning.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A Stability; FDA 21 CFR Part 211.137; EMA IMPD Guideline

attributes.name: shelf_life_months
attributes.description: Approved shelf life of the investigational product in months from the date of manufacture, as established by stability studies and documented in the IMPD/IND. Drives expiry date calculation, supply planning, and resupply triggers in Medidata Rave RTSM.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A Stability; FDA 21 CFR Part 211.137; EMA IMPD Guideline

attributes.name: sponsor_product_code
attributes.description: Sponsor's internal product or compound code used in portfolio management systems, distinct from the IMP code used in clinical operations. Enables cross-referencing between clinical development and commercial product pipelines.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Sponsor SOPs; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: Required storage conditions for the investigational product as specified in the IMPD/IND and product label (e.g., 'Store at 2–8°C, protected from light', 'Store below 25°C'). Critical for supply chain cold chain management and site pharmacy compliance.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A Stability; FDA 21 CFR Part 211.142; EMA IMPD Guideline

attributes.name: storage_temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for the investigational product. Used by supply chain and site pharmacy to configure cold chain monitoring alerts and validate storage compliance.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A Stability; FDA 21 CFR Part 211.142; WHO Technical Report Series

attributes.name: storage_temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for the investigational product. Used by supply chain and site pharmacy to configure cold chain monitoring alerts and validate storage compliance.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A Stability; FDA 21 CFR Part 211.142; WHO Technical Report Series

attributes.name: strength
attributes.description: Nominal strength or concentration of the active substance in the investigational product as labeled (e.g., '10 mg', '100 mg/mL', '5 mg/kg'). Captured in the IMPD/IND and referenced in supply chain, pharmacy, and SDTM EX domain.
attributes.references: ICH Q6A; CDISC SDTM EX Domain (EXDOSE); FDA CMC Guidance

attributes.name: strength_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the investigational product strength (e.g., mg, mg/mL, IU). Standardized per CDISC controlled terminology to enable cross-study comparisons and SDTM dataset generation.
attributes.references: CDISC Controlled Terminology (UNIT); ICH Q6A; FDA CMC Guidance

attributes.name: therapeutic_class
attributes.description: Therapeutic or pharmacological class of the investigational product (e.g., oncology, cardiovascular, CNS, anti-infective). Used for portfolio analytics, regulatory strategy, and study feasibility assessments.
attributes.references: WHO ATC; MedDRA SOC; FDA Pharmacologic Class

attributes.name: unit_of_dispensing
attributes.description: The unit in which the investigational product is dispensed to subjects at the investigational site (e.g., tablet, vial, kit, syringe). Used in RTSM dispensing records, drug accountability logs, and SDTM EX domain.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX Domain; Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the investigational product master record was last modified, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11, ALCOA+ principles, and change management tracking.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ Principles; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: who_dd_code
attributes.description: WHO Drug Dictionary (WHO-DD) drug code assigned to the investigational product for standardized drug coding in adverse event reporting, SDTM datasets, and regulatory submissions. Enables cross-study signal detection in the source system
attributes.references: WHO-DD; CDISC SDTM CM/EX domains; ICH E2B(R3)

products.name: dosing_regimen
products.description: Defines the dosing regimen for each investigational product within a study arm. Records regimen name, dose level, dose unit, dosing frequency, dosing route, dosing duration, dose escalation scheme (for dose-escalation studies), dose modification rules
products.reference: CDISC SDTM EX (Exposure) Domain / ICH E4

attributes.name: dosing_regimen_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the dosing regimen record within the Clinical Trials data platform. Primary key for the dosing_regimen product in the study domain.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: arm_id
attributes.description: Reference to the study arm (treatment group) to which this dosing regimen applies. A study may have multiple arms each with distinct regimens (e.g., active drug arm vs. placebo arm).
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM ARM; ICH E9 Statistical Principles

attributes.name: codelist_id
attributes.description: the pharmaceutical dose form from CDISC CT codelist FRM (C66726)
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX.EXDOSFRM; CDISC Controlled Terminology; FDA NDA/BLA Labeling

attributes.name: epoch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.epoch. Business justification: A dosing regimen is administered during a specific study epoch (e.g., a loading dose regimen during the Run-in epoch, a maintenance regimen during the Treatment epoch).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: investigational_product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational product (IP) being administered under this dosing regimen. Supports traceability from regimen to supply chain and accountability logs.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX.EXTRT; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent clinical study for which this dosing regimen is defined. Links the regimen to the study protocol and all associated study-level metadata.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: study_protocol_amendment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.study_protocol_amendment. Business justification: dosing_regimen has amendment_number as a STRING but no FK to study_protocol_amendment.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: treatment_arm_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to randomization.treatment_arm. Business justification: A dosing regimen is the operational specification of what a treatment_arm administers.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: adam_adex_mapping_notes
attributes.business_glossary_term: CDISC ADaM Exposure (ADEX) Domain Mapping Notes
attributes.description: Notes describing how this dosing regimen maps to the CDISC ADaM ADEX (Analysis Dataset for Exposure) domain, including derivation rules for cumulative dose, dose intensity, and relative dose intensity calculations used in biostatistical analysis.
attributes.references: CDISC ADaM ADEX Implementation Guide; CDISC Controlled Terminology; FDA Statistical Review Guidance; SAP

tag_set.value: CDISC ADaM Exposure (ADEX) Domain Mapping Notes

attributes.name: allocation_ratio
attributes.description: The allocation ratio of the dosing regimen.

attributes.name: blinding_type
attributes.description: Blinding level applied to this dosing regimen as defined in the study protocol (e.g., 'double-blind' where neither subject nor investigator knows the treatment assignment). Impacts RTSM/IRT dispensing logic and unblinding procedures.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM TI Domain; FDA Guidance on Blinding

attributes.name: comparator_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this regimen represents an active investigational product, placebo, vehicle control, sham procedure, or no-treatment arm. Critical for ITT and PP population definitions and regulatory benefit-risk assessment.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; ICH E10 Choice of Control Group; CDISC SDTM TA Domain; FDA Guidance on Placebo Controls

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this dosing regimen record was first created in the data platform, conforming to ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ Principles; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: dose_escalation_step
attributes.description: Sequential step number within the dose escalation scheme (e.g., 1, 2, 3). Enables ordering of dose cohorts in escalation studies and supports dose-response curve construction in PK/PD modeling.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX Domain; FDA Guidance on Dose-Escalation Studies; ICH E9

attributes.name: dose_level
attributes.description: Numeric dose amount to be administered per dosing event as specified in the protocol (e.g., 10.0, 50.5, 100.0). Represents the planned dose per administration. Used in PK/PD modeling and dose-response analysis.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX.EXDOSE; ICH E9 Statistical Principles; FDA Guidance on PK Studies

attributes.name: dose_modification_rules
attributes.description: Narrative description of protocol-defined rules for dose modifications, reductions, interruptions, or discontinuations based on toxicity or adverse events (e.g., 'Reduce by 25% for Grade 2 AE; discontinue for Grade 3 SAE').
attributes.references: CTCAE v5.0; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; CDISC SDTM EX Domain

attributes.name: dose_reduction_levels
attributes.description: Number of permitted dose reduction levels defined in the protocol (e.g., 2 levels: Level -1 and Level -2). Used in oncology studies to manage toxicity while maintaining therapeutic benefit. Supports safety dose-response analysis.
attributes.references: CTCAE v5.0; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Guidance on Oncology Drug Dosing

attributes.name: dosing_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency of dose administration using standard clinical abbreviations (e.g., 'QD' = once daily, 'BID' = twice daily, 'QW' = once weekly, 'Q2W' = every two weeks). Conforms to CDISC SDTM EX.EXDOSFRQ controlled terminology.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX.EXDOSFRQ; CDISC Controlled Terminology; ICH E9

attributes.name: dosing_interval_days
attributes.description: Numeric interval between doses expressed in days (e.g., 1.0 for QD, 0.5 for BID, 7.0 for QW). Provides machine-readable precision for automated scheduling in RTSM/IRT systems and PK modeling when frequency alone is insufficient.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX Domain; Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E9

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this dosing regimen version ceased to be effective (e.g., superseded by an amendment). Null for currently active regimens. Supports temporal versioning and historical audit of regimen changes.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA Clinical Trials Regulation EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this dosing regimen version became effective in the study, typically aligned with protocol approval or amendment approval date. Supports temporal versioning of regimen changes across the study lifecycle.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA Clinical Trials Regulation EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: escalation_scheme_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the dose escalation scheme applied in this regimen (e.g., '3+3 design', 'Accelerated Titration', 'BOIN design', 'mTPI-2'). Populated only when is_dose_escalation = True. Supports Phase I safety and PK/PD analysis.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Dose-Escalation Studies; ICH E9; CDISC SDTM EX Domain

attributes.name: infusion_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Duration of intravenous or subcutaneous infusion in minutes, applicable when dosing_route is 'INTRAVENOUS' or similar. Null for non-infusion routes. Critical for PK modeling of IV drug exposure and site nursing procedure planning.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX.EXDUR; ICH E9; FDA Guidance on PK Studies

attributes.name: is_dose_escalation
attributes.description: Indicates whether this regimen is part of a dose-escalation scheme (True) or a fixed-dose regimen (False). When True, the escalation_scheme_description and mtd_flag fields become operationally relevant. Common in Phase I oncology studies.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; FDA Guidance on Dose-Escalation Studies; CDISC SDTM EX Domain

attributes.name: is_mtd
attributes.description: Indicates whether this dose level has been designated as the Maximum Tolerated Dose (MTD) by the Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) or study team (True = MTD confirmed). Critical for Phase I dose-finding studies and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on MTD Determination; ICH E9; DSMB Charter; CDISC SDTM EX Domain

attributes.name: loading_dose_duration_days
attributes.description: Number of days the loading dose is administered before transitioning to the maintenance dose. Null if no loading dose is defined. Supports PK/PD modeling of drug accumulation and steady-state calculations.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX Domain; ICH E9; FDA Guidance on PK Studies; DMPK principles

attributes.name: loading_dose_level
attributes.description: Initial higher dose administered to rapidly achieve therapeutic drug concentrations before transitioning to the maintenance dose level. Expressed in the same unit as dose_unit. Null if no loading dose is specified in the protocol.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX Domain; ICH E9; FDA Guidance on PK Studies; DMPK principles

attributes.name: maximum_dose_level
attributes.description: Maximum allowable dose level for this regimen as defined in the protocol (e.g., dose cap for safety). Expressed in the same unit as dose_unit. Used in dose modification rules and safety monitoring.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA Clinical Trials Regulation

attributes.name: pd_assessment_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether pharmacodynamic (PD) biomarker assessments are required for subjects on this dosing regimen (True = PD assessments mandated per protocol). Supports PK/PD modeling and dose-response analysis.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Guidance on PD Studies; CDISC SDTM CE/FA Domains; SAS Drug Development

attributes.name: pk_sampling_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether pharmacokinetic (PK) blood sampling is required for subjects on this dosing regimen (True = PK sampling mandated per protocol). Drives PK visit scheduling, sample collection logistics, and DMPK analysis planning.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Guidance on PK Studies; CDISC SDTM PC/PP Domains; SAS Drug Development

attributes.name: planned_duration_days
attributes.description: Total planned duration of the dosing regimen expressed in days as specified in the study protocol (e.g., 84 days for a 12-week treatment period). Used for treatment period planning, supply forecasting, and CDISC SDTM EX.EXENDY derivation.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX.EXENDY; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: protocol_version
attributes.description: Version of the study protocol under which this dosing regimen was defined or last amended (e.g., 'v1.0', 'v2.1'). Enables traceability of regimen changes across protocol amendments. Supports TMF/eTMF document management and regulatory audit trails.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 6; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA Clinical Trials Regulation EU CTR 536/2014; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: randomization_ratio
attributes.description: Allocation ratio for randomization to this arm/regimen expressed as a colon-separated ratio (e.g., '1:1', '2:1', '1:1:1'). Used in RTSM/IRT configuration and statistical analysis plan (the source system) for sample size and power calculations.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; CDISC SDTM TA Domain; Medidata Rave RTSM; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: regimen_code

products.description: Records the site feasibility evaluation conducted prior to site selection for a specific study. Captures feasibility questionnaire responses, estimated enrollment capacity, patient population availability, competing trial load, infrastructure readiness
products.reference: Site Feasibility Questionnaire (SFQ)

attributes.name: feasibility_assessment_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the site feasibility assessment record. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: Oracle Clinical One Site Management Module; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: country_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.country. Business justification: Site feasibility scoring is evaluated against country-level enrollment rate assumptions, screen failure rate assumptions, and feasibility scores stored in study.country.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: investigational_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational site being evaluated for feasibility.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: lab_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.lab_facility. Business justification: Feasibility assessments formally evaluate a specific lab facility's capability (lab_capabilities_available flag).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: principal_investigator_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Principal Investigator (PI) proposed for this site and study during the feasibility evaluation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: protocol_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.protocol. Business justification: Feasibility assessments evaluate a site against a specific protocol version — protocol complexity, visit burden, and eligibility criteria drive feasibility scoring.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: sample_size_calc_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to biostatistics.sample_size_calc. Business justification: Feasibility assessments are conducted against a specific enrollment target derived from the sample size calculation.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study for which this feasibility assessment is being conducted.
attributes.references: Oracle Clinical One; ICH E6(R2) Good Clinical Practice (GCP)

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to site.study_site. Business justification: A feasibility assessment is conducted for a specific study-site pairing. study_site is the canonical association entity representing the full lifecycle of a study at a site.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: tmf_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: Feasibility questionnaires and assessment reports are TMF artifacts (DIA Zone 2, pre-study documentation).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: assessment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the feasibility assessment questionnaire was initiated or formally submitted by the site. Principal business event date for this transaction.
attributes.references: Oracle Clinical One; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: assessment_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the feasibility assessment, used in CTMS and sponsor communications (e.g., FA-2024-0042). Unique within a study.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: assessment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the feasibility assessment workflow within the CTMS. Tracks progression from initial draft through sponsor review to final decision.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: competing_trial_count
attributes.description: Number of currently active or planned clinical trials at the site that compete for the same patient population or therapeutic area. High competing trial load may reduce enrollment capacity.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this feasibility assessment record was first created in the source system. Supports audit trail requirements under GCP and 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: decision_date
attributes.description: Date on which the sponsor or CRO made the final site selection decision (selected, not selected, or on hold) based on this feasibility assessment.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: dedicated_research_staff_count
attributes.description: Number of dedicated clinical research staff (Clinical Research Coordinators (CRCs), research nurses, data entry staff) available at the site to support this study.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: edc_access_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the site has the necessary IT infrastructure, internet connectivity, and hardware to access the study's Electronic Data Capture (EDC) system (e.g., Medidata Rave).
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave EDC

attributes.name: enrollment_experience_score
attributes.description: Sub-score component reflecting the site's historical enrollment performance, patient population access, and therapeutic area experience. Contributes to the composite feasibility score.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: estimated_enrollment_capacity
attributes.description: The site's self-reported estimate of the number of eligible subjects it can enroll for this specific study over the planned enrollment period. Core metric for site selection decisions.
attributes.references: Oracle Clinical One; Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: estimated_screen_failure_rate
attributes.description: Site's estimated percentage of screened subjects expected to fail eligibility criteria for this study. Used to adjust enrollment projections and calculate required screening numbers.
attributes.references: Oracle Clinical One; ICH E9 Statistical Principles for Clinical Trials

attributes.name: feasibility_score
attributes.description: Composite numeric score (typically 0–100) assigned to the site based on weighted evaluation of all feasibility criteria including enrollment potential, infrastructure, and experience. Used for comparative site ranking.
attributes.references: Oracle Clinical One; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: feasibility_score_tier
attributes.description: Categorical tier classification derived from the feasibility score (e.g., High ≥ 75, Medium 50–74, Low < 50). Used for rapid site prioritization and sponsor reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: gcp_training_current
attributes.description: Indicates whether the site's Principal Investigator and key study staff hold current GCP training certifications as required by ICH E6(R2) and applicable regulatory authorities.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA Clinical Trials Regulation EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: imaging_capabilities_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the site has the required imaging infrastructure (e.g., MRI, CT, PET) specified in the study protocol for efficacy or safety assessments.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: irb_iec_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Status
attributes.description: Current status of the site's Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) relationship at the time of feasibility assessment. Active IRB/IEC is a prerequisite for site activation.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 56; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 3; OHRP; EMA Clinical Trials Regulation EU CTR 536/2014

tag_set.value: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Status

attributes.name: lab_capabilities_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the site has on-site or contracted laboratory capabilities required by the study protocol (e.g., local lab processing, sample storage, cold chain management).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CLIA (Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments); CAP (College of American Pathologists)

attributes.name: patient_population_size
attributes.description: Estimated number of patients in the site's catchment area who match the study's target indication and could potentially be eligible for enrollment.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: pharmacy_capabilities_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the site has an investigational drug pharmacy with appropriate storage, dispensing, and accountability capabilities as required by the study protocol.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; USP <797> Pharmaceutical Compounding

attributes.name: phase
attributes.description: The regulatory phase of the clinical trial (Phase I through Phase IV) for which the site is being assessed. Influences the complexity and infrastructure requirements evaluated.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; ICH E8(R1); EMA Clinical Trials Regulation EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: prior_study_experience_count
attributes.description: Number of prior clinical studies the site has conducted in the same therapeutic area or indication. Reflects site expertise and GCP compliance track record.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: questionnaire_response_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing additional site comments, clarifications, or qualitative responses provided by the site during the feasibility questionnaire completion.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: questionnaire_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the feasibility questionnaire template used for this assessment (e.g., v2.1). Ensures traceability of assessment criteria across protocol amendments.
attributes.references: Oracle Clinical One; Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_score
attributes.description: Sub-score component reflecting the site's GCP compliance history, inspection findings, audit outcomes, and regulatory standing. Derived from CTMS compliance tracking data.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA Clinical Trials Regulation EU CTR 536/2014; MasterControl

attributes.name: reviewed_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the sponsor or CRO representative who reviewed and approved the feasibility assessment and made the site selection decision.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: selection_decision
attributes.description: Final site selection outcome derived from this feasibility assessment. Indicates whether the site was selected, not selected, placed on hold, or awaiting decision.
attributes.references: Oracle Clinical One; Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: site_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the country in which the investigational site is located. Used for regional enrollment planning and regulatory jurisdiction determination.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; ICH E6(R2) GCP; EMA Clinical Trials Regulation EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: site_infrastructure_score
attributes.description: Sub-score component of the overall feasibility score reflecting the site's physical and technical infrastructure readiness (EDC, lab, pharmacy, imaging). Scored on a standardized scale.
attributes.references: Oracle Clinical One; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: site_region
attributes.description: Geographic region classification of the investigational site (e.g., North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific). Used for regional enrollment tracking and sponsor reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: The native primary key or record identifier of this feasibility assessment in the originating source system (the source system or the source system Enables lineage tracing and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Oracle Clinical One; Oracle Siebel CTMS; ALCOA+ (Attributable Legible Contemporaneous Original Accurate)

attributes.name: sponsor_comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments entered by the sponsor or CRO reviewer following evaluation of the feasibility questionnaire. Documents rationale for selection decisions or follow-up requirements.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the completed feasibility questionnaire was formally submitted by the site to the sponsor or CRO for review.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this feasibility assessment record. Supports audit trail and data integrity requirements under GCP and 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

products.name: selection
products.description: Records the formal site selection decision for a study-site pairing, including selection rationale, selection committee approval, selection date, rejection reasons (if applicable), and the transition from feasibility to activation.
products.reference: CTMS Site Selection Record

attributes.name: selection_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the site selection decision record. Primary key for the site_selection data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: activation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the site activation record that was initiated as a result of this selection decision. Null until the site transitions from selected to activation workflow. Establishes the selection-to-activation traceability chain.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: compliance_sop_id
attributes.description: Reference to the selection committee or governance body that reviewed and approved or rejected this site selection decision.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; SOPs

attributes.name: country_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.country. Business justification: Site selection decisions are made against country-level enrollment targets, planned site counts, and activation status in study.country.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: feasibility_assessment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the prior feasibility assessment record that informed this site selection decision, establishing traceability from feasibility to selection.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: ind_application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.ind_application. Business justification: Site selection decisions for Phase 1-3 trials must reference the IND under which the study operates.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: investigational_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational site being evaluated and selected or rejected for participation in the study.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: irb_iec_approval_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to site.irb_iec_approval. Business justification: selection already captures irb_iec_approval_date and irb_iec_status as denormalized fields.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: principal_investigator_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Principal Investigator (PI) proposed or confirmed for this study-site pairing at the time of selection. The PI's qualifications are a key selection criterion per GCP.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.53; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: protocol_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.protocol. Business justification: Site selection decisions are made against a specific protocol version; protocol_version is a plain-text denormalization.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: risk_assessment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.risk_assessment. Business justification: Risk-based site selection methodology incorporates site risk assessments for GCP compliance, enrollment capacity, and regulatory history.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: sample_size_calc_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to biostatistics.sample_size_calc. Business justification: Site selection assigns target_enrollment_count and enrollment_rate_per_month to each site based on the study's sample size calculation.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study (protocol) for which this site selection decision was made. Links the selection event to the governing protocol.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to site.study_site. Business justification: site_selection records the formal site selection decision for a study-site pairing. study_site is the canonical association entity representing the full lifecycle of that pairing.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: tmf_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: Site selection documentation (selection rationale, committee decisions) is a TMF artifact (DIA Zone 2). The existing tmf_document_reference is a plain string.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: activation_target_date
attributes.description: Planned date by which the selected site should complete all activation requirements and be ready to enroll the first subject. Used for study timeline management and milestone tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: competing_trial_count
attributes.description: Number of other active clinical trials running concurrently at this site at the time of selection. Used to assess site capacity and potential enrollment competition.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: conditional_requirements
attributes.description: Description of conditions that must be met before a conditionally selected site can proceed to activation (e.g., additional staff training, equipment procurement, IRB approval). Populated when selection_status is 'conditionally_selected'.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this site selection record was first created in the source system. Used for audit trail and data lineage per ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: ctms_site_record_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS) Site Record ID
attributes.description: The source system record identifier from the source system for this site selection record, enabling traceability and reconciliation between the Silver Layer and the operational CTMS.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; Oracle Siebel CTMS

tag_set.value: Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS) Site Record ID

attributes.name: decision_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time (with timezone offset) at which the site selection decision was formally recorded in the CTMS system, supporting 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: enrollment_rate_per_month
attributes.description: Projected number of subjects the site is expected to enroll per calendar month, based on feasibility assessment data. Used for study timeline planning and site performance forecasting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: feasibility_score
attributes.description: Composite numeric score derived from the feasibility assessment, summarizing the site's overall suitability for the study. Higher scores indicate greater suitability. Used as a key input to the selection decision.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: first_patient_in_target_date
attributes.description: Target date for enrolling the first subject (First Patient In / FPI) at this site. A key study milestone used for enrollment planning and sponsor KPI reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; KPI reporting

attributes.name: gcp_compliance_confirmed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the site has been confirmed as GCP-compliant at the time of selection, based on prior audit history, inspection records, and training verification.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA; MHRA

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this site selection record. Supports change tracking and audit trail requirements per ALCOA+ and 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, observations, or contextual information recorded by the selection committee or CRA that do not fit into structured fields. Supports comprehensive documentation per ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this site selection decision record, used in CTMS, eTMF, and sponsor communications (e.g., SS-PROT001-00042). Serves as the human-readable reference number.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: patient_population_size
attributes.description: Estimated number of eligible patients in the site's catchment area who meet the study's inclusion/exclusion criteria, as assessed during feasibility. A primary driver of the selection decision.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: pi_qualification_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Principal Investigator's (PI) qualifications, CV, and GCP training have been verified and confirmed as adequate for this study at the time of selection, per ICH E6(R2) requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.53

attributes.name: prior_audit_finding
attributes.description: Indicates whether the site has any prior significant audit findings or regulatory inspection observations that were considered as part of the selection decision. Supports risk-based site selection.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; MasterControl CAPA

attributes.name: rationale
attributes.description: Narrative justification for the site selection decision, documenting the business and scientific reasons the site was chosen or rejected. Required for TMF documentation and sponsor oversight.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.6; Veeva Vault eTMF; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: region
attributes.description: Sponsor-defined geographic region grouping for the site (e.g., North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific). Used for regional enrollment tracking, CRA assignment, and operational reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a regulatory submission (e.g., IND amendment, CTA, or national competent authority notification) is required before this site can be activated. Drives regulatory workflow initiation.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2) GCP; MHRA; PMDA

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the primary reason a site was not selected. Populated only when selection_status is 'rejected' or 'withdrawn'. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: rejection_reason_detail
attributes.description: Free-text elaboration of the rejection reason, providing additional context beyond the standardized rejection_reason_code. Populated only when the site is rejected or withdrawn.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: selection_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the formal site selection decision was made and approved by the selection committee. This is the principal business event date for this transaction.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: selection_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the site selection decision. Drives workflow transitions from feasibility through activation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: selected|rejected|pending_review|conditionally_selected|withdrawn|on_hold — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: selection_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the nature of the site selection: whether the site is a newly added site, a replacement for a terminated site, a backup site held in reserve, or an expansion site added to increase enrollment capacity.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: sponsor_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the sponsor formally approved the site selection decision. Null if sponsor approval is not required or has not yet been received.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.2; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: sponsor_approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the sponsor must provide explicit written approval before this site selection decision is finalized. Relevant for CRO-managed studies where sponsor sign-off is a contractual requirement.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.2; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; CRO sponsor agreements

attributes.name: sponsor_site_number
attributes.description: Sponsor-assigned alphanumeric identifier for the site within the context of this specific study, used in EDC, RTSM, and regulatory submissions. Distinct from the internal site_id.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: target_enrollment_count
attributes.description: The planned number of subjects to be enrolled at this site as agreed at the time of selection. Used for enrollment planning, site performance benchmarking, and resource allocation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: visit_conducted
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal site selection visit (also known as a pre-study site visit or PSSV) was conducted at this site prior to the selection decision, as recommended by ICH E6(R2).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.6; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: visit_date
attributes.description: Date on which the site selection visit (pre-study site visit / PSSV) was conducted. Null if no visit was conducted or if the visit is pending.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.6; Oracle Siebel CTMS

products.name: study_site
products.description: Association entity representing the full lifecycle relationship between a specific study (protocol) and an investigational site, from selection through activation to closeout.

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the study-site association record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: audit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.audit. Business justification: Study site audits assess GCP compliance, data integrity, and regulatory readiness. Audit scheduling, findings tracking, and CAPA closure verification at study site level require direct audit

attributes.name: central_lab_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.lab_facility. Business justification: Each study_site is assigned a central laboratory for specimen analysis. This drives specimen shipment routing, lab kit ordering, result reporting, and eTMF documentation.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: clinical_trial_authorization_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.clinical_trial_authorization. Business justification: Each study_site in EU member states is governed by a specific CTA for that country.

attributes.name: country_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.country. Business justification: Each study_site belongs to exactly one study-country record. Country-level enrollment targets, CTA approval status, and regulatory hold flags in study.country directly govern site activation

attributes.name: investigational_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational site master record. Links to the site entity representing the physical or organizational research location.

attributes.name: primary_depot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.depot. Business justification: Sites require a designated primary depot for supply chain operations. Resupply orders, shipment routing, and supply planning all depend on knowing which depot serves each study site.

attributes.name: principal_investigator_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Principal Investigator (PI) assigned to lead clinical research activities at this site for this study. The PI is responsible for the conduct of the trial per ICH E6(R2) GCP.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.53; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: rand_list_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to randomization.rand_list. Business justification: In site-stratified randomization, each study_site is assigned a specific randomization list in the IRT/RTSM system.

attributes.name: study_id

attributes.name: budget_agreed_amount
attributes.description: Total agreed budget amount for this site's participation in the study, as specified in the Clinical Trial Agreement. Covers per-patient fees, overhead, and procedure costs. Managed in the source system accounting.

attributes.name: capacity_subjects

attributes.name: cda_execution_date

attributes.name: contract_execution_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Clinical Trial Agreement (CTA) or Clinical Site Agreement between the sponsor/CRO and the site institution was fully executed. A mandatory activation milestone before site initiation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; TransCelerate Site Activation Metrics; SAP S/4HANA Contract Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this study-site association record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.

attributes.name: actual_enrolled_count
attributes.description: The actual number of subjects enrolled (randomized or consented per protocol definition) at this site during the reporting period. Sourced from Medidata Rave EDC and the source system randomization data.

attributes.name: completed_count
attributes.description: The number of subjects who completed all protocol-required study procedures and visits at this site during the reporting period. Used for PP population analysis and study close-out planning.

attributes.name: cumulative_dropout_count
attributes.description: The total number of enrolled subjects who have discontinued participation at this site from study activation through the end of the current reporting period. Used for retention analysis and ITT/PP population tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM DS domain

attributes.name: cumulative_enrolled_count
attributes.description: The total number of subjects enrolled at this site from study activation through the end of the current reporting period. Primary metric for tracking progress toward the site's enrollment target.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; Medidata Rave EDC; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: cumulative_screened_count
attributes.description: The total number of subjects screened at this site from study activation through the end of the current reporting period. Enables longitudinal enrollment trend analysis and forecasting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; Medidata Rave EDC

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Indicates the originating system from which this enrollment performance record was sourced or integrated. Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation between CTMS and EDC systems.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: dropout_count
attributes.description: The number of enrolled subjects who discontinued participation (withdrew consent, were lost to follow-up, or were discontinued by investigator) during the reporting period. Impacts ITT and PP population sizes.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM DS domain

attributes.name: dropout_rate
attributes.description: The proportion of enrolled subjects who dropped out during the reporting period, expressed as a percentage (dropout_count / actual_enrolled_count × 100). Stored as a raw business metric from CTMS; used for retention risk assessment and site performance
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: enrollment_rate_per_month
attributes.description: The average number of subjects enrolled per calendar month at this site during the reporting period. Sourced from CTMS enrollment tracking; used for enrollment forecasting and site performance benchmarking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; FDA Guidance on Clinical Trial Conduct

attributes.name: enrollment_target_achievement_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of the site's total enrollment target achieved cumulatively as of the end of the reporting period (cumulative_enrolled_count / site_enrollment_target × 100). Stored as a raw business metric from CTMS for site performance dashboards.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS KPI framework

attributes.name: enrollment_variance
attributes.description: The difference between actual enrolled subjects and planned enrolled subjects for the reporting period (actual_enrolled_count - planned_enrolled_count). Negative values indicate under-enrollment; positive values indicate over-enrollment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS KPI framework

attributes.name: gcp_compliance_status
attributes.description: The current GCP compliance status of the site as assessed by the most recent monitoring visit or audit. Drives risk-based monitoring decisions and regulatory escalation. Sourced from the source system monitoring records.

attributes.name: next_monitoring_visit_date
attributes.description: The date of the next scheduled monitoring visit at this site, as planned in the CTMS. Used for CRA workload planning and ensuring monitoring frequency meets the risk-based monitoring plan.

attributes.name: open_query_count

attributes.name: performance_status
attributes.description: Current enrollment performance status of the site for the reporting period, indicating whether the site is meeting, exceeding, or falling short of its planned enrollment targets. Drives CRA escalation and site management actions in the CTMS.

attributes.name: planned_completion_date
attributes.description: The originally planned date by which the site was expected to complete enrollment of its assigned target, as defined in the site enrollment plan or study protocol timeline.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: planned_enrolled_count
attributes.description: The target number of subjects planned to be enrolled (randomized or consented per protocol definition) at this site during the reporting period. Derived from the site-level enrollment plan agreed with the sponsor.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: planned_screened_count
attributes.description: The number of subjects planned to be screened at this site during the reporting period, as defined in the site enrollment plan or feasibility agreement. Baseline for screen failure rate analysis.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: projected_completion_date
attributes.description: The forecasted date by which the site is expected to complete enrollment of its assigned target, based on current enrollment rate. Updated each reporting period in the CTMS for timeline management.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; FDA Guidance on Clinical Trial Conduct

attributes.name: protocol_deviation_count
attributes.description: The number of protocol deviations recorded at this site during the reporting period. Includes both major and minor deviations as classified per the study deviation management plan. Sourced from CTMS deviation tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.5; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: randomized_count
attributes.description: The number of subjects who were randomized (assigned to a treatment arm via RTSM/IVRS) at this site during the reporting period. Distinct from enrolled count in studies where enrollment precedes randomization.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the site agreement is scheduled to expire or cease to be operative. Nullable for open-ended agreements. Triggers renewal workflow alerts in Veeva Vault. Aligns with MASTER_AGREEMENT EFFECTIVE_UNTIL category.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.6; Veeva Vault Contract Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: governing_law_country

attributes.name: last_monitoring_visit_date

attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; Oracle Siebel CTMS; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance

attributes.name: monitoring_approach
attributes.description: Defines the monitoring methodology applied by the CRA for this assignment. 'on_site' = traditional in-person SDV; 'remote' = off-site data review; 'hybrid' = combination; 'centralized' = statistical/data-driven central monitoring per risk-based monitoring
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Risk-Based Monitoring (2013); EMA Reflection Paper on RBM; ICH E6(R2) GCP; TransCelerate RBM Methodology

attributes.name: next_monitoring_visit_date
attributes.description: The date of the next planned monitoring visit (on-site or remote) for this CRA-site assignment as scheduled in the CTMS. Drives visit scheduling workflows and resource planning.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; Oracle Siebel CTMS; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance

attributes.name: open_action_items_count
attributes.description: The current number of unresolved monitoring action items or follow-up items outstanding for this CRA-site assignment. Supports site oversight, escalation management, and GCP compliance tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; Oracle Siebel CTMS; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance

attributes.name: planned_end_date
attributes.description: The originally planned end date for the CRA assignment at the time of creation. Enables comparison against actual end date to track assignment duration variances and resource planning accuracy.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP; TransCelerate Monitoring Methodology

attributes.name: protocol_training_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assigned CRA has completed the required study protocol-specific training prior to initiating monitoring activities at the site. True = training completed; False = pending. Regulatory requirement per GCP.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18.1; MasterControl; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: protocol_training_date
attributes.description: The date on which the CRA completed the study protocol-specific training required for this assignment. Supports audit trail and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18.1; MasterControl; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: risk_tier
attributes.description: The risk classification of the assigned site as assessed under the risk-based monitoring (RBM) framework. Determines monitoring intensity, visit frequency, and SDV scope for this assignment. 'high' = intensive monitoring required.
attributes.references: FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance (2013); EMA Reflection Paper on RBM; ICH E6(R2) GCP; TransCelerate RBM Methodology

attributes.name: sdv_rate_pct
attributes.description: The agreed or actual percentage of critical data fields subject to Source Data Verification (SDV) for this CRA-site assignment, as defined in the monitoring plan. Reflects risk-based monitoring (RBM) strategy. Valid range: 0.00 to 100.00.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18.3; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance; EMA Reflection Paper on RBM; CDISC

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the CRA's monitoring responsibility for the assigned study-site combination becomes effective. Used for coverage planning and workload scheduling.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: The reason for ending or cancelling the CRA assignment before or at its planned conclusion. Populated only when assignment_status is 'completed', 'cancelled', or 'transferred'.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP; SOP for Site Monitoring

attributes.name: territory_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code representing the primary country of the CRA's assigned territory (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU). Supports geographic reporting and regulatory jurisdiction tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; ICH E6(R2) GCP; GDPR; HIPAA

attributes.name: total_visits_completed
attributes.description: The cumulative count of monitoring visits (on-site and remote) completed by this CRA at the assigned site under this assignment. Used for performance tracking and monitoring coverage reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; Oracle Siebel CTMS; TransCelerate RBM Metrics

attributes.name: travel_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether overnight or significant travel is required for the CRA to conduct on-site monitoring visits at this assigned site. True = travel required; False = local or remote only. Used for travel budget planning and CRA logistics.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this CRA assignment record was most recently modified. Supports audit trail requirements per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ Principles; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: visit_frequency_planned
attributes.description: The planned frequency of on-site or remote monitoring visits for this CRA-site assignment as defined in the monitoring plan. Drives visit scheduling and resource forecasting in the CTMS.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: workload_allocation_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of the CRA's total available working capacity allocated to this specific study-site assignment. Used for workload balancing across multiple concurrent assignments. Valid range: 0.00 to 100.00.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18.1; TransCelerate Risk-Based Monitoring

attributes.name: closeout_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the site close-out record. Primary key for the site_closeout data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Good Clinical Practice; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: activation_id

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to site.site_payment. Business justification: Closeout financial reconciliation: site_closeout tracks final_payment_status and final_payment_amount.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: audit_id
