attributes.name: dmp_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to datamanagement.dmp. Business justification: Site closeout requires verification that all DMP-defined data management activities are complete: outstanding queries resolved, SDV percentage met, and DBL criteria satisfied.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: dsmb_recommendation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.dsmb_recommendation. Business justification: When a DSMB issues a stopping or early-termination recommendation, each affected site initiates a closeout directly in response.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: dsmb_review_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.dsmb_review. Business justification: Site closeout records reference the DSMB review meeting whose safety findings (stopping rule triggered, unacceptable risk) drove early termination.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: ind_application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.ind_application. Business justification: Site closeout notifications to FDA must reference the IND number. Final safety reports, study termination letters, and IND annual reports require site-level closeout data linked to
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: initiation_visit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to site.initiation_visit. Business justification: The closeout is the formal bookend to the site initiation visit — together they bracket the active study period at a site.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: investigational_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational site undergoing formal close-out. Identifies the specific study site within the CTMS.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: ip_accountability_log_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to monitoring.ip_accountability_log. Business justification: Site closeout requires confirmed drug accountability as a regulatory prerequisite (ICH E6, 21 CFR Part 312).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: irb_iec_approval_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to site.irb_iec_approval. Business justification: Closeout requires IRB/IEC notification (irb_iec_notification_status, irb_iec_notification_date fields exist).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: lab_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.lab_facility. Business justification: Site closeout requires tracking lab sample return/destruction, final lab report receipt, and lab-specific essential document archival.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: monitoring_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to monitoring.monitoring_visit. Business justification: The closeout visit IS a monitoring_visit (type=closeout). Linking enables CRA management to confirm the closeout visit report is filed, all findings resolved, and final payment
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: monitoring_visit_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to monitoring.monitoring_visit_schedule. Business justification: Site closeout visits are scheduled monitoring visits. Closeout records must link to the monitoring visit schedule entry to track closeout visit planning, execution, and
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: principal_investigator_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to site.principal_investigator. Business justification: The closeout record tracks pi_acknowledgement_date and pi_acknowledgement_received, indicating the PI is a key party in the closeout process.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to site.regulatory_submission_site. Business justification: Closeout involves regulatory authority notifications (regulatory_authority_notification_date, regulatory_authority_notification_status on closeout).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study for which this site close-out is being conducted. Links the close-out record to the parent study entity.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to site.study_site. Business justification: site_closeout records the formal close-out process for a study-site upon completion or early termination. study_site is the parent association entity for the study-site lifecycle.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: visit_report_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to monitoring.visit_report. Business justification: Site closeout completion requires the closeout visit report to be approved and filed in the eTMF.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: capa_reference_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Reference Number
attributes.description: Reference number of the CAPA record in MasterControl, if a CAPA was initiated as a result of close-out findings. Null if no CAPA is required.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); MasterControl CAPA; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

tag_set.value: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Reference Number

attributes.name: capa_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) plan is required at this site based on findings identified during the close-out visit or cumulative monitoring. Triggers CAPA workflow in MasterControl.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; MasterControl CAPA

attributes.name: closeout_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the site close-out process as tracked in the CTMS close-out workflow. Drives downstream regulatory notification and payment release actions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.9; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: closeout_type
attributes.description: Classification of the reason driving the site close-out. Distinguishes between normal study completion, early termination for safety or operational reasons, and sponsor-initiated decisions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: completed_date
attributes.description: Date on which all close-out activities were formally completed and the site was officially closed. Marks the end of the site lifecycle for this study.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.9; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this site close-out record was first created in the CTMS close-out workflow. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+

attributes.name: drug_accountability_completed_date
attributes.description: Date on which investigational medicinal product (IMP) accountability reconciliation was formally completed and signed off at the site.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.6; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: drug_accountability_status
attributes.description: Current status of investigational medicinal product (IMP) accountability reconciliation at the site. Confirms that all dispensed, returned, and destroyed drug quantities are fully accounted for per GCP requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.6; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; EMA EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: early_termination_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for early termination of the site, if applicable. Populated only when closeout_type is 'early_termination'. Supports regulatory reporting and sponsor decision documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: essential_doc_archival_date
attributes.description: Date on which all essential documents were confirmed as archived at the investigational site, satisfying ICH E6(R2) Section 8 requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 8; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: essential_doc_archival_status
attributes.description: Status of archival of all essential documents required by ICH E6(R2) Section 8 at the investigational site. Confirms that the site's Trial Master File (TMF) is complete and archived per regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 8; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: final_payment_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the final payment disbursed to the investigational site at close-out, denominated in the contract currency. Represents the net amount after reconciliation of all advances and prior payments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: final_payment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the final payment to the investigational site was processed and confirmed, closing all financial obligations under the site budget agreement.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: final_payment_status
attributes.description: Status of the final financial payment to the investigational site upon close-out, covering all outstanding per-subject fees, procedure fees, and close-out visit fees per the site budget agreement.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); SAP S/4HANA Finance; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: gcp_compliance_status
attributes.description: Overall GCP compliance assessment for the site at close-out, based on findings from the close-out visit and cumulative monitoring history. Informs the site's eligibility for future studies.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; ISO 14155

attributes.name: imp_return_date
attributes.description: Date on which unused investigational medicinal product (IMP) was returned to the sponsor/depot or destroyed on-site per the drug destruction protocol.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.6; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: imp_return_status
attributes.description: Status of the return or on-site destruction of unused investigational medicinal product (IMP) at the site. Distinct from drug accountability reconciliation — this tracks the physical disposition of remaining IMP stock.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.6; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; EMA EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: initiated_date
attributes.description: Date on which the formal site close-out process was officially initiated in the CTMS, typically following LSLV confirmation and sponsor authorization.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: irb_iec_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) was formally notified of study completion or early termination at this site.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3.3; FDA 21 CFR Part 56; OHRP

attributes.name: irb_iec_notification_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Notification Status
attributes.description: Status of the formal notification to the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) regarding study completion or early termination at this site, as required by GCP and applicable regulations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3.3; FDA 21 CFR Part 56; OHRP; EMA EU CTR 536/2014

tag_set.value: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Notification Status

attributes.name: lslv_date
attributes.description: Date of the last protocol-required visit for the last subject enrolled at this site. LSLV is a critical clinical milestone that triggers the initiation of the close-out process and database lock activities.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC SDTM; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for CRA or study manager notes regarding the close-out process, including any outstanding issues, special circumstances, or follow-up actions required after the close-out visit.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this close-out event, typically generated by the CTMS close-out workflow (e.g., CO-2024-0042). Used for cross-system referencing and regulatory correspondence.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: outstanding_queries_count
attributes.description: Number of unresolved data queries (discrepancies) remaining in the EDC system at the time of close-out visit. A non-zero value indicates data cleaning is incomplete and may delay database lock contribution.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM; ICH E6(R2); Medidata Rave EDC; ALCOA+

attributes.name: payment_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the final site payment (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Ensures consistent financial reporting across multi-currency global trials.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: pi_acknowledgement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Principal Investigator (PI) formally acknowledged the close-out letter and confirmed all site obligations were fulfilled.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.9; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: pi_acknowledgement_received
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Principal Investigator (PI) has formally acknowledged receipt of the close-out letter and confirmed completion of all close-out obligations, as required by ICH E6(R2).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.9; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: protocol_deviations_count
attributes.description: Total number of protocol deviations recorded at this site during the study. Summarized at close-out for site performance assessment and inclusion in the Clinical Study Report (CSR).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: regulatory_authority_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the applicable regulatory authority was formally notified of the site close-out.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; MHRA

attributes.name: regulatory_authority_notification_status
attributes.description: Status of notification to applicable regulatory authorities (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA) regarding site close-out, as required under applicable IND/CTA regulations.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; MHRA; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: sdv_completion_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of critical and non-critical data fields that have been source data verified (SDV) at the site as of the close-out visit. Reflects data quality and monitoring completeness per the monitoring plan.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; ALCOA+

attributes.name: site_file_transfer_date
attributes.description: Date on which the site's investigator file and essential documents were successfully transferred to the sponsor or CRO central archive.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 8; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: site_file_transfer_status
attributes.description: Status of the transfer of the site's investigator file and essential documents to the sponsor or CRO archive. Applicable when physical or electronic records must be transferred from the site to a central repository.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 8; Veeva Vault eTMF; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: subjects_completed_count
attributes.description: Number of subjects who completed all protocol-required visits and procedures at this site. Used to calculate site completion rate and assess protocol adherence.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC SDTM; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: subjects_discontinued_count
attributes.description: Number of subjects who discontinued from the study prior to completing all protocol-required activities at this site. Includes withdrawals, screen failures post-enrollment, and protocol deviations leading to discontinuation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC SDTM; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: subjects_enrolled_count
attributes.description: Total number of subjects who were enrolled (consented and randomized or assigned to treatment) at this site during the study. Used for final enrollment reconciliation at close-out.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC SDTM; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this site close-out record in the CTMS. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+

attributes.name: visit_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Clinical Research Associate (CRA) conducted the formal close-out monitoring visit at the investigational site. This is the principal real-world event date for the close-out transaction.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18; Oracle Siebel CTMS

domains.references: ICH GCP E6(R3); CDISC SDTM DM Domain; GDPR; HIPAA

products.name: trial_subject

attributes.name: trial_subject_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a trial subject record in the lakehouse Silver layer. Primary key for the trial_subject entity. All subject-level transactional records in the subject domain reference this identifier.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 — USUBJID domain conventions; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: arm_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.study_arm. Business justification: SDTM ACTARM/ARM derivation and enrollment-by-arm reporting require linking each subject to their assigned study_arm.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: clinical_trial_authorization_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.clinical_trial_authorization. Business justification: Regulatory compliance requires every enrolled subject to be traceable to the active CTA for their country.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: protocol_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.protocol. Business justification: SDTM DM domain and regulatory submissions require direct protocol traceability on the master subject record.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study in which this subject is enrolled or screened. Links the subject to the parent study master record.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM domain — STUDYID; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational site at which this subject was screened or enrolled. Supports site-level enrollment analytics and monitoring.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM domain — SITEID; ICH E6(R2) GCP §4

attributes.name: age_at_enrollment
attributes.description: Subject's age in years at the time of enrollment or first dose, calculated from date of birth and enrollment date. Used for eligibility verification, demographic reporting, and subgroup analyses.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM — AGE; ICH E6(R2); FDA Demographic Subgroup Analyses Guidance

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subject completed all required study procedures per protocol, including end-of-study visit. Used for subject disposition reporting, CSR preparation, and database lock readiness assessment.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DS domain — DSDTC (completion); ICH E3 CSR Structure; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the investigational site where the subject is enrolled. Used for geographic stratification, regulatory jurisdiction determination, and multi-regional trial reporting. Corresponds to CDISC SDTM DM COUNTRY variable.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM — COUNTRY; ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; ICH E6(R2); EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the trial subject record was first created in the lakehouse Silver layer. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking. Stored in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).
attributes.references: ALCOA+ Principles; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) §5.18.4; GDPR Article 5(1)(f)

attributes.name: data_lock_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject's data has been locked as part of the Database Lock (DBL) process, preventing further modifications to the subject's eCRF data. True = subject data locked; False = data still open for entry or query resolution.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) §5.18; FDA Guidance on Electronic Source Data; CDISC DMP; Medidata Rave EDC lock functionality; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: Subject's date of birth used to calculate age at screening, enrollment, and key study milestones. Classified as restricted PHI/PII. Stored in yyyy-MM-dd format.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM — BRTHDTC; HIPAA Safe Harbor De-identification; GDPR Article 9; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject met all inclusion and exclusion criteria as assessed during screening. True = all eligibility criteria confirmed met; False = one or more criteria not met. Sourced from the source system eligibility assessment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §4.3; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; Oracle Clinical One eligibility module; CDISC SDTM IE domain

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subject was formally enrolled in the study following confirmation of eligibility criteria. Distinct from screening date and randomization date. Used for enrollment tracking, site performance KPIs, and study timeline reporting.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM; ICH E6(R2) §4.3; Oracle Siebel CTMS enrollment milestone tracking

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the subject within the study, reflecting their progression from screening through completion or withdrawal. Drives subject disposition reporting and ITT/PP population flags.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DS domain — DSDECOD; ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Clinical Trial Endpoints

attributes.name: ethnicity
attributes.description: Subject's self-reported ethnic origin as collected at screening, coded per CDISC SDTM controlled terminology. Distinct from race per FDA demographic reporting requirements. Used in regulatory demographic summary tables.
attributes.value_regex: HISPANIC OR LATINO|NOT HISPANIC OR LATINO|NOT REPORTED|UNKNOWN
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM — ETHNIC; FDA Guidance on Collection of Race and Ethnicity Data; CDISC Controlled Terminology; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: deviation_category
attributes.description: Classification of the deviation by severity and impact. 'Major' deviations significantly affect subject safety or data integrity; 'important' deviations may affect subject rights or study data; 'minor' deviations have minimal impact.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5; FDA Guidance on Protocol Deviations

attributes.name: closed_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the deviation record was formally closed in the quality management system. Provides higher precision than resolution_date for audit and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); MasterControl

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, clarifications, or contextual notes related to the deviation that do not fit into structured fields. May include reviewer notes, sponsor feedback, or monitoring observations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Oracle Siebel CTMS; MasterControl

attributes.name: corrective_action_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the immediate corrective action taken to address the deviation and prevent recurrence at the subject or site level. Distinct from the formal CAPA process which is tracked separately in MasterControl.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.20; MasterControl; FDA CAPA Guidance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this deviation record was first created in the source system. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking per 21 CFR Part 11 and ICH E6(R2).
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: data_integrity_impact
attributes.description: Assessment of whether the deviation compromised the integrity of study data collected from the subject. Informs decisions on data exclusion, sensitivity analyses, and per-protocol (PP) population definitions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ Principles; FDA Data Integrity Guidance; CDISC

attributes.name: deviation_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the specific deviation that occurred, including what protocol requirement was not met, the circumstances, and any relevant context.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5; GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: deviation_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique identifier for the deviation record as assigned by the Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS) or MasterControl. Used for cross-system referencing, regulatory submissions, and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5; Oracle Siebel CTMS; MasterControl

attributes.name: deviation_status
attributes.description: Current workflow lifecycle state of the deviation record. Tracks progression from initial identification through review, resolution, and closure. Drives operational dashboards and compliance monitoring in the source system and MasterControl.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); MasterControl; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: identified_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the deviation was first identified or discovered, which may differ from the occurrence date. Used to calculate detection lag and assess monitoring effectiveness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18; FDA Guidance on Protocol Deviations; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: irb_iec_reportable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Reportability Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this deviation must be reported to the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) overseeing the study. Separate from regulatory authority reportability. True = must report to IRB/IEC.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3.3; 21 CFR Part 56; EU CTR 536/2014; OHRP

tag_set.value: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Reportability Flag

attributes.name: occurrence_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the protocol deviation actually occurred. This is the principal real-world event date, distinct from the date the deviation was identified or reported. Critical for ALCOA+ compliance and regulatory timelines.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ Principles; CDISC SDTM DV Domain DVSTDTC

attributes.name: pi_aware_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Principal Investigator (PI) was informed of the deviation. Used to track compliance with site notification requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.1; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: pi_aware_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Principal Investigator (PI) at the site has been made aware of this deviation. True = PI has been informed. Required for GCP compliance as the PI bears ultimate responsibility for conduct of the trial at the site.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.1; FDA GCP Guidance

attributes.name: protocol_section_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the specific section, clause, or requirement number within the approved study protocol that was deviated from (e.g., 'Section 6.3.2 - Inclusion Criteria'). Enables precise traceability to the protocol document.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6; FDA Protocol Deviation Guidance; CDISC SDTM DV Domain

attributes.name: regulatory_reportable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this deviation must be reported to a regulatory authority (FDA, EMA, PMDA, etc.), IRB/IEC, or sponsor per applicable regulations and the study protocol. True = reportable; False = not reportable. Drives regulatory submission workflows.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5.2; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014; EMA GCP Guidelines

attributes.name: reported_date
attributes.description: The date on which the deviation was formally reported to the sponsor, IRB/IEC, or regulatory authority as applicable. Used to track compliance with reporting timelines mandated by GCP and applicable regulations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5.2; 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the deviation was formally resolved and closed in the quality management system. Used to calculate time-to-resolution metrics and assess site responsiveness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); MasterControl; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: root_cause
attributes.description: Narrative description of the underlying root cause of the deviation as determined through investigation. Used to inform corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) and systemic quality improvement. Captured in MasterControl.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.20; MasterControl; FDA CAPA Guidance

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the root cause to enable trending and systemic analysis across deviations. Categories align with standard quality management frameworks used in MasterControl.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); MasterControl; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: sdtm_domain
attributes.description: The CDISC SDTM domain to which this deviation maps for regulatory submission. Protocol deviations are mapped to the DV (Protocol Deviations) domain per CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; FDA eCTD Submission Standards; EMA Data Standards

attributes.name: source_system_record_reference
attributes.description: The native record identifier from the originating source system (the source system or MasterControl). Enables bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse Silver Layer and the operational system of record.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ Principles; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: sponsor_notified_date
attributes.description: The date on which the sponsor was formally notified of the deviation. Used to verify compliance with contractual and regulatory notification timelines.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18.4; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: sponsor_notified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the study sponsor has been formally notified of this deviation. True = sponsor has been notified. Required per GCP obligations for sponsor oversight of investigational sites.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18.4; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: subject_continuation_decision
attributes.description: Decision regarding the subject's continued participation in the study following the deviation. Informs subject disposition tracking and intent-to-treat (ITT) and per-protocol (PP) population assignments.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.3; ICH E9 Statistical Principles; CDISC SDTM DS Domain

attributes.name: subject_rights_impact
attributes.description: Assessment of whether the deviation affected the rights or well-being of the trial subject, including informed consent procedures, privacy protections, or voluntary participation rights.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 2; Declaration of Helsinki; OHRP; GDPR; HIPAA

attributes.name: subject_safety_impact
attributes.description: Assessment of whether the deviation had an impact on subject safety. 'None' indicates no safety impact; 'potential' indicates possible but unconfirmed impact; 'confirmed' indicates a verified safety impact.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5; FDA Safety Reporting Guidance; EMA GCP Guidelines

attributes.name: type_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the specific type of protocol deviation (e.g., eligibility criteria violation, missed visit, incorrect dosing, prohibited medication use, consent procedure deviation).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); MasterControl; CDISC SDTM DV Domain DVCAT/DVTERM

attributes.name: type_description
attributes.description: Human-readable label corresponding to the deviation_type_code, providing a plain-language description of the deviation type for reporting and review purposes.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC SDTM DV Domain DVTERM

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this deviation record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail compliance, and incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ Principles

products.name: disposition
products.description: Transactional record capturing each formal disposition milestone of a subject through the study lifecycle (screened, enrolled, randomized, completed, discontinued, withdrawn, lost to follow-up, death).
products.reference: CDISC SDTM DS (Disposition) domain; ICH E3 Section 10.1

attributes.name: disposition_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each subject disposition milestone record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for the disposition data product. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — captures a discrete formal disposition event in the subject study
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DS Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: adverse_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.adverse_event. Business justification: Disposition records AE-driven discontinuations (ae_related_discontinuation flag). SDTM DS domain mapping (DSDECOD='ADVERSE EVENT') and regulatory narratives require identifying the
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: analysis_population_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to biostatistics.analysis_population. Business justification: Disposition events (completion, withdrawal, death) directly determine final analysis population membership flags (ITT, PP, Safety).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: arm_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.study_arm. Business justification: Disposition records capture the arm a subject was in at discontinuation or completion. FK to study_arm enables arm-level completion/discontinuation analysis for CSR disposition tables and
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: codelist_id
attributes.description: Standardized disposition event, governed by CDISC CT codelist DSDECOD.

attributes.name: database_lock_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to biostatistics.database_lock_event. Business justification: Disposition records must be locked for final analysis and regulatory submission.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: deviation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to subject.subject_deviation. Business justification: A subject's disposition (e.g., early termination, withdrawal) can be directly caused by a protocol deviation.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: ecrf_form_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to datamanagement.ecrf_form. Business justification: Disposition data is captured on the DS eCRF form; CRAs must reference the specific form version during SDV and SDTM DS domain generation.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: enrollment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to subject.enrollment. Business justification: A disposition milestone (completion, withdrawal, screen failure) is a formal event within a specific enrollment.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: protocol_deviation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the protocol deviation record that directly caused or is associated with the subject's discontinuation. Populated when the coded reason is PROTOCOL DEVIATION. Links disposition to the compliance domain.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM DV Domain; FDA Guidance on Protocol Deviations

attributes.name: randomization_assignment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to subject.randomization_assignment. Business justification: Disposition records for randomized subjects should reference the specific randomization assignment that was active at the time of disposition.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: serious_adverse_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.serious_adverse_event. Business justification: SAEs are primary driver of early termination dispositions. Regulatory CSRs per ICH E3 require direct SAE→disposition linkage for CONSORT flow diagrams and safety-driven
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study (protocol) under which this disposition event occurred. Links the disposition record to the parent study master.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DS Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational site at which the subject's disposition event was recorded. Used for site-level CONSORT flow and enrollment reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM DS Domain

attributes.name: subject_randomization_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to randomization.subject_randomization. Business justification: SDTM DS domain and CONSORT flow reporting require disposition records to be traceable to the specific IRT randomization event.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: submission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.submission. Business justification: SDTM DS (disposition) domain records are included in regulatory submissions. Linking disposition records to the submission supports SDTM submission traceability, enabling sponsors to
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: susar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.susar. Business justification: SUSARs trigger immediate disposition decisions (temporary/permanent discontinuation). Regulatory authorities require SUSAR→disposition traceability in safety narratives and DSUR per ICH E2F for
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: tmf_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: Subject disposition events (withdrawal, early termination, completion) generate essential TMF documents (withdrawal forms, end-of-study certificates).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: trial_subject_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trial participant (subject/patient) whose formal disposition milestone is being recorded. Core PARTY_REFERENCE for this transaction. Sourced from Medidata Rave EDC subject master.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DS Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: unblinding_request_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to randomization.unblinding_request. Business justification: Subject discontinuation due to SAE or emergency medical need often triggers or results from an unblinding event.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: visit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to subject.subject_visit. Business justification: A formal disposition milestone (completion, withdrawal, death, screen failure) is recorded at a specific clinical visit.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: withdrawal_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to consent.consent_withdrawal. Business justification: SDTM DS domain reconciliation requires linking subject disposition (withdrawal/discontinuation) to the formal consent_withdrawal record.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: ae_related_discontinuation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject's discontinuation was due to an adverse event (AE) or serious adverse event (SAE). When True, links to the safety domain for AE-driven disposition analysis and regulatory safety reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM AE/DS Domains; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32

attributes.name: analysis_population_itt
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject is included in the Intent-to-Treat (ITT) analysis population based on disposition and protocol criteria. Drives primary efficacy analysis dataset inclusion.
attributes.references: ICH E9; CDISC ADaM ADSL; FDA Guidance on ITT Principle; SAP

attributes.name: analysis_population_pp
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject is included in the Per Protocol (PP) analysis population. Subjects with major protocol deviations affecting efficacy assessment are typically excluded. Determined by biostatistics per the the source system.
attributes.references: ICH E9; CDISC ADaM ADSL; FDA Guidance on PP Analysis; SAP

attributes.name: analysis_population_safety
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject is included in the Safety analysis population (subjects who received at least one dose of investigational product). Drives safety tabulations in the CSR and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: ICH E9; CDISC ADaM ADSL; FDA/EMA Safety Reporting Requirements; SAP

attributes.name: data_entry_timestamp
attributes.description: RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED — timestamp when the disposition record was first entered into the EDC system (Medidata Rave). Supports ALCOA+ contemporaneous data entry requirements and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: death_cause
attributes.description: Verbatim or coded cause of death for subjects with DEATH disposition. Used in safety narratives, CSR, and regulatory submissions. Coded against MedDRA when applicable.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; CDISC SDTM DS Domain; MedDRA; FDA/EMA Safety Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: death_date
attributes.description: Date of subject death when the disposition term is DEATH. Required for survival analysis, time-to-event endpoints, and expedited safety reporting. Sourced from Medidata Rave EDC death records and the source system
attributes.references: ICH E2A; ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM DS/AE Domains; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: disposition_date
attributes.description: BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP (date precision) — the calendar date on which the formal disposition milestone occurred for the subject (e.g., date of randomization, date of last study visit, date of withdrawal).
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DS Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: disposition_status
attributes.description: LIFECYCLE_STATUS of this disposition record within the EDC/data management workflow. Indicates whether the record is the current active disposition, has been superseded by a correction, is pending data review, or has been cancelled.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: ds_seq
attributes.description: Sequential number identifying the order of disposition records for a given subject within the study, corresponding to the SDTM DSSEQ variable. Supports multiple disposition milestones per subject (e.g., enrolled then discontinued).
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DS Domain v3.3; FDA SDTM Implementation Guide

attributes.name: early_termination_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject terminated study participation before completing all protocol-required activities. Distinct from study_completion_flag in that it specifically flags premature exit for operational tracking and site performance metrics.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ICH E3 CSR Guidelines; CDISC SDTM DS Domain

attributes.name: event
attributes.description: The event of the disposition.

attributes.name: last_contact_date
attributes.description: Date of the subject's last known contact with the study team, including phone calls, remote visits, or any study-related communication. Used for lost-to-follow-up determination and survival analysis censoring.
attributes.references: ICH E3 CSR Guidelines; CDISC SDTM DS Domain; FDA Guidance on Missing Data in Clinical Trials

attributes.name: last_dose_date
attributes.description: Date of the subject's last administration of investigational product (IP) prior to or at the disposition milestone. Critical for calculating treatment duration, exposure windows, and safety follow-up periods. Sourced from Medidata Rave EDC dosing records.
attributes.references: ICH E3 CSR Guidelines; CDISC SDTM EX Domain; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; GCP ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED — timestamp of the most recent modification to this disposition record in the EDC system. Supports audit trail requirements and data change tracking per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: last_visit_date
attributes.description: Date of the subject's last scheduled or unscheduled study visit prior to or at the disposition milestone. Used to determine last study contact and assess visit compliance. Sourced from Medidata Rave EDC visit records.
attributes.references: ICH E3 CSR Guidelines; CDISC SDTM SV Domain; GCP ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: meddra_pt
attributes.description: MedDRA Preferred Term (PT) assigned to the coded discontinuation reason. Enables standardized cross-study analysis and regulatory reporting of disposition reasons. Populated by the medical coding process.
attributes.references: MedDRA; CDISC SDTM DS Domain; ICH M1; FDA/EMA Coding Requirements

attributes.name: meddra_soc
attributes.description: MedDRA System Organ Class (SOC) associated with the coded discontinuation reason Preferred Term. Supports regulatory tabulation and signal detection for disposition-related safety analysis.
attributes.references: MedDRA; CDISC SDTM DS Domain; ICH M1; FDA/EMA Coding Requirements

attributes.name: meddra_version
attributes.description: Version of the MedDRA dictionary used for coding the disposition reason (e.g., 26.0, 26.1). Required for regulatory submission traceability and reproducibility of coded terms.
attributes.references: MedDRA; ICH M1; CDISC SDTM DS Domain; FDA/EMA Submission Requirements

attributes.name: milestone_category
attributes.description: High-level category classifying the type of disposition milestone. Used to group disposition events for CONSORT flow diagram construction and CSR disposition tables. Aligns with SDTM DSCAT variable.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DS Domain; ICH E3 CSR Guidelines; CONSORT 2010 Statement

attributes.name: milestone_subcategory
attributes.description: Sponsor-defined subcategory further classifying the disposition milestone within its category (e.g., PROTOCOL DEVIATION, ADVERSE EVENT, SPONSOR DECISION under DISCONTINUATION). Corresponds to SDTM DSSCAT variable.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DS Domain; ICH E3 CSR Guidelines

attributes.name: query_open_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether there is at least one open data discrepancy query against this disposition record in the EDC system. Supports data management oversight and database lock (DBL) readiness tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11; Medidata Rave EDC

attributes.name: safety_followup_end_date
attributes.description: Planned or actual end date of the post-discontinuation safety follow-up period. Populated when safety_followup_required is True. Used to track completion of safety obligations for discontinued subjects.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; Protocol Safety Requirements

attributes.name: safety_followup_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject requires a post-discontinuation safety follow-up period per protocol requirements. True when the subject discontinued early and protocol mandates continued safety monitoring. Drives safety follow-up visit scheduling.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; Protocol Safety Requirements

attributes.name: screen_failure_reason
attributes.description: Reason why a screened subject failed to meet eligibility criteria and was not enrolled. Populated only for SCREEN FAILURE disposition. Used for site feasibility analysis and protocol amendment decisions.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DS Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Guidance on Eligibility Criteria

attributes.name: sdtm_ds_record_reference
attributes.description: Unique record identifier from the CDISC SDTM DS (Disposition) domain dataset, enabling traceability between the Silver Layer lakehouse record and the regulatory submission dataset. Supports eCTD submission package linkage.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DS Domain v3.3; FDA SDTM Implementation Guide; eCTD Submission Requirements

attributes.name: sdv_status
attributes.description: Status of source data verification (SDV) for this disposition record, indicating whether the CRA has verified the data against source documents. Sourced from the source system monitoring records. Supports GCP compliance and monitoring oversight.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Guidance on Risk-Based Monitoring; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: study_completion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject completed the study per protocol (True) or did not complete (False). Drives CONSORT flow diagram completion counts and CSR disposition summary tables.
attributes.references: CONSORT 2010 Statement; ICH E3 CSR Guidelines; CDISC SDTM DS Domain

attributes.name: subject_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned to the subject at the site (e.g., 001-001). Corresponds to SDTM USUBJID or site-assigned subject number. BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this transaction. Sourced from Medidata Rave EDC.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG; ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR Article 4; HIPAA §164.514

attributes.name: term
attributes.description: Standardized disposition term describing the subject's formal study milestone (e.g., COMPLETED, SCREEN FAILURE, DISCONTINUED, WITHDRAWN BY SUBJECT, LOST TO FOLLOW-UP, DEATH). Corresponds to SDTM DSTERM.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DS Domain; MedDRA; ICH E3 CSR Guidelines

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Full ISO 8601 timestamp of the disposition event when time-of-day precision is available. Supplements disposition_date for events requiring precise timing (e.g., time of death, time of last dose). Corresponds to SDTM DSSTDTC full datetime.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DS Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: verbatim_reason
attributes.description: Free-text verbatim reason for discontinuation or withdrawal as entered by the investigator or site staff in the eCRF. Captured prior to coding. Supports ALCOA+ attributability and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DS Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: verbatim_term
attributes.description: STRING

products.name: eligibility_assessment
products.description: Transactional record of the inclusion/exclusion criteria assessment performed for a subject during screening. Captures each criterion code, criterion text, assessment result (met/not met/not assessed), assessment date, assessor identity, and overall
products.reference: CDISC SDTM IE (Inclusion/Exclusion Criteria Not Met) domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP 4.3

attributes.name: eligibility_assessment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each eligibility assessment record in the Silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for this data product.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: consent_subject_consent_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to consent.subject_consent. Business justification: GCP requires consent to precede eligibility assessment. While icf_version_id already links to consent_icf_version, linking to subject_consent confirms the actual signed consent record
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: deviation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the protocol deviation record created when a subject was enrolled despite failing this eligibility criterion. Populated only when protocol_deviation_flag is True.

attributes.name: document_sop_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document_sop. Business justification: Eligibility assessments must be conducted per a specific SOP governing screening and inclusion/exclusion criteria evaluation.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: ecrf_form_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to datamanagement.ecrf_form. Business justification: Inclusion/exclusion criteria are captured on the IE eCRF form. Linking eligibility_assessment to ecrf_form normalizes the denormalized edc_form_name, supports SDV of eligibility
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: eligibility_criterion_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.eligibility_criterion. Business justification: Each eligibility assessment row evaluates one protocol-defined criterion. FK to eligibility_criterion enables SDTM IE domain derivation, criterion-level screen failure rate
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: enrollment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to subject.enrollment. Business justification: Eligibility assessments (inclusion/exclusion criteria checks) are performed as part of the screening phase of a specific enrollment.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: ethics_approval_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.ethics_approval. Business justification: Eligibility criteria assessments must be conducted under the protocol version authorized by a valid ethics approval.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: icf_version_id
attributes.description: Reference to the version of the Informed Consent Form (ICF) that was in effect at the time of this eligibility assessment. Ensures the subject consented under the correct protocol version before assessment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; FDA 21 CFR 50; OHRP 45 CFR 46; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: lab_result_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.lab_result. Business justification: Eligibility criteria are frequently lab-based (eGFR, HbA1c, platelet count). The eligibility_assessment must reference the specific lab_result that drove the pass/fail decision to
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: rand_scheme_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to randomization.rand_scheme. Business justification: Eligibility assessments are performed against criteria defined for a specific randomization scheme version.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study for which this eligibility assessment was performed. Links the assessment to the governing protocol.

attributes.name: consent_status

attributes.name: icf_date

attributes.name: icf_signed

attributes.name: reconsent_flag

attributes.name: blinding_status

attributes.name: causality_assessment

attributes.name: ctcae_grade
attributes.business_glossary_term: Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE) Severity Grade
attributes.description: The CTCAE severity grade assigned to the SAE, ranging from 1 (mild) to 5 (death). Grade 3 = severe, Grade 4 = life-threatening, Grade 5 = death. Used for oncology and other therapeutic area safety assessments.
attributes.references: NCI CTCAE v5.0; CDISC SDTM AE.AETOXGR; FDA Guidance on Adverse Event Reporting

tag_set.value: Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE) Severity Grade

attributes.name: dsmb_reported
attributes.business_glossary_term: Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) Reported Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SAE was reported to the Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) or Data Monitoring Committee (DMC) for independent safety review. Required for studies with an active DSMB/DMC charter.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on Data Monitoring Committees (2006); EMA Reflection Paper on DMCs

tag_set.value: Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) Reported Flag

attributes.name: expectedness
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SAE is expected (listed in the Investigator's Brochure or product labeling) or unexpected (not listed or differing in nature/severity). Unexpected + serious + related = SUSAR, triggering expedited regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 3; 21 CFR Part 312.32(a); EMA GVP Module VI; Oracle Argus Safety

attributes.name: follow_up_number
attributes.description: Sequential number indicating which follow-up report this record represents (0 = initial report, 1 = first follow-up, 2 = second follow-up, etc.). Used to track the evolution of the SAE case over time as new information becomes available.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; ICH E2B(R3); Oracle Argus Safety; 21 CFR Part 312.32

attributes.name: initial_report_date
attributes.description: The date on which the SAE was first reported to the sponsor or CRO by the investigational site. This is Day 0 for calculating regulatory reporting timelines (e.g., 7-day or 15-day expedited reporting clock).
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 5; 21 CFR Part 312.32(c); EMA GVP Module VI; Oracle Argus Safety

attributes.name: irb_iec_notification_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Notification Date
attributes.description: The date on which the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) was notified of the SAE. Required under GCP and local regulations to ensure ongoing ethical oversight of the study.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3.3; 21 CFR Part 312.66; EU CTR 536/2014; OHRP 45 CFR Part 46

tag_set.value: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Notification Date

attributes.name: is_susar
attributes.business_glossary_term: Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reaction (SUSAR) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SAE has been classified as a Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reaction (SUSAR), requiring expedited regulatory reporting to health authorities (e.g., FDA 7/15-day reporting, EMA reporting).
attributes.references: ICH E2A; 21 CFR Part 312.32(c); EU CTR 536/2014 Article 42; EMA GVP Module VI

tag_set.value: Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reaction (SUSAR) Flag

attributes.name: narrative
attributes.description: The full medical narrative describing the SAE, including clinical course, relevant medical history, concomitant medications, investigational product details, and the investigator's assessment.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 6; ICH E2B(R3); 21 CFR Part 312.32; Oracle Argus Safety

attributes.name: onset_date
attributes.description: The date on which the serious adverse event first began or was first observed by the subject or investigator. This is the principal BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP (date precision) for the SAE transaction.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 3; CDISC SDTM AE.AESTDTC; 21 CFR Part 312.32

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: The clinical outcome of the serious adverse event at the time of the most recent report. 'recovered_with_sequelae' indicates the subject recovered but with lasting effects. 'fatal' must align with seriousness_death = true.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; ICH E2B(R3) Element C.1.7; CDISC SDTM AE.AEOUT; Oracle Argus Safety

attributes.name: regulatory_report_due_date
attributes.description: The calculated deadline by which the expedited regulatory report (e.g., IND Safety Report, SUSAR notification) must be submitted to the relevant health authority.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 5; 21 CFR Part 312.32(c); EU CTR 536/2014 Article 42; EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: Classifies the type of safety report generated for this SAE. 'expedited' = 7/15-day SUSAR or IND safety report; 'periodic' = included in DSUR/PSUR; 'spontaneous' = post-marketing spontaneous report; 'literature' = identified from published literature.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; ICH E2C(R2) DSUR; EMA GVP Module VI; 21 CFR Part 312.32

attributes.name: reporting_authority
attributes.description: The health authority or regulatory body to which the SAE/SUSAR report was submitted (e.g., 'FDA', 'EMA', 'MHRA', 'PMDA', 'TGA', 'Health Canada'). May contain multiple authorities if reported to more than one.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; 21 CFR Part 312.32; EU CTR 536/2014; EMA GVP Module VI; MHRA; PMDA

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the serious adverse event resolved, stabilized, or the subject died. Null if the event is ongoing at the time of reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; CDISC SDTM AE.AEENDTC; Oracle Argus Safety

attributes.name: sae_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the SAE case in the source system 'initial' = first report received; 'follow_up' = additional information received; 'closed' = case fully resolved and closed; 'nullified' = case determined not to meet SAE criteria and voided.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; Oracle Argus Safety; 21 CFR Part 312.32

attributes.name: sae_term
attributes.description: The verbatim (as-reported) description of the serious adverse event as recorded by the investigator or site staff in the source document or eCRF. This is the raw, uncoded term prior to MedDRA coding.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; CDISC SDTM AE.AETERM; Oracle Argus Safety; 21 CFR Part 312.32

attributes.name: seriousness_congenital_anomaly
attributes.business_glossary_term: Seriousness Criterion: Congenital Anomaly or Birth Defect
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SAE meets the regulatory seriousness criterion of resulting in a congenital anomaly or birth defect in the offspring of the subject.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 2; 21 CFR Part 312.32(a); EMA GVP Module VI

tag_set.value: Seriousness Criterion: Congenital Anomaly or Birth Defect

attributes.name: seriousness_death
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SAE meets the regulatory seriousness criterion of resulting in death of the subject. One of the six ICH E2A seriousness criteria that must be captured individually.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 2; 21 CFR Part 312.32(a); EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: seriousness_disability
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SAE meets the regulatory seriousness criterion of resulting in persistent or significant disability or incapacity.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 2; 21 CFR Part 312.32(a); EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: seriousness_hospitalization
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SAE meets the regulatory seriousness criterion of requiring inpatient hospitalization or prolongation of existing hospitalization.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 2; 21 CFR Part 312.32(a); EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: seriousness_life_threatening
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SAE meets the regulatory seriousness criterion of being immediately life-threatening (i.e., the subject was at immediate risk of death at the time of the event).
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 2; 21 CFR Part 312.32(a); EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: seriousness_medically_important
attributes.business_glossary_term: Seriousness Criterion: Other Medically Important Condition
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SAE meets the regulatory seriousness criterion of being an other medically important condition — events that may not be immediately life-threatening but may jeopardize the subject or require intervention to prevent one of the other
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 2; 21 CFR Part 312.32(a); EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.description: The protocol-assigned subject identifier (e.g., site-subject number) for the patient who experienced the SAE. Restricted as it can be used to identify an individual participant in combination with study data.

attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; GDPR Article 4; HIPAA

attributes.name: acknowledgement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the regulatory agency formally acknowledged receipt of the ICSR submission. For electronic submissions via EudraVigilance or FDA gateway, this is the date of the automated acknowledgement message (ACK).
attributes.references: ICH E2B(R3); EMA EudraVigilance; FDA ESG (Electronic Submissions Gateway)

attributes.name: acknowledgement_number
attributes.description: The unique reference number or message ID returned by the regulatory agency in the acknowledgement (ACK) message confirming receipt of the ICSR. Used for reconciliation and proof of submission.
attributes.references: ICH E2B(R3); EMA EudraVigilance ACK; FDA ESG

attributes.name: applicable_deadline_date
attributes.description: The operative regulatory deadline date for this specific ICSR, reflecting the applicable reporting window (7-day or 15-day) based on the seriousness criteria and expectedness of the adverse event. Used for compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA EudraVigilance

attributes.name: argus_case_number
attributes.description: The unique case identifier assigned by the source system to the source safety case from which this ICSR was generated. Used for traceability back to the system of record.
attributes.references: Oracle Argus Safety case submission module; ICH E2B(R3)

attributes.name: awareness_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Clock Start Date (Date of First Awareness)
attributes.description: The date on which the sponsor or CRO first became aware of the adverse event that triggered this ICSR. This is the regulatory clock start date (Day 0) from which all expedited reporting deadlines (7-day and 15-day) are calculated per ICH E2A.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 3; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32(c); EMA EudraVigilance

tag_set.value: Clock Start Date (Date of First Awareness)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this ICSR record was first created in the source system and ingested into the Databricks Silver Layer. Supports audit trail and ALCOA+ data integrity requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8

attributes.name: deadline_15day_date
attributes.description: The calculated calendar date by which a serious unexpected adverse reaction (non-fatal/non-life-threatening SUSAR) must be submitted to the regulatory agency, computed as awareness_date + 15 calendar days per ICH E2A.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 3.2; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32(c)(1)(ii); EMA EudraVigilance

attributes.name: deadline_7day_date
attributes.description: The calculated calendar date by which a fatal or life-threatening unexpected SUSAR must be submitted to the regulatory agency, computed as awareness_date + 7 calendar days per ICH E2A.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 3.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32(c)(1)(i); EMA EudraVigilance

attributes.name: delay_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation documenting the reason why the ICSR was not submitted within the applicable regulatory deadline. Required for late submissions to support CAPA processes and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; GCP ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; CAPA requirements

attributes.name: dsmb_notified
attributes.business_glossary_term: Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) Notified Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) or Data Monitoring Committee (DMC) was notified of this ICSR. Required for studies with an active DSMB charter.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.5; FDA Guidance on DSMB; EMA DSMB guidance

tag_set.value: Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) Notified Flag

attributes.name: irb_iec_notification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) was formally notified of this ICSR. Used for compliance tracking against GCP notification requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.11; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.66; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: irb_iec_notified
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Notified Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) overseeing the study was notified of this ICSR, as required by GCP and applicable regulations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.11; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.66; EU CTR 536/2014; OHRP

tag_set.value: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Notified Flag

attributes.name: is_current_version
attributes.description: Indicates whether this record represents the most current version of the ICSR. True for the latest version; False for superseded versions retained for audit history.
attributes.references: ICH E2B(R3); ALCOA+ data integrity principles; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: is_fatal
attributes.description: Indicates whether the adverse event associated with this ICSR resulted in the death of the subject. Fatal cases trigger the 7-day expedited reporting clock per ICH E2A.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 3.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32(c)(1)(i); EMA EudraVigilance

attributes.name: is_life_threatening
attributes.description: Indicates whether the adverse event associated with this ICSR was life-threatening (i.e., the subject was at immediate risk of death). Life-threatening cases trigger the 7-day expedited reporting clock per ICH E2A.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Section 3.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32(c)(1)(i); EMA EudraVigilance

attributes.name: is_on_time
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ICSR was submitted to the regulatory agency on or before the applicable regulatory deadline date. True = compliant submission; False = late submission. Key KPI for regulatory compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA EudraVigilance; ISO 14155

attributes.name: is_susar
attributes.business_glossary_term: Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reaction (SUSAR) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ICSR relates to a Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reaction (SUSAR). SUSARs require expedited reporting to regulatory authorities and ethics committees under ICH E2A and EU CTR 536/2014.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 42; EMA EudraVigilance; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32

tag_set.value: Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reaction (SUSAR) Flag

attributes.name: narrative
attributes.description: The structured free-text clinical narrative summarizing the adverse event, patient information, treatment details, and outcome as included in the ICSR submission. Corresponds to ICH E2B(R3) H.1 narrative section.
attributes.references: ICH E2B(R3) H.1; FDA MedWatch 3500A Section G; EMA EudraVigilance

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: The reason provided by the regulatory agency when an ICSR submission is rejected (e.g., data validation failure, duplicate case, missing mandatory fields). Populated only when submission_status = 'rejected'.
attributes.references: ICH E2B(R3); EMA EudraVigilance; FDA ESG validation rules

attributes.name: report_number
attributes.description: The externally-known, unique regulatory report identifier assigned to this ICSR submission (e.g., the E2B message identifier or MedWatch report number). Used by health authorities to track and acknowledge the submission.
attributes.references: ICH E2B(R3) A.1.0.1; FDA MedWatch 3500A; EMA EudraVigilance

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ICSR is an initial submission, a follow-up update with new information, or a nullification (withdrawal) of a previously submitted report. Aligns with ICH E2B(R3) A.1.6.
attributes.references: ICH E2B(R3) A.1.6; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA EudraVigilance

attributes.name: report_version
attributes.description: Sequential version number of this ICSR record. Version 1 is the initial report; subsequent versions represent follow-up or amended submissions for the same case.
attributes.references: ICH E2B(R3); Oracle Argus Safety case versioning

attributes.name: sender_identifier
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the organization or individual sending the ICSR to the regulatory agency, as defined in ICH E2B(R3) A.3.1. Typically the sponsor or CRO EudraVigilance/FDA sender ID.
attributes.references: ICH E2B(R3) A.3.1; EMA EudraVigilance; FDA ESG

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: The actual calendar date on which the ICSR was transmitted to the regulatory agency. Used to calculate days-to-submission and determine on-time compliance against the applicable deadline.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA EudraVigilance; ALCOA+

attributes.name: submission_method
attributes.description: The technical format or channel used to transmit the ICSR to the regulatory agency. E2B XML is the standard electronic format per ICH E2B(R3); MedWatch and CIOMS I are paper/PDF formats used for specific agencies or fallback scenarios.
attributes.references: ICH E2B(R3); FDA MedWatch 3500A; CIOMS I Form; EMA EudraVigilance gateway

attributes.name: submission_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the ICSR submission lifecycle. Tracks progression from internal drafting through regulatory acknowledgement or rejection.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; ICH E2B(R3); FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA EudraVigilance

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (with timezone) at which the ICSR was electronically transmitted to the regulatory agency gateway. Provides audit-grade precision beyond the submission date for 21 CFR Part 11 compliance.
attributes.references: ICH E2B(R3); 21 CFR Part 11; EMA EudraVigilance gateway

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this ICSR record was most recently modified in the source system or the Databricks Silver Layer. Supports change tracking and ALCOA+ data integrity requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8

attributes.name: detection_method
attributes.description: Method used to detect the safety signal. Includes quantitative pharmacovigilance methods such as Proportional Reporting Ratio (PRR), Reporting Odds Ratio (ROR), Bayesian Confidence Propagation Neural Network (BCPNN), disproportionality analysis, clinical
attributes.references: ICH E2C(R2); EMA GVP Module IX; WHO Signal Detection Guidelines

attributes.name: evaluation_completion_date

attributes.name: evaluation_due_date
