attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this signal evaluation as assigned by the source system Used for cross-system traceability and regulatory correspondence. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this TRANSACTION_HEADER.
attributes.references: Oracle Argus Safety Signal Management; ICH E2E; FDA 21 CFR Part 314

tag_set.value: Oracle Argus Safety Signal Evaluation Number

attributes.name: benefit_risk_assessment_summary
attributes.description: Narrative summary of the benefit-risk assessment conducted during this evaluation cycle, documenting the clinical judgment on the balance between therapeutic benefit and identified safety risk.
attributes.references: ICH E2C(R2) Periodic Benefit-Risk Evaluation Report (PBRER); EMA GVP Module V; FDA Benefit-Risk Framework

attributes.name: benefit_risk_conclusion
attributes.description: Formal conclusion of the benefit-risk assessment for this evaluation cycle. Drives downstream regulatory action decisions.
attributes.references: ICH E2C(R2) PBRER; EMA GVP Module V; FDA Benefit-Risk Framework

attributes.name: case_count_reviewed
attributes.description: Total number of adverse event cases reviewed during this signal evaluation cycle. Provides a quantitative measure of the evidence base examined.
attributes.references: EMA GVP Module IX; ICH E2E; CIOMS VIII Signal Detection

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this signal evaluation record was first created in the system. RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records; ALCOA+ Principles; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: data_sources_reviewed
attributes.description: Description of the data sources reviewed during this evaluation, such as clinical trial databases, spontaneous report databases (FAERS, EudraVigilance), published literature, and DSMB/DMC reports.
attributes.references: EMA GVP Module IX; ICH E2E; CIOMS VIII

attributes.name: dsmb_dmc_recommendation
attributes.business_glossary_term: Data Safety Monitoring Board / Data Monitoring Committee (DSMB/DMC) Recommendation
attributes.description: Formal recommendation issued by the DSMB or DMC following their independent review of the referred signal evaluation. Populated only when a DSMB/DMC review has been completed.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Guidance on DSMB; EMA Reflection Paper on DMC

tag_set.value: Data Safety Monitoring Board / Data Monitoring Committee (DSMB/DMC) Recommendation

attributes.name: dsmb_dmc_referral_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Data Safety Monitoring Board / Data Monitoring Committee (DSMB/DMC) Referral Date
attributes.description: Date on which the signal evaluation was formally referred to the DSMB or DMC for independent safety review. Populated only when is_dsmb_dmc_referral is True.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Guidance on DSMB; EMA Reflection Paper on DMC

tag_set.value: Data Safety Monitoring Board / Data Monitoring Committee (DSMB/DMC) Referral Date

attributes.name: evaluation_completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the formal signal evaluation was completed and conclusions were finalized. Marks the end of the evaluation lifecycle for this cycle.
attributes.references: EMA GVP Module IX; ICH E2E; Oracle Argus Safety Signal Management

attributes.name: evaluation_cycle_number
attributes.description: Sequential cycle number for this evaluation of the signal (e.g., 1 for initial evaluation, 2 for re-evaluation after new data). Supports tracking of iterative evaluation rounds for the same signal.
attributes.references: EMA GVP Module IX Signal Management; ICH E2E

attributes.name: evaluation_initiated_date
attributes.description: The date on which the formal signal evaluation process was initiated. Serves as the principal BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP for this transaction, marking the start of the regulatory evaluation clock.
attributes.references: EMA GVP Module IX; FDA Guidance on Safety Reporting; ICH E2E

attributes.name: evaluation_outcome
attributes.description: Final outcome determination of the signal evaluation cycle. Indicates whether the signal was confirmed as a new safety finding, refuted by the evidence, or requires ongoing monitoring.
attributes.references: EMA GVP Module IX; ICH E2E; CIOMS VIII

attributes.name: evaluation_plan_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the evaluation plan, including the scope of data to be reviewed, analytical approach, and objectives for this evaluation cycle.
attributes.references: EMA GVP Module IX; ICH E2E; FDA Guidance on Safety Reporting

attributes.name: evaluation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the signal evaluation workflow. Tracks progression from initiation through completion. LIFECYCLE_STATUS for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: EMA GVP Module IX; ICH E2E Pharmacovigilance Planning; Oracle Argus Safety

attributes.name: expedited_report_due_date
attributes.description: Regulatory deadline by which the expedited safety report (e.g., SUSAR) must be submitted to the relevant authority. Calculated from the awareness date per ICH E2A timelines (7 or 15 calendar days).
attributes.references: ICH E2A Clinical Safety Data Management; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: expedited_reporting_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this signal evaluation triggers an expedited regulatory reporting obligation (e.g., SUSAR 7-day or 15-day report). True = expedited reporting required.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Clinical Safety Data Management; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: health_authority_query_reference
attributes.description: Reference number assigned by a regulatory authority (FDA, EMA, MHRA, etc.) for any formal query or request for information related to this signal evaluation. Enables traceability of regulatory correspondence.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GVP Module IX; MHRA; ICH E2E

attributes.name: is_current_version
attributes.description: Indicates whether this record represents the current active version of the signal evaluation. True = current version; False = superseded version. Supports slowly changing dimension (SCD) pattern in the Silver Layer.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records; ALCOA+ Principles; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer conventions

attributes.name: is_dsmb_dmc_referral
attributes.business_glossary_term: Data Safety Monitoring Board / Data Monitoring Committee (DSMB/DMC) Referral Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this signal evaluation has been referred to the Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) or Data Monitoring Committee (DMC) for independent review. True = referred; False = not referred.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Guidance on DSMB; EMA Reflection Paper on DMC

tag_set.value: Data Safety Monitoring Board / Data Monitoring Committee (DSMB/DMC) Referral Flag

attributes.name: is_susar
attributes.business_glossary_term: Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reaction (SUSAR) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the safety signal under evaluation has been classified as a Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reaction (SUSAR), triggering specific expedited reporting obligations under ICH E2A.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Clinical Safety Data Management; EMA GVP Module VI; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EU CTR 536/2014

tag_set.value: Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reaction (SUSAR) Flag

attributes.name: meddra_pt_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities (MedDRA) Preferred Term (PT) Code
attributes.description: MedDRA Preferred Term code representing the primary adverse event or medical concept under evaluation. Used for standardized coding and regulatory reporting alignment.
attributes.references: MedDRA (Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities); ICH M1; CDISC SDTM AE Domain

tag_set.value: Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities (MedDRA) Preferred Term (PT) Code

attributes.name: meddra_soc_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities (MedDRA) System Organ Class (SOC) Code
attributes.description: MedDRA System Organ Class code for the primary adverse event under evaluation. Supports aggregate safety reporting by organ system.
attributes.references: MedDRA (Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities); ICH M1; EMA GVP Module IX

tag_set.value: Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities (MedDRA) System Organ Class (SOC) Code

attributes.name: meddra_version
attributes.business_glossary_term: Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities (MedDRA) Version
attributes.description: Version of the MedDRA dictionary used for coding the signal evaluation (e.g., 26.0). Ensures reproducibility and regulatory traceability of coding decisions.
attributes.references: MedDRA (Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities); ICH M1; CDISC SDTM

tag_set.value: Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities (MedDRA) Version

attributes.name: protocol_amendment_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this signal evaluation has resulted in a recommendation to amend the study protocol (e.g., dose modification, additional safety monitoring, exclusion criteria update).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.30; EMA GVP Module IX; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: regulatory_action_justification
attributes.description: Narrative justification for the recommended regulatory action, documenting the clinical and scientific rationale supporting the recommendation.
attributes.references: EMA GVP Module IX; FDA 21 CFR Part 314; ICH E2E

attributes.name: regulatory_action_recommended
attributes.description: Formal regulatory action recommended as an outcome of this signal evaluation. Options include label update, Direct Healthcare Professional Communication (DHPC), study suspension, protocol amendment, Risk Management Plan (RMP) update, or urgent safety
attributes.references: EMA GVP Module IX; FDA 21 CFR Part 314.81; ICH E2E; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: risk_minimization_measure
attributes.description: Risk minimization measure recommended or implemented as a result of this signal evaluation. Supports Risk Management Plan (RMP) updates and regulatory commitments.
attributes.references: EMA GVP Module XVI Risk Minimisation Measures; ICH E2E; FDA REMS

attributes.name: signal_detection_method
attributes.description: Statistical or clinical methodology used to detect the safety signal prior to this evaluation. Examples include disproportionality analysis (PRR, ROR), data mining algorithms, or clinical case series review.
attributes.references: EMA GVP Module IX; ICH E2E; CIOMS VIII Signal Detection

attributes.name: signal_source
attributes.description: Origin of the safety signal that triggered this evaluation. Identifies whether the signal arose from spontaneous adverse event reports, clinical trial data, published literature, a regulatory authority communication, or DSMB/DMC review.
attributes.references: EMA GVP Module IX; ICH E2E; FDA Guidance on Safety Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this signal evaluation record was last modified. RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records; ALCOA+ Principles; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of this evaluation record, incremented each time the evaluation is updated or revised. Supports audit trail and version control per ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records; ALCOA+ Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP

products.name: dsmb_review
products.description: Master record for Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) / Data Monitoring Committee (DMC) safety governance, covering both committee definition and individual review meetings.
products.reference: ICH E9; FDA DSMB Guidance 2006; EMA DMC Reflection Paper

attributes.name: dsmb_review_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) Review ID
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each DSMB/DMC review record in the safety governance system. Primary key for the dsmb_review data product.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Good Clinical Practice; FDA Guidance for Clinical Trial Sponsors: Establishment and Operation of Clinical Trial Data Monitoring Committees

tag_set.value: Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) Review ID

attributes.name: blinding_config_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to randomization.blinding_config. Business justification: DSMB reviews operate under a specific blinding configuration defining the committee's unblinded access level.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: compliance_sop_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_sop. Business justification: A DSMB review is conducted under a specific charter version that defines stopping rules, alpha spending, and quorum requirements.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: database_lock_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to biostatistics.database_lock_event. Business justification: DSMB reviews are conducted on data packages prepared at a specific database lock.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: dmp_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to datamanagement.dmp. Business justification: DSMB data packages are prepared according to the DMP which defines data standards and review procedures.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: epoch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.epoch. Business justification: DSMB reviews are triggered by epoch milestones (e.g., end of treatment epoch, interim analysis epoch). The study_phase_reviewed attribute on dsmb_review is a denormalization of epoch context.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: health_authority_id
attributes.description: Reference to the safety oversight committee (DSMB, DMC, IDMC, or internal SRC) that conducted this review. Links to the committee master record.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance for Clinical Trial Sponsors: Establishment and Operation of Clinical Trial Data Monitoring Committees

attributes.name: interim_analysis_id
attributes.description: Reference to the formal interim analysis record associated with this DSMB/DMC review, if applicable. Links safety governance to the statistical interim analysis conducted per the Statistical Analysis Plan (the source system).
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs for Clinical Trials; CDISC ADaM

attributes.name: investigational_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.investigational_product. Business justification: DSMB reviews assess benefit-risk for a specific investigational product. Protocol-level IP context (mechanism of action, development phase, IND number) is required for DSMB
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: primary_dsmb_tmf_document_id
attributes.description: Document identifier for the official DSMB/DMC meeting minutes stored in the electronic Trial Master File (eTMF) system (Veeva Vault). Provides traceability to the formal meeting record.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 8 Essential Documents; 21 CFR Part 11; Veeva Vault eTMF; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: protocol_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.protocol. Business justification: DSMB reviews are conducted against a specific protocol version. The DSMB charter references the protocol.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: rand_scheme_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to randomization.rand_scheme. Business justification: DSMB reviews are conducted against a specific randomization scheme version governing blinding level, stratification, and allocation.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: sap_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to biostatistics.dsmb_meeting. Business justification: safety.dsmb_review and biostatistics.dsmb_meeting represent the same real-world DSMB event from safety and statistical perspectives respectively.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: sdtm_dataset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to datamanagement.sdtm_dataset. Business justification: DSMB data packages are prepared from specific SDTM dataset versions. The dsmb_review must reference the dataset version reviewed for audit trail and reproducibility; DSMB charters
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: signal_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.safety_signal. Business justification: dsmb_review has safety_signal_identified (BOOLEAN) and safety_signal_description (STRING) but no FK to the safety_signal record.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study for which this DSMB/DMC review was conducted. Links the safety oversight record to the parent study master.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC SDTM IG

attributes.name: submission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.submission. Business justification: DSMB reviews requiring regulatory notification generate formal submissions. Linking dsmb_review to its regulatory submission enables tracking of sponsor regulatory responses to DSMB
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: treatment_arm_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to randomization.treatment_arm. Business justification: DSMB charters mandate arm-level safety review — cumulative SAE counts, stopping rules, and benefit-risk assessments are evaluated per treatment arm.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: argus_safety_case_ref
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this DSMB/DMC review to related safety cases or aggregate safety reports in the source system Enables cross-referencing between safety governance decisions and individual case safety reports.
attributes.references: Oracle Argus Safety; ICH E2B(R3); FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: charter_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the DSMB/DMC charter document in effect at the time of this review (e.g., 'v1.0', 'v2.1'). Ensures traceability to the governing charter under which the review was conducted.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance for Clinical Trial Sponsors: Establishment and Operation of Clinical Trial Data Monitoring Committees; ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: closed_session_held
attributes.description: Indicates whether a closed (confidential, unblinded) session was held during the DSMB/DMC meeting, attended only by committee members and the unblinded statistician (True = closed session held; False = no closed session).
attributes.references: FDA Guidance for Clinical Trial Sponsors: Establishment and Operation of Clinical Trial Data Monitoring Committees; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this DSMB/DMC review record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: data_cutoff_date
attributes.description: The date through which clinical data was included in the unblinded safety data package reviewed by the DSMB/DMC. Defines the temporal scope of the safety data under review.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); CDISC ADaM; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs for Clinical Trials

attributes.name: data_package_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the unblinded safety data package provided to the DSMB/DMC for this review. Ensures traceability between the committee's recommendation and the exact data snapshot reviewed.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1) Statistical Principles for Clinical Trials; CDISC SDTM; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: implementation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the sponsor implemented the DSMB/DMC recommendation (e.g., date study was suspended, protocol amendment was issued, or continuation was confirmed). Used for regulatory timeline compliance tracking.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: is_independent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the committee is fully independent of the sponsor and investigator team (True = independent; False = internal/non-independent). Independence is a key regulatory requirement for unblinded safety reviews.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.5; FDA Guidance for Clinical Trial Sponsors: Establishment and Operation of Clinical Trial Data Monitoring Committees; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: meeting_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the DSMB/DMC review meeting was held. This is the principal business event date for the review record and is used for regulatory timeline tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: meeting_number
attributes.description: Sequential ordinal number of this DSMB/DMC meeting within the study (e.g., 1 = first meeting, 2 = second meeting). Used to track the progression of safety oversight across the study lifecycle.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance for Clinical Trial Sponsors: Establishment and Operation of Clinical Trial Data Monitoring Committees

attributes.name: meeting_type
attributes.description: Classification of the DSMB/DMC meeting format and trigger. Scheduled = pre-planned per charter; Ad hoc = convened outside regular schedule; Emergency = triggered by urgent safety signal; Teleconference = remote meeting; Written review = asynchronous
attributes.references: FDA Guidance for Clinical Trial Sponsors: Establishment and Operation of Clinical Trial Data Monitoring Committees; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: members_present_count
attributes.description: Number of DSMB/DMC committee members who attended and participated in this review meeting. Used to verify quorum compliance and document meeting validity.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance for Clinical Trial Sponsors: Establishment and Operation of Clinical Trial Data Monitoring Committees; DSMB Charter

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the next scheduled DSMB/DMC review meeting as recommended by the committee or defined in the charter. Used for proactive scheduling and safety oversight continuity planning.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance for Clinical Trial Sponsors: Establishment and Operation of Clinical Trial Data Monitoring Committees; DSMB Charter

attributes.name: open_session_held
attributes.description: Indicates whether an open (non-confidential) session was held during the DSMB/DMC meeting, typically attended by the sponsor and investigators (True = open session held; False = closed session only).
attributes.references: FDA Guidance for Clinical Trial Sponsors: Establishment and Operation of Clinical Trial Data Monitoring Committees

attributes.name: protocol_amendment_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the DSMB/DMC recommendation requires a protocol amendment to be submitted to the IRB/IEC and regulatory authorities (True = amendment required; False = no amendment required). Triggers the protocol amendment workflow.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.30; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 15; IRB/IEC Requirements

attributes.name: quorum_achieved
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required quorum of DSMB/DMC members was present for the meeting to be valid per the committee charter (True = quorum met; False = quorum not met). Meetings without quorum may require rescheduling or written ratification.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance for Clinical Trial Sponsors: Establishment and Operation of Clinical Trial Data Monitoring Committees; DSMB Charter

attributes.name: recommendation
attributes.description: The formal recommendation issued by the DSMB/DMC following the review. Continue = proceed without changes; Continue with modification = proceed with protocol or safety monitoring amendments; Suspend = temporary halt pending further review; Terminate =
attributes.references: FDA Guidance for Clinical Trial Sponsors: Establishment and Operation of Clinical Trial Data Monitoring Committees; ICH E6(R2); EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: recommendation_rationale
attributes.description: Narrative explanation provided by the DSMB/DMC justifying the formal recommendation. Documents the safety findings, benefit-risk assessment, and reasoning that led to the committee's decision.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance for Clinical Trial Sponsors: Establishment and Operation of Clinical Trial Data Monitoring Committees; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory authority was notified of the DSMB/DMC recommendation or safety findings. Populated only when regulatory_notification_required is True. Used for compliance with expedited reporting timelines.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA EU CTR 536/2014 Article 37; ICH E2A; MHRA Guidance

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_due_date
attributes.description: Deadline by which the regulatory authority must be notified per applicable regulations (e.g., 7-day or 15-day reporting window). Enables proactive compliance monitoring and escalation.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E2A; PMDA Notification Requirements

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the DSMB/DMC recommendation or safety findings from this review require expedited regulatory notification to health authorities (True = notification required; False = no notification required).
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA Clinical Trials Regulation EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E2A; MHRA Guidance

attributes.name: review_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the DSMB/DMC review record. Scheduled = meeting planned but not yet held; In progress = meeting underway or deliberations ongoing; Completed = recommendation issued and documented; Cancelled = meeting cancelled; Postponed =
attributes.references: Oracle Argus Safety; Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: safety_signal_identified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the DSMB/DMC identified a new or emerging safety signal during this review that requires further investigation or monitoring (True = signal identified; False = no new signal).
attributes.references: ICH E2E Pharmacovigilance Planning; FDA Safety Reporting Guidance; EMA Guideline on Good Pharmacovigilance Practices (GVP) Module IX

attributes.name: sponsor_response
attributes.description: The sponsor's formal response to the DSMB/DMC recommendation. Accepted = sponsor will implement as recommended; Accepted with modification = sponsor accepts intent but modifies implementation; Rejected = sponsor disagrees and provides counter-rationale
attributes.references: FDA Guidance for Clinical Trial Sponsors: Establishment and Operation of Clinical Trial Data Monitoring Committees; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: sponsor_response_rationale
attributes.description: Narrative explanation of the sponsor's response to the DSMB/DMC recommendation, particularly required when the sponsor rejects or modifies the recommendation. Documents the sponsor's benefit-risk reasoning.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance for Clinical Trial Sponsors: Establishment and Operation of Clinical Trial Data Monitoring Committees; ICH E6(R2); EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: stopping_rule_description
attributes.description: Description of the specific pre-specified stopping rule that was triggered, if applicable (e.g., 'Futility boundary crossed at IA2', 'Excess SAE rate in treatment arm exceeds 15%'). Populated only when stopping_rule_triggered is True.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs; DSMB Charter

attributes.name: stopping_rule_triggered
attributes.description: Indicates whether a pre-specified stopping rule defined in the DSMB charter or Statistical Analysis Plan (the source system) was triggered at this review (True = stopping rule met; False = no stopping rule triggered). Critical for regulatory audit trail.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs; SAP; DSMB Charter

attributes.name: study_phase_reviewed
attributes.description: Clinical development phase of the study at the time of the DSMB/DMC review. Determines the regulatory framework and risk thresholds applicable to the safety assessment.
attributes.references: ICH E8(R1) General Considerations for Clinical Studies; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA Guideline on Clinical Trials in Small Populations

attributes.name: subjects_enrolled_count
attributes.description: Total number of subjects enrolled in the study at the time of the DSMB/DMC data cutoff. Provides context for the safety data volume reviewed and is a key metric in the committee's benefit-risk assessment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC SDTM DM Domain; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: subjects_exposed_count
attributes.description: Number of subjects who received at least one dose of investigational product at the time of the data cutoff. Used for exposure-adjusted safety rate calculations in the DSMB/DMC review.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC SDTM EX Domain; CTCAE; FDA Safety Reporting Guidance

attributes.name: unblinded_statistician_present
attributes.description: Indicates whether the independent unblinded statistician was present at the DSMB/DMC meeting to present the unblinded safety data package (True = present; False = not present). Required for valid closed-session deliberations.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); FDA Guidance for Clinical Trial Sponsors: Establishment and Operation of Clinical Trial Data Monitoring Committees

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this DSMB/DMC review record. Required for audit trail compliance under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: study_visit_schedule_id

attributes.name: treatment_arm_id

attributes.name: trial_subject_id

attributes.name: visit_id

attributes.name: alcoa_compliant

attributes.name: cdisc_sdtm_domain
attributes.business_glossary_term: Clinical Data Interchange Standards Consortium (CDISC) Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM) Domain
attributes.description: The CDISC SDTM domain code to which this eCRF form maps (e.g., 'DM' for Demographics, 'VS' for Vital Signs, 'AE' for Adverse Events, 'LB' for Laboratory). Used to drive SDTM transformation and regulatory submission packaging in SAS Drug Development.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide; SAS Drug Development

tag_set.value: Clinical Data Interchange Standards Consortium (CDISC) Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM) Domain

attributes.name: completion_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the eCRF form in Medidata Rave. Reflects the data entry and review workflow: incomplete (data entry in progress), complete (all required fields entered), frozen (data frozen pending review), locked (data locked post-database
attributes.references: Medidata Rave; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; ALCOA+

attributes.name: data_completeness_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of required eCRF fields that have been populated for this subject visit form, calculated as (completed fields / total required fields) × 100. Key metric for data quality monitoring and site performance KPIs. Range: 0.00 to 100.00.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC DMP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: data_entry_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when data was first entered into this eCRF form in Medidata Rave. Represents the ALCOA+ 'Contemporaneous' requirement — data must be recorded at the time of the observation. This is the record creation audit timestamp.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave

attributes.name: data_review_status
attributes.description: Current status of the medical/data management review of this subject visit form. Tracks the review workflow from initial data entry through medical monitor approval. Values: not_started, in_review, reviewed, approved, requires_correction.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC DMP; Medidata Rave; ALCOA+

attributes.name: edc_record_reference
attributes.description: The native record identifier assigned by Medidata Rave EDC to this subject visit form instance. Used for traceability back to the source EDC system and for audit trail reconciliation.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: entered_by
attributes.description: The username of the Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) or site staff member who initially entered data into this eCRF form in Medidata Rave. Satisfies ALCOA+ 'Attributable' requirement — data must be traceable to the person who recorded it.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave

attributes.name: freeze_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this subject visit form has been frozen in Medidata Rave (True = frozen; False = not frozen). Freezing is a pre-lock step that prevents further data entry while allowing review. Distinct from lock_status.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: freeze_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this subject visit form was frozen in Medidata Rave. Null if the form has not been frozen. Supports the pre-database lock workflow audit trail.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: investigator_signature_status
attributes.description: Status of the Principal Investigator (PI) or sub-investigator electronic signature on this eCRF form. Required for regulatory compliance under 21 CFR Part 11 and ICH E6(R2). Values: not_required, pending, signed, rejected.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.9; Medidata Rave; FDA

attributes.name: investigator_signature_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the Principal Investigator (PI) or sub-investigator applied their electronic signature to this eCRF form. Null if not yet signed. Required for 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.9; Medidata Rave

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: The username of the user who most recently modified this eCRF form record in Medidata Rave. Supports ALCOA+ 'Attributable' requirement for all data changes.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this eCRF form record was most recently modified in Medidata Rave. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail and change tracking for data management workflows.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave

attributes.name: lock_status
attributes.description: Indicates the database lock state of this subject visit form. Unlocked = data entry and editing permitted; locked = form locked as part of the database lock (DBL) workflow; hard_locked = irreversibly locked post-database lock for regulatory submission.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave; ALCOA+

attributes.name: lock_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this subject visit form was locked in Medidata Rave as part of the database lock (DBL) workflow. Null if the form has not been locked. Critical for regulatory audit trail.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave; ALCOA+

attributes.name: locked_by
attributes.description: The username of the data management user who applied the lock to this subject visit form in Medidata Rave. Required for 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records audit trail.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave; ALCOA+

attributes.name: medical_coding_status
attributes.description: Status of medical coding for verbatim terms on this eCRF form using MedDRA (adverse events, medical history) or WHO Drug Dictionary (concomitant medications). Values: not_applicable (no codeable terms), pending, coded, approved, rejected.
attributes.references: MedDRA; WHO-DD; CDISC SDTM; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA

attributes.name: missing_data_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether one or more required data fields are missing or unanswered on this eCRF form for the subject visit. True = missing data present; False = all required fields populated. Supports ALCOA+ compliance tracking.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC DMP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: missing_field_count
attributes.description: The number of required eCRF fields that are currently unanswered or missing for this subject visit form. Provides granular data completeness tracking beyond the binary missing_data_flag.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC DMP

attributes.name: open_query_count
attributes.description: The number of currently open data queries (discrepancies) raised against this subject visit form in Medidata Rave. Used to track data cleaning progress and site responsiveness.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; CDISC DMP

attributes.name: protocol_deviation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a protocol deviation has been identified in association with this subject visit data record (True = deviation present; False = no deviation). Supports compliance monitoring and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; ISO 14155; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: rave_page_repeat_key
attributes.description: The repeat sequence key for repeating forms (log pages) in Medidata Rave, used when a subject has multiple instances of the same form within a single visit (e.g., multiple adverse event entries). Value is 1 for non-repeating forms.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave; CDISC ODM; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: sdv_date
attributes.description: The date on which source data verification (SDV) was completed for this subject visit form by the Clinical Research Associate (CRA). Null if SDV has not been performed.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: sdv_status
attributes.description: Current status of source data verification (SDV) for this subject visit form. Reflects whether the CRA has verified the eCRF data against source documents at the site.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; Oracle Siebel CTMS; Medidata Rave

attributes.name: subject_number
attributes.description: The externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned to the subject within the study (e.g., site-subject number such as '001-0042'). Used in eCRF, regulatory submissions, and CDISC SDTM USUBJID derivation. Directly identifies a trial participant.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM USUBJID; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.11; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: total_query_count
attributes.description: The total number of data queries (discrepancies) ever raised against this subject visit form, including open, answered, and closed queries. Supports data quality trend analysis.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: visit_date
attributes.description: The actual calendar date on which the subject attended the study visit and clinical data was collected. Represents the principal real-world event date. Maps to SVSTDTC in CDISC SDTM.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM SVSTDTC; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: visit_window_end_date
attributes.description: The latest acceptable calendar date for this protocol-defined visit per the study schedule of assessments. Used to assess whether the visit occurred within the protocol-specified window.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: visit_window_start_date
attributes.description: The earliest acceptable calendar date for this protocol-defined visit per the study schedule of assessments. Used to assess whether the visit occurred within the protocol-specified window.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: visit_within_window
attributes.description: Indicates whether the actual visit date falls within the protocol-defined visit window (visit_window_start_date to visit_window_end_date). True = within window; False = outside window (potential protocol deviation).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; CDISC SDTM

products.name: field_entry
products.description: Atomic-level transactional record capturing a single field-level data entry in the EDC system (Medidata Rave). Stores the field value, entry timestamp, entered-by user, reason for change, previous value, audit trail reference, and ALCOA+ compliance flags
products.reference: Medidata Rave Audit Trail / ALCOA+ Data Point

attributes.name: field_entry_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each atomic field-level data entry record in the Electronic Data Capture (EDC) system. Primary key for the field_entry data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC CDASH

attributes.name: demographic_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to subject.demographic. Business justification: Field entries capturing demographic data must link to demographic records for data lineage, source data verification, and SDTM DM domain traceability. Required for regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: discrepancy_query_id
attributes.description: Reference to an open or resolved data query (discrepancy) raised against this field entry. A field entry may have an associated query requiring site clarification before database lock (DBL). Null if no query exists.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC CDASH; Medidata Rave Query Management

attributes.name: dispensing_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.dispensing_record. Business justification: EDC field entries for dispensing/accountability eCRF forms must be reconcilable against RTSM dispensing confirmations.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: ecrf_field_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to datamanagement.ecrf_field. Business justification: field_entry is an atomic data entry for a specific eCRF field. ecrf_field is the master field definition.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: ecrf_form_id
attributes.description: Reference to the electronic Case Report Form (eCRF) form definition that contains this field. Identifies the form context (e.g., Adverse Event form, Vital Signs form) within Medidata Rave.
attributes.references: CDISC CDASH; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: ehr_data_transfer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to datamanagement.ehr_data_transfer. Business justification: A field_entry record can be populated via an eSource/EHR data transfer batch rather than manual EDC entry.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: enrollment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to subject.enrollment. Business justification: Field entries require enrollment context for data lock scope, population flag determination, and protocol version-specific validation rules.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: irt_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to randomization.irt_transaction. Business justification: IRT-EDC reconciliation requires linking eCRF field entries for randomization/kit fields directly to the IRT transaction that triggered them.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: lab_result_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.lab_result. Business justification: Source Data Verification (SDV) requires matching each eCRF field entry for lab values against the originating lab result from the LIMS.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study (protocol) under which this field entry was captured. Links the field entry to its parent study context for filtering, reporting, and regulatory submission.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational site at which this field entry was recorded. Supports site-level data quality monitoring and CRA (Clinical Research Associate) review workflows.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: subject_randomization_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to randomization.subject_randomization. Business justification: Individual eCRF field entries for randomization-related data points (randomization number, treatment assignment confirmation) must be traceable to the
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: subject_visit_data_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to datamanagement.subject_visit_data. Business justification: field_entry is an atomic-level data entry that belongs to a subject visit data record.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: trial_subject_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical trial subject (patient) whose data this field entry represents. Enables subject-level audit trail and source data verification (SDV) traceability.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; HIPAA; GDPR Article 4; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: validation_rule_id
attributes.description: The identifier of the edit check or validation rule in Medidata Rave that was triggered by this field entry. Supports data validation rule management, discrepancy tracking, and DMP (Data Management Plan) compliance reporting.
attributes.references: CDISC CDASH; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave Edit Check Specification; FDA Data Integrity Guidance

attributes.name: visit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the scheduled or unscheduled study visit during which this field entry was collected. Provides temporal context for the data point within the subject's study timeline.
attributes.references: CDISC CDASH; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: alcoa_accurate
attributes.description: ALCOA+ compliance flag indicating whether the field entry value has been verified as accurate against the source document or original observation. Set to true upon successful SDV or data review confirmation.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; FDA Data Integrity Guidance 2018; ICH E6(R2) GCP; MHRA GXP Data Integrity Guidance

attributes.name: alcoa_attributable
attributes.description: ALCOA+ compliance flag indicating whether the field entry is attributable to a specific, identified individual (i.e., the entered_by_user is known and authenticated). One of the core ALCOA+ data integrity principles required by FDA and ICH.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; FDA Data Integrity Guidance 2018; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: alcoa_contemporaneous
attributes.description: ALCOA+ compliance flag indicating whether the field entry was recorded at the time the observation was made (i.e., entry_timestamp is within an acceptable window of the actual observation date). Supports data integrity and GCP compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; FDA Data Integrity Guidance 2018; ICH E6(R2) GCP; EMA GCP Inspection Findings

attributes.name: alcoa_legible
attributes.description: ALCOA+ compliance flag indicating whether the field entry value is legible and readable. Particularly relevant for transcribed or scanned source data. Supports data integrity assessments during regulatory inspections.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; FDA Data Integrity Guidance 2018; ICH E6(R2) GCP; MHRA GXP Data Integrity Guidance

attributes.name: alcoa_original
attributes.description: ALCOA+ compliance flag indicating whether this field entry represents the original (first) recorded value, as opposed to a transcription or copy. Distinguishes primary source data from derived or transferred data.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; FDA Data Integrity Guidance 2018; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: audit_trail_ref
attributes.description: The unique reference identifier linking this field entry to its corresponding audit trail record in Medidata Rave. Enables direct cross-referencing with the EDC system's immutable audit log for regulatory inspection and SDV activities.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave Audit Trail Specification

attributes.name: coded_term
attributes.description: The standardized dictionary term assigned to this field entry after medical coding (e.g., MedDRA Preferred Term (PT) for adverse events, WHO-DD drug name for medications). Null for fields not requiring coding.
attributes.references: MedDRA; WHO-DD; CDISC SDTM; ICH E2A; ICH M1

attributes.name: coding_dictionary
attributes.description: The standardized medical coding dictionary used to code this field entry (e.g., MedDRA for adverse events and medical history, WHO-DD for concomitant medications). Null or 'not_applicable' for fields not requiring coding.
attributes.references: MedDRA; WHO-DD; CDISC SDTM; ICH M1; FDA Adverse Event Reporting

attributes.name: data_entry_type
attributes.description: Classifies how the field value was populated in the EDC system. Distinguishes between manual site entry, system auto-population (e.g., calculated fields), data migration, or external data import (e.g., lab data transfer).
attributes.references: ALCOA+; CDISC CDASH; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Data Integrity Guidance

attributes.name: entry_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the field entry within the EDC system lifecycle. Drives data review, query management, and database lock (DBL) readiness assessments.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave Workflow Specification

attributes.name: entry_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time (with timezone) at which the field value was originally entered into the EDC system by the site user. Supports ALCOA+ contemporaneous data entry verification and audit trail analysis.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Data Integrity Guidance

attributes.name: entry_value
attributes.description: The actual data value entered into the eCRF field by the site user. Stored as STRING to accommodate all field types (numeric, text, date, coded). This is the primary clinical data payload and is classified as Protected Health Information (PHI) under HIPAA.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; GDPR Article 9; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: field_data_type
attributes.description: The data type of the eCRF field as defined in the study build (e.g., text, numeric, date, coded list). Governs validation rules applied to the entry_value and supports downstream SDTM transformation logic.
attributes.references: CDISC ODM 1.3.2; CDISC CDASH; Medidata Rave Study Build Specification

attributes.name: form_name
attributes.description: The name of the eCRF form (e.g., 'Adverse Events', 'Vital Signs', 'Laboratory Results') within which this field resides. Provides form-level context for data review and query management.
attributes.references: CDISC CDASH; Medidata Rave Study Build Specification

attributes.name: has_open_query
attributes.description: Indicates whether this field entry currently has at least one open data query (discrepancy) requiring resolution. Supports real-time data cleaning dashboards and DBL readiness tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave Query Management; CDISC CDASH

attributes.name: is_frozen
attributes.description: Indicates whether this field entry has been frozen, preventing further modification by site users. Freezing is a pre-lock step in the database lock (DBL) workflow to protect data integrity prior to statistical analysis.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; Medidata Rave DBL Workflow

attributes.name: is_locked
attributes.description: Indicates whether this field entry has been locked as part of the Database Lock (DBL) process. Locked fields are immutable and represent the final, analysis-ready dataset. Supports ALCOA+ 'Enduring' and 'Available' principles.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; CDISC SDTM; FDA DBL Guidance

attributes.name: is_missing
attributes.description: Indicates whether this field entry represents a missing data point (i.e., the field was expected but no value was entered or a missing reason code was provided). Supports data completeness reporting and ALCOA+ compliance tracking.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; ICH E9(R1) Statistical Principles; CDISC CDASH; FDA Missing Data Guidance

attributes.name: locked_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this field entry was locked as part of the Database Lock (DBL) process. Null if the field has not yet been locked. Provides a precise audit record of the lock event for regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA DBL Guidance; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: medical_coding_status
attributes.description: The medical coding status for fields requiring standardized coding (e.g., adverse event terms coded to MedDRA, concomitant medications coded to WHO-DD). Tracks whether the verbatim term has been coded to a standard dictionary term.
attributes.references: MedDRA; WHO-DD; CDISC SDTM; ICH E2A; FDA Adverse Event Reporting

attributes.name: missing_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code explaining why a field value is missing (e.g., NOT_DONE, UNKNOWN, NA). Aligns with CDISC CDASH missing data handling conventions and supports statistical analysis plan (the source system) imputation strategies.
attributes.references: CDISC CDASH; ICH E9(R1); FDA Missing Data Guidance; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: The username or system identifier of the EDC user who last modified this field entry. Null if the field has never been modified. Required for complete audit trail attribution under 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Section 11.10; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time of the most recent modification to this field entry. Null if the field has never been modified after initial entry. Part of the complete audit trail required under 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: previous_value
attributes.description: The value of the field prior to the most recent modification. Captured as part of the ALCOA+ (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate) audit trail to support source data verification (SDV) and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; FDA Data Integrity Guidance

attributes.name: rave_record_reference
attributes.description: The native record identifier assigned by Medidata Rave EDC to the parent data record (row) containing this field entry. Used for cross-referencing with the source EDC system and audit trail reconciliation.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; Medidata Rave Audit Trail Specification

attributes.name: reason_for_change
attributes.description: The free-text justification provided by the site user when modifying a previously entered field value. Mandatory for all post-entry modifications per GCP and 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail requirements. Supports ALCOA+ 'Accurate' principle.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.9.3; ALCOA+; FDA Data Integrity Guidance

attributes.name: sdtm_domain
attributes.description: The CDISC SDTM domain (two-letter code) to which this field belongs (e.g., AE for Adverse Events, VS for Vital Signs, LB for Laboratory). Supports SDTM dataset construction and regulatory submission packaging.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide; ICH M8

attributes.name: sdtm_variable
attributes.description: The CDISC SDTM variable name to which this field maps (e.g., AESTDTC, VSORRES, LBSTRESC). Enables automated SDTM transformation and regulatory submission dataset generation via SAS Drug Development.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide; EMA Data Standards

attributes.name: sdv_by_user
attributes.description: The username of the CRA or authorized reviewer who performed Source Data Verification (SDV) on this field entry. Satisfies ALCOA+ 'Attributable' requirement for the verification action.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: sdv_status
attributes.description: The current Source Data Verification (SDV) status of this field entry. Indicates whether a CRA has verified the entered value against the original source document (e.g., medical record). Critical for GCP compliance and monitoring visit reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; FDA Guidance on Risk-Based Monitoring; EMA Reflection Paper on Risk-Based Quality Management

attributes.name: sdv_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the CRA completed Source Data Verification (SDV) for this field entry. Null if SDV has not been performed. Supports monitoring visit close-out and audit trail completeness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance

attributes.name: validation_result
attributes.description: The outcome of the edit check or validation rule applied to this field entry at the time of data entry. A 'fail' result triggers a data query. Supports data quality monitoring and DMP compliance.

attributes.name: dataset_name

attributes.name: dataset_status

attributes.name: dbl_date

attributes.name: define_xml_version

attributes.references: CDISC Define-XML v2.1; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide; EMA Data Standards

attributes.name: domain_class
attributes.description: CDISC SDTM observation class to which this dataset belongs. Classifies the dataset into one of the standard SDTM domain classes: Events (e.g., AE, DS), Interventions (e.g., CM, EX), Findings (e.g., LB, VS, EG), Special Purpose (e.g., DM, CO), Relationship
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.4 Section 4

attributes.name: domain_code
attributes.description: SDTM domain code (e.g. AE, DM, VS).

attributes.name: generation_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this SDTM dataset was generated from source EDC data. Used for audit trail and submission package dating per ALCOA+ contemporaneous principle.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ Principles; 21 CFR Part 11; CDISC SDTM IG

attributes.name: generation_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time at which the SDTM dataset was generated, including timezone offset. Supports ALCOA+ contemporaneous documentation and 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ Principles; 21 CFR Part 11; CDISC SDTM IG

attributes.name: is_split_dataset

attributes.name: is_submission_ready

attributes.references: FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide; CDISC SDTM IG; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: SDTM domain label.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing dataset-specific annotations, known issues, deviation justifications, or reviewer instructions that do not fit into structured fields. Supports ALCOA+ documentation completeness.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ Principles; CDISC SDTM IG; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: pinnacle21_error_count

attributes.references: FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide; Pinnacle 21 Validation Rules

attributes.name: pinnacle21_run_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent Pinnacle 21 validation was executed against this dataset. Supports audit trail and ensures validation currency relative to dataset generation.
attributes.references: FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: pinnacle21_validation_status
attributes.description: Outcome of the Pinnacle 21 Community or Enterprise conformance validation run against this SDTM dataset. Regulatory agencies (FDA, PMDA) require Pinnacle 21 validation reports as part of the submission package.
attributes.references: FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide; Pinnacle 21 Validation Rules; PMDA Data Standards

attributes.name: pinnacle21_warning_count

attributes.references: FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide; Pinnacle 21 Validation Rules

attributes.name: qc_completion_date

attributes.references: ALCOA+ Principles; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: qc_status
attributes.description: Current quality control review status for this SDTM dataset. Tracks progression through the double-programming or independent QC review process required before regulatory submission.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG; ALCOA+ Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide

attributes.name: record_count

attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide

attributes.name: reviewer_guide_reference

attributes.name: sas_dataset_path

attributes.name: sdtm_ig_version

attributes.name: split_sequence

attributes.name: sponsor_dataset_name

attributes.name: subject_count

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.references: ALCOA+ Principles; 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: variable_count

attributes.name: xpt_file_size_kb

attributes.name: derivation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the mapping derivation method: 'direct' (verbatim copy from source), 'derived' (computed from one or more source fields), 'assigned' (constant or protocol-defined value), 'predecessor' (derived from a previously mapped SDTM variable)

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this version of the mapping rule is no longer active and has been superseded or deprecated. Null for currently active mapping rules. Supports temporal versioning of mapping specifications across protocol amendments.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this version of the mapping rule is effective and applicable to SDTM transformation runs. Supports version-controlled mapping specifications where different versions apply to different data collection periods or protocol amendments.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: is_multi_source
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SDTM variable mapping requires data from more than one source field or form (True) or derives from a single source field (False). When True, the derivation_algorithm field documents all contributing source fields and the combination

attributes.name: is_predecessor_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the predecessor variable dependency documented in predecessor_variable is a hard requirement (True) that must be resolved before this mapping executes, or an informational dependency (False).
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; SAS Drug Development

attributes.name: is_sensitive_variable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the target SDTM variable contains sensitive subject data requiring special handling under GDPR, HIPAA, or sponsor data privacy agreements (True). Examples include subject identifiers, dates of birth, and geographic data.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; HIPAA; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this SDTM mapping rule record was most recently updated. Updated on every change to the mapping rule, derivation logic, or status. Supports change tracking and ALCOA+ audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: mapping_rule_code
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique code identifying this mapping rule within the study's SDTM mapping specification document. Follows the pattern MAP-{DOMAIN}-{VARIABLE}-{SEQUENCE}. Used in Data Management Plans (DMP) and CDISC submission packages.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide

attributes.name: mapping_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this SDTM mapping rule. Controls which version is active for production CDISC transformation runs. 'approved' rules are eligible for DBL and regulatory submission.

attributes.name: mapping_version
attributes.description: Version number of this mapping rule in major.minor format (e.g., 1.0, 2.3). Incremented when the transformation logic, source field, or controlled terminology mapping changes.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional programmer or reviewer notes about this mapping rule, including special handling instructions, known data quality issues, sponsor-specific requirements, or cross-references to related mapping rules.

attributes.name: predecessor_variable

attributes.name: reviewer_name

attributes.name: sdtm_domain

attributes.name: sdtm_ig_version

attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide; EMA Data Standards

attributes.name: sdtm_variable_core

attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide v3.4; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide

attributes.name: sdtm_variable_label
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive label for the target SDTM variable as defined in the CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide (e.g., 'Dictionary-Derived Term', 'Numeric Result/Finding in Standard Units').
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide v3.4; CDISC Define-XML v2.1

attributes.name: sdtm_variable_name
attributes.description: Name of the target CDISC SDTM variable within the specified domain (e.g., AEDECOD, LBSTRESN, VSORRES). Must conform to CDISC SDTM naming conventions: uppercase, 2–8 characters, domain prefix for most variables.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide v3.4; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide

attributes.name: sdtm_variable_role
attributes.description: CDISC-defined role of the target SDTM variable within its domain class (Identifier, Topic, Qualifier, Timing, Rule). Determines how the variable functions within the SDTM dataset structure and governs its position and usage in regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide v3.4

attributes.name: sdtm_variable_type
attributes.description: CDISC-defined data type of the target SDTM variable. 'Char' for character/text variables and 'Num' for numeric variables, as specified in the SDTM Implementation Guide and define.xml metadata. Governs SAS dataset column type in regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide v3.4; CDISC Define-XML v2.1

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: Ordinal sequence number of this mapping rule within the parent SDTM dataset specification. Governs the order in which variables appear in the SDTM dataset and define.xml, and the execution order of transformation programs in SAS Drug Development.

attributes.name: source_dataset_name

attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; SAS Drug Development; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide

attributes.name: suppqual_flag

attributes.name: validation_status

attributes.references: CDISC Conformance Rules; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide; Pinnacle 21

attributes.name: workflow_id

attributes.name: capa_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for any Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) initiated as a result of systemic discrepancies identified during this reconciliation. Links to the CAPA management system (MasterControl).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ISO 9001; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this reconciliation record was first created in the system. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: critical_discrepancy_count
attributes.description: Number of discrepancies classified as critical (e.g., safety-impacting, primary endpoint data, regulatory submission data). Critical discrepancies require mandatory resolution before DBL.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Guidelines; ALCOA+

attributes.name: dataset_name
attributes.description: Name of the specific CDISC SDTM domain or dataset (e.g., AE, LB, CM, VS) being reconciled. Provides dataset-level traceability for SDTM submission readiness.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide; EMA Data Standards

attributes.name: dbl_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reconciliation is a mandatory prerequisite for Database Lock (DBL). When True, outstanding discrepancies must be resolved or formally waived before DBL can proceed.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC Data Management Standards; FDA Guidance on DBL

attributes.name: discrepancy_count
attributes.description: Total number of data discrepancies identified between the source and target systems during this reconciliation exercise. Includes all open, resolved, and outstanding discrepancies.
attributes.references: CDISC Data Management Standards; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: discrepancy_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of records with at least one discrepancy relative to total records compared (discrepancy_count / total_records_compared * 100). Key quality KPI for data management performance reporting and study risk assessment.
attributes.references: CDISC Data Management Standards; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: escalation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for escalation, including the nature of critical discrepancies, impacted data domains, and recommended corrective actions. Populated only when escalation_required is True.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: escalation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reconciliation outcome requires escalation to the study team, sponsor, or Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) due to critical unresolved discrepancies or systemic data quality issues.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Guidelines

attributes.name: frequency
attributes.description: Cadence at which this type of reconciliation is performed for the study, as defined in the DMP. Drives scheduling and resource planning for data management activities.
attributes.references: CDISC Data Management Standards; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: method
attributes.description: Approach used to perform the reconciliation — fully manual review, automated system comparison, or a hybrid semi-automated process. Informs quality risk assessment and resource planning.
attributes.references: CDISC Data Management Standards; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for data manager comments, observations, or contextual information about the reconciliation activity, including any known data transfer delays, system outages, or protocol amendments affecting the comparison.
attributes.references: CDISC Data Management Standards; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for the reconciliation activity, used in Data Management Plans (DMP), audit trails, and cross-system references. Typically formatted as REC-{StudyCode}-{Sequence}.
attributes.references: CDISC Data Management Standards; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: outstanding_count
attributes.description: Number of discrepancies that remain unresolved at the time of the reconciliation record. A non-zero value blocks DBL (Database Lock) unless formally justified and documented.
attributes.references: CDISC Data Management Standards; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: period_end
attributes.description: End date of the data window covered by this reconciliation activity. Defines the upper bound of the data extract or comparison period.
attributes.references: CDISC Data Management Standards; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: period_start
attributes.description: Start date of the data window covered by this reconciliation activity. Defines the lower bound of the data extract or comparison period.
attributes.references: CDISC Data Management Standards; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: planned_reconciliation_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the reconciliation activity as defined in the Data Management Plan (DMP) or study timeline. Enables variance tracking between planned and actual reconciliation dates.
attributes.references: CDISC Data Management Standards; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the reconciliation activity was formally executed. Principal business event date used for scheduling, DMP milestone tracking, and pre-DBL (Database Lock) compliance verification.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC Data Management Standards; ALCOA+

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the reconciliation activity, from initiation through sign-off. Drives workflow progression and DBL (Database Lock) readiness gates.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC Data Management Standards; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: reconciliation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the reconciliation activity by the category of external data source being reconciled against the EDC (Electronic Data Capture) system. Drives workflow routing and DMP compliance checks.
attributes.references: CDISC Data Management Standards; ICH E6(R2) GCP; DMP Guidelines

attributes.name: resolved_count
attributes.description: Number of discrepancies that have been investigated and resolved (closed) as of the reconciliation sign-off date. Used to assess reconciliation completeness.
attributes.references: CDISC Data Management Standards; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Granularity level at which the reconciliation is performed — whether it covers the full study, a specific site, individual subjects, a visit window, or a specific dataset. Determines the breadth of the reconciliation exercise.
attributes.references: CDISC Data Management Standards; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: signoff_by
attributes.description: Name or user identifier of the individual who formally approved and signed off the reconciliation activity. Supports electronic signature audit trail per 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: signoff_status
attributes.description: Formal approval status of the reconciliation activity by the responsible data manager and/or study team. Approved sign-off is required before the reconciliation can be considered complete for DBL purposes.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; CDISC Data Management Standards

attributes.name: signoff_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the reconciliation was formally signed off. Provides the precise audit timestamp for regulatory inspection readiness per 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: source_data_extract_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the data extract was pulled from the source system for reconciliation purposes. Critical for ALCOA+ contemporaneity and audit trail integrity.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: target_data_extract_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the data extract was pulled from the target system for reconciliation comparison. Paired with source_data_extract_timestamp to establish the comparison window.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: target_system
attributes.description: Name of the receiving or comparison operational system against which source data is reconciled (e.g., Medidata Rave EDC, the source system SAS Drug Development). Identifies the system-of-record on the receiving side.
attributes.references: CDISC Data Management Standards; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: tool
attributes.description: Name of the software tool or system used to perform the reconciliation (e.g., Medidata Rave, SAS macro, custom script, the source system Supports audit trail and reproducibility documentation.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; CDISC Data Management Standards; ALCOA+

attributes.name: total_records_compared
attributes.description: Total count of data records (e.g., subject visits, lab results, AE entries) included in the reconciliation comparison between source and target systems. Denominator for discrepancy rate calculations.
attributes.references: CDISC Data Management Standards; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this reconciliation record was last modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail integrity, and Silver Layer incremental load processing.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the reconciliation activity, incremented when a reconciliation is re-executed (e.g., after additional data is received or discrepancies are resolved). Supports iterative reconciliation tracking.
attributes.references: CDISC Data Management Standards; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: waived_count
attributes.description: Number of discrepancies formally waived with documented justification (e.g., clinically insignificant, data not required for analysis). Supports transparent DBL decision-making.
attributes.references: CDISC Data Management Standards; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+
