attributes.name: is_safety_panel
attributes.description: Indicates whether this panel is designated as a safety monitoring panel (e.g., liver function, renal function, hematology) required for adverse event assessment and DSMB/DMC review.

attributes.name: panel_short_name

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_sop. Business justification: PK sample collection, processing, and storage must comply with bioanalytical SOPs (ICH M10, 21 CFR Part 58 GLP).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: consent_subject_consent_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to consent.consent_subject_consent. Business justification: GCP audit trails for PK data in regulatory submissions require direct traceability from each PK sample to the subject consent record.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: epoch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.study_epoch. Business justification: PK sampling is epoch-specific (single-dose, multiple-dose, steady-state epochs); NCA and compartmental modeling require epoch-level stratification. SDTM PC domain requires epoch assignment.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: icf_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to consent.consent_icf_version. Business justification: PK sampling requires explicit consent authorization; NDA/BLA regulatory submissions for PK/PD data require traceability to the ICF version authorizing PK sampling.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: manufacture_batch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.manufacture_batch. Business justification: DMPK analysts require direct traceability from PK samples to the IMP manufacture batch administered.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shipment record under which this PK sample was transported to the central or bioanalytical laboratory. Enables chain-of-custody tracking and temperature excursion investigation at the shipment level.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain; ICH M10; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance; ALCOA+

attributes.name: specimen_aliquot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.specimen_aliquot. Business justification: A PK sample is derived from a specific specimen aliquot prepared for pharmacokinetic analysis.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: specimen_id
attributes.description: The internal sample identifier assigned by the bioanalytical or central laboratory upon receipt. Used for cross-referencing between the clinical trial management system and the laboratory information management system (LIMS).
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC.PCREFID; ICH M10; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance; ALCOA+

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study under whose protocol this PK sample was collected. Links the sample to the governing study protocol, sponsor, and regulatory submission context.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM TS Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: study_protocol_amendment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the protocol-defined PK sampling schedule that governs this sample collection event. Links to the schedule definition containing all nominal time points, required volumes, and acceptable windows for the study arm and period.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain; Study Protocol; FDA PK Guidance for Industry

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational site where the PK sample was collected. Used for site-level PK compliance monitoring and logistics tracking.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM SITEID convention; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: study_visit_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.study_visit_schedule. Business justification: PK samples are collected at protocol-defined visit timepoints. Linking pk_sample to study_visit_schedule enables PK sampling window compliance reporting and SDTM PC domain visit
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: subject_randomization_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to randomization.subject_randomization. Business justification: PK sampling schedules are treatment-arm-specific (dose level, nominal timepoints).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: trial_subject_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trial subject (patient) from whom this PK sample was collected. Core party reference linking the sample to the enrolled participant record.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM USUBJID convention; ICH E6(R2); HIPAA 45 CFR §164; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: visit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the scheduled or unscheduled clinical visit during which this PK sample was collected. Enables linkage to visit-level data including dosing records and clinical assessments.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM VISITNUM convention; Oracle Siebel CTMS visit tracking

attributes.name: actual_time_post_dose_hours
attributes.description: Calculated elapsed time in hours between the actual dose administration time and the actual sample collection time. Distinct from nominal_time_hours; used as the primary time variable in PK concentration-time profiles and non-compartmental analysis (NCA).
attributes.references: CDISC ADaM ADPC ATPT variable; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance; ICH E3 Section 11.4

attributes.name: analyte_name
attributes.description: The name of the drug compound, metabolite, or biomarker being measured in this PK sample (e.g., parent compound, active metabolite, total drug). Corresponds to CDISC SDTM PC.PCTEST.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC.PCTEST; WHO-DD; ICH M10; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance

attributes.name: collection_method
attributes.description: The method used to collect the biological sample from the subject. Relevant for bioanalytical method validation and potential pre-analytical variability assessment.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC.PCLOC; ICH M10 Bioanalytical Method Validation; FDA Guidance

attributes.name: collection_timestamp
attributes.description: PK sample collection date/time; implements SDTM PC.PCDTC
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC.PCDTC; ICH E6(R2); FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance; ALCOA+

attributes.name: container_type
attributes.description: The type of collection container or tube used for the PK sample. Determines anticoagulant/additive present, which affects matrix type (plasma vs serum) and bioanalytical method compatibility. Critical for pre-analytical quality control.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC.PCTUBE; ICH M10; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time this PK sample record was first created in the source system (EDC or LIMS). Required for audit trail compliance under 21 CFR Part 11 and ICH E6(R2). Represents the ALCOA+ 'contemporaneous' requirement.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: dose_administration_timestamp
attributes.description: The actual date and time of the reference dose administration used to calculate actual time post-dose for this sample. Sourced from the dosing record in the EDC (Medidata Rave). Required for accurate ATPT calculation per CDISC SDTM PC domain conventions.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC.PCRFTDTC; CDISC SDTM EX Domain; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance

attributes.name: dose_number
attributes.description: The sequential dose number relative to which this PK sample was collected (e.g., 1 for first dose, steady-state dose number). Critical for distinguishing single-dose PK from multiple-dose/steady-state PK profiles in DMPK analysis.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC.PCRFTDTC reference dose; CDISC ADaM ADPC; FDA PK Guidance for Industry

attributes.name: edc_form_reference
attributes.description: The reference identifier of the eCRF form in the EDC system (Medidata Rave) where this PK sample collection event was recorded. Enables direct traceability from the silver-layer data product back to the source EDC record for SDV and audit purposes.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; ALCOA+; Medidata Rave eCRF

attributes.name: exclusion_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason for excluding this PK sample from the primary analysis dataset. Populated only when sample_exclusion_flag is True. Examples include 'Outside sampling window', 'Haemolysed sample', 'Vomiting within 2h of dose', 'Bioanalytical
attributes.references: CDISC ADaM ADPC; FDA PK Guidance for Industry; ICH E9; Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP)

attributes.name: freeze_thaw_cycles
attributes.description: The number of freeze-thaw cycles the PK sample has undergone. Excessive freeze-thaw cycles can degrade analyte stability and invalidate bioanalytical results.
attributes.references: ICH M10 Bioanalytical Method Validation; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018)

attributes.name: lab_receipt_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time the PK sample was received and logged at the bioanalytical or central laboratory. Used to calculate total sample transit time and to verify cold-chain compliance. Part of the chain-of-custody audit trail.
attributes.references: ICH M10 Bioanalytical Method Validation; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: nominal_time_hours
attributes.description: Numeric representation of the nominal time point in hours relative to dose administration (e.g., -0.0833 for pre-dose, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0). Negative values indicate pre-dose collections.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC.PCTPTNUM; CDISC ADaM ADPC; FDA PK Guidance; ICH E3

attributes.name: nominal_time_point
attributes.description: The protocol-specified nominal time point for sample collection relative to dose administration (e.g., 'Pre-dose', '0.5h', '1h', '2h', '4h', '8h', '24h'). Used as the planned time point label in PK analysis and SDTM PC domain mapping.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC.PCTPTNOM; ICH E3 Section 11.4; FDA PK Guidance for Industry

attributes.name: pre_dose_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this sample is a pre-dose (trough/baseline) collection. True = pre-dose sample; False = post-dose sample. Pre-dose samples are used to assess trough concentrations, baseline drug levels, and accumulation ratios in multiple-dose PK
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC.PCTPT; CDISC ADaM ADPC; FDA PK Guidance for Industry

attributes.name: processing_status
attributes.description: Current processing stage of the PK sample from collection through shipment to the bioanalytical laboratory. Distinct from sample_status (overall lifecycle); this tracks the physical processing workflow.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain; ICH M10; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance; ALCOA+

attributes.name: processing_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time the sample was processed (e.g., centrifuged and aliquoted) after collection. Time from collection to processing is a critical pre-analytical variable that can affect analyte stability and bioanalytical results.
attributes.references: ICH M10 Bioanalytical Method Validation; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance; ALCOA+

attributes.name: protocol_deviation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a protocol deviation was associated with this PK sample collection event (e.g., collection outside the acceptable sampling window, incorrect tube used, missed collection). True = deviation present; False = no deviation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.5; FDA Guidance on Protocol Deviations; 21 CFR Part 312; CDISC SDTM DV Domain

attributes.name: sample_code
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique identifier for the PK sample, typically printed on the sample tube label and used across CTMS, LIMS, and bioanalytical systems for chain-of-custody tracking. Corresponds to the specimen barcode or accession number.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC.PCREFID; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: sample_condition_on_receipt
attributes.description: Assessment of the physical condition of the PK sample upon receipt at the bioanalytical laboratory. Conditions such as haemolysis, lipaemia, or temperature excursion may affect analyte measurement and trigger sample rejection or result flagging.
attributes.references: ICH M10 Bioanalytical Method Validation; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance; CDISC SDTM PC Domain

attributes.name: sample_exclusion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this PK sample has been excluded from the primary PK analysis dataset. True = excluded; False = included. Exclusions may be due to protocol deviations, sample integrity issues, or bioanalytical failures.
attributes.references: CDISC ADaM ADPC ANL01FL; FDA PK Guidance for Industry; ICH E9 Statistical Principles

attributes.name: sample_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the PK sample from scheduled collection through bioanalytical reporting. Drives workflow routing in LIMS and CTMS. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain; Medidata Rave specimen workflow; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: sample_type
attributes.description: The biological matrix type of the PK sample. Determines the bioanalytical method applied and the reference range for analyte concentration. Plasma and serum are most common for small molecule PK; urine for renal clearance studies; CSF for CNS penetration
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC.PCSPEC; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); ICH M10

attributes.name: sampling_window_end_hours
attributes.description: The protocol-defined acceptable latest collection time in hours relative to dose for this nominal time point. Together with sampling_window_start_hours, defines the acceptable window for protocol compliance assessment.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain; Study Protocol PK Sampling Schedule; FDA PK Guidance for Industry

attributes.name: sampling_window_start_hours
attributes.description: The protocol-defined acceptable earliest collection time in hours relative to dose for this nominal time point. Used to assess whether the actual collection time falls within the acceptable PK sampling window for protocol compliance determination.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain; Study Protocol PK Sampling Schedule; FDA PK Guidance for Industry

attributes.name: sdtm_domain
attributes.business_glossary_term: CDISC Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM) Domain
attributes.description: Target SDTM domain (PC/PP); implements SDTM Dataset.DOMAIN
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide v3.4; FDA eCTD Technical Specifications; ICH M2

tag_set.value: CDISC Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM) Domain

attributes.name: storage_temperature_c
attributes.description: The temperature in degrees Celsius at which the PK sample is stored prior to shipment or analysis. Critical for analyte stability monitoring; deviations from protocol-specified storage conditions (e.g., -70°C, -20°C) must be documented and assessed for
attributes.references: ICH M10 Bioanalytical Method Validation; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance; ICH Q1A Stability

attributes.name: subject_number
attributes.description: The protocol-assigned subject number (e.g., site-subject identifier such as 001-001) used to identify the participant in regulatory submissions and PK analysis datasets.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM SUBJID; ICH E6(R2); HIPAA 45 CFR §164; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time this PK sample record was most recently modified. Required for audit trail and data integrity monitoring under 21 CFR Part 11 and ICH E6(R2). Used to detect unauthorized or unexplained data changes.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: volume_collected_ml
attributes.description: The actual volume of biological sample collected from the subject, expressed in millilitres. Used for sample sufficiency assessment, bioanalytical aliquoting planning, and protocol compliance verification against the required volume specified in the PK
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC.PCVOL; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance; ICH M10

attributes.name: volume_required_ml
attributes.description: The protocol-specified minimum volume of sample required for the PK assay at this time point, expressed in millilitres. Used to assess whether the collected volume meets protocol requirements and to flag insufficient sample events.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain; Study Protocol PK Sampling Schedule; ICH M10

attributes.name: within_sampling_window
attributes.description: Indicates whether the actual sample collection time falls within the protocol-defined acceptable PK sampling window for this nominal time point. True = within window (compliant); False = outside window (potential protocol deviation).
attributes.references: CDISC ADaM ADPC; FDA PK Guidance for Industry; ICH E3 Section 11.4; 21 CFR Part 312

products.name: bioanalytical_assay
products.description: Master definition of a validated bioanalytical assay used to quantify drug concentrations, biomarkers, or immunogenicity in clinical trial samples. Captures assay name, analyte measured, assay type (LC-MS/MS, ELISA, ECL, PCR, flow cytometry), validation
products.reference: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance 2018; EMA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guideline

attributes.name: bioanalytical_assay_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the bioanalytical assay record in the lakehouse. Primary key. Entity role: MASTER_RESOURCE — represents a validated analytical method owned and managed by the bioanalytical laboratory.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018)

attributes.name: application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.application. Business justification: A bioanalytical assay is developed and validated to measure a specific investigational compound or metabolite (pipeline asset).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: blinding_config_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to randomization.blinding_config. Business justification: GCP requires bioanalytical labs to operate under a defined blinding configuration — unblinded PK labs must be formally designated per blinding_config.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: document_sop_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document_sop. Business justification: GLP/GCP bioanalytical assays must reference their validated method SOP. Regulatory submissions (NDA/BLA bioanalytical section) and FDA/EMA inspections require direct traceability from
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: imp_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.imp_master. Business justification: FDA/EMA bioanalytical method validation guidance requires each validated assay to be linked to the specific IMP it measures.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: investigational_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.investigational_product. Business justification: Bioanalytical assays are validated to measure specific investigational products.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: lab_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.lab_facility. Business justification: A bioanalytical assay is validated and performed at a specific laboratory facility.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: lab_panel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.lab_panel. Business justification: A bioanalytical assay (used for PK/PD/DMPK quantification) is associated with a specific lab panel definition — for example, a PK panel (is_pk_panel=true on lab_panel) maps to the
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: protocol_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.protocol. Business justification: FDA bioanalytical method validation guidance requires protocol-specific assay validation documentation.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the study this record belongs to, for study context and traceability.

attributes.name: study_protocol_amendment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.study_protocol_amendment. Business justification: Protocol amendments frequently trigger new bioanalytical assay versions (new analyte, matrix change, updated LLOQ).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: submission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.submission. Business justification: FDA and EMA require bioanalytical method validation reports in NDA/BLA submissions (FDA Guidance for Industry: Bioanalytical Method Validation).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: validation_tmf_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: Bioanalytical validation reports are TMF documents (DIA TMF Reference Model Zone 3, Section 3.2).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: accuracy_percent
attributes.description: Mean accuracy of the assay expressed as percent of nominal concentration (%Nominal) at QC levels during validation. Regulatory acceptance criterion is typically 85–115% (80–120% at LLOQ). Stored as the worst-case value across QC levels.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Guideline on Bioanalytical Method Validation (2011); ICH M10

attributes.name: analyte_category
attributes.description: Broad classification of the analyte type measured by the assay. Distinguishes small molecule drugs (PK), large molecule biologics, biomarkers (PD), immunogenicity (anti-drug antibodies), metabolites, and endogenous compounds.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Guideline on Bioanalytical Method Validation (2011); ICH M10

attributes.name: analyte_name
attributes.description: Name of the substance being measured by the assay (e.g., drug compound, metabolite, biomarker, anti-drug antibody). Directly links the assay to the pharmacokinetic (PK), pharmacodynamic (PD), or immunogenicity endpoint it supports.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); ICH M10

attributes.name: assay_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric code assigned to the assay by the bioanalytical laboratory or sponsor (e.g., 'BA-LC-001', 'ELISA-TNF-003'). Used as the business identifier across CTMS, EDC, and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Guideline on Bioanalytical Method Validation (2011)

attributes.name: assay_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the bioanalytical assay as used in study protocols, validation reports, and regulatory submissions (e.g., 'LC-MS/MS Assay for Compound XYZ in Human Plasma'). Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE IDENTITY_LABEL category.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); ICH M10 Bioanalytical Method Validation

attributes.name: assay_purpose
attributes.description: Primary scientific purpose the assay serves within the clinical or nonclinical program. PK (Pharmacokinetics) assays measure drug concentration over time; PD (Pharmacodynamics) assays measure biological effect; Immunogenicity assays detect anti-drug
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC/PP Domains; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); ICH M10

attributes.name: assay_type
attributes.description: Analytical technology platform used to perform the assay. Common types include LC-MS/MS (Liquid Chromatography-Tandem Mass Spectrometry), ELISA (Enzyme-Linked Immunosorbent Assay), ECL (Electrochemiluminescence), PCR (Polymerase Chain Reaction), Flow
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Guideline on Bioanalytical Method Validation (2011); ICH M10

attributes.name: calibration_curve_model
attributes.description: Mathematical regression model used to fit the calibration curve for back-calculation of analyte concentrations from instrument response. Common models include Linear (1/x or 1/x² weighting), Quadratic, 4-Parameter Logistic (4PL), and 5-Parameter Logistic
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Guideline on Bioanalytical Method Validation (2011); ICH M10

attributes.name: cdisc_test_code
attributes.description: CDISC test code; implements SDTM PC.PCTESTCD
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; CDISC Controlled Terminology; FDA SDTM Submission Requirements

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the bioanalytical assay record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate) data integrity principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: cut_point_method
attributes.description: Statistical method used to establish the screening and confirmatory cut points for immunogenicity (anti-drug antibody) assays (e.g., 'Parametric 5th percentile', 'Non-parametric 5th percentile').
attributes.references: FDA Immunogenicity Testing Guidance (2019); EMA Guideline on Immunogenicity Assessment; ICH M10

attributes.name: dilution_integrity_factor
attributes.description: Maximum validated dilution factor that can be applied to samples exceeding the ULOQ while maintaining assay accuracy and precision within acceptance criteria. Samples requiring dilution beyond this factor must be flagged.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); ICH M10

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date after which the assay validation is no longer considered current and re-validation or re-qualification is required. Relevant for long-running studies where assay reagents, reference standards, or critical reagents may expire.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Guideline on Bioanalytical Method Validation (2011); ICH M10

attributes.name: gcp_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assay is performed under Good Clinical Practice (GCP) standards as required for clinical trial sample analysis. True = GCP-compliant; False = non-GCP.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Directive 2005/28/EC

attributes.name: glp_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assay was validated and is performed under Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) regulations. GLP compliance is required for nonclinical safety studies submitted to regulatory agencies. True = GLP-compliant; False = non-GLP.
attributes.references: GLP (21 CFR Part 58); OECD Principles of GLP; EMA GLP Directive 2004/10/EC

attributes.name: inter_run_precision_cv
attributes.description: Between-run precision expressed as percent coefficient of variation (%CV) across multiple analytical runs during validation. Regulatory acceptance criterion is typically ≤15% (%CV). Stored as the worst-case value across QC levels.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Guideline on Bioanalytical Method Validation (2011); ICH M10

attributes.name: internal_standard
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the internal standard (IS) used in the assay for quantification normalization (e.g., stable isotope-labeled analog, structural analog).
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); ICH M10

attributes.name: intra_run_precision_cv
attributes.description: Within-run precision expressed as percent coefficient of variation (%CV) at the QC concentration levels, as determined during validation. Regulatory acceptance criterion is typically ≤15% (%CV), or ≤20% at LLOQ.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Guideline on Bioanalytical Method Validation (2011); ICH M10

attributes.name: lloq
attributes.description: Lower Limit of Quantification — the lowest analyte concentration that can be reliably quantified with acceptable accuracy and precision per the validated method. Expressed in the unit defined by lloq_uloq_unit.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Guideline on Bioanalytical Method Validation (2011); ICH M10; CDISC SDTM PC Domain

attributes.name: lloq_uloq_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measurement for the LLOQ and ULOQ values (e.g., 'ng/mL', 'pg/mL', 'µg/mL', 'nM'). Must be consistent with the unit reported in PK/PD concentration data submitted to regulatory agencies.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); ICH M10

attributes.name: long_term_stability_days
attributes.description: Number of days for which analyte stability in the biological matrix at long-term storage conditions (typically -20°C or -70°C) has been validated. Samples stored beyond this period require re-validation of stability before results can be reported.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Guideline on Bioanalytical Method Validation (2011); ICH M10

attributes.name: matrix_effect_assessed
attributes.description: Indicates whether matrix effect (ion suppression/enhancement for LC-MS/MS; non-specific binding for LBA) was formally evaluated during validation. True = matrix effect experiments conducted; False = not assessed.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); ICH M10

attributes.name: matrix_type
attributes.description: Specimen matrix type; implements SDTM PC.PCSPEC (CDISC CT SPECTYPE codelist)
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Guideline on Bioanalytical Method Validation (2011); ICH M10

attributes.name: parallelism_assessed
attributes.description: Indicates whether parallelism (serial dilution of incurred samples producing results parallel to the calibration curve) was assessed. Relevant primarily for LBA and immunogenicity assays. True = parallelism assessed; False = not assessed.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Guideline on Bioanalytical Method Validation (2011); ICH M10

attributes.name: reference_standard_lot
attributes.description: Lot number of the certified reference standard used to prepare calibration standards and quality control (QC) samples. Traceability of the reference standard lot is required for regulatory submissions and audit purposes.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); USP Reference Standards; ICH M10

attributes.name: sample_volume_required_ul
attributes.description: Minimum volume of biological matrix (in microliters) required per sample aliquot for a single assay run. Used for specimen collection planning, biobank management, and feasibility assessment of retrospective analyses.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); ICH M10; CDISC SDTM BS Domain

attributes.name: selectivity_assessed
attributes.description: Indicates whether selectivity (absence of interference from endogenous matrix components) was formally assessed during validation. True = selectivity experiments conducted and documented; False = not assessed.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); ICH M10

attributes.name: species
attributes.description: Biological species for which the assay has been validated. Assays validated in human matrices may differ from those validated in preclinical animal species used in DMPK studies. Drives applicability to clinical vs. nonclinical programs.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); ICH M10; OECD GLP Principles

attributes.name: sponsor_assay_code
attributes.description: Sponsor-assigned identifier for the assay as referenced in the study protocol, the source system, or regulatory submission. May differ from the CRO's internal assay code. Required for cross-referencing sponsor documents with CRO laboratory records.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA IND (21 CFR Part 312); CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: stability_freeze_thaw_cycles
attributes.description: Number of freeze-thaw cycles for which analyte stability in the biological matrix has been validated. Samples subjected to more freeze-thaw cycles than validated must be flagged or excluded from analysis.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Guideline on Bioanalytical Method Validation (2011); ICH M10

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: Required storage temperature and conditions for samples analyzed by this assay (e.g., '-70°C ± 10°C', '-20°C', '2–8°C'). Defines the chain-of-custody storage requirement for clinical samples to maintain analyte integrity.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); ICH M10; ICH Q1A Stability Testing

attributes.name: superseded_by_assay_code
attributes.description: Assay code of the newer version that replaces this assay when it is retired or superseded. Supports version lineage tracking and ensures historical sample results can be linked to the correct assay version.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); ICH M10; ALCOA+

attributes.name: uloq
attributes.description: Upper Limit of Quantification — the highest analyte concentration that can be reliably quantified within the validated dynamic range. Samples above ULOQ must be diluted and re-assayed. Expressed in the unit defined by lloq_uloq_unit.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Guideline on Bioanalytical Method Validation (2011); ICH M10

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the bioanalytical assay record. Required for audit trail compliance under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles. Tracks when assay parameters, validation status, or metadata were last changed.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: validation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the bioanalytical method validation was formally completed and the validation report was approved. Marks the point from which the assay is considered fit for regulated use in clinical sample analysis.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); ICH M10; GLP (21 CFR Part 58)

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Current regulatory validation tier of the assay. 'Validated' indicates full GLP/GCP-compliant validation per FDA/EMA/ICH M10 guidelines; 'Qualified' indicates fit-for-purpose qualification; 'Exploratory' indicates early-phase research use only; 'In
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); EMA Guideline on Bioanalytical Method Validation (2011); ICH M10; GLP (21 CFR Part 58)

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier of the assay method (e.g., 'v1.0', 'v2.1'). Incremented when the assay undergoes method changes requiring partial or full re-validation. Enables traceability of which assay version was used for each study's sample analysis.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); ICH M10; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: weighting_factor
attributes.description: Statistical weighting factor applied to the calibration curve regression to minimize heteroscedasticity (e.g., '1/x', '1/x²', 'none'). Documented in the validation report and applied consistently during sample analysis.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance (2018); ICH M10

products.name: bioanalytical_result
products.description: Transactional record of a bioanalytical or biomarker assay result from a clinical trial PK/PD, DMPK, or exploratory biomarker sample. Captures assay run ID, sample ID, analyte/biomarker measured, concentration or categorical result value, unit/scale
products.reference: CDISC SDTM PC Domain; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance

attributes.name: bioanalytical_result_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each bioanalytical or biomarker assay result record in the clinical trial laboratory data product. Serves as the primary key for the silver-layer lakehouse table.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC/PP Domain; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: arm_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.study_arm. Business justification: PK/PD exposure analysis by treatment arm is a core pharmacokinetic reporting requirement. Arm-level PK parameter comparisons (e.g., AUC, Cmax by dose group) are required for regulatory
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: bioanalytical_assay_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.bioanalytical_assay. Business justification: A bioanalytical result is produced by executing a specific validated bioanalytical assay.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: compliance_sop_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_sop. Business justification: Bioanalytical result generation, review, and reporting must follow compliance SOPs (ICH M10 Section 7).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: consent_subject_consent_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to consent.subject_consent. Business justification: Bioanalytical data sharing with third parties (CROs, partners, regulators) requires subject consent verification.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: database_lock_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to biostatistics.database_lock_event. Business justification: Bioanalytical results are subject to database lock for PK analysis datasets.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: epoch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.study_epoch. Business justification: PK/PD results must be epoch-stratified for NCA (single-dose vs steady-state epochs) and SDTM PC domain mapping.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: icf_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to consent.consent_icf_version. Business justification: Bioanalytical results (drug concentration data) submitted in NDA/BLA packages must be traceable to the ICF version authorizing PK/PD sampling.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: lab_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.lab_facility. Business justification: A bioanalytical result is generated at a specific laboratory facility. The existing laboratory_code STRING column is a denormalized reference to lab_facility.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: manufacture_batch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.manufacture_batch. Business justification: FDA/EMA bioanalytical method validation guidance requires traceability from drug concentration results to the specific IMP manufacture batch.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: pk_sample_id
attributes.description: Reference to the biological specimen record from which this assay result was derived. Supports chain-of-custody traceability from collection through analysis.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain PCREFID; 21 CFR Part 58 (GLP)

attributes.name: protocol_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.protocol. Business justification: Bioanalytical results require protocol-level traceability for NDA/BLA regulatory submissions (SDTM PC/PP domains). bioanalytical_result has study_id but not protocol_id.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: sap_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to biostatistics.pk_analysis_spec. Business justification: Bioanalytical results are processed into PK parameters according to a specific PK analysis spec (LLOQ handling, NCA rules, exclusion criteria).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: specimen_aliquot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.specimen_aliquot. Business justification: A bioanalytical result (PK/PD/DMPK) is produced from a specific specimen aliquot.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study (protocol) under which this bioanalytical result was generated. Links the result to the governing protocol, sponsor, and regulatory context.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: study_protocol_amendment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.study_protocol_amendment. Business justification: Bioanalytical results must reference the protocol amendment version active at analysis time for NDA/BLA submission traceability (SDTM PC domain).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_visit_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.study_visit_schedule. Business justification: PK/PD bioanalytical results must be mapped to protocol-defined sampling visits for SDTM PC/PP domain generation and NCA analysis.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: subject_randomization_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to randomization.subject_randomization. Business justification: PK/bioanalytical analysis (NCA, population PK, exposure-response) requires treatment arm and dose level from randomization.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: trial_subject_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trial subject (participant) from whom the bioanalytical sample was collected. Enables subject-level PK/PD profiling and safety linkage.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP; HIPAA

attributes.name: actual_time_point
attributes.description: The actual elapsed time (in hours post-dose) at which the sample was collected, calculated from the dose administration timestamp and sample collection timestamp. Used in non-compartmental and compartmental PK analysis.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain; FDA PK Guidance; ICH E14

attributes.name: analysis_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the bioanalytical assay was performed and the result was generated by the laboratory instrument or system. Distinct from collection timestamp; used for audit trail and turnaround time tracking.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance 2018

attributes.name: assay_platform
attributes.description: Analytical technology platform used to generate this result. Determines method-specific acceptance criteria and regulatory validation requirements. Values include LC-MS/MS (liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry), ELISA, ECL
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance 2018; EMA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guideline 2011; ICH Q2(R1)

attributes.name: assay_run_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned by the bioanalytical laboratory to the analytical run (batch) in which this sample was processed. Used to link results to calibration curve and QC sample performance for the run. Maps to PCRUNID in CDISC SDTM PC domain.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain PCRUNID; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance 2018; EMA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guideline 2011

attributes.name: calibration_curve_accepted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the calibration curve for the analytical run met pre-defined acceptance criteria (e.g., ≥75% of calibrators within ±15% of nominal, ±20% at LLOQ). A failed calibration curve invalidates all results from the run.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance 2018; EMA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guideline 2011

attributes.name: categorical_result
attributes.description: Qualitative or categorical result for assays that produce non-numeric outcomes (e.g., POSITIVE/NEGATIVE for immunogenicity, BELOW_LLOQ for concentrations below the lower limit of quantification). Null when numeric_result is populated.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain PCSTRESC; FDA Immunogenicity Guidance 2019

attributes.name: collection_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the biological sample was collected from the subject. The principal real-world event time for this bioanalytical result record. Maps to PCDTC in CDISC SDTM PC domain. Conforms to ISO 8601 format.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain PCDTC; ISO 8601; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this bioanalytical result record was first created in the system of record. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: dilution_factor
attributes.description: The dilution factor applied to the sample prior to analysis when the original concentration exceeded the ULOQ. The reported result incorporates this factor. Maps to PCDILIND/PCDILUTN in CDISC SDTM PC domain.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain PCDILUTN; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance 2018

attributes.name: exclusion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this result has been excluded from the primary PK/PD analysis dataset (e.g., due to protocol deviation, sample integrity issue, or statistical outlier determination per the Statistical Analysis Plan).
attributes.references: CDISC ADaM ADPC; ICH E9(R1) Statistical Principles; FDA PK Guidance

attributes.name: exclusion_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason for excluding this result from the PK/PD analysis dataset. Required when exclusion_flag is true. Examples: 'Sample collected outside protocol window', 'Hemolyzed sample', 'Calibration curve failure', 'Subject vomited within 2
attributes.references: CDISC ADaM ADPC; ICH E9(R1); FDA PK Guidance; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: freeze_thaw_cycles
attributes.description: Number of freeze-thaw cycles the sample underwent prior to analysis. Stability data from method validation defines the maximum allowable cycles; exceedance may invalidate the result.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance 2018; EMA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guideline 2011

attributes.name: isr_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this sample was selected for Incurred Sample Reanalysis (ISR), a regulatory requirement to demonstrate reproducibility of results in authentic study samples. ISR is mandatory for pivotal PK studies submitted to FDA and EMA.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance 2018; EMA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guideline 2011; Crystal City IV Workshop

attributes.name: isr_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the Incurred Sample Reanalysis (ISR) assessment. PASS indicates the original and repeat results agree within ±20% of their mean for ≥67% of ISR samples. FAIL triggers investigation. NOT_APPLICABLE when isr_flag is false.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance 2018; EMA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guideline 2011

attributes.name: lloq
attributes.description: The lowest concentration of analyte in a sample that can be quantitatively determined with acceptable precision and accuracy for this validated method and run. Used to flag results as BLQ (below limit of quantification).
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain PCLLOQ; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance 2018; EMA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guideline 2011

attributes.name: matrix_type
attributes.description: Type of biological matrix from which the sample was derived and analyzed. Determines applicable method validation parameters and reference ranges. Maps to PCSPEC in CDISC SDTM PC domain.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain PCSPEC; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance 2018

attributes.name: nominal_time_point
attributes.description: The protocol-specified time point (in hours post-dose) at which the sample was scheduled to be collected (e.g., 0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 4.0, 8.0, 24.0). Used as the reference for PK modeling and deviation calculation. Maps to PCTPTNUM in CDISC SDTM PC domain.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain PCTPTNUM; ICH E14; FDA PK Guidance

attributes.name: numeric_result
attributes.description: Numeric result; implements SDTM PC.PCSTRESN
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain PCSTRESN; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance 2018

attributes.name: qc_sample_performance
attributes.description: Overall acceptance outcome for the QC samples (low, medium, high QC) within the analytical run. PASS indicates ≥67% of QC samples within ±15% of nominal with at least 50% at each level passing. FAIL invalidates the run. MARGINAL triggers scientific review.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance 2018; EMA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guideline 2011; ICH Q2(R1)

attributes.name: result_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the bioanalytical result type: PK_CONCENTRATION (pharmacokinetic drug/metabolite concentration), BIOMARKER (pharmacodynamic or disease biomarker), IMMUNOGENICITY (anti-drug antibody or neutralizing antibody), EXPLORATORY
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC/PP Domains; ICH E16 Biomarker Qualification; FDA Biomarker Guidance

attributes.name: result_comment
attributes.description: Free-text comment entered by the bioanalytical scientist or laboratory reviewer providing additional context for the result (e.g., instrument flags, unusual chromatography, sample appearance notes). Maps to PCORRES or PCCOMMENT in CDISC SDTM PC domain.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: result_reported_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the validated bioanalytical result was formally reported and released by the laboratory to the sponsor or data management team. Marks the transition from laboratory-internal to reportable status.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: result_status
attributes.description: Current disposition status of the bioanalytical result indicating whether it is reportable for inclusion in the clinical database, requires repeat analysis, or has been invalidated. Drives data flow into EDC and CDISC SDTM datasets.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance 2018; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: result_unit
attributes.description: Result unit; implements SDTM PC.PCSTRESU (CDISC CT UNIT codelist)
attributes.references: CDISC Controlled Terminology UNIT; CDISC SDTM PC Domain PCSTRESU; SI Units

attributes.name: sample_stability_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the sample met stability criteria at the time of analysis based on validated short-term, long-term, and freeze-thaw stability data. False indicates a potential stability failure that may affect result validity.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance 2018; EMA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guideline 2011

attributes.name: sdtm_domain
attributes.description: Target SDTM domain (PC); implements SDTM Dataset.DOMAIN
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3; FDA eCTD Submission Standards; EMA CDISC Requirements

attributes.name: subject_number
attributes.description: Human-readable subject identifier (e.g., site-subject number such as 001-001) used in the clinical trial. Distinct from the surrogate subject_id; used for cross-system reconciliation and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DM Domain USUBJID; ICH E6(R2); HIPAA Safe Harbor

attributes.name: time_deviation_hours
attributes.description: Deviation of the actual sample collection time from the nominal protocol-specified time point, expressed in hours (actual minus nominal). Positive values indicate late collection; negative values indicate early collection.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA PK Guidance

attributes.name: uloq
attributes.description: The highest concentration of analyte in a sample that can be quantitatively determined with acceptable precision and accuracy for this validated method and run. Results above ULOQ require dilution and re-analysis.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance 2018; EMA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guideline 2011

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this bioanalytical result record. Required for audit trail compliance and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks silver layer.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

products.name: lab_kit
products.description: Master record for laboratory collection kits supplied to clinical sites for specimen collection. Captures kit type, kit lot number, components list (tubes, containers, preservatives, requisition forms), storage requirements, expiry date, kit version, and
products.reference: CDISC SDTM SD Domain; GCP ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: lab_kit_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the laboratory collection kit master record. Primary key for the lab_kit entity.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: clinical_trial_authorization_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.clinical_trial_authorization. Business justification: EU CTAs and substantial modifications must list investigational medicinal product (IMP) and ancillary material kits.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: document_sop_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document_sop. Business justification: Lab kits must be assembled, labeled, and distributed per specific SOPs governing kit preparation and handling. GCP requires kit handling procedures to be documented and traceable.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: epoch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.epoch. Business justification: Lab kits are epoch-specific (screening kits, treatment kits, follow-up kits have different components and expiry requirements).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: lab_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.lab_facility. Business justification: A laboratory collection kit is supplied by and associated with a specific central laboratory facility. The central_lab_code STRING column is a denormalized reference to lab_facility.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: lab_panel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the laboratory panel definition that this kit is designed to support. Ensures correct collection materials are used per protocol-specified assays.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM LB domain; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: protocol_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.protocol. Business justification: Lab kits are designed and versioned per protocol specification (tube types, volumes, handling instructions).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: regulatory_protocol_amendment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.regulatory_protocol_amendment. Business justification: Regulatory protocol amendments that change specimen collection procedures (tube type, volume, timing) require new lab kit versions.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study for which this kit is designated. Links the kit to a specific protocol and sponsor.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical site to which this kit is assigned or shipped. Supports site-level inventory tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: treatment_arm_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to randomization.treatment_arm. Business justification: Lab kits are designed and assigned per treatment arm — active arm kits may require different tube types, volumes, or preservatives than placebo arm kits.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which the kit design and components list was formally approved by the sponsor or quality team for use in the study. Supports audit trail and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11; MasterControl QMS; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: biohazard_classification
attributes.description: IATA/UN biohazard classification for shipping the collected specimen (Category A UN2814, Category B UN3373, Exempt). Determines packaging and shipping documentation requirements for specimen transport.
attributes.references: IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations P650; UN Model Regulations; WHO Guidance on Regulations for the Transport of Infectious Substances

attributes.name: cdisc_lbspec_code
attributes.description: CDISC specimen type code; implements SDTM LB.LBSPEC (CDISC CT SPECTYPE codelist)
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; CDISC Controlled Terminology; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide

attributes.name: collection_timepoint
attributes.description: Specific timepoint within a visit at which the specimen should be collected (e.g., pre-dose, 1h post-dose, 4h post-dose). Particularly relevant for PK/PD sampling schedules.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM LBTPTNUM; ICH E6(R2); FDA Bioanalytical Method Guidance

attributes.name: components_description
attributes.description: Free-text or structured description of all components included in the kit (e.g., EDTA tubes, serum separator tubes, cryovials, dry ice packs, biohazard bags, requisition forms, instruction leaflets). Supports site training and deviation investigation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ISO 15189; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the lab kit master record was first created in the system. Part of the mandatory audit trail for GCP compliance and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date after which the kit must not be used for specimen collection. Expiry is driven by the stability of collection tubes, preservatives, and reagents. Sites must discard or return kits past this date.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ISO 15189; 21 CFR Part 211; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: fasting_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject must be fasting prior to specimen collection using this kit. Fasting status affects reference ranges and result interpretation for metabolic and lipid panels.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM LBFAST; ICH E6(R2); ISO 15189

attributes.name: is_ancillary_kit
attributes.description: Indicates whether this kit is an ancillary/backup kit (True) rather than a primary protocol-required kit (False). Ancillary kits are used for repeat collections or unscheduled assessments.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: kit_category
attributes.description: Functional category of the kit indicating the scientific purpose of the specimen collection (e.g., Pharmacokinetics (PK), Pharmacodynamics (PD), safety labs, biomarker, genetic). Aligns kit to the study's analytical objectives.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM LBCAT; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: kit_label_language
attributes.description: ISO 639 language code for the primary language of the kit label and instruction leaflet (e.g., en, fr, de, ja). Ensures regulatory compliance for multi-country trials requiring local language labelling.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; PMDA; Health Canada; ICH E6(R2); ISO 639

attributes.name: kit_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric identifier assigned to the kit, typically printed on the kit label and used for chain-of-custody tracking. Corresponds to the kit barcode or label ID in RTSM/IRT systems such as Medidata Rave RTSM.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: kit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the kit. Drives inventory management workflows and ensures expired or quarantined kits are not used for specimen collection. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: available|assigned|shipped|received|used|expired|quarantined|destroyed|returned —
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: kit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the kit by specimen matrix type (e.g., blood, urine, tissue). Determines the collection containers and preservatives included. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: blood|urine|saliva|tissue|csf|stool|buccal_swab|plasma|serum|other — promote to reference
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM LBSPEC; ISO 15189

attributes.name: kit_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the kit design or configuration. Used to track protocol amendments that change collection requirements, ensuring sites use the correct kit version per the current protocol.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: lab_accreditation_standard
attributes.description: Accreditation standard under which the central laboratory processing specimens from this kit is certified (e.g., ISO 15189, CAP, CLIA, GCLP). Required for regulatory submissions and sponsor quality oversight.
attributes.references: ISO 15189; CAP; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; GCLP Guidelines; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Manufacturing lot number assigned by the kit supplier or central laboratory. Enables traceability for quality investigations, recalls, and regulatory inspections. Critical for ALCOA+ compliance.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 15189

attributes.name: manufacture_date
attributes.description: Date on which the kit was manufactured or assembled by the supplier. Used in conjunction with expiry date to calculate shelf life and manage inventory rotation.
attributes.references: ISO 15189; 21 CFR Part 211; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: preservative_type
attributes.description: Type of preservative or additive included in the kit (e.g., EDTA, heparin, sodium fluoride, formalin, RNAlater). Critical for specimen stability and downstream analytical method compatibility.
attributes.references: ISO 15189; CLSI; CDISC SDTM LBMETHOD

attributes.name: protocol_visit_reference
attributes.description: Protocol-defined visit name or visit window for which this kit is intended (e.g., Screening, Day 1, Week 4). Ensures the correct kit type is used at the correct study visit per the protocol schedule of assessments.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC SDTM VISITNUM; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: quantity_per_shipment
attributes.description: Standard number of kits included in a single shipment to a site. Used for supply planning, purchase order generation, and site inventory management.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); SAP S/4HANA Supply Chain; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: reorder_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum quantity of kits at a site below which a resupply order should be triggered. Supports proactive inventory management to prevent site stock-outs.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Oracle Siebel CTMS; SAP S/4HANA

attributes.name: requisition_form_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether a laboratory requisition form (paper or pre-printed label) is included in the kit. Requisition forms are required by central labs for specimen processing and chain-of-custody documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ISO 15189; ALCOA+

attributes.name: return_kit_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the used kit or residual materials must be returned to the central laboratory or sponsor after specimen collection. Relevant for chain-of-custody and waste management compliance.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ISO 15189; IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: Categorical storage condition required for the kit (e.g., refrigerated 2–8°C, frozen −20°C, room temperature). Complements the numeric temperature range with a human-readable label for site staff.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ISO 15189; IATA P650

attributes.name: storage_temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum allowable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for the kit. Used alongside minimum temperature to define the acceptable storage range and trigger excursion alerts.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ISO 15189; IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations

attributes.name: storage_temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum allowable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for the kit. Ensures cold-chain integrity and preservative efficacy. Deviations must be documented per GCP.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ISO 15189; IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations

attributes.name: supplier_kit_catalog_number
attributes.description: Supplier's own catalog or part number for this kit configuration. Used for reordering, purchase orders in the source system supplier quality documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Procurement; ISO 15189; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: supplier_name
attributes.description: Name of the vendor or central laboratory that manufactured and supplied the kit. Used for procurement, quality investigations, and supplier qualification tracking.
