attributes.references: CDISC SDTM SA domain (SAVOL); FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance; ISO 15189

attributes.name: volume_sufficient_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the remaining aliquot volume is sufficient to complete the assigned assay or testing requirement. Drives re-collection or backup aliquot retrieval workflows.
attributes.references: FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ISO 15189

attributes.name: volume_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the aliquot volume. Typically mL for liquid specimens; mg or g for tissue aliquots.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM SA domain; UCUM (Unified Code for Units of Measure); ISO 15189

products.name: protocol_lab_schedule
products.description: Master definition of the protocol-mandated laboratory assessment schedule for a study, mapping each study visit to required lab panels. Captures study ID, visit name/number, visit window (day range), required lab panels, optional panels, fasting
products.reference: CDISC SDTM TS/TV Domains; ICH E6(R2) Protocol Requirements

attributes.name: protocol_lab_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each protocol-mandated laboratory assessment schedule record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: arm_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.arm. Business justification: Protocol lab schedules are frequently arm-specific in multi-arm studies (e.g., PK panels only in treatment arm, different safety panels per dose level).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: clinical_trial_authorization_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.clinical_trial_authorization. Business justification: EU CTAs explicitly authorize the assessment schedule including lab assessments per visit.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: compliance_sop_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_sop. Business justification: Protocol lab schedules define GCP-required assessments; their implementation must comply with SOPs governing collection windows, fasting requirements, and result turnaround.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: epoch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.study_epoch. Business justification: Lab schedules are organized by study epoch (screening, treatment, follow-up); linking to epoch enables epoch-level lab requirement reporting, SDTM TE domain mapping, and protocol schedule
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: lab_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.lab_facility. Business justification: A protocol lab schedule entry designates whether central or local lab is required (central_lab_required, local_lab_allowed flags exist).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: lab_panel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the laboratory panel (e.g., hematology, chemistry, urinalysis, PK/PD, DMPK) required or optionally collected at this visit per the protocol schedule.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM LB domain; LOINC

attributes.name: protocol_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.protocol. Business justification: Protocol lab schedules are defined per protocol version; regulatory submissions and protocol compliance audits require tracing which lab panels were mandated by which protocol version.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: regulatory_protocol_amendment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.protocol_amendment. Business justification: Protocol amendments frequently change lab assessment schedules (adding/removing panels, changing timepoints).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study for which this laboratory assessment schedule is defined. Links to the master study record.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM TA domain

attributes.name: treatment_arm_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to randomization.treatment_arm. Business justification: Protocol lab schedules are arm-specific in clinical trials — different treatment arms require different panels, collection windows, and processing requirements.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: backup_sample_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a backup or reserve aliquot must be collected and stored alongside the primary specimen for potential future analysis (e.g., for biomarker or pharmacogenomics research).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); study laboratory manual

attributes.name: central_lab_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this laboratory assessment must be performed at the central laboratory (as opposed to a local laboratory). Drives specimen shipment logistics and result routing.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR 312

attributes.name: collection_time_constraint
attributes.description: Time-of-day or dose-relative constraint for specimen collection at this visit (e.g., pre-dose, post-dose, morning only, timed serial PK sampling). Critical for PK/PD and DMPK assessments.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC/PP domains; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: collection_time_offset_hours
attributes.description: Nominal time offset in hours relative to dose administration for post-dose or timed serial specimen collection (e.g., 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8, 24 hours post-dose). Applicable primarily to PK/PD and DMPK assessments.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC domain; FDA Guidance on PK Studies

attributes.name: collection_time_window_minutes
attributes.description: Acceptable deviation window in minutes around the nominal collection time offset for timed specimen collection. Used to assess protocol deviations for PK/PD sampling.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC domain; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: collection_tube_type
attributes.description: Type of collection tube or container required for specimen collection (e.g., EDTA, SST, lithium heparin, sodium citrate, PAXgene). Drives specimen collection kit configuration and laboratory processing instructions.
attributes.references: CLSI GP41; study laboratory manual

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this protocol laboratory schedule record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ICH E6(R2) GCP.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: critical_result_review_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether results from this laboratory assessment require expedited medical review upon receipt of a critical or panic value. Triggers safety review workflows and potential SAE/SUSAR reporting obligations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR 312.32; CTCAE

attributes.name: edc_form_name
attributes.description: Name of the eCRF form in Medidata Rave that corresponds to this laboratory assessment at this visit. Used to drive EDC study build configuration and eCRF lab page activation.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave EDC; CDISC ODM

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this laboratory schedule entry is effective, typically aligned with the protocol version approval date or protocol amendment effective date.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR 312.23

attributes.name: fasting_duration_hours_min
attributes.description: Minimum number of hours the subject must fast prior to specimen collection when fasting is required. Null when fasting_required is false.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); study protocol schedule of assessments

attributes.name: fasting_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject must be in a fasted state prior to specimen collection for this laboratory assessment at this visit. Drives subject instructions and site collection procedures.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC SDTM LB.LBFAST

attributes.name: is_exploratory
attributes.description: Indicates whether this laboratory assessment is an exploratory or research-use-only endpoint not included in the primary or secondary efficacy analyses. Supports data management and the source system
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: is_pd_assessment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this laboratory assessment is a pharmacodynamic (PD) biomarker collection. Supports differentiation of PD endpoints from standard safety laboratory panels.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM LB/MB domains; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: is_pk_assessment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this laboratory assessment is a pharmacokinetic (PK) or DMPK sample collection. When true, timed serial collection rules and PK-specific processing instructions apply.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC domain; FDA Guidance on PK Studies; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: is_safety_assessment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this laboratory assessment is designated as a safety laboratory panel per the protocol. Safety assessments trigger critical value review workflows and DSMB/DMC reporting obligations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR 312.32; CTCAE

attributes.name: local_lab_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether results from a local (site) laboratory are acceptable for this assessment, either as a primary result or as a backup when central lab results are unavailable.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); study laboratory manual

attributes.name: panel_requirement
attributes.description: Indicates whether the laboratory panel is mandatory (required), optional, conditional on a clinical trigger, restricted to the PK cohort, or applicable only to a defined subject subset per the protocol schedule of assessments.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC SDTM LB domain

attributes.name: processing_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the specimen requires on-site processing (e.g., centrifugation, aliquoting) prior to shipment to the central laboratory. Drives site laboratory capability requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); study laboratory manual

attributes.name: repeat_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a repeat specimen collection is permitted at this visit if the initial sample is insufficient, haemolysed, or otherwise unacceptable. Drives site instructions and EDC query management.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: result_turnaround_days
attributes.description: Expected number of calendar days from specimen receipt at the laboratory to result reporting. Used for monitoring visit planning, data management timelines, and SLA tracking with the central laboratory.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); central laboratory service agreement

attributes.name: schedule_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or footnotes from the protocol schedule of assessments providing additional instructions, conditional collection rules, or clarifications for this laboratory assessment at this visit.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); study protocol schedule of assessments

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this protocol laboratory schedule entry. Reflects whether the schedule is in draft, active per the current protocol version, amended, superseded by a protocol amendment, or retired.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR 312; Veeva Vault document lifecycle

attributes.name: sdtm_domain
attributes.description: Target SDTM domain; implements SDTM Dataset.DOMAIN
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; FDA eCTD submission requirements

attributes.name: shipment_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which specimens collected at this visit should be shipped to the central laboratory (e.g., immediate same-day shipment for PK samples, weekly batch shipment for routine safety labs).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); study laboratory manual; IATA P650

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: Native identifier of this laboratory schedule record in the originating operational system (e.g., the source system assessment ID, Medidata Rave form OID). Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and audit traceability in the Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: specimen_type
attributes.description: Type of biological specimen required for this laboratory panel at this visit (e.g., blood, urine, plasma, serum, CSF). Drives specimen collection kit configuration and chain of custody planning.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM LB.LBSPEC; ISBER Best Practices

attributes.name: specimen_volume_ml
attributes.description: Volume of biological specimen in millilitres required for this laboratory panel assessment. Used for specimen collection planning, blood volume burden calculations, and supply chain management.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); study protocol schedule of assessments

attributes.name: storage_temperature
attributes.description: Required storage temperature condition for the specimen prior to shipment or analysis (e.g., ambient, refrigerated 2-8°C, frozen -20°C, frozen -80°C, liquid nitrogen). Drives cold chain logistics and supply chain management.
attributes.references: ISBER Best Practices; IATA P650; study laboratory manual

attributes.name: study_day_target
attributes.description: The nominal study day on which this visit and laboratory assessment is scheduled relative to the reference start date (Day 1 = first dose). Negative values indicate pre-dose screening days. Aligns with CDISC SDTM study day conventions.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM General Observation Class; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: subject_population
attributes.description: Defines which subject population is required to undergo this laboratory assessment at the specified visit. Supports PK cohort-specific sampling, sentinel cohort rules, and expansion cohort differentiation as defined in the protocol.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs

attributes.name: superseded_date
attributes.description: Date on which this laboratory schedule entry was superseded by a protocol amendment or replaced by a new schedule version. Null for currently active entries.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR 312

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this protocol laboratory schedule record was last modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail requirements, and Silver Layer incremental load processing.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: visit_name
attributes.description: Visit name; implements SDTM --VISIT
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM TV domain; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: visit_num
attributes.description: Visit number; implements SDTM --VISITNUM
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM TV.VISITNUM; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: visit_type
attributes.description: Visit type; implements SDTM TV/SV visit metadata (CDISC CT visit-type codelist)
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM TV domain; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: visit_window_day_max
attributes.description: Latest allowable study day (relative to target study day) for the visit window, defining the acceptable upper bound for specimen collection. Used for protocol deviation assessment and site monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5; FDA 21 CFR 312

attributes.name: visit_window_day_min
attributes.description: Earliest allowable study day (relative to target study day) for the visit window, defining the acceptable lower bound for specimen collection. Used for protocol deviation assessment and site monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5; FDA 21 CFR 312

products.name: panel_capability
products.description: This association product represents the accreditation and capability relationship between lab_panel and lab_facility. It captures which laboratory facilities are validated, accredited, and operationally capable of performing which test panels.
products.reference: Internal - M:N Association

attributes.name: panel_capability_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for this panel capability record. Primary key for the association.

attributes.name: lab_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the laboratory facility that holds the capability to perform the panel
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: lab_panel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the laboratory test panel that this capability record authorizes the facility to perform
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: accreditation_certificate_number
attributes.description: Certificate or approval number issued by the accrediting body specifically for this panel at this facility. Some panels require separate accreditation beyond general facility accreditation.

attributes.name: accreditation_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the panel-specific accreditation at this facility. Triggers reaccreditation workflows and specimen routing changes.

attributes.name: accreditation_status
attributes.description: Current accreditation status of this facility for this specific panel. Tracks whether the facility holds valid regulatory accreditation to perform this panel per CLIA/CAP/ISO 15189 requirements.
attributes.references: CLIA/CAP/ISO 15189

attributes.name: capability_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of this panel capability at this facility. Controls whether specimens for this panel can be routed to this facility.

attributes.name: capacity_per_day
attributes.description: Maximum number of specimens for this panel that this facility can process per day. Used for capacity planning and specimen distribution across network facilities.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this panel capability record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and capability history tracking.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this facility is no longer authorized to perform this panel. May be due to accreditation expiry, contract termination, or facility decommissioning.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this facility is authorized and operationally capable of performing this panel. Used for specimen routing decisions and study startup planning.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this panel capability record. Tracks changes to accreditation status, capacity, or turnaround time commitments.

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the panel-specific contact at this facility. Used for operational communications regarding this panel.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the laboratory scientist or technical lead at this facility responsible for this panel. Used for technical queries and result clarifications.

attributes.name: turnaround_time_hours
attributes.description: Contractually committed turnaround time in hours from specimen receipt to result reporting for this panel at this facility. Used for SLA monitoring and site selection.

attributes.name: validation_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when method validation for this panel was completed at this facility. Required for regulatory inspection readiness and audit trail.

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Status of analytical method validation for this panel at this facility per ICH M10 and FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation guidance. Tracks facility-specific validation lifecycle.
attributes.references: ICH M10, FDA BMV

domains.name: supply
domains.description: Manages investigational medicinal product (IMP) and clinical supply chain operations. Owns drug supply planning, depot and site inventory, randomization kits, dispensing records via RTSM (Medidata Rave), expiry management, returns and destruction
domains.references: ICH Q10; EU GMP Annex 13; CDISC SDTM EX Domain; GCP Supply Management

products.name: imp_master
products.description: Master record for all investigational and comparator products used in clinical trials, including sponsor IMPs, active comparators, and placebos. Captures product identity, product type (IMP/comparator/placebo), formulation details, dosage form, strength
products.reference: IMP (Investigational Medicinal Product)

attributes.name: imp_master_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each investigational medicinal product master record within the supply domain. Serves as the primary key for all downstream supply chain, dispensing, and accountability references.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.application. Business justification: IMP master records are the physical supply representation of a sponsor's pipeline asset.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: audit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.audit. Business justification: IMP-specific audits (manufacturer qualification audit, comparator sourcing audit, biological product audit) are conducted against specific investigational medicinal products.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: compliance_sop_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_sop. Business justification: The current approved Investigator's Brochure and IMP labeling document are directly associated with each investigational product.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: health_authority_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.special_designation. Business justification: Orphan drug, breakthrough therapy, and fast-track designations directly affect IMP supply strategy — expedited supply timelines, special labeling requirements, and fee waivers.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: ind_application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.ind_application. Business justification: IND/IMPD covers the investigational product — regulatory affairs and supply teams must verify IND status before manufacturing and releasing IMP.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: investigational_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.investigational_product. Business justification: GMP/GCP batch release and IND/IMPD regulatory submissions require traceability from supply-domain IMP master records to the protocol-registered investigational product.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: regulatory_binder_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.regulatory_binder. Business justification: IMP master records are directly associated with regulatory submissions (IND/IMPD/CTA). imp_master has ind_impd_reference as plain text.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the study this record belongs to.

attributes.name: tmf_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: IMPD/IND dossiers and GMP certificates are ICH GCP essential TMF documents directly associated with each IMP master record.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: active_substance_name
attributes.description: International Nonproprietary Name (INN) or chemical name of the active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) contained in the IMP. Used for regulatory submissions, pharmacovigilance coding, and WHO-DD cross-referencing.
attributes.references: WHO INN Programme; EMA IMPD Guideline; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: atc_code
attributes.description: WHO Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical (ATC) classification code assigned to the active substance. Used for pharmacovigilance signal detection, WHO-DD cross-referencing, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: WHO ATC/DDD Index; WHO-DD; EMA IMPD Guideline

attributes.name: blinding_type
attributes.description: Blinding configuration applicable to this IMP within the trial design: open-label (all parties know treatment), single-blind (subject blinded), double-blind (subject and investigator blinded), or triple-blind (subject, investigator, and sponsor blinded).
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Guidance on Blinding

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the IMP master record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements under ALCOA+ principles, 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance, and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ (Attributable Legible Contemporaneous Original Accurate); ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: destruction_method
attributes.description: Approved method for destruction of unused, expired, or returned IMP. Required for accountability reconciliation, environmental compliance, and regulatory documentation of drug disposition.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; EMA IMPD Guideline; EPA Hazardous Waste Regulations

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the IMP was formally discontinued from use in clinical trials. Populated when product_status transitions to 'discontinued'. Used for supply chain close-out, accountability reconciliation, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; EMA IMPD Guideline

attributes.name: dispensing_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measure used for dispensing the IMP to subjects at the site level (e.g., kit, vial, tablet, capsule). Aligns with RTSM dispensing records and site accountability logs.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; CDISC SDTM EX Domain; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: dosage_form
attributes.description: Physical form of the IMP as administered to subjects (e.g., tablet, capsule, injection, infusion, patch, oral solution). Drives dispensing instructions, packaging requirements, and cold-chain logistics.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM CM Domain; FDA Dosage Form Terminology; EMA IMPD Guideline

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this IMP master record version is considered authoritative and approved for use in supply planning and dispensing. Supports version control and regulatory compliance for product specification changes.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA IMPD Guideline; ALCOA+

attributes.name: formulation_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the IMP formulation including excipients, concentration, and any special formulation characteristics (e.g., modified-release, lyophilised). Sourced from sponsor-provided specifications and IMPD.
attributes.references: EMA IMPD Guideline; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; ICH Q8

attributes.name: gmp_certificate_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the GMP certificate issued by the relevant regulatory authority for the manufacturing site producing this IMP. Required for regulatory submissions, batch release, and inspection readiness.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; EMA GMP Guidelines (EudraLex Vol. 4); ICH Q7

attributes.name: impd_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the IMPD or IND module that governs the current specifications for this IMP. Ensures traceability between the product master record and the regulatory submission version in effect. Supports inspection readiness and TMF completeness.
attributes.references: EMA IMPD Guideline; EU CTR 536/2014; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: is_biological
attributes.description: Indicates whether the IMP is a biological product (e.g., monoclonal antibody, vaccine, gene therapy, cell therapy) as opposed to a small-molecule chemical entity.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 600 (Biologics); EMA Guideline on Biological Medicinal Products; ICH Q5A-Q5E

attributes.name: is_cold_chain
attributes.description: Indicates whether the IMP requires cold-chain logistics (temperature-controlled storage and transport, typically 2–8°C or below). Drives cold-chain packaging selection, qualified shipper requirements, and temperature monitoring obligations.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A; WHO Technical Report Series 961 (Cold Chain); GDP Guidelines (EU 2013/C 343/01)

attributes.name: is_controlled_substance
attributes.description: Indicates whether the IMP is classified as a controlled substance under applicable national regulations (e.g., DEA Schedule in the US, Misuse of Drugs Act in the UK).
attributes.references: US DEA Controlled Substances Act (21 USC 812); UK Misuse of Drugs Act 1971; EMA Guideline on Controlled Substances

attributes.name: is_orphan_designated
attributes.description: Indicates whether the IMP has received orphan drug designation from FDA (ODD) or EMA (OMP), conferring special regulatory incentives and obligations. Relevant for regulatory strategy, supply planning, and sponsor reporting.
attributes.references: FDA Orphan Drug Act (21 CFR Part 316); EMA Regulation (EC) No 141/2000; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: manufacturer_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where the IMP is manufactured. Used for import/export regulatory compliance, customs documentation, and supply chain risk assessment.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA IMPD Guideline

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Name of the GMP-certified manufacturer responsible for producing the IMP. Required for regulatory submissions (IND/IMPD), batch release documentation, and supply chain traceability.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; EMA IMPD Guideline; ICH Q7 GMP

attributes.name: max_storage_temp_c
attributes.description: Maximum permissible storage temperature in degrees Celsius for the IMP. Used to define temperature excursion thresholds, configure temperature monitoring devices, and assess cold-chain compliance at depots and sites.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A Stability Guidelines; GDP Guidelines (EU 2013/C 343/01); FDA 21 CFR Part 211.142

attributes.name: min_storage_temp_c
attributes.description: Minimum permissible storage temperature in degrees Celsius for the IMP. Used to define temperature excursion thresholds, configure temperature monitoring devices, and assess cold-chain compliance at depots and sites.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A Stability Guidelines; GDP Guidelines (EU 2013/C 343/01); FDA 21 CFR Part 211.142

attributes.name: ndc_code
attributes.description: FDA-assigned National Drug Code (NDC) for commercially procured comparators or approved products used in the trial. Applicable for US-sourced products. Used for procurement, accountability, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: FDA NDC Directory; FDA 21 CFR Part 207

attributes.name: packaging_configuration
attributes.description: Description of the IMP packaging unit configuration as used in the trial (e.g., 'blister pack of 28 tablets', 'vial 10 mL', 'pre-filled syringe 1 mL'). Drives kit assembly, labelling design, and RTSM dispensing unit definitions.
attributes.references: EMA IMPD Guideline; FDA 21 CFR Part 211.130; ICH Q6A

attributes.name: product_code
attributes.description: Sponsor-assigned alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the IMP within the sponsor's product catalogue. Used as the externally-known business identifier across RTSM, EDC, and regulatory submissions. Maps to the product code field in Medidata Rave RTSM.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA IMPD Guideline

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Full human-readable name of the investigational medicinal product as defined by the sponsor. May be a code name, development compound name, or commercial name for comparators. Used in labelling, supply documentation, and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA IMPD Guideline

attributes.name: product_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the IMP master record within the supply domain. Active records are eligible for supply planning and dispensing. Inactive or discontinued records are retained for audit and historical accountability.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA IMPD Guideline

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: Classification of the product role within the clinical trial: IMP (the investigational compound under study), comparator (active reference product), placebo (inactive control), or auxiliary medicinal product (supportive agent not under investigation).
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; EMA IMPD Guideline; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: regulatory_classification
attributes.description: Regulatory filing category under which the IMP is authorised for use in the clinical trial. Determines the applicable regulatory framework, submission requirements, and oversight obligations across jurisdictions (FDA IND, EMA IMPD/CTA, etc.).
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312 (IND); EMA EU CTR 536/2014 (IMPD/CTA); ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: retest_period_months
attributes.description: Period in months after which the IMP must be retested before continued use, applicable where a formal expiry date is not assigned. Relevant for bulk drug substances and certain investigational compounds.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A Stability Guidelines; FDA 21 CFR Part 211.137; EMA IMPD Guideline

attributes.name: route_of_administration
attributes.description: The path by which the IMP is delivered into the body (e.g., oral, intravenous, subcutaneous, intramuscular, topical). Required for eCRF design, SDTM CM domain mapping, and regulatory labelling.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM CM Domain; FDA Route of Administration Terminology; EMA IMPD Guideline

attributes.name: rtsm_product_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Randomization and Trial Supply Management (RTSM) Product Identifier
attributes.description: The product identifier as configured in the Medidata Rave RTSM system. Used to reconcile the IMP master record with RTSM kit assignments, dispensing records, and inventory transactions. Source system reference for integration and lineage.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) GCP

tag_set.value: Randomization and Trial Supply Management (RTSM) Product Identifier

attributes.name: shelf_life_months
attributes.description: Approved shelf life of the IMP in months from the date of manufacture, as established by stability studies and documented in the IMPD/IND. Used for expiry management, resupply planning, and depot/site inventory accountability.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A Stability Guidelines; FDA 21 CFR Part 211.137; EMA IMPD Guideline

attributes.name: sourcing_strategy
attributes.description: Indicates how the IMP is obtained for the clinical trial: manufactured (custom GMP production), commercially procured (purchased from market), over-the-counter, or imported.
attributes.references: EMA IMPD Guideline; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; ICH Q7

attributes.name: sponsor_product_code
attributes.description: The sponsor's internal product code or compound number for the IMP (e.g., development compound identifier such as 'ABC-123'). Distinct from the CRO's product_code; used for sponsor-facing reporting, cross-study portfolio analytics, and regulatory
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA IMPD Guideline

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: Required storage conditions for the IMP as specified in the product dossier and labelling (e.g., 'Store at 2–8°C', 'Store below 25°C, protect from light').
attributes.references: ICH Q1A Stability Guidelines; FDA 21 CFR Part 211.142; EMA IMPD Guideline

attributes.name: strength_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the active substance strength (e.g., mg, g, mcg, mg/mL, IU). Combined with strength_value to fully define the IMP dose strength for labelling, dispensing, and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX Domain; FDA 21 CFR Part 201; UCUM (Unified Code for Units of Measure)

attributes.name: strength_value
attributes.description: Numeric quantity of the active substance per dosage unit (e.g., 10, 500, 1.5). Must be interpreted in conjunction with strength_unit. Represents the principal quantitative fact about the IMP formulation.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX Domain; FDA 21 CFR Part 201; EMA IMPD Guideline

attributes.name: units_per_kit
attributes.description: Number of individual dosage units (tablets, vials, syringes, etc.) contained in one RTSM dispensing kit. Used for supply planning, kit assembly, and accountability reconciliation in Medidata Rave RTSM.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the IMP master record. Supports change tracking, audit trail requirements under ALCOA+ and 21 CFR Part 11, and incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP

products.name: kit_definition
products.description: Defines randomization kit configurations used in RTSM (Medidata Rave). Captures kit type, treatment arm association, blinding level, component IMPs, pack size, label text, kit number range, and applicable study/protocol version.
products.reference: RTSM Kit Configuration

attributes.name: kit_definition_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the kit definition record in the RTSM (Randomization and Trial Supply Management) system. Primary key for this entity. Role: MASTER_RESOURCE.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: arm_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.arm. Business justification: Kit definitions are arm-specific (active vs. placebo vs. comparator arm). Supply planners and RTSM configuration teams must validate kit configurations against protocol-defined arms to ensure
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: imp_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary investigational medicinal product (IMP) component included in this kit definition. Represents the principal drug or biologic being studied.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; ICH Q8; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: investigational_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.investigational_product. Business justification: Kit definitions must reference the study protocol's investigational product definition for regulatory label approval (IND/IMPD number, strength, formulation).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the study this record belongs to.

attributes.name: treatment_arm_id
attributes.description: Reference to the treatment arm (e.g., active drug, placebo, comparator) that this kit definition is associated with. Drives randomization assignment logic in RTSM.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; Medidata Rave RTSM; CDISC SDTM ARM domain

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this kit definition was formally approved for use in manufacturing and dispensing. Required for GCP compliance and audit trail documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ Principles; EMA Annex 13 GMP

attributes.name: blinding_level
attributes.description: Indicates the blinding configuration applied to this kit definition. Determines whether the subject, investigator, and/or sponsor are masked to treatment assignment. Critical for maintaining trial integrity and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on Blinding; EMA Reflection Paper on Blinding

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this kit definition record was first created in the system. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ Principles; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: destruction_method
attributes.description: The approved method for destruction of returned or expired kits of this definition type. Required for regulatory accountability documentation and environmental compliance.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA Annex 13 GMP; EPA Hazardous Waste Regulations

attributes.name: dispensing_quantity
attributes.description: The standard number of dispensing units to be issued to a subject per dispensing event for this kit definition. Used by RTSM to automate dispensing recommendations at scheduled visits.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2); GCP

attributes.name: dispensing_unit
attributes.description: The unit of dispensing for this kit definition as configured in the RTSM. Defines how the kit is dispensed to subjects at site visits (e.g., per kit, per bottle, per blister pack).
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2); GCP

attributes.name: dosage_form
attributes.description: The pharmaceutical dosage form of the IMP contained in this kit (e.g., tablet, capsule, injection, patch, oral solution). Aligns with the IMP manufacturing specification and label text.
attributes.references: ICH Q8 Pharmaceutical Development; FDA 21 CFR Part 201; EMA Guideline on Pharmaceutical Development; WHO Drug Dictionary (WHO-DD)

attributes.name: dose_strength
attributes.description: The numeric dose strength of the IMP per unit in this kit definition (e.g., 10.0000 for a 10 mg tablet). Serves as the principal MEASUREMENT_OR_VALUE for this MASTER_RESOURCE. Must be read in conjunction with dose_strength_unit.
attributes.references: ICH Q8; FDA 21 CFR Part 201; EMA Guideline on Pharmaceutical Development; CDISC SDTM EX domain

attributes.name: dose_strength_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measurement for the dose strength value (e.g., mg, mcg, g, mg/mL, IU). Required to fully interpret the dose_strength field. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mg|mcg|g|mg/mL|IU|mmol|mEq|% — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH Q8; CDISC SDTM Controlled Terminology; WHO-DD; FDA 21 CFR Part 201

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this kit definition version becomes effective and may be used for manufacturing and dispensing. Supports protocol amendment versioning of kit configurations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: is_blinded
attributes.description: Indicates whether kits of this definition are blinded (True) or open-label (False). A key flag for RTSM dispensing logic and unblinding procedures.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on Blinding; EMA Reflection Paper on Blinding

attributes.name: is_comparator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this kit definition contains a comparator drug (True) rather than the investigational product or placebo. Used for supply chain sourcing differentiation and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); EU CTR 536/2014; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA Guideline on Comparator Products

attributes.name: is_rescue_medication
attributes.description: Indicates whether this kit definition represents a rescue medication (True) rather than the primary study treatment. Rescue medication kits follow different dispensing and accountability rules.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; CDISC SDTM CM domain

attributes.name: kit_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the kit definition including its intended use, contents summary, and any special handling instructions relevant to the kit template.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2); GCP

attributes.name: kit_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the kit definition as configured in the RTSM system (e.g., 'Study XYZ Arm A 10mg Tablet 28-Day Supply'). Serves as the IDENTITY_LABEL for this MASTER_RESOURCE.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: kit_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique alphanumeric identifier assigned to this kit definition template in the RTSM system. Used by manufacturers, depots, and sites to reference the kit configuration. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this MASTER_RESOURCE.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2); GCP

attributes.name: kit_number_range_end
attributes.description: The last sequential kit number in the numeric range allocated to physical kits manufactured from this kit definition. Together with kit_number_range_start, defines the total pool of physical kits that can be generated from this definition.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2); GCP

attributes.name: kit_number_range_start
attributes.description: The first sequential kit number in the numeric range allocated to physical kits manufactured from this kit definition. Used by RTSM to assign unique kit numbers to physical instances during manufacturing.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2); GCP

attributes.name: kit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the kit definition template. Draft indicates under development; approved indicates validated and ready for manufacture; active indicates in use for dispensing; superseded indicates replaced by a newer version; retired indicates
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2); GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: kit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the kit by its therapeutic content category. Distinguishes between active drug kits, placebo kits, comparator kits, combination kits, device kits, and ancillary supply kits. Serves as the CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE for this MASTER_RESOURCE.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; EU CTR 536/2014; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: label_language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code (optionally with ISO 3166-1 country subtag) for the primary language of the kit label text (e.g., 'en', 'fr', 'de', 'ja'). Required for multi-country studies with country-specific labeling.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1; EMA Annex 13 GMP; EU CTR 536/2014; FDA 21 CFR Part 201

attributes.name: label_text
attributes.description: The regulatory-approved label text to be printed on physical kits manufactured from this definition. Must comply with applicable labeling regulations and may include study number, kit number, storage conditions, and investigational use statement.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 201; EMA Annex 13 GMP; ICH Q8; EU CTR 536/2014; GCP

attributes.name: manufacturing_site_code
attributes.description: The code identifying the manufacturing or packaging site responsible for producing physical kits from this definition. Used for supply chain traceability and GMP compliance.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; EMA Annex 13 GMP; ICH Q7; GMP Guidelines

attributes.name: max_storage_temp_c
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for kits of this definition. Used for cold-chain monitoring alerts and excursion detection.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A Stability Testing; ICH Q8; FDA 21 CFR Part 211; EMA Annex 13 GMP

attributes.name: min_storage_temp_c
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for kits of this definition. Used for cold-chain monitoring alerts and excursion detection.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A Stability Testing; ICH Q8; FDA 21 CFR Part 211; EMA Annex 13 GMP

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this kit definition record was last modified. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements and change tracking for regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ Principles; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: pack_size
attributes.description: The number of individual dosage units (e.g., tablets, capsules, vials) contained in one physical kit of this definition. Used for supply planning, dispensing calculations, and accountability reconciliation.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2); EU CTR 536/2014; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: pack_size_unit
attributes.description: The unit descriptor for the pack size count (e.g., tablet, capsule, vial). Clarifies what each unit in the pack_size count represents. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: tablet|capsule|vial|ampoule|syringe|patch|sachet|bottle — 8 candidates stripped; promote to
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; CDISC SDTM Controlled Terminology; ICH Q8

attributes.name: randomization_scheme
attributes.description: The randomization methodology applied to kits of this definition type within the RTSM. Determines how kits are allocated to subjects during enrollment and randomization events.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; Medidata Rave RTSM; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs

attributes.name: retest_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days from manufacture after which kits of this definition must be retested before continued use. Applicable for IMP components with defined retest periods rather than fixed expiry dates.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A Stability Testing; FDA 21 CFR Part 211; EMA Annex 13 GMP

attributes.name: return_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether used or unused kits of this definition must be returned to the depot or sponsor for accountability reconciliation and destruction. Drives returns logistics workflows.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA Annex 13 GMP; GCP

attributes.name: rtsm_kit_type_code
attributes.description: The internal kit type code as configured in the Medidata Rave RTSM system. Used for system-to-system integration and reconciliation between the RTSM and downstream data systems.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: The approved shelf life duration in days for kits manufactured from this definition, measured from the date of manufacture. Used to calculate expiry dates on physical kit instances and to trigger re-supply or destruction workflows.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A Stability Testing; FDA 21 CFR Part 211; EMA Annex 13 GMP; ICH Q8

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: Required storage condition for kits of this definition type. Drives cold-chain logistics planning, depot storage allocation, and site storage compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A Stability Testing; ICH Q8; FDA 21 CFR Part 211; EMA Annex 13 GMP; WHO Good Storage Practices

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of this kit definition (e.g., '1.0', '2.1'). Incremented when the kit definition is amended due to protocol changes, labeling updates, or manufacturing changes. Supports audit trail and regulatory traceability.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11; EU CTR 536/2014; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: visit_type
attributes.description: The type of study visit at which this kit definition is intended to be dispensed (e.g., baseline, treatment, follow-up, unscheduled). Drives RTSM dispensing schedule configuration.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; CDISC SDTM SV domain; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: depot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supply depot or central warehouse currently holding this kit. Null when the kit has been shipped to a site.

attributes.name: document_sop_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document_sop. Business justification: Kit inventory management, storage, and handling procedures are governed by GCP SOPs. Linking kit_inventory to document_sop enables GCP compliance audits and inspection readiness

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.manufacture_batch. Business justification: Each physical kit instance belongs to a specific manufacturing batch (kit_inventory.batch_number is denormalized).

attributes.description: Reference to the inbound or outbound shipment record associated with the most recent logistics movement of this kit.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; ICH Q10

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the study this record belongs to.

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational site currently holding or assigned to receive this kit. Used for site-level inventory tracking and accountability.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: subject_randomization_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to randomization.subject_randomization. Business justification: IMP accountability regulations (ICH E6 GCP) require tracing each physical kit to the randomization event that triggered its dispensing.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: trial_subject_id
attributes.description: Reference to the enrolled subject to whom this kit has been dispensed. Null when the kit has not yet been assigned or dispensed to a subject.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM DM domain

attributes.name: accountability_reconciled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this kit has been fully reconciled in the drug accountability log, confirming that dispensed, returned, and destroyed quantities are accounted for. Required for study close-out and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EU GMP Annex 13; ALCOA+

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: The manufacturing batch or lot number of the IMP contained in this kit. Essential for batch recall management, drug accountability, and regulatory submissions. Sourced from the Certificate of Analysis (CoA).
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; FDA 21 CFR Part 211.68; ICH Q7; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: blinding_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the kit identity (treatment assignment) is blinded, unblinded, or open-label for this record. Critical for maintaining study integrity and controlling access to treatment assignment information.
attributes.references: ICH E9; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: cold_chain_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the kit has maintained cold-chain compliance throughout its custody chain based on temperature monitoring data. A value of False triggers a quality investigation before dispensing.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; WHO TRS 961; FDA Guidance on Temperature-Sensitive Drug Products; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: cold_chain_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this kit requires cold-chain storage and transportation (e.g., 2–8°C refrigeration or frozen conditions). Drives logistics planning, temperature monitoring requirements, and qualified packaging selection.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; WHO Technical Report Series 961 (Cold Chain); FDA Guidance on Temperature-Sensitive Drug Products; ICH Q1A

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for site staff or supply chain personnel to record notes about this kit, such as reasons for quarantine, partial dispensing explanations, or deviation observations. Supports ALCOA+ documentation requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where this kit is currently located or was last recorded. Used for import/export compliance, country-specific labeling requirements, and regional supply planning.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; EU CTR 536/2014; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this kit inventory record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: current_location_type
attributes.description: Categorical indicator of where the kit physically resides in the supply chain at the current point in time. Used in conjunction with depot_id or site_id to determine precise location.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: depot_receipt_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the kit was received at the supply depot from the manufacturer or another depot. Initiates the depot inventory record and chain-of-custody tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: destroyed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the kit was confirmed destroyed per the destruction certificate. Required for drug accountability reconciliation and regulatory close-out documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU GMP Annex 13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; ALCOA+

attributes.name: destruction_certificate_number
attributes.description: The reference number of the official destruction certificate issued upon confirmed destruction of the kit. Required for drug accountability close-out and regulatory submission documentation.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: dispensed_quantity
attributes.description: The actual number of dosage units dispensed to the subject from this kit. Used for drug accountability reconciliation and compliance with protocol-specified dosing.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: dispensed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this kit was physically dispensed to the subject by site staff. Captured in RTSM (Medidata Rave) as part of the chain-of-custody audit trail. Conforms to ALCOA+ contemporaneous documentation requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11; CDISC SDTM EX domain

attributes.name: dispensing_visit
attributes.description: The protocol-defined visit name or number at which this kit was dispensed to the subject (e.g., 'Visit 2 - Week 4'). Used for protocol compliance verification and eCRF reconciliation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM EX domain; CDISC CDASH

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The expiration date of the investigational medicinal product within this kit as printed on the label. Kits must not be dispensed after this date. Used for expiry management, re-supply planning, and regulatory accountability.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; FDA 21 CFR Part 211.137; ICH Q1A Stability; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: kit_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric identifier assigned to the physical randomization kit by the RTSM (Medidata Rave). This is the primary business identifier used in drug accountability logs, dispensing records, and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC CDASH; EU GMP Annex 13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: kit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the kit within the supply chain. 'available' = at depot or site, ready for assignment; 'assigned' = allocated to a subject via RTSM but not yet dispensed; 'dispensed' = physically given to subject; 'expired' = past expiry date
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU GMP Annex 13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; ALCOA+

attributes.name: label_version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the IMP label applied to this kit. Used to verify that the correct, IRB/IEC-approved label version was used at the time of dispensing and for regulatory label reconciliation.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.6; ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: manufacture_date
attributes.description: Date on which the investigational medicinal product in this kit was manufactured. Used for shelf-life calculation, batch traceability, and regulatory accountability.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; FDA 21 CFR Part 211; ICH Q7

attributes.name: protocol_version
attributes.description: The version of the study protocol under which this kit was dispensed or assigned. Ensures that kit dispensing is traceable to the correct protocol amendment for regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: randomization_number
attributes.description: The unique randomization number assigned to the subject-kit pairing by the RTSM (IRT/IVRS) at the point of subject randomization. Links the kit to the randomization schedule for unblinding and accountability.
attributes.references: ICH E9; ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM RANDO; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: retest_date
attributes.description: Date by which the kit must be retested or re-evaluated for continued use, particularly for products with conditional shelf-life extensions. Distinct from expiry_date; used for stability management.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2) Stability Testing; EU GMP Annex 13; FDA 21 CFR Part 211.137

attributes.name: returned_quantity
attributes.description: The number of dosage units returned by the subject or site for this kit. Used in drug accountability reconciliation to calculate compliance and account for unused medication.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; EU GMP Annex 13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: returned_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the kit was returned by the subject or site to the depot or destruction facility. Part of the chain-of-custody audit trail for drug accountability.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.description: The source system identifier for this kit record as assigned by the RTSM module in Medidata Rave. Used for data lineage, reconciliation between the Silver Layer and the operational RTSM system, and audit trail traceability.

attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: Required storage condition for this kit as specified on the label and protocol. Drives warehouse and site storage assignment, cold-chain logistics, and temperature excursion monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2); EU GMP Annex 13; FDA 21 CFR Part 211.142; USP <1079>

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this kit inventory record was last modified. Supports audit trail requirements and change tracking under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

products.name: depot

products.reference: Clinical Supply Depot

attributes.name: depot_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the clinical supply depot. Primary key for the depot master record.

attributes.name: clinical_trial_authorization_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.clinical_trial_authorization. Business justification: Depots holding IMP in a given country must operate under a valid CTA for that jurisdiction.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: document_sop_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document_sop. Business justification: Depot qualification, storage, and handling operations are governed by GMP/GCP SOPs. Linking depot to document_sop enables audit trail verification that the correct SOP version governed
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: lab_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.lab_facility. Business justification: Depot 3PL providers are engaged via subcontracts that govern service obligations, GMP requirements, and liability.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: regulatory_binder_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.regulatory_binder. Business justification: Depot import licenses, wholesale distribution licenses, and GMP certificates are filed in regulatory binders.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the study this record belongs to.

attributes.name: tmf_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: Depot qualification reports and GMP certificates are ICH GCP essential TMF documents (Zone 5). Each depot must link to its qualification/GMP certificate document in the eTMF.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the depot facility. Used for logistics routing, regulatory filings, and cold-chain shipment documentation.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; ICH Q10; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address detail (suite, building, floor) for the depot facility.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; ICH Q10

attributes.name: ambient_storage_capacity_m3
attributes.description: Total ambient temperature storage capacity of the depot measured in cubic metres. Ambient storage is typically 15–25°C. Used for supply planning and capacity allocation across studies.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A Stability Guidelines; EU GMP Annex 13; USP <1079>

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City in which the depot facility is located. Used for geographic distribution planning and regulatory jurisdiction determination.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: depot_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the depot within the clinical supply network. Used in RTSM (Randomization and Trial Supply Management) and CTMS for depot referencing across studies.
attributes.references: CDISC CDASH; ICH Q10

attributes.name: cold_chain_qualified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the depot has been formally qualified for cold-chain IMP handling, including validated temperature monitoring, qualified packaging, and trained personnel per WHO and GDP guidelines.
attributes.references: WHO TRS 961 Annex 9; EU GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01; ICH Q1A

attributes.name: controlled_substance_licensed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the depot is licensed to store and handle controlled substances (narcotics, psychotropics) as defined by DEA Schedule (US), Home Office (UK), or equivalent national authority.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301; UK Misuse of Drugs Regulations 2001; UN Convention on Psychotropic Substances

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the country in which the depot is located. Drives regulatory jurisdiction, import/export rules, and cold-chain routing logic.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; ICH Q10; EU GMP Annex 13; FDA 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the depot master record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: ctms_depot_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS) Depot ID
attributes.description: Depot identifier as recorded in the source system Enables cross-system reconciliation between the supply chain data product and clinical trial management records.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

tag_set.value: Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS) Depot ID

attributes.name: decommission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the depot was or is scheduled to be decommissioned and removed from the active clinical supply network. Null for currently active depots.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: depot_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle status of the depot. Active depots are approved for IMP storage and distribution. Suspended depots are temporarily halted pending investigation or re-qualification. Decommissioned depots are permanently closed.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211.68

attributes.name: depot_type
attributes.description: Classification of the depot within the clinical supply logistics network. Central depots serve as primary distribution hubs; regional depots serve geographic clusters; local depots are near investigational sites; satellite depots are temporary; returns
attributes.references: ICH Q10; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: destruction_authorized
attributes.description: Indicates whether the depot is authorized to perform on-site destruction of expired, returned, or unusable IMPs in compliance with GMP and environmental regulations.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; ICH Q10; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EPA Hazardous Waste Regulations

attributes.name: erp_vendor_code
attributes.description: Vendor or supplier identifier for the depot as registered in the source system for purchase order processing, invoice matching, and financial reconciliation of depot service fees.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA; SOX Section 404; ICH Q10

attributes.name: frozen_storage_capacity_m3
attributes.description: Total frozen storage capacity (typically -20°C or -80°C) of the depot in cubic metres. Required for biologics, gene therapies, and other temperature-sensitive IMPs.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A; EU GMP Annex 13; USP <1079>; WHO TRS 961 Annex 9

attributes.name: gmp_certificate_expiry_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) Certificate Expiry Date
attributes.description: Date on which the depot's GMP certificate expires. Triggers re-qualification workflows and may suspend depot operations if not renewed prior to expiry.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211; EMA

tag_set.value: Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) Certificate Expiry Date

attributes.name: gmp_certificate_number
attributes.description: Official certificate number issued by the regulatory authority confirming GMP compliance for the depot. Referenced in regulatory submissions and audit documentation.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; EU GMP Annex 13; EMA; MHRA; TGA

attributes.name: gmp_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the depot holds a current Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) certification as required for IMP storage and handling under ICH Q7/Q10 and applicable regional regulations.
attributes.references: ICH Q7; ICH Q10; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211; EMA GMP Guidelines

attributes.name: import_license_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiry date of the depot's import license for IMP receipt. Expired licenses block inbound international shipments.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; EU GMP Annex 13; FDA; PMDA

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent GMP/GDP audit conducted at the depot by the sponsor, CRO, or regulatory authority. Audit outcomes are tracked in the quality management system (MasterControl).
attributes.references: ICH Q10; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 9001

attributes.name: last_qualification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the depot last completed a formal qualification or re-qualification exercise (IQ/OQ/PQ). Qualification records are maintained in the eTMF and are subject to regulatory inspection.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; EU GMP Annex 15; 21 CFR Part 211.68; ISPE GAMP 5

attributes.name: depot_name
attributes.description: Full legal or operational name of the clinical supply depot as registered with regulatory authorities and used in the Trial Master File (TMF).
attributes.references: ICH Q10; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: next_audit_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next GMP/GDP audit at the depot. Used for audit planning and compliance calendar management.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: next_qualification_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next depot qualification or re-qualification. Drives preventive maintenance and compliance calendar in the CTMS and quality management system.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; EU GMP Annex 15; 21 CFR Part 211.68

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special handling instructions, or depot-specific constraints relevant to clinical supply operations. Not intended for regulatory documentation.
attributes.references: ICH Q10

attributes.name: operational_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the depot became operationally active for clinical supply activities. Used for lifecycle tracking and regulatory documentation.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the depot facility. Used for logistics routing and regulatory jurisdiction mapping.
attributes.references: ICH Q10

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary operational contact at the depot. Used for shipment alerts, RTSM notifications, and supply chain communications.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; ICH Q10

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary operational contact person at the depot. Used for logistics coordination, shipment notifications, and regulatory correspondence.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the depot operational contact. Used for urgent logistics coordination and cold-chain incident escalation.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; ICH Q10

attributes.name: refrigerated_storage_capacity_m3
attributes.description: Total refrigerated storage capacity (typically 2–8°C) of the depot in cubic metres. Critical for IMPs requiring cold-chain management.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A; EU GMP Annex 13; USP <1079>; WHO TRS 961 Annex 9

attributes.name: returns_accepted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the depot is authorized to receive returned Investigational Medicinal Products (IMPs) from investigational sites. Required for accountability reconciliation and destruction workflows.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; ICH Q10; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: rtsm_depot_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Randomization and Trial Supply Management (RTSM) Depot Code
attributes.description: Depot identifier as configured in the RTSM system (Medidata Rave RTSM). Used to link depot master records to RTSM dispensing, randomization kit assignment, and resupply trigger logic.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; CDISC CDASH; ICH E6(R2) GCP

tag_set.value: Randomization and Trial Supply Management (RTSM) Depot Code

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region where the depot is located. Relevant for import/export licensing and regional regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: temperature_monitoring_system
attributes.description: Name or model of the continuous temperature monitoring system installed at the depot (e.g., Sensitech TempTale, Berlinger ELPRO). Ensures 21 CFR Part 11 compliant electronic records of storage conditions.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; EU GDP Guidelines; WHO TRS 961 Annex 9; ICH Q1A

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the depot location (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London). Used for scheduling shipment windows, expiry checks, and operational hours alignment.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; ICH Q10

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the depot master record. Supports change tracking and audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: wholesale_license_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiry date of the wholesale distribution license. Depot cannot legally distribute IMPs after this date without renewal.
attributes.references: EU GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01; MHRA; 21 CFR Part 205

products.name: site_inventory
products.description: Tracks IMP and kit stock positions at supply chain nodes (investigational sites and depots). Each record represents current inventory levels by IMP/kit type at a specific location, including quantity on-hand, received, dispensed, allocated, quarantined
