attributes.name: site_inventory_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each site inventory record representing a stock position of an Investigational Medicinal Product (IMP) or kit type at a specific supply chain node (investigational site or depot).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: arm_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.arm. Business justification: Site-level IMP inventory is maintained per treatment arm; resupply triggers and accountability reconciliation are arm-specific.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: clinical_trial_authorization_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.clinical_trial_authorization. Business justification: Site-level IMP inventory is authorized for holding and dispensing only under a valid country-specific CTA.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: depot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.depot. Business justification: site_inventory tracks IMP and kit stock positions at supply chain nodes including both investigational sites AND depots (the product description explicitly states 'supply chain nodes
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: document_sop_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document_sop. Business justification: Site inventory management, reconciliation, and storage procedures are governed by GCP SOPs.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: imp_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Investigational Medicinal Product (IMP) master record defining the drug substance, formulation, and dosage form tracked in this inventory position.

attributes.name: kit_definition_id
attributes.description: Reference to the randomization kit type as defined in the RTSM (Randomization and Trial Supply Management) system (Medidata Rave). Identifies the specific kit configuration (e.g., treatment arm, dose level, pack size) tracked in this inventory record.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM Kit Type; ICH E6(R2); CDISC CDASH

attributes.name: manufacture_batch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.manufacture_batch. Business justification: Site inventory is tracked by batch (site_inventory.batch_number is denormalized). Each site inventory record represents stock of a specific manufacturing batch at a site.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: receipt_shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.shipment. Business justification: Site inventory records are created or updated when a shipment is received at the investigational site. Adding receipt_shipment_id links the site inventory record to the inbound shipment.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: site_file_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.site_file. Business justification: Site inventory accountability records are essential site file documents required for GCP inspection readiness.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study for which this inventory is being tracked. Links inventory records to the sponsoring protocol and enables study-level accountability reconciliation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM IG; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational site or depot location where this inventory is physically held. Enables site-level stock position reporting and resupply trigger management.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS site record; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: treatment_arm_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to randomization.treatment_arm. Business justification: Site inventory is maintained per treatment arm to enforce arm-specific minimum/maximum stock thresholds and trigger resupply.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: accountability_reconciled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the IMP accountability reconciliation has been completed for this inventory position. Set to True when all received, dispensed, returned, expired, and destroyed quantities have been formally reconciled and signed off per GCP requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014; GCP

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer's batch or lot number for the IMP stock held at this location. Required for regulatory traceability, recall management, and accountability reconciliation. Corresponds to the batch/lot number on the IMP label.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 312.23; ICH Q7; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13

attributes.name: blinding_level
attributes.description: Blinding level applicable to this inventory position, indicating whether the IMP identity is masked at this location. Drives labeling requirements and access controls for inventory data to preserve study integrity.
attributes.references: ICH E9; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: destruction_authorized
attributes.description: Indicates whether destruction of expired, returned, or quarantined IMP stock at this location has been formally authorized by the sponsor or designee. Required before physical destruction can proceed per GCP and regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014; GCP

attributes.name: destruction_date
attributes.description: Date on which IMP units or kits were destroyed at or from this location. Required for regulatory accountability documentation and study close-out reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiry date of the IMP batch or kit stock held at this location, as stated on the product label. Used for expiry management, resupply planning, and to prevent dispensing of expired product to study subjects.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 312.23; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13.2; ICH Q1A

attributes.name: imp_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure used to count IMP stock at this location (e.g., kit, vial, tablet, capsule, syringe, ampoule). Ensures consistent quantity reporting across different IMP formulations and packaging configurations.
attributes.references: CDISC CDASH; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 312; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: inventory_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique identifier for this inventory position record, typically generated by the RTSM or CTMS system. Used in regulatory accountability documentation and audit trails.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: inventory_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this inventory position. 'active' indicates stock is available for dispensing; 'quarantined' indicates stock is held pending investigation or quality review; 'depleted' indicates zero usable stock; 'closed' indicates the
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; GCP; 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: last_dispensing_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent IMP or kit dispensing event occurred at this location. Used to monitor site dispensing activity and identify inactive sites that may require supply reallocation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; Medidata Rave RTSM dispensing records; CDISC CDASH

attributes.name: last_physical_count_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent physical inventory count was conducted at this location for this IMP or kit type. Used to assess inventory data currency and schedule the next physical count per the accountability reconciliation plan.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; GCP; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: last_physical_count_qty
attributes.description: Actual physical count of IMP units or kits recorded during the most recent physical inventory count at this location. Compared against the system quantity to identify discrepancies requiring investigation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: last_shipment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent inbound IMP or kit shipment was received and confirmed at this location. Used to track supply chain activity and assess time since last replenishment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; Medidata Rave RTSM shipment module

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: Classification of the supply chain node holding this inventory. Distinguishes between investigational sites (where IMP is dispensed to subjects), depots (regional or central storage), central pharmacies, and satellite depots.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; EU CTR 536/2014; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: maximum_stock_qty
attributes.description: Maximum number of IMP units or kits permitted at this location to prevent overstocking, minimize expiry risk, and comply with storage capacity constraints. Used in supply planning and RTSM configuration.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; Medidata Rave RTSM; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: minimum_stock_qty
attributes.description: Absolute minimum number of IMP units or kits that must be maintained at this location to ensure uninterrupted subject dosing. Falling below this level triggers an urgent resupply escalation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM supply parameters

attributes.name: qty_adjusted
attributes.description: Net inventory adjustment quantity applied to this position due to physical count discrepancies, data corrections, or reconciliation differences. Positive values indicate upward adjustments; negative values indicate downward adjustments.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: qty_allocated
attributes.description: Number of IMP units or kits currently reserved or allocated to specific subjects or randomization slots via the RTSM but not yet physically dispensed. Reduces available-for-dispensing stock.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13

attributes.name: qty_destroyed
attributes.description: Cumulative number of IMP units or kits that have been destroyed at or from this location, including expired, damaged, or returned-and-destroyed stock. Required for regulatory accountability reconciliation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: qty_dispensed
attributes.description: Cumulative number of IMP units or kits dispensed to study subjects at this location since the study began or since the last accountability reconciliation period. Sourced from dispensing records in the RTSM.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; Medidata Rave RTSM; 21 CFR Part 312.62; CDISC CDASH

attributes.name: qty_expired
attributes.description: Number of IMP units or kits that have passed their expiry date at this location and are no longer eligible for dispensing. Tracked separately for regulatory accountability and waste reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: qty_on_hand
attributes.description: Current physical count of IMP units or kits available at this location, excluding quarantined, allocated, and reserved stock. Represents the net usable inventory at the time of the last update. Used as the primary metric for resupply trigger evaluation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; Medidata Rave RTSM; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: qty_quarantined
attributes.description: Number of IMP units or kits currently placed in quarantine at this location due to quality concerns, temperature excursions, damaged packaging, or pending investigation. These units are not available for dispensing.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; GCP; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: qty_received
attributes.description: Cumulative number of IMP units or kits received at this location since the study began or since the last accountability reconciliation period. Sourced from inbound shipment confirmations in the RTSM.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; Medidata Rave RTSM; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: qty_returned
attributes.description: Cumulative number of IMP units or kits returned from subjects or from this site to the depot or sponsor for destruction or reconciliation. Used in accountability reconciliation calculations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; Medidata Rave RTSM; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent IMP accountability reconciliation was completed and approved for this inventory position. Required for regulatory inspection readiness and study close-out documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this inventory record was first created in the system, conforming to ALCOA+ principles of contemporaneous data capture. Used for audit trail and data lineage purposes.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this inventory record was most recently modified. Supports audit trail requirements under ALCOA+ and 21 CFR Part 11, and enables change detection in the Databricks lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: reorder_point
attributes.description: Minimum quantity threshold at which a resupply request should be triggered for this IMP or kit type at this location. When qty_on_hand falls at or below this value, the RTSM or supply planner initiates a replenishment shipment.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; GCP supply planning best practices

attributes.name: reorder_qty
attributes.description: Standard replenishment quantity to be shipped when a resupply is triggered for this location and IMP/kit type. Defined in the supply plan and used by the RTSM to generate resupply orders automatically.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13

attributes.name: resupply_request_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent resupply request was initiated for this inventory position. Used to track supply chain responsiveness and expected delivery timelines.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13

attributes.name: resupply_triggered
attributes.description: Indicates whether an active resupply request has been triggered for this inventory position. Set to True when qty_on_hand falls at or below the reorder_point and a resupply order has been initiated in the RTSM or supply management system.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; GCP supply planning

attributes.name: retest_date
attributes.description: Date by which the IMP batch must be retested to confirm continued stability and suitability for use. Applicable for products with defined retest periods rather than fixed expiry dates. Triggers stability testing workflows.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2); EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 312.23

attributes.name: rtsm_location_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Randomization and Trial Supply Management (RTSM) Location Code
attributes.description: The location identifier assigned to this site or depot within the RTSM system (Medidata Rave). Used to reconcile inventory records between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational RTSM source system.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11

tag_set.value: Randomization and Trial Supply Management (RTSM) Location Code

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: Required storage condition for the IMP or kit at this location, as specified in the Investigational Medicinal Product Dossier (IMPD) or protocol. Drives cold-chain logistics planning and compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13.2; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 312.23; USP <1079>

attributes.name: storage_condition_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the current storage conditions at this location are compliant with the required storage condition specification for this IMP or kit type.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13.2; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 312; GCP

attributes.name: temperature_excursion_count
attributes.description: Cumulative number of recorded temperature excursion events for this inventory position at this location. Used to assess cold-chain compliance history and inform quarantine or destruction decisions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13.2; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211.68; USP <1079>

products.name: supply_plan
products.description: Clinical supply plan - distinct concept, separate owner from monitoring_plan and program_plan.
products.reference: Clinical Supply Plan

attributes.name: supply_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the investigational medicinal product (IMP) supply plan record within the clinical trial supply chain management system.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.application. Business justification: Supply plans are built around a specific investigational compound's development phase, enrollment projections, and manufacturing requirements.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: clinical_trial_authorization_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.clinical_trial_authorization. Business justification: Supply plans are scoped to specific CTAs per country/region — IMP can only be supplied where a valid CTA exists.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: dosing_regimen_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.dosing_regimen. Business justification: Supply quantity forecasting is directly calculated from the dosing regimen (dose frequency, treatment duration, number of subjects per arm).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: imp_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational medicinal product (IMP) being planned, linking to the product master record that defines formulation, dosage form, and strength.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU Directive 2001/20/EC; 21 CFR Part 312; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: ind_application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.ind_application. Business justification: Supply plans are scoped to an IND — the IND defines the protocol coverage, phase, and product authorization that drives manufacturing quantity planning.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: interim_analysis_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to biostatistics.interim_analysis. Business justification: In adaptive trials, interim analysis outcomes (sample size re-estimation, early stopping) directly trigger supply plan revisions.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: investigational_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.investigational_product. Business justification: Supply plans are built for a specific investigational product as defined in the study protocol (IND/IMPD reference, storage conditions, shelf life).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: protocol_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.protocol. Business justification: Supply plans are built against a specific protocol version — planned enrollment, dosing regimen, number of arms, and visit frequency all derive from the protocol.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: rand_list_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to randomization.rand_list. Business justification: Supply plans are built against a specific randomization list version; when a new rand_list is activated (e.g., post-amendment), the supply plan must reference that version for
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: rand_scheme_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to randomization.rand_scheme. Business justification: Supply planning is directly driven by the randomization scheme — allocation ratios, treatment arm counts, block sizes, and stratification factors determine IMP quantities and
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: regulatory_binder_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.regulatory_binder. Business justification: Supply plans are submitted as part of IND/CTA regulatory packages. Linking supply_plan to regulatory_binder enables tracking of which regulatory submission package contains the
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: risk_assessment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.risk_assessment. Business justification: Supply plans for clinical trials require a formal risk assessment (supply shortage risk, cold chain risk, expiry risk).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: sample_size_calc_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to biostatistics.sample_size_calc. Business justification: Supply plan quantities (forecasted_enrollment, dropout_rate_pct, total_units_planned) are derived directly from the approved sample size calculation.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study for which this supply plan is created. Links the supply plan to the study protocol, enrollment projections, and dosing regimen.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC CDASH; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: tmf_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: Supply plans are essential TMF documents filed under DIA TMF Reference Model Section 11 (IP Management).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: accountability_reconciliation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether drug accountability reconciliation is required under this supply plan, as mandated by GCP and regulatory requirements. Drives reconciliation workflow in RTSM and site monitoring activities.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014; MHRA GCP guidelines

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the supply plan was formally approved by the sponsor supply team and/or CRO supply chain lead. Null if plan has not yet been approved.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: blinding_type
attributes.description: Blinding configuration of the study as it affects supply planning. Double-blind studies require matched placebo kits; open-label studies have simpler kit structures. Impacts kit design and labeling requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU GMP Annex 13; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: buffer_stock_weeks
attributes.description: Target buffer stock expressed in weeks of supply to be maintained at depot and/or site level. Ensures continuity of supply during manufacturing lead times and logistics delays.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU GMP Annex 13; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: cold_chain_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the IMP requires cold-chain logistics (temperature-controlled storage and transport) throughout the supply chain. Drives depot selection, packaging specifications, and logistics provider requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU GMP Annex 13; WHO Technical Report Series 961; GDP guidelines

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this supply plan record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and ALCOA+ compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: destruction_plan_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether this supply plan version includes a returns and destruction plan for expired, unused, or damaged IMP. Required for GMP compliance and accountability reconciliation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 312.62; FDA IND regulations

attributes.name: dropout_rate_pct
attributes.description: Assumed subject dropout/discontinuation rate (as a percentage) applied in demand forecasting calculations. Accounts for subjects who withdraw consent, are lost to follow-up, or are discontinued per protocol.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP; SAP guidelines

attributes.name: expiry_management_strategy
attributes.description: Strategy applied for managing IMP expiry at depot and site level. FIFO (First In First Out), FEFO (First Expired First Out), manual review, or RTSM-managed automated expiry tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU GMP Annex 13; Medidata Rave RTSM; 21 CFR Part 211.137

attributes.name: forecasted_enrollment
attributes.description: Total number of subjects projected to be enrolled over the planning horizon, derived from enrollment projections and site feasibility assessments. Primary driver of IMP demand forecasting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Description of the geographic coverage of this supply plan, specifying countries or regions included (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU). Drives country-level demand forecasting and depot assignment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU CTR 536/2014; ISO 3166-1 alpha-3

attributes.name: horizon_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the planning horizon covered by this supply plan. Typically extends to study completion or database lock (DBL) plus a buffer for returns and destruction.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: horizon_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the planning horizon covered by this supply plan. Defines the beginning of the forecasted demand and manufacturing schedule window.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for supply chain planners to document assumptions, constraints, protocol amendment impacts, or sponsor-specific instructions relevant to this supply plan version.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: overage_pct
attributes.description: Planned overage percentage applied on top of net demand to account for wastage, damaged kits, protocol amendments, and supply chain uncertainties. Agreed with sponsor and documented in the supply agreement.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: plan_date
attributes.description: The principal business date on which this supply plan was formally prepared or issued. Represents the real-world event date distinct from system audit timestamps.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: plan_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique identifier for the supply plan, typically formatted as SP-{StudyCode}-{Year}-{Sequence}. Used in sponsor communications, RTSM configuration, and regulatory documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC CDASH; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: planned_manufacturing_batches
attributes.description: Total number of manufacturing batches planned to fulfill the forecasted IMP demand over the planning horizon, including buffer and overage quantities.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211; FDA IND regulations

attributes.name: planning_cycle
attributes.description: Frequency or trigger basis for this supply plan update cycle. Typically monthly or per enrollment milestone as defined in the supply agreement with the sponsor.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: randomization_method
attributes.description: Randomization methodology used in the RTSM for kit assignment to subjects. Drives kit numbering, stratification factors, and supply allocation logic within Medidata Rave RTSM.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: resupply_quantity
attributes.description: Standard quantity of kits or units to be shipped per resupply order when the resupply trigger threshold is reached. Defined per site tier and country in the supply plan.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: resupply_trigger_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum kit or unit quantity at depot or site level that triggers an automatic resupply order via RTSM (Interactive Response Technology). When inventory falls to or below this threshold, a resupply shipment is initiated.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM; CDISC CDASH

attributes.name: rtsm_plan_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Randomization and Trial Supply Management (RTSM) Plan ID
attributes.description: Identifier of the corresponding supply plan configuration record within the Medidata Rave RTSM system. Enables traceability between the lakehouse supply plan record and the operational RTSM configuration.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

tag_set.value: Randomization and Trial Supply Management (RTSM) Plan ID

attributes.name: shelf_life_months
attributes.description: Approved shelf life of the IMP in months from date of manufacture, as defined in the product specification and stability data. Critical for expiry management and resupply timing calculations.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A Stability Testing; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211.137; FDA IND regulations

attributes.name: site_tier_scope
attributes.description: Site tier classification covered by this supply plan. Allows differentiated supply planning for high-enrolling versus low-enrolling sites, supporting optimized kit allocation and resupply strategies.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: storage_temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for the IMP as specified in the product dossier. Defines upper bound for cold-chain and ambient storage qualification.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A Stability Testing; EU GMP Annex 13; WHO GDP guidelines; 21 CFR Part 211.68

attributes.name: storage_temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for the IMP as specified in the product dossier. Used to define cold-chain logistics requirements and depot qualification criteria.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A Stability Testing; EU GMP Annex 13; WHO GDP guidelines; 21 CFR Part 211.68

attributes.name: supply_plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the supply plan. Draft indicates initial creation; under_review indicates sponsor/CRO review; approved indicates sign-off; active indicates currently governing supply operations; superseded indicates replaced by a newer
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: total_units_planned
attributes.description: Total number of IMP units (e.g., tablets, vials, kits) planned for manufacture and distribution over the planning horizon, inclusive of overage and buffer stock.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU GMP Annex 13; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: treatment_arms_count
attributes.description: Number of treatment arms (including placebo/comparator) in the study protocol that require separate IMP supply planning. Drives kit type differentiation in RTSM randomization configuration.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ICH E9; Medidata Rave RTSM; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which IMP supply quantities are expressed and tracked throughout the supply plan (e.g., kit, vial, tablet). Aligns with RTSM kit configuration and dispensing records.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM; CDISC CDASH; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this supply plan record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Updated on every planning cycle revision or status change.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the supply plan (e.g., v1.0, v2.3), incremented at each planning cycle or upon significant enrollment milestone updates. Supports version history and audit trail.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

products.name: manufacture_batch
products.description: Records IMP manufacturing batch details including batch number, manufacturing date, batch size, manufacturing site, GMP certificate of analysis reference, release status (quarantine, released, rejected), expiry date, and storage conditions.
products.reference: GMP Batch Record

attributes.name: manufacture_batch_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the IMP manufacturing batch record in the clinical supply chain. Primary key for all downstream kit, inventory, and accountability traceability.
attributes.references: ICH Q7 Good Manufacturing Practice Guide; 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: approval_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.approval. Business justification: Batch release decisions require traceability to the regulatory approval authorizing the product.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: capa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_capa. Business justification: CAPAs are frequently initiated against specific manufacture batches (batch release failure, GMP deviation on a specific batch). manufacture_batch has no compliance_capa_id.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: clinical_trial_authorization_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.clinical_trial_authorization. Business justification: In EU/non-US jurisdictions, CTAs govern batch release and authorized use of IMP.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: imp_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.imp_master. Business justification: Each manufacturing batch produces a specific IMP. manufacture_batch.imp_name and imp_code are denormalized from imp_master.product_name and product_code.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: ind_application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.ind_application. Business justification: IND applications govern which batches can be manufactured and used in US clinical trials.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: investigational_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.investigational_product. Business justification: Regulatory batch release and GMP compliance require traceability from each manufactured batch to the protocol-registered investigational product.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: rand_scheme_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to randomization.rand_scheme. Business justification: Batch release QA documentation must reference the randomization scheme to confirm blinding compliance and correct active/placebo/comparator quantities.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: regulatory_binder_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.regulatory_binder. Business justification: Batch records and CoAs are submitted as part of IND/CTA regulatory submissions. manufacture_batch has ind_number and cta_reference as plain text.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the study this record belongs to.

attributes.name: supply_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.supply_plan. Business justification: Manufacturing batches are produced in accordance with a clinical supply plan. supply_plan has planned_manufacturing_batches count, indicating it governs batch production.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: tmf_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: Batch release documents (Certificate of Analysis, GMP release certificates) are essential TMF documents per ICH E6 R2 Section 8.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: available_quantity
attributes.description: Current quantity of units from this batch that are available for allocation to depots or clinical sites, net of already allocated, dispensed, returned, and destroyed quantities. Used for supply planning and shortage risk monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); EU GMP Annex 13; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric batch/lot number assigned by the manufacturing site, as printed on the IMP label and referenced in the Certificate of Analysis (CoA).
attributes.references: ICH Q7; 21 CFR Part 211.68; EU GMP Annex 13; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: batch_size
attributes.description: Total number of units (e.g., tablets, vials, kits) manufactured in this batch. Used for supply planning, yield calculations, and accountability reconciliation against dispensed and returned quantities.
attributes.references: ICH Q7; 21 CFR Part 211.186; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: batch_size_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the batch size quantity (e.g., units, vials, tablets, kits). Required for unambiguous interpretation of batch_size in supply planning and accountability reports.
attributes.references: ICH Q7; EU GMP Annex 13; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: batch_type
attributes.description: Classification of the batch purpose: clinical (intended for subject dosing), validation (process validation), stability (stability study samples), reference (retained reference samples), reserve (emergency reserve).
attributes.references: ICH Q7; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: blinding_type
attributes.description: Blinding classification of the IMP batch indicating whether the batch is open-label, single-blind, double-blind, or triple-blind. Determines labelling requirements, handling procedures, and unblinding protocols at clinical sites.
attributes.references: ICH E9; ICH E6(R2); EU CTR 536/2014; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this manufacture batch record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: cta_reference
attributes.description: Clinical Trial Authorisation (CTA) reference number issued by the relevant national competent authority (e.g., EMA, MHRA) under which this IMP batch is authorised for use in the clinical trial.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; EMA; MHRA; Health Canada

attributes.name: destroyed_quantity
attributes.description: Total number of units from this batch that have been confirmed destroyed, including rejected units, expired returns, and reconciliation destructions. Required for GMP accountability reconciliation and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ICH Q7; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211.208; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: destruction_certificate_ref
attributes.description: Reference number of the destruction certificate issued upon confirmed destruction of batch units. Required for GMP accountability reconciliation and regulatory audit trail. Links to document management system (Veeva Vault).
attributes.references: ICH Q7; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211.208; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: dosage_form
attributes.description: Pharmaceutical dosage form of the IMP in this batch (e.g., tablet, capsule, injection). Determines storage, handling, and dispensing requirements at clinical sites.
attributes.references: ICH Q6A; FDA Dosage Form Terminology; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date after which the IMP batch must not be used, as determined by stability studies and printed on the IMP label. Critical for expiry management, site recall, and RTSM kit assignment logic to prevent dispensing of expired product.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2) Stability Testing; 21 CFR Part 211.137; EU GMP Annex 13; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: gmp_certificate_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the GMP manufacturing authorisation or certificate issued by the relevant regulatory authority for the manufacturing site. Confirms the site is authorised to manufacture IMPs for clinical trials.
attributes.references: EU GMP Directive 2003/94/EC; 21 CFR Part 211; ICH Q7; EMA

attributes.name: is_comparator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this batch is a comparator (active control or placebo) product rather than the investigational drug. True = comparator/placebo; False = investigational drug. Used for supply planning, kit assembly, and RTSM randomization configuration.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: is_placebo
attributes.description: Indicates whether this batch contains placebo (no active ingredient). True = placebo batch; False = active drug batch. Distinct from is_comparator as a batch may be a comparator active drug. Used for blinded supply management and kit labelling.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); EU GMP Annex 13; ICH E9

attributes.name: manufacture_date
attributes.description: The date on which manufacturing of this IMP batch was completed, as recorded in the batch manufacturing record. Used as the reference point for shelf-life and expiry date calculation.
attributes.references: ICH Q7; 21 CFR Part 211.188; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: manufacturing_site_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where the manufacturing site is located. Used for import/export regulatory compliance and supply chain risk assessment.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; ICH Q7; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: manufacturing_site_name
attributes.description: Name of the GMP-certified facility where this IMP batch was manufactured. Used for regulatory traceability, site audit trails, and supply chain accountability.
attributes.references: ICH Q7; 21 CFR Part 211; EU GMP Annex 13; ICH CTD Module 3

attributes.name: packaging_configuration
attributes.description: Description of the primary and secondary packaging configuration for this batch (e.g., '30-count HDPE bottle', '10-pack blister card', '1 mL pre-filled syringe'). Used for kit assembly planning and site dispensing instructions.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211.94; ICH Q8

attributes.name: quarantine_quantity
attributes.description: Number of units from this batch currently held in quarantine pending QP release or investigation. Tracked separately from available quantity for GMP accountability.
attributes.references: ICH Q7; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211.192

attributes.name: recall_date
attributes.description: Date on which the recall of this batch was initiated. Populated only when recall_flag is True. Used for regulatory reporting timelines and site notification tracking.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 7; EU GMP Chapter 8; FDA; EMA

attributes.name: recall_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this batch has been subject to a product recall. True = batch recalled; False = no recall. Triggers urgent site notification, return logistics, and regulatory reporting obligations.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 7; EU GMP Chapter 8; ICH E6(R2); FDA; EMA

attributes.name: release_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Qualified Person (QP) or authorized release authority formally released this batch for clinical use. Marks the transition from quarantine to released status and triggers downstream supply chain activities.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; ICH Q7; 21 CFR Part 211.192

attributes.name: release_status
attributes.description: Current GMP release status of the batch as determined by the Qualified Person (QP) or authorized release authority. Controls whether the batch may be shipped to depots or dispensed to subjects.
attributes.references: ICH Q7; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211.192; EMA Guideline on QP Certification

attributes.name: retest_date
attributes.description: Date by which the batch must be retested to confirm continued compliance with specifications before further use. Applicable for APIs and some drug products where retest rather than expiry dating is used.
attributes.references: ICH Q7; ICH Q1A(R2); 21 CFR Part 211.137

attributes.name: shelf_life_months
attributes.description: Approved shelf life of the IMP batch in months, as determined by stability data and declared in the product specification. Used to calculate and validate the expiry date relative to the manufacture date.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2); ICH Q1E; 21 CFR Part 211.137; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: source_system_batch_key
attributes.description: Native batch record identifier from the originating source system (e.g., Medidata Rave RTSM batch record ID, sponsor ERP batch key from the source system for data lineage, reconciliation, and ETL traceability between the lakehouse silver layer and
attributes.references: ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11; Medidata Rave RTSM; SAP S/4HANA

attributes.name: sponsor_batch_reference
attributes.description: Sponsor-assigned reference number for this batch as provided in the sponsor batch release documentation. May differ from the manufacturing site batch number. Used for sponsor reconciliation and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ICH Q7; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: stability_study_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the ICH stability study protocol under which this batch is enrolled for ongoing stability monitoring. Used to track shelf-life extensions and expiry date updates.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2); ICH Q1E; 21 CFR Part 211.166; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: Required storage condition for this IMP batch as specified in the product dossier and CoA. Drives cold-chain logistics planning, depot and site storage requirements, and temperature excursion monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2); ICH Q8; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211.142

attributes.name: storage_temp_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for this IMP batch, as specified in the product specification. Used for cold-chain monitoring, temperature excursion assessment, and depot/site compliance verification.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2); EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211.142

attributes.name: storage_temp_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for this IMP batch, as specified in the product specification. Used for cold-chain monitoring, temperature excursion assessment, and depot/site compliance verification.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2); EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211.142

attributes.name: strength
attributes.description: Declared strength or concentration of the active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) per unit dose in this batch (e.g., '100 mg', '5 mg/mL'). Used for dose verification and dispensing accountability.
attributes.references: ICH Q6A; 21 CFR Part 201; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: units_per_kit
attributes.description: Number of IMP units (e.g., tablets, vials) contained in each randomization kit assembled from this batch. Used by RTSM for kit assembly configuration and dispensing accountability calculations.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this manufacture batch record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Required for change tracking, audit trail compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); GDPR Article 5

products.name: shipment
products.description: Transactional record of IMP/kit shipments between supply chain nodes (manufacturer to depot, depot to site, site to site, site to depot for returns). Captures shipment number, origin, destination, carrier, tracking number, shipment date, expected delivery
products.reference: IMP Shipment Record

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each IMP/kit shipment record in the clinical supply chain. Primary key for the shipment data product.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 211; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: audit_finding_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.audit_finding. Business justification: GDP audits produce findings against specific IMP shipments (cold chain documentation deficiency, import permit non-compliance). audit_finding has study_site_id but no shipment_id.
