attributes.name: accountability_reconciliation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the drug accountability reconciliation record. Primary key for this entity. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — periodic reconciliation event with a defined lifecycle (open → reconciled / discrepancy-flagged).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.application. Business justification: IMP accountability reconciliation is a contractual obligation defined in the study contract.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: arm_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.arm. Business justification: GCP requires IMP accountability reconciliation at the treatment arm level — dispensed, returned, and destroyed quantities must balance per arm.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: clinical_trial_authorization_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.clinical_trial_authorization. Business justification: IMP accountability reconciliation is a CTA-specific regulatory obligation.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: compliance_sop_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_sop. Business justification: Accountability reconciliation reports are formal SOW deliverables with acceptance criteria, billing milestone linkage, and TMF filing requirements.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: imp_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational medicinal product (IMP) being reconciled. A single reconciliation record covers one IMP or comparator product at the site for the period.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014 Article 2(5); ICH E6(R2) GCP §5.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.23

attributes.name: ind_application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.ind_application. Business justification: IND annual reports require IMP accountability data aggregated by IND. Reconciliation records must reference the IND to support annual report preparation and FDA inspection
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: inspection_finding_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.inspection_finding. Business justification: Regulatory inspectors (FDA, EMA) routinely issue findings against IMP accountability records.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: kit_definition_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.kit_definition. Business justification: Drug accountability reconciliation is performed at the kit type level — reconciling quantities dispensed, returned, and destroyed for a specific kit definition.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: monitoring_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the monitoring visit during which this drug accountability reconciliation was performed or reviewed by the Clinical Research Associate (CRA). Null if reconciliation is performed outside a scheduled monitoring visit (e.g., at Database Lock).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §5.18.4; Oracle Siebel CTMS Visit Tracking

attributes.name: monitoring_visit_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to monitoring.monitoring_visit_schedule. Business justification: IP accountability reconciliation is a scheduled CRA activity performed during monitoring visits per the monitoring visit schedule.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: protocol_deviation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.protocol_deviation. Business justification: Accountability reconciliation discrepancies (missing kits, quantity mismatch) are a direct trigger for protocol deviation reporting under GCP.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: quality_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.quality_event. Business justification: Unresolved accountability reconciliation discrepancies are escalated as quality events under GCP.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: rand_scheme_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to randomization.rand_scheme. Business justification: IMP accountability reconciliation must validate that kit usage matches the allocation ratios and blinding rules defined in the randomization scheme.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: site_cra_assignment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to site.site_cra_assignment. Business justification: Drug accountability reconciliation is performed by the assigned CRA during monitoring visits. The cra_name column is a denormalized reference to the CRA assignment.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: site_file_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.site_file. Business justification: IMP accountability reconciliation records are essential site file documents required for GCP inspection readiness.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: site_inventory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.site_inventory. Business justification: Drug accountability reconciliation is performed at the site level against the site inventory position.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study for which this drug accountability reconciliation is performed. Links the reconciliation to the study protocol, IMP details, and regulatory submission context.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; CDISC SDTM TS Domain

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational site at which this drug accountability reconciliation is conducted. Each reconciliation is site-specific and covers all IMP activity at that site for the defined period.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: tmf_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: IMP accountability reconciliation is an ICH GCP essential TMF document (Section 8.3). The reconciliation record must link to its filed TMF document to support inspection readiness.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: actual_closing_balance_units
attributes.description: Physical count of IMP units on hand at the site at the end of the reconciliation period, as verified by the site staff and/or CRA during the monitoring visit. This is the ground-truth inventory count.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62(a); ISO 14155

attributes.name: adjusted_units
attributes.description: Net quantity adjustment applied to the reconciliation (positive or negative) to account for documented corrections such as data entry errors, kit relabeling, or sponsor-approved adjustments. Zero if no adjustments were made.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, observations, or contextual notes entered by the CRA, site staff, or data manager regarding this reconciliation. Supplements the discrepancy_detail field for general narrative.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: cra_signoff_date
attributes.description: The date on which the CRA / monitor signed off on this drug accountability reconciliation. Null if cra_signoff_flag is False.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §5.18.4; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.68; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: cra_signoff_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Clinical Research Associate (CRA) Monitor Sign-Off Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Clinical Research Associate (CRA) / monitor has reviewed and signed off on this drug accountability reconciliation record. True = signed; False = pending. Required at every monitoring visit per ICH E6(R2).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §5.18.4; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.68; 21 CFR Part 11

tag_set.value: Clinical Research Associate (CRA) Monitor Sign-Off Flag

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this drug accountability reconciliation record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate) principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; ALCOA+ principles; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: destroyed_units
attributes.description: Total quantity of IMP units destroyed at the site or returned to depot for destruction during the reconciliation period. Destruction must be documented per sponsor SOP and applicable regulations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62(a); EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: discrepancy_count
attributes.description: Number of individual discrepancy line items identified during this reconciliation (e.g., missing kit, unaccounted return, dispensing record mismatch). Distinct from discrepancy_units which measures total quantity variance.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: discrepancy_detail
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the nature, root cause, and resolution status of identified discrepancies. Captured by the CRA or site staff. Required when discrepancy_count > 0. Supports regulatory inspection readiness and CAPA documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; ALCOA+ principles; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: discrepancy_resolution_status
attributes.description: Current resolution status of identified discrepancies. 'not_applicable' = no discrepancy found; 'open' = discrepancy identified, investigation not started; 'under_investigation' = root cause analysis in progress; 'resolved' = discrepancy explained and
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; MasterControl CAPA

attributes.name: discrepancy_units
attributes.description: Quantity difference between expected_closing_balance_units and actual_closing_balance_units (actual minus expected). A non-zero value triggers discrepancy investigation. Positive = surplus; negative = shortage.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: dispensed_units
attributes.description: Total quantity of IMP units dispensed to subjects at the site during the reconciliation period. Sourced from dispensing records in Medidata Rave RTSM and eCRF dispensing logs.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62(a); CDISC SDTM EX Domain

attributes.name: expected_closing_balance_units
attributes.description: Calculated expected closing balance: opening_balance_units + received_units - dispensed_units + returned_units - destroyed_units + adjusted_units. Used as the reference value against which the physical count is compared to identify discrepancies.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62(a)

attributes.name: expired_units_count
attributes.description: Number of IMP units that had expired as of the reconciliation period end date. Expired units must be quarantined and destroyed per sponsor SOP; their presence in usable inventory constitutes a protocol deviation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §5.13.3; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: expiry_date_earliest
attributes.business_glossary_term: Earliest IMP Expiry Date on Site
attributes.description: The earliest expiry date among all IMP units currently on hand at the site as of the reconciliation period end date. Used to flag impending expiry risk and trigger resupply or destruction actions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §5.13.3; EU CTR 536/2014; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.23

tag_set.value: Earliest IMP Expiry Date on Site

attributes.name: gcp_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reconciliation record is fully compliant with GCP §8.3.13 requirements (both investigator and CRA sign-offs obtained, no unresolved discrepancies, all required fields populated). True = compliant; False = non-compliant or pending.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: inspection_ready_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reconciliation record and its supporting documentation are complete and ready for regulatory inspection (FDA, EMA, MHRA, etc.). True = inspection-ready; False = documentation gaps exist. Supports eTMF completeness tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.68; EU CTR 536/2014; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: investigator_name
attributes.description: Full name of the Principal Investigator (PI) who signed off on this reconciliation. Captured at time of sign-off for audit trail integrity per ALCOA+ principles. Confidential as it identifies a named professional in a regulatory context.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §4.6.1; ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: investigator_signoff_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Principal Investigator (PI) or delegated sub-investigator signed off on this drug accountability reconciliation. Null if investigator_signoff_flag is False.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §4.6.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: investigator_signoff_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Principal Investigator (PI) or delegated sub-investigator has reviewed and signed off on this drug accountability reconciliation record. True = signed; False = pending. Required for GCP compliance and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §4.6.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: next_reconciliation_due_date
attributes.description: The scheduled due date for the next drug accountability reconciliation at this site for this IMP. Derived from the monitoring visit schedule or protocol-defined reconciliation frequency. Used for proactive compliance tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §5.18.4; Oracle Siebel CTMS Visit Tracking

attributes.name: opening_balance_units
attributes.description: The quantity of IMP units (e.g., tablets, vials, kits) on hand at the site at the start of the reconciliation period. Carried forward from the closing balance of the prior reconciliation period or from the initial receipt if this is the first period.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62(a); CDISC SDTM EX Domain

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the reconciliation period covered by this record. Defines the closing boundary for all IMP transactions included in this reconciliation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62(a)

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the reconciliation period covered by this record. Together with period_end_date, defines the window of IMP activity (receipts, dispensing, returns, destruction) being reconciled.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62(a)

attributes.name: protocol_deviation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a protocol deviation was identified during this reconciliation (e.g., expired IMP dispensed, incorrect kit dispensed, dispensing outside visit window). True = deviation identified; False = no deviation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §4.5; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; MasterControl CAPA

attributes.name: received_units
attributes.description: Total quantity of IMP units received at the site from the depot or sponsor during the reconciliation period. Sourced from shipment receipt records in Medidata Rave RTSM.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62(a); CDISC SDTM EX Domain

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the drug accountability reconciliation was physically performed (i.e., the date of the physical count and record review). This is the principal business event date for this transaction, distinct from sign-off dates.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; ALCOA+ principles; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: reconciliation_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for this reconciliation record, typically generated by the RTSM or CTMS (e.g., RECON-SITE001-20240315). Used in monitoring reports, TMF filings, and regulatory inspection packages.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; CDISC SDTM EX Domain

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the reconciliation record. 'open' = in progress; 'reconciled' = balances confirmed with no discrepancy; 'discrepancy_flagged' = unresolved quantity mismatch requiring investigation; 'pending_review' = awaiting CRA or
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: reconciliation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the reconciliation trigger. 'routine_monitoring' = performed at a scheduled CRA monitoring visit; 'pre_dbl' = required prior to Database Lock (DBL); 'site_closeout' = performed at study close-out; 'interim' = ad hoc between visits
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §5.18.4; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; CDISC SDTM EX Domain

attributes.name: returned_units
attributes.description: Total quantity of IMP units returned from subjects to the site (unused or partially used) during the reconciliation period. Includes returns captured in Medidata Rave RTSM return logs.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62(a); CDISC SDTM EX Domain

attributes.name: rtsm_reconciliation_ref
attributes.description: The reconciliation reference or transaction identifier assigned by the Randomization and Trial Supply Management (RTSM) system (Medidata Rave) for this accountability event. Enables traceability back to the source system record.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: source_document_ref
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the physical or electronic source document (e.g., drug accountability log, dispensing record binder, eTMF artifact ID in Veeva Vault) that supports this reconciliation record. Required for SDV and regulatory inspection.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §1.52; ALCOA+ principles; Veeva Vault eTMF; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: temperature_excursion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any cold-chain temperature excursion was recorded for IMP stored at this site during the reconciliation period. True = at least one excursion event occurred; False = no excursion.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §5.13.2; EU GMP Annex 13; FDA 21 CFR Part 211.68

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which IMP quantities are counted and reconciled (e.g., kit, tablet, vial). Must be consistent with the dispensing unit defined in the kit definition and RTSM configuration.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX Domain (EXDOSU); ICH E6(R2) GCP §5.13; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this drug accountability reconciliation record was most recently modified. Required for audit trail completeness under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles. Tracks the last state change in the reconciliation lifecycle.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; ALCOA+ principles

products.name: resupply_order
products.description: Captures resupply order requests triggered by RTSM resupply algorithms or manual supply manager intervention. Records the requesting site or depot, IMP/kit type requested, quantity requested, urgency level, order date, expected fulfillment date
products.reference: RTSM Resupply Order

attributes.name: resupply_order_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the resupply order record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.application. Business justification: Resupply orders are executed under the study contract's supply scope and purchase order terms.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: arm_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.arm. Business justification: Resupply orders are triggered per treatment arm when arm-specific stock falls below threshold. Supply managers must validate resupply quantities against arm-specific enrollment targets and dosing
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: clinical_trial_authorization_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.clinical_trial_authorization. Business justification: Resupply orders to EU/EEA sites require confirmation of valid CTA status in the destination member state before order approval and dispatch.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: ind_application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.ind_application. Business justification: Resupply orders for US-based studies must be traceable to the governing IND. FDA inspections require that all IMP supply activities reference the IND — resupply orders without IND
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: kit_definition_id
attributes.description: Reference to the IMP kit type or kit definition being requested in this resupply order, as defined in the RTSM kit catalogue.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: protocol_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific protocol version in effect at the time the resupply order was generated. Ensures supply is aligned with the current approved protocol and dosing schedule.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the outbound shipment record created to fulfill this resupply order. Populated once the order transitions to a dispatched or fulfilled state.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: site_inventory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.site_inventory. Business justification: A resupply order is triggered when site inventory falls below the minimum stock threshold (stock_at_trigger, min_stock_threshold attributes on resupply_order).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: source_depot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the depot or distribution center from which the IMP kits will be dispatched to fulfill this resupply order. Supports depot-to-site and depot-to-depot supply chain tracking.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study for which the resupply order was generated. Links the order to the sponsoring protocol and IMP supply plan.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM IG

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational site or depot that triggered or is the destination of the resupply order. Identifies the requesting or receiving location in the supply chain.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS site record

attributes.name: supply_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the IMP supply plan or forecast that this resupply order is fulfilling. Links operational orders back to strategic supply planning for variance analysis.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: treatment_arm_id
attributes.description: Reference to the study treatment arm for which the IMP kits are being resupplied. Ensures blinded or unblinded supply allocation aligns with randomization scheme.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM IG

attributes.name: accountability_reconciled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the IMP kits in this resupply order have been reconciled in the drug accountability log at the receiving site or depot. Required for GCP compliance and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR 312; EU GMP Annex 13; ALCOA+

attributes.name: actual_delivery_date
attributes.description: Date on which the resupply shipment was confirmed as received at the destination site or depot. Used to calculate fulfillment lead time and identify supply delays.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the resupply order was reviewed and approved by the supply manager or depot coordinator prior to dispatch.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: blinding_level
attributes.description: Blinding status of the IMP kits in this resupply order. Determines handling, labelling, and access control requirements during supply chain operations.
attributes.references: ICH E9; ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why the resupply order was cancelled. Populated only when order_status is 'cancelled'. Required for supply accountability and audit trail.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: cold_chain_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the IMP kits in this resupply order require cold-chain logistics (temperature-controlled transport and storage). Drives courier selection and packaging requirements.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A; EU GMP Annex 13; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: courier_name
attributes.description: Name of the logistics provider or courier company assigned to transport the resupply shipment. Used for tracking, accountability, and vendor performance monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this resupply order record was first captured in the system of record. Supports audit trail and ALCOA+ data integrity requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: expected_fulfillment_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the resupply order is expected to be delivered to the requesting site or depot, based on standard lead times and courier schedules.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: expiry_date_earliest
attributes.description: The earliest expiry date among the IMP kits included in this resupply order. Critical for expiry management to ensure kits will remain within shelf life for the expected dispensing window.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU GMP Annex 13; FDA 21 CFR 312

attributes.name: is_emergency_override
attributes.description: Indicates whether this resupply order was processed as an emergency override, bypassing standard approval workflows due to critical patient supply risk. Triggers mandatory post-hoc documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: min_stock_threshold
attributes.description: The minimum stock level (in units/kits) at the requesting site or depot that triggered the resupply order. Captured at the time of order creation for audit and analytics.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: order_comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for supply manager notes, special handling instructions, or contextual information related to this resupply order. Supports operational communication between depots and sites.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: order_date
attributes.description: The date and time at which the resupply order was formally placed or triggered, either by the RTSM resupply algorithm or by a supply manager. This is the principal business event timestamp for the order.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: order_number
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally-known business identifier for the resupply order, typically generated by the RTSM (Medidata Rave) or supply management system. Used in communications with depots, couriers, and sponsors.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the resupply order workflow, from initial trigger through fulfillment or cancellation. Drives operational dashboards and escalation logic.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: quantity_approved
attributes.description: Number of IMP kits or units approved for dispatch after supply manager or depot review. May differ from quantity_requested due to stock availability or protocol constraints.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: quantity_requested
attributes.description: Number of IMP kits or units requested in this resupply order, as specified at the time of order creation by the RTSM algorithm or supply manager.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: quantity_shipped
attributes.description: Actual number of IMP kits or units included in the outbound shipment fulfilling this resupply order. Populated at dispatch and used for accountability reconciliation.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: quantity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the quantities specified in this resupply order (e.g., kit, vial, blister pack). Ensures consistent interpretation across depots and sites.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; CDISC SDTM IG

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the drug accountability reconciliation was completed for the IMP kits delivered under this resupply order. Populated when accountability_reconciled is True.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR 312; EU GMP Annex 13; ALCOA+

attributes.name: requesting_location_type
attributes.description: Classifies whether the resupply order was initiated by an investigational site, a regional depot, or a central pharmacy. Determines routing and fulfillment logic.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: rtsm_order_reference
attributes.description: The native order reference or transaction ID assigned by the RTSM system (Medidata Rave) when the resupply order was generated. Used for cross-system reconciliation and audit.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: rtsm_trigger_rule
attributes.description: Identifier or name of the RTSM resupply algorithm rule that triggered this order (e.g., minimum stock level rule, days-of-supply threshold rule). Null for manually initiated orders.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: source_system_order_code
attributes.description: The native primary key or unique identifier of this resupply order in the originating source system (e.g., Medidata Rave RTSM internal order ID). Enables cross-system traceability and reconciliation.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: specimen_collection_id

attributes.name: study_site_id

attributes.name: tmf_document_id

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: trial_subject_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to subject.trial_subject. Business justification: Subject-specific action items (missing ICF, SDV discrepancy for a specific subject, unreported AE) are a standard CTMS operational concept.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: visit_report_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to monitoring.visit_report. Business justification: Action items are formally raised as a result of monitoring findings documented in visit reports.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: action_item_number

attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: action_type
attributes.description: Classifies whether the action item represents a corrective action (addressing an existing finding), preventive action (mitigating future risk), observation (noted but not requiring immediate action), recommendation, or escalation.

attributes.name: closed_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the action item was formally closed following verification of corrective action completion and evidence review. Null for open or in-progress items.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: closure_evidence_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the evidence provided to confirm resolution of the action item (e.g., updated SOP reference, re-training record, corrected eCRF entry, SDV confirmation). Required for GCP-compliant closure documentation.

attributes.name: closure_evidence_document_ref
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URL to the supporting document stored in Veeva Vault eTMF that substantiates the closure of this action item (e.g., training certificate, corrected source document scan, updated SOP version).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this action item record was first created in the source system Provides the audit trail creation event per 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records requirements and ALCOA+ contemporaneous documentation standards.

attributes.name: ctms_record_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS) Record ID
attributes.description: Native record identifier from the source system for this action item. Preserved in the Silver Layer to enable bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse and the operational system of record.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 8

tag_set.value: Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS) Record ID

attributes.name: data_integrity_impact
attributes.description: Indicates whether the finding underlying this action item compromises the integrity of clinical trial data (e.g., eCRF entries, source data, audit trail). When True, may require data query issuance in Medidata Rave EDC and notification to data management.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ Principles; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18; FDA Data Integrity Guidance 2018; MHRA Data Integrity Guidance

attributes.name: days_overdue
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the action item has been open past its due date (or extended due date if applicable). Populated by the source system automated workflow; zero for on-time or not-yet-due items.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance 2013

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the responsible party must complete and close the action item. Used by the source system automated escalation workflows to flag overdue items and notify CRA supervisors and sponsor representatives.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: escalation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the action item was formally escalated. Null if is_escalated is False. Used to measure escalation response time and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18

attributes.name: escalation_reason
attributes.description: Narrative explanation of why the action item was escalated, including the triggering condition (e.g., overdue beyond threshold, critical safety implication, repeated non-compliance). Required when is_escalated is True.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: extended_due_date
attributes.description: Revised due date granted after a formal extension request and approval. Null if no extension has been granted. Tracks due date changes for audit trail and SLA compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18

attributes.name: gcp_reference
attributes.description: GCP reference. Implements ICH E6(R2) Good Clinical Practice guideline reference.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Guideline; ISO 14155; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: is_escalated
attributes.description: Indicates whether this action item has been formally escalated to a higher authority (e.g., sponsor medical monitor, regulatory affairs, DSMB) due to non-resolution, critical priority, or subject safety risk.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this action item record in the source system Used for incremental data pipeline processing and audit trail completeness per 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: monitoring_action_item_category
attributes.description: Business classification of the action item by the type of finding or compliance gap it addresses. Drives routing logic, escalation thresholds, and regulatory reporting groupings in the source system
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Guideline; CDISC

attributes.name: monitoring_action_item_description
attributes.description: Full narrative description of the monitoring finding, protocol deviation, or compliance gap that necessitated this action item. Includes observed facts, regulatory reference, and expected corrective action per GCP documentation standards (ALCOA+).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18; ALCOA+ Principles; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: monitoring_action_item_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the action item lifecycle in the source system Overdue status is set automatically when the due date passes without closure. Closed status requires documented evidence of resolution.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: monitoring_visit_type
attributes.description: Type of monitoring visit during which the action item was identified. Denormalized from the monitoring visit record for reporting efficiency. Supports analysis of finding patterns by visit type (e.g., higher deviation rates at initiation visits).
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance 2013

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the action item indicating urgency and potential impact on subject safety, data integrity, or regulatory compliance. Critical items trigger immediate escalation workflows in the source system
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Guideline

attributes.name: raised_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the action item was formally raised and entered into the source system Serves as the principal business event date for SLA calculation, aging analysis, and regulatory inspection timelines.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: recurrence_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this action item represents a recurring finding previously identified at the same site or study. Recurring findings may trigger escalation to a formal CAPA workflow and are tracked for site performance risk scoring.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance 2013; MasterControl CAPA

attributes.name: regulatory_impact
attributes.description: Assessment of the potential regulatory impact of the finding underlying this action item. Drives prioritization for regulatory submission readiness, inspection preparation, and escalation to regulatory affairs.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Guideline; ICH E6(R2); EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: response_date
attributes.description: Date on which the site formally submitted their response to the action item. Used to measure site responsiveness KPIs and to determine whether the response was received within the required timeframe.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18

attributes.name: response_text
attributes.description: Formal written response provided by the site (PI or CRC) acknowledging the action item and describing the planned or completed corrective actions. Captured in the source system as part of the action item resolution workflow.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) Section 4.1; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: responsible_party_role
attributes.description: Functional role category of the party accountable for resolving the action item. Distinguishes between site staff (PI, CRC), CRA, sponsor, or functional team (data management, safety). Used for workload distribution and escalation routing.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: source_type
attributes.description: Identifies the originating activity or process that generated this action item (e.g., on-site monitoring visit, remote monitoring review, SDV finding, protocol deviation, safety signal, audit). Supports risk-based monitoring (RBM) analytics.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance 2013; EMA Reflection Paper on RBM

attributes.name: subject_safety_impact
attributes.description: Subject safety impact flag. Implements ICH E6(R2) GCP 5.18.4 subject safety concept.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.11; ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GCP Guideline

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Short, descriptive title summarizing the action item finding or required corrective action. Used as the primary display label in CTMS dashboards, monitoring visit reports, and escalation notifications.

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: Method used by the CRA or monitor to verify that the corrective action was implemented and the action item can be closed (e.g., SDV, document review, on-site visit, remote review). Supports GCP audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: capa_required

attributes.name: risk_indicator_category
attributes.description: Business category classifying the domain of risk the KRI monitors. Supports stratified risk reporting across enrollment, data quality, safety, protocol compliance, and Investigational Product (IP) accountability domains.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance; TransCelerate RBM Framework

attributes.name: computation_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the KRI value was most recently computed for the site. Used to assess data currency and trigger recomputation schedules in the RBM monitoring plan.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ Principles; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance

attributes.name: computation_frequency
attributes.description: Scheduled frequency at which the KRI is recomputed for each site (e.g., weekly for enrollment KRIs, monthly for data quality KRIs). Defined in the RBM monitoring plan.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: computation_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time at which the KRI value was computed, including timezone offset. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: computed_value
attributes.description: Current computed numeric value of the KRI for the associated site, derived from the source system data as of the last computation run. This is the principal quantitative fact of the risk indicator record.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance; CDISC ADaM

attributes.name: consecutive_breach_count
attributes.description: Number of consecutive computation cycles during which the KRI has remained at or above the amber or red threshold. Used to trigger escalation workflows and CAPA initiation per the RBM monitoring plan.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance; MasterControl CAPA

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this KRI record was first created in the system, supporting audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which the KRI input data is extracted for computation (e.g., Medidata Rave EDC for data quality KRIs, the source system for safety KRIs, the source system for enrollment KRIs).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: denominator_value
attributes.description: Raw denominator component of the KRI computation (e.g., total subjects screened, total expected data points, total SAEs reported). Stored alongside the numerator to enable independent verification of the computed value.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ Principles; CDISC ADaM

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date from which this KRI definition became active and applicable to the study and site. Supports versioning of KRI definitions when monitoring plan amendments are issued.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Veeva Vault eTMF; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date on which this KRI definition was superseded or retired. Null for currently active KRI definitions. Supports historical analysis and monitoring plan amendment tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Veeva Vault eTMF; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: escalation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the current KRI alert status and breach history require formal escalation to the sponsor, Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB), or senior management per the RBM escalation procedure.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance; TransCelerate RBM Framework

attributes.name: indicator_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of what the KRI measures, its business rationale, and how it supports risk detection within the RBM framework.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance

attributes.name: indicator_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the KRI as defined in the RBM monitoring plan (e.g., 'Screen Failure Rate', 'Missing Data Rate', 'SAE Reporting Timeliness'). Used in dashboards, monitoring visit reports, and sponsor communications.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance

attributes.name: indicator_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the KRI definition within the monitoring plan. Active KRIs are computed and monitored; draft KRIs are under review; retired KRIs are no longer in use.

attributes.name: indicator_type

attributes.name: is_centralized_monitoring
attributes.description: Indicates whether this KRI is part of the Centralized Statistical Monitoring (CSM) program, as opposed to a site-level operational indicator. Supports differentiation of CSM KRIs from operational monitoring metrics.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance; TransCelerate RBM Framework

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for CRA or data manager annotations regarding the KRI computation, alert status, or remediation context. Supports monitoring visit report narrative and sponsor communication.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: numerator_value
attributes.description: Raw numerator component of the KRI computation (e.g., number of screen failures, number of missing data points, number of overdue SAE reports). Stored to support audit and recomputation validation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ Principles; CDISC ADaM

attributes.name: prior_computed_value
attributes.description: KRI computed value from the immediately preceding computation cycle for the same site. Enables trend analysis and detection of rapid deterioration or improvement in site risk profile.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance; TransCelerate RBM Framework

attributes.name: red_threshold
attributes.description: Numeric threshold value at which the KRI triggers a red (critical) alert, indicating a significant risk requiring immediate escalation and corrective action per the RBM monitoring plan.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance; TransCelerate RBM Framework

attributes.name: reference_period_end
attributes.description: End date of the data window used to compute the KRI value. Together with reference_period_start, defines the exact temporal scope of the KRI computation for reproducibility and audit.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: reference_period_start
attributes.description: Start date of the data window used to compute the KRI value (e.g., rolling 30-day window start, or study start date for cumulative KRIs). Defines the temporal scope of the computation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance; TransCelerate RBM Framework

attributes.name: risk_score_contribution
attributes.description: Weighted contribution of this KRI to the overall site risk score, expressed as a percentage (0–100). Reflects the KRI's relative importance in the composite site risk scoring model.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; TransCelerate RBM Framework; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance

attributes.name: sdv_impact

attributes.name: outstanding_queries_count

attributes.name: overall_risk_score

attributes.name: previous_risk_score

attributes.name: previous_risk_tier

attributes.name: query_rate_percent

attributes.name: recommended_monitoring_intensity

attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; 21 CFR 312.62

tag_set.value: Investigational Product (IP) Quantity Unit of Measure

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: The outcome status of the IP quantity reconciliation performed by the CRA. 'Balanced' indicates quantities account for all IP; 'Discrepancy Identified' indicates a mismatch requiring investigation. Drives CAPA and escalation workflows.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13.4; 21 CFR 312.62; GCP

attributes.name: return_log_reviewed
attributes.business_glossary_term: Investigational Product (IP) Return Log Reviewed Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the CRA reviewed the site's IP return log during the monitoring visit to verify that all returned IP units are documented with subject ID, return date, and quantity.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13.4; 21 CFR 312.62; GCP

tag_set.value: Investigational Product (IP) Return Log Reviewed Flag

attributes.name: review_period_end_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Investigational Product (IP) Accountability Review Period End Date
attributes.description: The end date of the period covered by this IP accountability review (i.e., the date up to which IP transactions are being reconciled). Typically corresponds to the current monitoring visit date.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13.4; 21 CFR 312.62; GCP

tag_set.value: Investigational Product (IP) Accountability Review Period End Date

attributes.name: review_period_start_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Investigational Product (IP) Accountability Review Period Start Date
attributes.description: The start date of the period covered by this IP accountability review (i.e., the date from which IP transactions are being reconciled). Typically corresponds to the date of the previous monitoring visit or last accountability check.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13.4; 21 CFR 312.62; GCP

tag_set.value: Investigational Product (IP) Accountability Review Period Start Date

attributes.name: rtsm_irt_reconciled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Randomization and Trial Supply Management (RTSM) / Interactive Response Technology (IRT) Reconciled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the site's physical IP accountability records have been reconciled against the RTSM/IRT system (e.g., Medidata Rave RTSM) dispensing and randomization data. Discrepancies between physical records and RTSM/IRT are a critical GCP finding.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13.4; Medidata Rave RTSM; GCP

tag_set.value: Randomization and Trial Supply Management (RTSM) / Interactive Response Technology (IRT) Reconciled Flag

attributes.name: sponsor_notification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the sponsor was notified of IP accountability findings or discrepancies. Populated when sponsor_notified is True. Used to track timeliness of sponsor communication per GCP requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18.3; 21 CFR 312.62; GCP

attributes.name: sponsor_notified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the sponsor has been notified of IP accountability discrepancies, temperature excursions, or critical findings identified during this verification. Required for critical and major findings under GCP.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18.3; 21 CFR 312.62; GCP

attributes.name: storage_condition_verified
attributes.business_glossary_term: Investigational Product (IP) Storage Condition Verified Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the CRA verified that the investigational product was stored under the protocol-specified conditions (e.g., temperature range, light protection, humidity) at the time of the monitoring visit.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13.2; 21 CFR 312.62; EU GMP Annex 13

tag_set.value: Investigational Product (IP) Storage Condition Verified Flag

attributes.name: storage_temperature_max_c
attributes.description: The maximum temperature (in degrees Celsius) recorded in the IP storage area during the period under review, as verified by the CRA from temperature monitoring logs or data loggers. Used to assess compliance with protocol-specified storage conditions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13.2; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR 312.62

attributes.name: storage_temperature_min_c
attributes.description: The minimum temperature (in degrees Celsius) recorded in the IP storage area during the period under review, as verified by the CRA from temperature monitoring logs or data loggers. Used to assess compliance with protocol-specified storage conditions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13.2; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR 312.62

attributes.name: temperature_excursion_details
attributes.description: Free-text description of any temperature excursion identified, including the duration, magnitude, affected IP units, and any corrective actions taken by site staff. Populated only when temperature_excursion_occurred is True.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13.2; 21 CFR 312.62; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: temperature_excursion_occurred
attributes.business_glossary_term: Investigational Product (IP) Temperature Excursion Occurred Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a temperature excursion (storage outside the protocol-specified temperature range) was identified during the CRA review of temperature monitoring records. True triggers mandatory sponsor notification and potential IP quarantine.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13.2; 21 CFR 312.62; EU GMP Annex 13

tag_set.value: Investigational Product (IP) Temperature Excursion Occurred Flag

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: verification_date

attributes.name: verification_status

attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18.3; ALCOA+

attributes.description: The clinically meaningful difference or effect size assumed between treatment arms (e.g., mean difference, odds ratio, hazard ratio) used as the basis for the sample size calculation.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Sample Size Calculations

attributes.name: effect_size_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measurement for the assumed effect size (e.g., mmHg, %, hazard ratio, odds ratio, mean difference), providing dimensional context for regulatory interpretation.
attributes.references: ICH E9; CDISC SDTM Unit Standards

attributes.name: event_rate_control
attributes.description: The assumed event rate or response rate in the control arm, applicable for binary or time-to-event endpoints. Null for continuous endpoints.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Statistical Guidance

attributes.name: event_rate_treatment
attributes.description: The assumed event rate or response rate in the treatment arm, applicable for binary or time-to-event endpoints. Null for continuous endpoints.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Statistical Guidance

attributes.name: follow_up_period_months
attributes.description: The assumed minimum follow-up period in months after the last patient enrolled, used in time-to-event calculations to ensure sufficient events are observed.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Oncology Endpoint Guidance

attributes.name: hypothesis_type
attributes.description: The statistical hypothesis framework applied (superiority, non-inferiority, equivalence), which determines the directionality and margin used in the sample size formula.
attributes.references: ICH E9; ICH E10 Choice of Control Group; FDA Non-Inferiority Guidance

attributes.name: interim_analysis_planned
attributes.description: Indicates whether one or more interim analyses are planned for this study, which may require alpha-spending adjustments to the sample size calculation.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Adaptive Design Guidance; EMA Reflection Paper on Adaptive Designs

attributes.name: median_survival_control
attributes.description: The assumed median survival time in the control arm for time-to-event endpoints, used in log-rank or exponential model-based sample size calculations. Null for non-survival endpoints.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Oncology Endpoint Guidance

attributes.name: non_inferiority_margin
attributes.description: The pre-specified non-inferiority or equivalence margin (delta) used in the hypothesis test, applicable when hypothesis_type is non_inferiority or equivalence. Null for superiority designs.
attributes.references: ICH E9; ICH E10; FDA Non-Inferiority Guidance 2016

attributes.name: number_of_arms
attributes.description: Total number of treatment arms (including control) in the study design, used to determine the allocation structure and multiplicity adjustments.
attributes.references: ICH E9; ICH E10

attributes.name: number_of_events_required
attributes.description: The minimum number of primary endpoint events (e.g., deaths, progressions) required to achieve the specified power for time-to-event analyses. Null for non-event-driven endpoints.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Oncology Endpoint Guidance; EMA Guideline on Survival Analysis

attributes.name: power
attributes.description: The pre-specified statistical power (1 minus Type II error rate, beta) used in the calculation, representing the probability of detecting the assumed effect size. Typically 0.80 or 0.90.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Statistical Guidance

attributes.name: primary_endpoint_type
attributes.description: Statistical nature of the primary efficacy endpoint (e.g., continuous, binary, time-to-event, ordinal, count) that drives the choice of sample size formula.
attributes.references: ICH E9; ICH E9(R1) Estimands Addendum; CDISC ADaM

attributes.name: reference_source
attributes.description: Citation or reference for the data source used to derive the assumed effect size, standard deviation, or event rate (e.g., published literature citation, prior Phase II study identifier, internal pilot data).
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Statistical Guidance; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: sample_size_per_arm
attributes.description: The calculated number of subjects required per treatment arm to achieve the specified power at the given alpha level, accounting for the assumed effect size and standard deviation.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Statistical Guidance

attributes.name: software_name
attributes.description: Name of the validated statistical software used to perform the sample size calculation (e.g., PASS, nQuery Advisor, SAS PROC POWER, R), required for regulatory audit trail.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E9; CDISC Validation Standards

attributes.name: software_version
attributes.description: Version number of the statistical software used (e.g., PASS 2023, nQuery 9.1), required for reproducibility and regulatory validation documentation.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E9; 21 CFR Part 820 (software validation)

attributes.name: standard_deviation
attributes.description: The assumed population standard deviation for continuous endpoints, derived from prior studies or literature, used in the sample size formula. Null for non-continuous endpoints.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Statistical Guidance

attributes.name: statistical_method
attributes.description: The specific statistical formula or method used for the calculation (e.g., two-sample t-test, log-rank test, chi-square test, Kaplan-Meier), providing methodological traceability.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Statistical Guidance; CDISC ADaM

attributes.name: study_design_type
attributes.description: The clinical trial design type (e.g., parallel group, crossover, factorial, adaptive) that determines the statistical methodology applied in the sample size calculation.
attributes.references: ICH E9; ICH E9(R1); FDA Adaptive Design Guidance

attributes.name: study_phase
attributes.description: Clinical development phase of the study (Phase I through Phase IV) for which the sample size is being calculated, influencing regulatory expectations and statistical rigor.
attributes.value_regex: Phase I|Phase II|Phase IIa|Phase IIb|Phase III|Phase IV
attributes.references: ICH E8 General Considerations for Clinical Trials; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: test_sidedness
attributes.description: Specifies whether the statistical test is one-sided or two-sided, directly affecting the critical value and resulting sample size.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Statistical Guidance

attributes.name: total_enrollment_target
attributes.description: The total number of subjects to be enrolled (randomized) after inflating the total sample size by the assumed dropout rate, representing the actual recruitment target submitted in the protocol.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: total_sample_size
attributes.description: The total number of subjects required across all treatment arms before applying the dropout inflation, representing the minimum evaluable sample.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Statistical Guidance

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this sample size calculation record was most recently modified, supporting version control and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ principles; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Guidance on DMCs 2006; EMA Guideline on DMCs

tag_set.value: Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) / Data Monitoring Committee (DMC) Involvement Flag

attributes.name: dsmb_meeting_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) or Data Monitoring Committee (DMC) convened to review the interim analysis results and issue a recommendation.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on DMCs 2006; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: efficacy_boundary_value
attributes.description: Pre-specified critical value (e.g., z-statistic or p-value threshold) for the efficacy stopping boundary at this interim look. If the observed test statistic exceeds this boundary, early stopping for efficacy is triggered.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); O'Brien & Fleming (1979); FDA Adaptive Design Guidance 2019

attributes.name: events_observed
attributes.description: Number of primary endpoint events (e.g., deaths, disease progression events) observed as of the data cutoff date. Applicable for event-driven trials; used to compute the actual information fraction.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); CDISC ADaM ADTTE; FDA Oncology Guidance

attributes.name: events_planned_total
attributes.description: Total number of primary endpoint events required for the final analysis as specified in the the source system size calculation. Used as the denominator for the information fraction in event-driven trials.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); FDA Adaptive Design Guidance 2019

attributes.name: firewall_maintained
attributes.description: Indicates whether a blinding firewall was maintained between the unblinded interim analysis team and the blinded study team (True = firewall in place; False = firewall not maintained or not applicable).
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); FDA Adaptive Design Guidance 2019; EMA Reflection Paper on Adaptive Designs

attributes.name: futility_boundary_binding
attributes.description: Indicates whether the futility stopping boundary is binding (True = mandatory stop if crossed; False = non-binding/advisory only). Binding futility boundaries affect the overall Type I error calculation.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); FDA Adaptive Design Guidance 2019

attributes.name: futility_boundary_value
attributes.description: Pre-specified critical value for the futility stopping boundary at this interim look. If the observed test statistic falls below this boundary, early stopping for futility (lack of efficacy) may be triggered.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); FDA Adaptive Design Guidance 2019; EMA Reflection Paper on Adaptive Designs

attributes.name: information_fraction_actual
attributes.description: Observed proportion of total planned statistical information actually accumulated at the time of this interim analysis. May differ from planned fraction due to enrollment variability or event rate changes.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); Lan-DeMets alpha spending framework

attributes.name: information_fraction_planned
attributes.description: Pre-specified proportion of the total planned statistical information (e.g., events, subjects) accumulated at the time of this interim analysis, expressed as a decimal between 0 and 1 (e.g., 0.5000 = 50% of planned events).
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); Lan-DeMets alpha spending framework; FDA Adaptive Design Guidance 2019

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional context, operational notes, deviations from the pre-specified plan, or DSMB/DMC commentary relevant to this interim analysis that is not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: observed_p_value
attributes.description: The nominal p-value from the primary hypothesis test at this interim analysis. Must be interpreted in the context of the alpha spending boundary, not as a standalone significance threshold.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); CDISC ADaM; FDA Statistical Guidance

attributes.name: observed_test_statistic
attributes.description: The actual computed test statistic (e.g., z-score, chi-square, log-rank statistic) from the interim analysis dataset. Compared against efficacy and futility boundaries to determine the outcome.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); CDISC ADaM; SAS Drug Development

attributes.name: planned_analysis_date
attributes.description: Pre-specified calendar date on which the interim analysis is planned to be conducted, as documented in the the source system charter.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the interim analysis results or the resulting design adaptation must be submitted to a regulatory authority (FDA, EMA, PMDA, etc.) as part of an IND, NDA, BLA, or MAA amendment (True = submission required; False = not required).
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312; FDA IND Regulations; EMA Clinical Trial Regulation EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E9(R1)

attributes.name: results_disclosed_externally
attributes.description: Indicates whether the interim analysis results have been disclosed externally (e.g., to regulators, in a public registry, or in a publication) prior to study completion (True = disclosed; False = not disclosed).
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); WHO ICTRP; EU CTR 536/2014; FDA Transparency Guidance

attributes.name: revised_sample_size
attributes.description: Updated total sample size determined through the pre-specified sample size re-estimation procedure at this interim analysis. Null if sample_size_reestimated is False.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); FDA Adaptive Design Guidance 2019

attributes.name: sample_size_reestimated
attributes.description: Indicates whether a pre-specified sample size re-estimation was performed as part of this interim analysis (True = sample size re-estimated; False = no re-estimation performed).
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); FDA Adaptive Design Guidance 2019

attributes.name: sas_program_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the SAS Drug Development program or analysis package used to execute this interim analysis, enabling reproducibility and audit traceability.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; CDISC ADaM; SAS Drug Development platform

attributes.name: stopping_rule_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the specific stopping rule(s) triggered at this interim analysis, including the criterion crossed and the observed vs. boundary values. Populated only when stopping_rule_triggered is True.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); FDA Adaptive Design Guidance 2019

attributes.name: stopping_rule_triggered
attributes.description: Indicates whether any pre-specified stopping rule (efficacy, futility, or safety) was triggered by the results of this interim analysis (True = stopping rule crossed; False = no stopping rule triggered).
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); FDA Adaptive Design Guidance 2019

attributes.name: subjects_enrolled_at_cutoff
attributes.description: Total number of subjects enrolled in the study as of the data cutoff date for this interim analysis. Provides context for the information fraction and statistical power.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); CDISC SDTM DM domain

attributes.name: unblinding_authorization_date
attributes.description: Date on which formal authorization was granted to unblind the interim analysis data, as documented in the unblinding log. Required for audit trail and blinding integrity compliance.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: unblinding_scope
attributes.description: Defines the extent of treatment assignment unblinding performed for this interim analysis: full (all treatment assignments revealed to the analysis team), partial (only aggregate or summary-level unblinding), or none (blinded analysis only).
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Adaptive Design Guidance 2019; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this interim analysis record was most recently modified, supporting audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles

products.name: database_lock_event

attributes.name: study_protocol_amendment_id

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: submission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.submission. Business justification: Database lock date is the critical data cutoff milestone that determines submission readiness for NDA/BLA packages.

attributes.name: tmf_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: Database lock memos are essential TMF documents per ICH E6 R2. The existing lock_memo_reference is a denormalized text reference; replacing it with a proper FK to tmf_document enforces
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: actual_lock_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the database was formally locked. This is the principal business event date for the DBL milestone and is recorded in the eTMF, regulatory submissions, and CSR statistical sections.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; 21 CFR Part 312; CDISC SDTM/ADaM

attributes.name: amendment_number
attributes.description: Sequential amendment number for post-lock data corrections. Zero for the original lock; increments with each formal unlock and re-lock cycle. Tracks the amendment history of the locked database.
