attributes.name: amendment_reason
attributes.description: Formal description of the reason for unlocking and re-locking the database after the initial lock. Documents the nature of the data correction or update requiring the amendment. Null for the original lock (amendment_number = 0).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: analysis_type
attributes.description: The type of statistical analysis for which this database lock is being performed. Determines the downstream workflow: interim analyses feed DSMB/DMC reviews; final analyses feed CSR and regulatory submissions (NDA/BLA/MAA).
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; ICH E9(R1); FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs; EMA Guideline on Multiplicity

attributes.name: biostatistics_approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the Biostatistics representative provided electronic authorization for the database lock. Required for 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: coding_complete
attributes.description: Indicates whether all medical coding assignments (MedDRA for adverse events/medical history, WHO-DD for concomitant medications) have been completed and verified in the EDC system prior to database lock.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; MedDRA Guidelines; WHO-DD Guidelines; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which this database lock event record was first created in the lakehouse (Silver Layer). Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ standards.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ Principles; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: data_cut_date
attributes.description: The clinical data cut-off date defining which subject data and observations are included in this lock. All data with a collection date on or before this date is included in the locked dataset. Critical for interim and partial locks.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; ICH E9(R1) Addendum; CDISC ADaM Guidelines

attributes.name: dbl_event_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique identifier for this database lock event (e.g., DBL-2024-001). Used in regulatory submissions, TMF filings, and cross-system references in Medidata Rave and the source system
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; CDISC Data Management Guidelines

attributes.name: dm_approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the Data Management representative provided electronic authorization for the database lock. Required for 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: dmp_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the Data Management Plan (DMP) that governed the data collection and cleaning activities for this database lock event.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC Data Management Guidelines; FDA Guidance on Clinical Trial Conduct

attributes.name: dsmb_notification_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) Notification Date
attributes.description: The date on which the DSMB/DMC was formally notified of the database lock and provided access to the locked dataset for their review.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Guidance on DSMB; ICH E9(R1)

tag_set.value: Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) Notification Date

attributes.name: dsmb_notification_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) Notification Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) or Data Monitoring Committee (DMC) must be notified of this database lock event, typically for interim analysis locks where the DSMB reviews unblinded data.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Guidance on DSMB; ICH E9(R1)

tag_set.value: Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) Notification Required Flag

attributes.name: edc_system_lock_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Data Capture (EDC) System Lock Reference
attributes.description: The lock event reference number or identifier generated by the EDC system (Medidata Rave) at the time of lock execution. Used for cross-system traceability between the lakehouse and the source EDC system.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ Principles

tag_set.value: Electronic Data Capture (EDC) System Lock Reference

attributes.name: lock_scope
attributes.description: Defines the scope of data included in this lock event. Full study locks the entire study database; interim locks a defined data cut for interim analysis; partial locks a subset of data (e.g., specific sites or forms); cohort locks a defined patient
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; CDISC Data Management Guidelines; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs

attributes.name: lock_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the database lock event. Tracks progression from planning through execution and any subsequent unlock/re-lock cycles required for data corrections or amendments.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; CDISC Data Management Guidelines

attributes.name: lock_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time (with timezone) at which the database lock was executed in the EDC system (Medidata Rave). Required for 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail compliance and ALCOA+ data integrity standards.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ Principles; CDISC Data Management Guidelines

attributes.name: lock_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lock is a hard lock (no further data changes permitted without formal unlock and re-lock procedure) or a soft lock (data is locked for analysis but minor corrections may still be applied under controlled conditions).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; CDISC Data Management Guidelines

attributes.name: medical_monitor_approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the Medical Monitor provided electronic authorization for the database lock. Required for 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, observations, or operational notes related to this database lock event that are not captured in structured fields. Includes deviations from planned timelines or special circumstances.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: outstanding_query_count
attributes.description: Number of open data queries (discrepancies) remaining unresolved in the EDC system (Medidata Rave) at the time of database lock. A non-zero count must be formally justified and documented per GCP and ALCOA+ requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ Principles; CDISC Data Management Guidelines; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: outstanding_query_justification
attributes.description: Formal written justification for proceeding with database lock when outstanding queries remain unresolved. Required by GCP and ALCOA+ when outstanding_query_count is greater than zero. Documented in the DMP and lock memo.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ Principles; CDISC Data Management Guidelines

attributes.name: planned_lock_date
attributes.description: The originally scheduled calendar date for the database lock event as defined in the Data Management Plan (DMP) and study timeline. Used for milestone tracking in the source system and project planning.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC Data Management Guidelines; FDA Guidance on Clinical Trial Conduct

attributes.name: pre_lock_qc_checklist_complete
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pre-Lock Quality Control (QC) Checklist Completion Status
attributes.description: Indicates whether all items on the pre-database lock Quality Control (QC) checklist have been completed and signed off prior to lock execution. The checklist covers data cleaning, query resolution, coding completion, and SAE reconciliation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC Data Management Guidelines; FDA Guidance on Clinical Trial Conduct

tag_set.value: Pre-Lock Quality Control (QC) Checklist Completion Status

attributes.name: pre_lock_qc_completion_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pre-Lock Quality Control (QC) Checklist Completion Date
attributes.description: The date on which the pre-database lock QC checklist was formally completed and all items signed off. Must precede the actual lock date.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC Data Management Guidelines

tag_set.value: Pre-Lock Quality Control (QC) Checklist Completion Date

attributes.name: sae_reconciliation_complete
attributes.business_glossary_term: Serious Adverse Event (SAE) Reconciliation Completion Status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reconciliation between the EDC system (Medidata Rave) and the safety database (the source system for Serious Adverse Events (SAEs) has been completed and confirmed prior to database lock.

tag_set.value: Serious Adverse Event (SAE) Reconciliation Completion Status

attributes.name: sdv_complete
attributes.description: Indicates whether Source Data Verification (SDV) has been completed to the required percentage or scope across all sites prior to database lock. SDV confirms EDC data matches source documents per GCP requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; FDA Guidance on Risk-Based Monitoring; EMA Reflection Paper on Risk-Based Quality Management

attributes.name: sites_locked_count
attributes.description: Total number of investigative sites whose data is included in this database lock event. Relevant for partial and site-specific lock scopes.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC Data Management Guidelines

attributes.name: study_part
attributes.description: Identifies the specific study part, period, or epoch covered by this lock event (e.g., Part A, Part B, Period 1, Run-in, Treatment, Follow-up). Applicable for multi-part or adaptive study designs.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs

attributes.name: subjects_locked_count
attributes.description: Total number of study subjects whose data is included in this database lock event. Used for completeness verification and comparison against enrollment targets defined in the the source system.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ICH E9 Statistical Principles; CDISC ADaM Guidelines

attributes.name: unblinding_date
attributes.description: The date on which treatment assignment unblinding was performed following the database lock. Null if unblinding_required is false or unblinding has not yet occurred.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs

attributes.name: unblinding_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether treatment unblinding is required as part of or immediately following this database lock event. Applicable for blinded studies where the lock precedes the formal unblinding procedure for final or interim analysis.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; ICH E9(R1); ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs

attributes.name: unlock_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the database was formally unlocked to permit post-lock data corrections. Null if the database has not been unlocked. Required for 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ Principles; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: confidence_interval_level

attributes.name: covariates
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of pre-specified covariates and stratification factors included in the statistical model for this endpoint (e.g., 'baseline_value, region, age_group'). Defined in the the source system guideline on adjustment for baseline covariates.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this statistical endpoint record was first created in the system. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance.

attributes.name: csr_section_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the Clinical Study Report (CSR) section where this endpoint's results are reported (e.g., 'Section 11.4.1'). Supports traceability from the source system to the final regulatory submission document per ICH E3.

attributes.name: effect_measure
attributes.description: The statistical measure used to quantify the treatment effect for this endpoint (e.g., 'Mean Difference', 'Hazard Ratio', 'Odds Ratio', 'Risk Difference', 'Least Squares Mean Difference'). Specified in the the source system in TLFs and the CSR.
attributes.references: ICH E9; CDISC ADaM; FDA Statistical Guidance; EMA Guideline on Clinical Trials

attributes.name: endpoint_classification
attributes.description: Hierarchical classification of the endpoint within the study's inferential framework: primary (confirmatory, controls Type I error), secondary (supportive), exploratory (hypothesis-generating), or safety (adverse event-related).
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Multiple Endpoints; EMA Guideline on Multiplicity Issues

attributes.name: endpoint_description
attributes.description: Full narrative description of the statistical endpoint as stated in the the source system, including the precise definition of the outcome measure, population, and timeframe.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Clinical Trial Endpoints; EMA Guideline on Clinical Trials

attributes.name: endpoint_name
attributes.description: Short, human-readable name of the statistical endpoint as defined in the the source system Survival', 'Change from Baseline in HbA1c at Week 24'). Used in TLF titles and regulatory submissions.

attributes.name: consent_method

attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Use of Electronic Informed Consent (2016); ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.9; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: consent_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this consent event, typically generated by the EDC or eConsent system (Clinpal). Used for cross-system traceability and audit referencing (e.g., CNST-2024-00123).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: consent_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the subject's consent. Drives subject eligibility and study participation decisions. 'consented' = valid active consent; 'withdrawn' = subject revoked consent; 're_consent_pending' = amendment requires new signature; 'expired'
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50; GDPR Article 7; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 29

attributes.name: consent_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time (with timezone offset) at which the consent signature or electronic acknowledgement was captured. Required for 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance and ALCOA+ contemporaneous documentation.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: consent_type
attributes.description: Classification of the consent event. 'initial' = first consent for study participation; 're_consent' = repeat consent after protocol amendment; 'amendment' = consent to a specific protocol change; 'optional_procedure' = consent for an optional sub-study
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: consenting_staff_role
attributes.description: Role of the staff member who obtained consent. 'PI' = Principal Investigator; 'sub_investigator' = Sub-Investigator; 'CRC' = Clinical Research Coordinator; 'delegate' = other delegated staff member listed on the delegation log.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.1; 21 CFR Part 312.62; FDA Delegation of Authority

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this consent record was first created in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; GDPR Article 5(2)

attributes.name: data_use_after_withdrawal
attributes.business_glossary_term: Data Use After Withdrawal Permitted Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject explicitly permitted use of previously collected data after withdrawal of consent. Critical for GDPR right-to-erasure compliance and statistical analysis plan (the source system) decisions on data inclusion.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17; ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.3; FDA Guidance on Informed Consent; HIPAA

tag_set.value: Data Use After Withdrawal Permitted Flag

attributes.name: econsent_completion_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the eConsent workflow modules completed by the subject in Clinpal (0.00–100.00). Used to track partial completions and identify subjects who did not fully review all consent materials before signing.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Use of Electronic Informed Consent (2016); Clinpal eConsent Platform; ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8

attributes.name: gdpr_lawful_basis
attributes.description: Legal basis under GDPR Article 9 for processing the subject's special category (health) data. 'explicit_consent' = subject provided explicit consent per Article 9(2)(a); 'vital_interests' = Article 9(2)(c); 'public_interest' = Article 9(2)(i) for
attributes.references: GDPR Article 9; GDPR Article 6; EU CTR 536/2014; EMA Guidance on GDPR in Clinical Trials

attributes.name: hipaa_authorization_obtained
attributes.description: Indicates whether a HIPAA Authorization for use and disclosure of Protected Health Information (PHI) was obtained from the subject, as required for U.S. clinical trials. May be combined with or separate from the ICF.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164.508; 21 CFR Part 50; FDA Guidance on HIPAA and Clinical Research

attributes.name: icf_approval_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Informed Consent Form (ICF) IRB/IEC Approval Date
attributes.description: Date on which the IRB or IEC approved the specific ICF version used for this consent event. Confirms that the consent was obtained using a currently approved document, a key GCP compliance check.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3.1; 21 CFR Part 56; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 9

tag_set.value: Informed Consent Form (ICF) IRB/IEC Approval Date

attributes.name: lar_involved
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Legally Authorized Representative (LAR) provided consent on behalf of the subject (e.g., for subjects who lack decision-making capacity, minors, or cognitively impaired individuals).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.12; 21 CFR Part 50.3(l); EU CTR 536/2014 Article 31

attributes.name: reconsent_due_date
attributes.description: Deadline by which the subject must complete re-consent to remain eligible for continued study participation. Populated when reconsent_required is True. Drives site monitoring alerts.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.2; 21 CFR Part 50; Oracle Siebel CTMS monitoring workflow

attributes.name: reconsent_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject is required to provide re-consent due to a protocol amendment, new safety information, or ICF version update. Triggers re-consent workflow in Clinpal.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.2; 21 CFR Part 50; FDA Guidance on Informed Consent Amendments

attributes.name: reconsent_trigger
attributes.description: Reason that triggered the re-consent requirement. 'protocol_amendment' = protocol change affecting subject participation; 'safety_update' = new safety information impacting risk-benefit; 'icf_version_update' = new IRB-approved ICF version
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.2; 21 CFR Part 50; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 29

attributes.name: sample_use_after_withdrawal
attributes.business_glossary_term: Biological Sample Use After Withdrawal Permitted Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject permitted continued use of previously collected biological samples (e.g., blood, tissue) after withdrawal of consent. Distinct from data_use_after_withdrawal as it governs physical biospecimen retention.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.3; GDPR Article 17; 21 CFR Part 50; EU Biobanking Regulations

tag_set.value: Biological Sample Use After Withdrawal Permitted Flag

attributes.name: subject_questions_documented
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject's questions and the investigator's responses were documented during the consent discussion, as required by GCP. Supports audit readiness and IRB inspection compliance.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.10; 21 CFR Part 50.25; OHRP Guidance

attributes.name: translation_language
attributes.description: ISO 639-1/639-2 language code of the ICF translation provided to the subject (e.g., 'es' for Spanish, 'fr' for French, 'zh-CN' for Simplified Chinese). Null if the ICF was provided in the site's primary language.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.6; 21 CFR Part 50.25; ISO 639-1; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this consent record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Required for change tracking, audit trail completeness, and ALCOA+ compliance.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; GDPR Article 5(2)

attributes.name: withdrawal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subject formally withdrew consent to participate in the study. Populated only when consent_status is 'withdrawn'. Triggers subject discontinuation workflow.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.3; 21 CFR Part 50.25(a)(8); GDPR Article 7(3); EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: withdrawal_reason
attributes.description: Primary reason for consent withdrawal as documented at the site. Used for subject disposition analysis and protocol feasibility reporting. Aligns with CDISC SDTM DS Domain disposition reason coding.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.3; CDISC SDTM DS Domain; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: witness_name
attributes.description: Full name of the impartial witness present during the informed consent process, where required. Captured when witness_required is True. Classified as confidential as it identifies a third-party individual in a clinical context.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.9; 21 CFR Part 50.27(b)

attributes.name: witness_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a witness was required for this consent event (e.g., for illiterate subjects, subjects with limited reading ability, or verbal consent scenarios per ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.9).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.9; 21 CFR Part 50.27(b)

attributes.name: witness_signature_date
attributes.description: Date on which the impartial witness signed the ICF, confirming they witnessed the consent process. Must match or follow the subject's consent_date.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.9; 21 CFR Part 50.27(b); ALCOA+

products.name: econsent_session
products.description: Tracks each eConsent workflow session initiated in Clinpal for a subject, including both on-site and remote/decentralized consent sessions. Captures session start and end timestamps, device type, IP address, session modality (in-person, remote via
products.reference: eConsent Session / Clinpal Session

attributes.name: econsent_session_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each eConsent workflow session initiated in Clinpal for a trial subject. Primary key for this data product.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: icf_version_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific IRB/IEC-approved Informed Consent Form (ICF) version presented to the subject during this session. Ensures the correct, current consent document was used.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: investigational_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical trial site at which the subject is enrolled and where this consent session is associated. Supports site-level compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study (protocol) for which this eConsent session was conducted. Enables study-level consent compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: tmf_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: Econsent session audit trails and e-signature records are TMF-filed under 21 CFR Part 11 and ICH E6(R2). Regulatory inspectors review econsent session records against TMF filings.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: trial_subject_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trial subject (participant) for whom this eConsent session was initiated. Links to the subject master record.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 50; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: capacity_assessment_outcome
attributes.description: Result of the capacity assessment performed for the subject. 'capable' indicates the subject has decision-making capacity; 'not-capable' indicates a legally authorized representative is required; 'not-assessed' indicates no assessment was conducted
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50.20; OHRP Guidance; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 29

attributes.name: capacity_assessment_performed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal capacity assessment was performed for the subject prior to or during this consent session (True = performed; False = not performed). Required for vulnerable populations and subjects with potential cognitive impairment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50.20; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 29; OHRP Guidance

attributes.name: clinpal_session_ref
attributes.description: The native session identifier assigned by the Clinpal eConsent platform for this workflow session. Used for cross-system traceability and reconciliation with the source system of record.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; Clinpal eConsent Platform

attributes.name: communication_platform
attributes.description: The teleconference or video communication platform used for remote consent sessions (e.g., Zoom, Microsoft Teams, WebEx). Applicable only when session_modality is 'remote-video' or 'remote-phone'.
attributes.references: FDA Remote Consent Guidance (2020); ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: comprehension_attempt_number
attributes.description: The sequential attempt number for the comprehension check within this session. Subjects may be permitted multiple attempts after remediation. Tracks how many times the subject attempted the comprehension assessment.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Informed Consent (2016); ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; Clinpal eConsent Platform

attributes.name: comprehension_check_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the comprehension check question set administered to the subject during this session. Ensures traceability to the specific validated question set used, as question sets may be updated with ICF amendments.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Informed Consent (2016); ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; Clinpal eConsent Platform

attributes.name: comprehension_overall_passed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject passed the overall comprehension check for this session (True = passed; False = failed). Determined by comparing the score against the minimum passing threshold defined in the ICF version.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Informed Consent (2016); ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; Clinpal eConsent Platform

attributes.name: comprehension_questions_passed
attributes.description: Number of comprehension check questions answered correctly by the subject in this session. Used to compute the overall comprehension score and determine pass/fail outcome.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Informed Consent (2016); ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8

attributes.name: comprehension_questions_total
attributes.description: Total number of comprehension check questions administered to the subject in this session. Used to calculate the comprehension score and assess understanding of the consent content.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Informed Consent (2016); ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8

attributes.name: consent_granted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject (or legally authorized representative) granted informed consent at the conclusion of this session (True = consent granted; False = consent not granted or declined). The definitive consent outcome flag for this session.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 50; ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; GDPR Article 7; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.508

attributes.name: consenter_role
attributes.description: The role of the individual who provided consent during this session. 'subject' indicates the participant themselves; 'legally-authorized-representative' indicates a proxy consenter; 'parent' or 'guardian' applies to pediatric studies.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 50.25; ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 29

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time (with timezone offset) when this eConsent session record was first created in the data platform. Supports ALCOA+ (Attributable, Contemporaneous) audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5(2); ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: device_os
attributes.description: Operating system and version of the device used during the eConsent session (e.g., iOS 16.4, Android 13, Windows 11). Supports technical audit trail and system validation requirements under 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Remote Consent Guidance (2020)

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: Category of device used by the subject to access and complete the eConsent session. Supports technical audit trail requirements and device compatibility analysis.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Remote Consent Guidance (2020)

attributes.name: esignature_captured
attributes.description: Indicates whether an electronic signature was successfully captured from the subject (or legally authorized representative) during this session (True = captured; False = not captured).
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Section 11.50; ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: esignature_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time (with timezone offset) when the subject's electronic signature was captured in Clinpal. Critical for ALCOA+ (Contemporaneous) compliance and 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail. Null if no signature was captured.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Section 11.50; ALCOA+ (Contemporaneous); ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8

attributes.name: interpreter_used
attributes.description: Indicates whether a language interpreter was used during the consent session (True = interpreter used; False = no interpreter). Relevant for non-English-speaking subjects and required for GCP documentation of consent comprehension.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50.25; FDA Guidance on Informed Consent (2016)

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: IP address of the device used by the subject during the eConsent session. Required for 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records audit trail and GDPR accountability. May be considered PII in certain jurisdictions.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Section 11.10; GDPR Article 4; HIPAA Security Rule

attributes.name: irb_approval_ref
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board (IRB) / Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) Approval Reference
attributes.description: The IRB or IEC approval number or reference associated with the ICF version used in this session. Confirms the consent document presented was approved by the appropriate ethics body at the time of the session.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 56; ICH E6(R2) Section 3.1; EU CTR 536/2014; OHRP 45 CFR Part 46

tag_set.value: Institutional Review Board (IRB) / Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) Approval Reference

attributes.name: reconsent_trigger
attributes.description: Indicates whether this session was initiated as a re-consent event (True) rather than an initial consent (False). Re-consent is triggered by protocol amendments, new safety information, or ICF version updates requiring subjects to re-affirm consent.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.2; 21 CFR Part 50.25; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 28

attributes.name: remediation_provided
attributes.description: Indicates whether remediation (additional educational content or re-review of ICF sections) was provided to the subject following a failed comprehension check attempt (True = remediation was provided; False = not provided).
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Informed Consent (2016); ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8

attributes.name: remediation_steps_count
attributes.description: Number of remediation steps (re-review sections or educational modules) completed by the subject following a failed comprehension check. Null if no remediation was provided.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Informed Consent (2016); ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; Clinpal eConsent Platform

attributes.name: review_steps_completed
attributes.description: The number of ICF review steps (content sections) the subject completed during this session. Compared against review_steps_total to assess session progress and identify drop-off points.
attributes.references: Clinpal eConsent Platform; ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: review_steps_total
attributes.description: The total number of review steps (content sections or pages) defined in the ICF version presented during this session. Used to calculate completion percentage and identify where subjects abandoned the session.
attributes.references: Clinpal eConsent Platform; ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8

attributes.name: session_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time (with timezone offset) when the eConsent session concluded, regardless of outcome (completed, abandoned, timed-out, or declined). Null if the session is still in-progress.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ (Contemporaneous); ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: session_language
attributes.description: IETF BCP 47 language tag representing the language in which the eConsent session was conducted (e.g., 'en', 'es', 'fr-CA'). Ensures the subject received consent information in their preferred language, as required by GCP and GDPR.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50.25(b); GDPR Article 7; IETF BCP 47

attributes.name: session_modality
attributes.description: The mode by which the consent session was conducted. 'in-person' indicates the subject and site staff were physically co-located; 'remote-video' indicates a teleconference/video call; 'remote-phone' indicates a telephone-only session; 'hybrid' indicates a
attributes.references: FDA Remote Consent Guidance (2020); ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: session_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time (with timezone offset) when the eConsent session was initiated by the subject or site staff in Clinpal. Serves as the principal business event timestamp for this transaction.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ (Contemporaneous); ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: session_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the eConsent workflow session. 'in-progress' indicates an active session; 'completed' indicates the subject finished all steps; 'abandoned' indicates the subject exited without completing; 'timed-out' indicates the session
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Remote Consent Guidance (2020); ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: subject_auth_method
attributes.description: The method used to authenticate the subject's identity at the start of the eConsent session. Supports 21 CFR Part 11 identity verification requirements for electronic signatures.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Section 11.100; ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: subject_location_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the country where the subject was physically located at the time of the eConsent session. Relevant for decentralized trials and cross-border GDPR/HIPAA compliance determination.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 3; HIPAA; ISO 3166-1; FDA Remote Consent Guidance (2020)

attributes.name: technical_issue_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of any technical issue encountered during the session (e.g., 'Video connection dropped at step 3', 'Signature pad unresponsive'). Null if no technical issue was encountered. Supports deviation investigation and CAPA processes.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); MasterControl CAPA

attributes.name: technical_issue_encountered
attributes.description: Indicates whether any technical issue (connectivity failure, platform error, device malfunction, signature capture failure) was encountered during the session (True = issue encountered; False = no issues).
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Remote Consent Guidance (2020); Clinpal eConsent Platform

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time (with timezone offset) when this eConsent session record was last modified in the data platform. Supports change tracking and audit trail completeness under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5(2); ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: witness_esignature_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time (with timezone offset) when the site staff witness (PI or CRC) applied their electronic countersignature to the consent record. Required for GCP-compliant consent documentation. Null if witness signature was not captured in this session.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Section 11.50; ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50

products.name: reconsent_trigger

attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each re-consent trigger record in the system. Primary key for the reconsent_trigger data product.

attributes.name: compliance_protocol_deviation_id

attributes.name: enrollment_id

attributes.name: icf_amendment_id

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: icf_version_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific Informed Consent Form (ICF) version that triggered the re-consent requirement. Identifies the new IRB/IEC-approved ICF version subjects must sign.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.2; 21 CFR Part 50.27; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: irb_iec_approval_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to site.irb_iec_approval. Business justification: Operational compliance: reconsent triggers are often mandated by a new IRB/IEC approval of an amended ICF.

attributes.name: safety_report_submission_id

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study for which this re-consent trigger was raised. Links the trigger to the parent study protocol context.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM IG

attributes.name: study_protocol_amendment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the protocol amendment that necessitated this re-consent trigger, when the trigger type is a protocol amendment. Nullable for non-amendment triggers.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 3.3.7; 21 CFR Part 312.30; FDA Guidance on Protocol Amendments

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigative site at which the re-consent trigger applies. Drives site-level workflow assignment and monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4; Oracle Siebel CTMS site management

attributes.name: subject_randomization_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to randomization.subject_randomization. Business justification: When a reconsent trigger is raised (e.g., safety letter, protocol amendment), the subject's active randomization and treatment arm assignment must be reviewed to determine

attributes.name: susar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.safety_communication. Business justification: Reconsent is formally initiated by safety communications (SUSAR notifications, urgent safety measures).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: trial_subject_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trial subject who must be re-consented. Nullable when the trigger applies to all subjects at a site or study level rather than a specific individual.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50; GDPR Article 7; HIPAA 45 CFR 164

attributes.name: triggering_submission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.submission. Business justification: Regulatory submissions (e.g., agency-directed safety label updates) directly mandate reconsent.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: withdrawal_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to consent.withdrawal. Business justification: The reconsent_trigger table tracks events that necessitate re-consent, and one possible resolution outcome is subject withdrawal.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: affected_icf_version_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Affected Informed Consent Form (ICF) Version Number
attributes.description: The version number of the new IRB/IEC-approved ICF that subjects must sign as part of the re-consent process. Stored as a human-readable version string (e.g., 'v3.0', 'Amendment 2') for audit trail and site communication purposes.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.2; 21 CFR Part 50.27; CDISC CDASH ICF domain

tag_set.value: Affected Informed Consent Form (ICF) Version Number

attributes.name: affected_subject_count
attributes.description: The total number of subjects at the site (or study-wide, per subject_scope) who are required to be re-consented as a result of this trigger. Used for site workload planning and sponsor oversight reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; Oracle Siebel CTMS monitoring; FDA Guidance on Protocol Amendments

attributes.name: capacity_assessment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the subject's mental capacity to provide informed consent was formally assessed. Nullable when capacity_assessment_required is False. Required for vulnerable population compliance documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.12; 21 CFR Part 50.20; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 31

attributes.name: capacity_assessment_outcome
attributes.description: The result of the mental capacity assessment for the subject. Determines whether the subject can provide direct consent or whether a legally authorized representative (LAR) must consent on their behalf.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.12; 21 CFR Part 50.20; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 31; Mental Capacity Act 2005 (UK)

attributes.name: capacity_assessment_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a mental capacity assessment is required before re-consent can be obtained from this subject, applicable for vulnerable populations or subjects with cognitive impairment. Triggers capacity assessment workflow when True.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.12; 21 CFR Part 50.20; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 31; Mental Capacity Act 2005 (UK)

attributes.name: consent_method
attributes.description: The method by which re-consent was or will be obtained from the subject. Drives regulatory compliance checks and audit trail requirements. Values: electronic (eConsent via Clinpal), paper (wet-ink signature), verbal_with_witness (emergency/capacity
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50.27; FDA Guidance on Use of Electronic Informed Consent; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 29

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp at which this re-consent trigger record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and ALCOA+ compliance. Distinct from trigger_date which represents the real-world event date.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; ALCOA+ principles; GDPR Article 5(2)

attributes.name: escalation_date
attributes.description: The date on which this re-consent trigger was escalated to the sponsor, CRA, or regulatory authority. Nullable when escalation_required is False. Used for compliance tracking and CAPA initiation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; Oracle Siebel CTMS; MasterControl CAPA tracking

attributes.name: escalation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this re-consent trigger has been escalated to the sponsor, CRA, or regulatory authority due to non-compliance, overdue status, or subject refusal. Triggers escalation workflow and sponsor notification.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; Oracle Siebel CTMS monitoring; FDA Guidance on Clinical Investigator Responsibilities

attributes.name: irb_iec_approval_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Approval Date
attributes.description: The date on which the IRB or IEC approved the updated ICF version that subjects must sign. Establishes the earliest permissible date for initiating re-consent at the site.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 3.1.2; 21 CFR Part 56.109; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 4

tag_set.value: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Approval Date

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, site communications, or contextual information related to this re-consent trigger that is not captured in structured fields. Supports audit trail completeness per ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: previous_icf_version_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Previous Informed Consent Form (ICF) Version Number
attributes.description: The version number of the ICF that the subject had previously signed before this re-consent trigger was raised. Enables version-to-version change tracking and audit trail completeness per ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11

tag_set.value: Previous Informed Consent Form (ICF) Version Number

attributes.name: protocol_deviation_raised
attributes.description: Indicates whether a protocol deviation has been raised in the compliance system as a result of failure to re-consent within the required timeframe. When True, links to the compliance.protocol_deviation product for CAPA tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.5; 21 CFR Part 312.62; FDA Guidance on Protocol Deviations; MasterControl CAPA

attributes.name: reconsent_completed_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the subject was successfully re-consented and signed the updated ICF. Nullable until re-consent is completed. Used to calculate cycle time and compliance metrics.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50.27; ALCOA+ principles; Clinpal eConsent

attributes.name: reconsent_deadline
attributes.description: The date by which re-consent must be obtained from the subject, as mandated by the IRB/IEC approval, regulatory authority, or sponsor protocol. Used to calculate overdue status and drive site escalation workflows.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.2; 21 CFR Part 50; IRB/IEC approval conditions; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: reconsented_subject_count
attributes.description: The number of subjects who have been successfully re-consented to date against this trigger. Compared against affected_subject_count to track completion progress and identify outstanding re-consents.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; Oracle Siebel CTMS monitoring; Clinpal eConsent

attributes.name: reminder_count
attributes.description: The total number of reminder notifications sent to the site for this re-consent trigger. Used to assess site responsiveness and determine when escalation is warranted per sponsor oversight SOPs.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; Oracle Siebel CTMS; sponsor oversight SOPs

attributes.name: reminder_sent_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent reminder notification was sent to the site regarding the outstanding re-consent requirement. Used to track communication cadence and demonstrate sponsor oversight diligence.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; Oracle Siebel CTMS monitoring; Clinpal eConsent notification

attributes.name: resolution_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the re-consent trigger. Drives operational dashboards and site follow-up. Values: pending (trigger raised, re-consent not yet initiated), in_progress (re-consent process underway), completed (subject successfully re-consented)
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50; Oracle Siebel CTMS workflow; Clinpal eConsent

attributes.name: subject_scope
attributes.description: Defines the population of subjects affected by this re-consent trigger. Values: individual_subject (single subject identified by subject_id), all_active_subjects (all currently enrolled subjects at the site), site_cohort (a defined subset at the site)
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.2; OHRP Guidance on Re-Consent; FDA Guidance on Protocol Amendments

attributes.name: subject_withdrawal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject withdrew from the study as a result of the re-consent process (e.g., declined to sign the updated ICF). When True, triggers subject discontinuation workflow and safety follow-up per protocol.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.3; 21 CFR Part 50.25(a)(8); EU CTR 536/2014 Article 28(3)

attributes.name: trigger_date
attributes.description: The date on which the re-consent triggering event occurred (e.g., date of protocol amendment approval, date of safety letter issuance, date of regulatory authority directive).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: trigger_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the specific event or change that necessitated re-consent. Provides context beyond the trigger type classification, including the nature of the protocol change, safety finding, or regulatory directive.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.2; OHRP Guidance on Re-Consent; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: trigger_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the re-consent trigger event, used in site communications, audit trails, and regulatory correspondence. Follows the format RCT-{StudyCode}-{Sequence}.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 50.25; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 28

attributes.name: trigger_type
attributes.description: Classification of the event that necessitated re-consent. Drives workflow routing and regulatory reporting. Values: protocol_amendment (change to study protocol), new_safety_information (SAE/SUSAR/IB update), icf_version_update (administrative ICF
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.2; 21 CFR Part 50.25(b); EU CTR 536/2014 Article 28; OHRP Guidance on Re-Consent

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp at which this re-consent trigger record was most recently modified. Required for audit trail integrity, change tracking, and ALCOA+ compliance in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; ALCOA+ principles; GDPR Article 5(2)

attributes.name: waiver_approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the IRB/IEC formally approved the waiver of re-consent for this trigger. Nullable when no waiver has been granted. Required for regulatory audit trail when resolution_status is 'waived'.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 56.109(c); 45 CFR 46.116(d)

attributes.name: waiver_justification
attributes.description: Documented justification for waiving the re-consent requirement, as approved by the IRB/IEC. Required when resolution_status is 'waived'. Must reference the IRB/IEC waiver approval and the regulatory basis for the waiver.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 56.109(c); OHRP Guidance on Waiver of Informed Consent; 45 CFR 46.116(d)

attributes.name: withdrawal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the subject formally withdrew from the study following refusal to re-consent. Nullable when subject_withdrawal_flag is False. Used for subject disposition reporting and safety follow-up scheduling.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.3; 21 CFR Part 50.25(a)(8); CDISC SDTM DS domain

products.name: capacity_assessment

attributes.name: consent_subject_consent_id

attributes.name: icf_version_id

attributes.name: lar_representative_id

attributes.name: prior_assessment_capacity_assessment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the immediately preceding capacity assessment record for this subject on this study, enabling longitudinal tracking of capacity status changes over the subject's participation lifecycle.

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study for which this capacity assessment is being conducted. Provides study-level context for regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigative site where the capacity assessment was conducted. Used for site-level compliance monitoring and IRB/IEC reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.1; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: tmf_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: Capacity assessment supporting documentation must be filed in the TMF for vulnerable population oversight and regulatory inspection.

attributes.name: trial_subject_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trial subject whose mental capacity to provide informed consent is being assessed. Links to the subject master record.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50; GDPR Article 9

attributes.name: assessment_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the formal mental capacity assessment was conducted. This is the principal real-world event date for the assessment, distinct from the record creation timestamp. Required for GCP compliance and ALCOA+ data integrity.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: assessment_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for this capacity assessment, typically generated by the CTMS or eConsent system (Clinpal). Used for cross-system referencing, audit trails, and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50.25; OHRP Guidance

attributes.name: assessment_outcome
attributes.description: Formal determination of the subject's mental capacity to provide informed consent. Drives downstream consent workflow: Capable proceeds to standard ICF signing; Incapable triggers LAR (Legally Authorized Representative) requirement; Borderline may require
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.1; 21 CFR Part 50.3(l); EU CTR 536/2014 Article 31; Mental Capacity Act 2005 (UK)

attributes.name: assessment_score
attributes.description: Numeric score produced by the assessment tool (e.g., MMSE score out of 30, MacCAT-CR subscale score). Provides quantitative evidence supporting the capacity determination outcome.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; CDISC CDASH; CTCAE v5.0

attributes.name: assessment_score_max
attributes.description: Maximum possible score for the assessment tool used, providing context for interpreting the assessment_score. Required when multiple tools with different scales are used across sites.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; CDISC CDASH Standards

attributes.name: assessment_setting
attributes.description: Mode in which the capacity assessment was conducted: In-Person at the investigative site, Remote via telehealth/eConsent platform (Clinpal), or Hybrid. Relevant for regulatory acceptability and audit trail documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; FDA Guidance on Remote Clinical Trials; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: assessment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the capacity assessment record. Drives workflow routing in Clinpal and CTMS. Superseded indicates a newer assessment has replaced this one for the same subject-study combination.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 11; Clinpal eConsent Workflow

attributes.name: assessment_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time (with timezone offset) at which the capacity assessment was performed. Supports ALCOA+ contemporaneous documentation requirements and audit trail integrity per 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ Principles; ICH E6(R2) Section 8

attributes.name: assessment_tool
attributes.description: Name or code of the standardized tool, instrument, or method used to evaluate mental capacity (e.g., MacCAT-CR, MMSE, ACE-III, clinical interview, structured questionnaire). Supports methodological consistency and IRB/IEC reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50 Subpart B; OHRP Guidance on Vulnerable Populations

attributes.name: assessment_tool_version
attributes.description: Version or edition of the assessment tool or instrument used. Ensures reproducibility and comparability of assessments across sites and time points.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; CDISC CDASH Standards

attributes.name: assessment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the assessment within the subject's consent lifecycle: Initial (first assessment at screening), Re-Assessment (triggered by condition change or borderline outcome), Periodic (scheduled interval), Post-Amendment (following protocol or ICF
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50; OHRP Guidance

attributes.name: assessor_credentials
attributes.description: Professional credentials or qualifications of the assessor (e.g., MD, PhD, RN, NP) as documented at the time of assessment. Supports regulatory verification of assessor competency.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.1; 21 CFR Part 312.62; ISO 14155

attributes.name: assessor_name
attributes.description: Full name of the qualified individual who conducted the capacity assessment, captured at the time of assessment for audit trail completeness. Retained as a denormalized field to preserve historical accuracy even if personnel records change.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: assessor_role

attributes.name: assessor_signature_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the assessor applied their electronic signature to the capacity assessment record, as required by 21 CFR Part 11 for electronic records. Distinct from the assessment_timestamp (when the assessment occurred).

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional clinical observations, contextual notes, or qualifications related to the capacity assessment that are not captured in structured fields. Supports comprehensive documentation per ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; ALCOA+ Principles; 21 CFR Part 50

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which this capacity assessment record was first created in the system. Supports ALCOA+ contemporaneous documentation requirements and audit trail integrity per 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ Principles; ICH E6(R2) Section 8

attributes.name: interpreter_used

attributes.name: irb_iec_notification_date
