attributes.description: Date on which the IRB or IEC was formally notified of the consent withdrawal, when notification was required.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 3.3; 21 CFR Part 56.108; EU CTR 536/2014

tag_set.value: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Notification Date

attributes.name: itt_population_impact
attributes.description: Indicates the impact of this withdrawal on the subject's inclusion in the Intent-to-Treat (ITT) analysis population: 'included' means the subject remains in ITT per the source system means the subject is removed from ITT; 'pending_review' means
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; CDISC ADaM ADSL; SAP guidelines

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which this consent withdrawal record was most recently modified. Supports audit trail requirements and change tracking per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.5.3; 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR Article 5(1)(f)

attributes.name: method
attributes.description: The medium through which the withdrawal was communicated and documented: 'electronic' via Clinpal eConsent platform, 'paper' via signed paper form, 'verbal' with documented witness, 'telephone' with documented confirmation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 11; 21 CFR Part 50

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for this withdrawal event, typically generated by the eConsent system (Clinpal) or CTMS (the source system for cross-system traceability and regulatory audit trails.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50

attributes.name: pi_notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the Principal Investigator (PI) was formally notified of the consent withdrawal event.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: pi_notified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Principal Investigator (PI) has been formally notified of the subject's withdrawal of consent, as required by GCP.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: post_withdrawal_data_handling
attributes.description: Specifies how previously collected subject data must be handled following withdrawal, per protocol and applicable regulations. 'retain_all' allows retention of all data collected prior to withdrawal; 'retain_safety_only' retains only safety-relevant data
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.524; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 29

attributes.name: protocol_deviation_triggered
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consent withdrawal event triggered a protocol deviation that must be reported to the sponsor, IRB/IEC, or regulatory authority.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.5; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: reason_category
attributes.description: Standardized categorical classification of the primary reason for withdrawal. 'voluntary' indicates subject-initiated without specific cause; 'adverse_event_related' indicates withdrawal driven by an Adverse Event (AE) or safety concern
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; CDISC SDTM DS domain DSDECOD; MedDRA coding

attributes.name: reconsent_attempted
attributes.description: Indicates whether site staff attempted to re-consent the subject before the withdrawal was finalized, for example by providing additional information or addressing concerns.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50

attributes.name: reconsent_outcome
attributes.description: Outcome of the re-consent attempt: 'successful' indicates the subject agreed to continue and withdrawal was rescinded; 'unsuccessful' indicates the subject maintained the withdrawal decision; 'not_attempted' indicates no re-consent was attempted.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50

attributes.name: safety_follow_up_end_date
attributes.description: The date through which safety follow-up activities must continue for the subject post-withdrawal, as defined by the protocol. Applicable when safety_follow_up_required is true.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; ICH E2A; 21 CFR Part 312.32

attributes.name: safety_follow_up_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject requires ongoing safety follow-up activities (e.g., SAE reporting, survival follow-up) after withdrawal of consent, as mandated by the protocol or regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; ICH E2A; 21 CFR Part 312.32; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: study_discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subject was formally discontinued from the study following consent withdrawal. Used for Intent-to-Treat (ITT) and Per Protocol (PP) population analyses.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM DS domain; ICH E9 Statistical Principles

attributes.name: subject_stated_reason
attributes.description: Free-text verbatim reason for withdrawal as stated by the subject or their Legally Authorized Representative (LAR). Captured to support ALCOA+ attributability and regulatory audit requirements. May contain sensitive personal context.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.3; ALCOA+ principles; CDISC SDTM DS domain DSTERM

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (with timezone offset) at which the subject or their Legally Authorized Representative (LAR) formally communicated withdrawal of consent. This is the principal real-world event time per GCP requirements and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.3; ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11; CDISC SDTM DS domain

attributes.name: tmf_filing_status
attributes.description: Status of the withdrawal documentation filing in the electronic Trial Master File (eTMF) in Veeva Vault: 'pending' indicates documents are awaiting upload; 'filed' indicates documents have been uploaded; 'verified' indicates QC review of the filing is
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; Veeva Vault eTMF; EU CTR 536/2014; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: treatment_stop_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subject's investigational treatment was discontinued as a result of the consent withdrawal. May differ from the withdrawal_timestamp for treatment_withdrawal type.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; CDISC SDTM EX domain; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: withdrawal_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the withdrawal record. 'pending' indicates the withdrawal has been initiated but not yet formally confirmed; 'confirmed' indicates the withdrawal is complete and binding; 'rescinded' indicates the subject reversed the withdrawal
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50; GDPR Article 7(3)

attributes.name: withdrawal_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the scope of the withdrawal: 'full_withdrawal' means the subject withdraws from all study activities and data use; 'treatment_withdrawal' means withdrawal from investigational treatment only while allowing continued data collection
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; GDPR Article 7(3); HIPAA 45 CFR 164.508; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 29

products.name: lar_representative
products.description: Master record for a Legally Authorized Representative (LAR) associated with a trial subject who lacks capacity to consent independently. Stores LAR full name, relationship to subject, contact details, legal authority documentation type and reference
products.reference: LAR / Legally Authorized Representative

attributes.name: lar_representative_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the Legally Authorized Representative (LAR) master record in the Silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: 21 CFR 50.25; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: legal_authority_tmf_document_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Legal Authority Tmf Document Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: The legal authority document (power of attorney, guardianship order) authorizing the LAR must be on file in the TMF as an essential document for vulnerable subject protection.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

tag_set.value: Legal Authority Tmf Document Id (Foreign Key)

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study for which this LAR authorization is applicable. Scopes the LAR record to a specific trial protocol.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 50

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational site where the subject is enrolled and where the LAR authorization is operative.

attributes.name: trial_subject_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trial subject for whom this LAR is authorized to provide consent. Links the LAR record to the subject master.

attributes.name: authorization_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the LAR's legal authority to consent on behalf of the subject expires or is terminated. Null indicates open-ended authority. Used to enforce consent eligibility checks.

attributes.name: authorization_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the LAR's legal authority to consent on behalf of the subject became effective. Defines the beginning of the valid consent authorization window.

attributes.name: authorization_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the LAR's legal authorization to consent on behalf of the subject. Drives consent workflow eligibility in Clinpal eConsent and the source system
attributes.references: 21 CFR 50.25; ICH E6(R2) 4.8; GCP

attributes.name: capacity_assessment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the formal assessment of the subject's decision-making capacity was conducted, confirming the need for LAR consent. Required for regulatory documentation in pediatric and cognitively impaired populations.
attributes.references: 21 CFR 50.3(l); ICH E6(R2) 4.8.12; OHRP Guidance

attributes.name: capacity_assessment_outcome
attributes.description: Outcome of the formal capacity assessment determining the subject's ability to provide independent informed consent. Drives the requirement for LAR consent and re-assessment scheduling.

attributes.name: capacity_assessment_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal capacity assessment was required to establish the subject's inability to consent independently, thereby necessitating LAR involvement. True for cognitively impaired or pediatric populations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the LAR master record was first created in the system, conforming to ALCOA+ (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate) data integrity principles. Stored in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) 5.5.3; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: ctms_lar_record_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS) LAR Record ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the LAR record in the source system Enables reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver layer and the CTMS operational system for site monitoring and visit tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) 5.5; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

tag_set.value: Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS) LAR Record ID

attributes.name: econsent_platform_record_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the LAR record in the Clinpal eConsent platform. Used for cross-system traceability between the Silver layer lakehouse and the operational eConsent system of record.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) 5.5.3; ALCOA+

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Email address of the Legally Authorized Representative. Used for eConsent workflow notifications via Clinpal, re-consent triggers, and regulatory correspondence.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.514; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Legal given name of the Legally Authorized Representative as it appears on their government-issued identification or legal authority document.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.514; 21 CFR 50.3(l)

attributes.name: irb_iec_approval_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: IRB/IEC Approval Required for LAR Consent Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether specific IRB (Institutional Review Board) or IEC (Independent Ethics Committee) approval was required for the use of LAR consent procedures for this subject population at this site.
attributes.references: 21 CFR 56; ICH E6(R2) 3.1; EU CTR 536/2014; OHRP

tag_set.value: IRB/IEC Approval Required for LAR Consent Flag

attributes.name: jurisdiction
attributes.description: The legal jurisdiction (country, state, or province) under whose laws the LAR's authority document was issued and is recognized. Governs applicable legal standards for LAR validity (e.g., US-CA, US-NY, GBR, DEU).
attributes.references: 21 CFR 50.3(l); EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2); GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Legal family name or surname of the Legally Authorized Representative as it appears on their government-issued identification or legal authority document.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.514; 21 CFR 50.3(l)

attributes.name: legal_authority_document_date
attributes.description: Date on which the legal authority document (e.g., court order, power of attorney) was issued or became effective. Used to validate currency of authorization.

attributes.name: legal_authority_document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the legal instrument that establishes the LAR's authority to consent on behalf of the subject (e.g., court order, power of attorney, guardianship certificate). Required for regulatory compliance per 21 CFR 50.3(l).
attributes.references: 21 CFR 50.3(l); ICH E6(R2) 4.8.12; OHRP Guidance

attributes.name: mailing_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the LAR's mailing address (street number and name). Used for postal correspondence, regulatory notifications, and ICF delivery.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.514; 21 CFR 50.25

attributes.name: mailing_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the LAR's mailing address (apartment, suite, unit number). Supplements address line 1 for complete postal delivery.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.514

attributes.name: mailing_city
attributes.description: City or municipality of the LAR's mailing address. Required for complete postal address and jurisdictional determination.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.514

attributes.name: mailing_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the LAR's mailing address (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU). Determines applicable privacy regulations (GDPR, HIPAA) and legal authority standards.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; GDPR Article 4; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.514

attributes.name: mailing_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the LAR's mailing address. Required for complete postal address and geographic analytics.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.514

attributes.name: mailing_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or region of the LAR's mailing address. Used for jurisdictional compliance and postal delivery.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.514

attributes.name: middle_name
attributes.description: Legal middle name or initial of the Legally Authorized Representative as recorded on official identification documents. May be null if not applicable.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.514

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for site staff to record additional observations, special circumstances, or contextual information about the LAR's authorization that are not captured in structured fields. Subject to ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) 4.8; GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: population_category
attributes.description: Classification of the vulnerable population category that necessitates LAR consent for this subject. Determines applicable regulatory requirements and IRB/IEC conditions.

attributes.name: preferred_contact_method
attributes.description: The LAR's preferred channel for receiving communications from the site, including re-consent notifications and study updates. Drives outreach workflow in Clinpal and the source system
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) 4.8; GCP; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: preferred_language
attributes.description: ISO 639-1/639-2 language code representing the LAR's preferred language for consent documentation and communications (e.g., 'en', 'es', 'fr-CA'). Ensures ICF is provided in a language the LAR understands per GCP.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) 4.8.9; 21 CFR 50.25(b); GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: primary_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for contacting the Legally Authorized Representative. Used for re-consent notifications, safety communications, and site follow-up.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.514; ICH E6(R2) 4.8

attributes.name: re_consent_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a re-consent process is required for this LAR due to a protocol amendment, new safety information, or ICF version update. Triggers re-consent workflow in Clinpal.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) 4.8.2; 21 CFR 50.25; GCP; FDA Guidance on Informed Consent

attributes.name: re_consent_trigger_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for why re-consent is required from the LAR. Drives re-consent workflow prioritization and regulatory documentation in the eConsent system.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) 4.8.2; 21 CFR 50.25; FDA Guidance on Informed Consent

attributes.name: relationship_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the LAR's legal or familial relationship to the trial subject (e.g., parent, legal guardian, healthcare proxy). Determines the basis of legal authority.

attributes.name: subject_assent_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subject's assent was obtained alongside the LAR's consent. Applicable for pediatric or partially capacitated subjects. Null if assent was not required or not obtained.

attributes.name: subject_assent_obtained
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject's assent (agreement to participate, distinct from formal consent) was obtained in addition to the LAR's consent. Applicable for pediatric subjects with developing capacity per 21 CFR 50.55.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the LAR master record. Used for change tracking, audit trail compliance, and Silver layer incremental processing.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) 5.5.3; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the LAR's identity and legal authority documentation were verified by authorized site personnel (PI or CRC). Required for GCP audit trail.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) 4.8.12; GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Status of the site staff's verification of the LAR's identity and legal authority documentation. Tracks whether the CRC or PI has confirmed the LAR's credentials per GCP requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) 4.8.12; GCP; 21 CFR 50.25; ALCOA+

attributes.name: withdrawal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the LAR withdrew their consent authorization on behalf of the subject, or the date on which the LAR's authority was formally revoked. Triggers subject withdrawal workflow.

attributes.name: withdrawal_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason for the withdrawal of the LAR's consent authorization or revocation of legal authority. Required for regulatory reporting and subject safety follow-up.

products.name: icf_amendment
products.description: Tracks amendments to an approved ICF version, capturing the amendment number, amendment date, nature of change (safety update, protocol change, administrative correction), regulatory authority requiring the amendment, IRB/IEC submission date and approval
products.reference: ICF Amendment / Informed Consent Form Amendment

attributes.name: icf_amendment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the ICF amendment record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Good Clinical Practice; 21 CFR Part 50; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: clinpal_workflow_id
attributes.description: The workflow identifier assigned by the Clinpal eConsent system for the re-consent or new consent workflow triggered by this amendment. Enables traceability between the amendment record and the eConsent execution.
attributes.references: Clinpal eConsent Platform; FDA Guidance on Use of Electronic Informed Consent; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: country_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.country. Business justification: ICF amendments have country-specific applicability and require country-level regulatory submission and approval. The existing country_code plain attribute is a denormalization of study.country.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: ethics_approval_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.ethics_approval. Business justification: GCP requires that amended ICFs are only implemented after ethics committee approval.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: ethics_submission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.ethics_submission. Business justification: An ICF amendment is formally submitted to the ethics committee via an ethics_submission.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: icf_version_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Resulting Informed Consent Form (ICF) Version ID
attributes.description: Reference to the new ICF version produced as a result of this amendment. Null until the amended ICF version is formally approved and issued.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; Veeva Vault eTMF document versioning

tag_set.value: Resulting Informed Consent Form (ICF) Version ID

attributes.name: ind_application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.ind_application. Business justification: IB safety updates with new risk information directly trigger ICF amendments per ICH E6 GCP.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: protocol_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.protocol. Business justification: ICF amendments are directly triggered by protocol amendments and must reference the governing protocol version.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: regulatory_binder_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.regulatory_binder. Business justification: ICF amendments requiring regulatory submission (regulatory_submission_required flag) are filed in regulatory binders for agency review.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_protocol_amendment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.study_protocol_amendment. Business justification: Protocol amendments directly drive ICF amendments — when a study_protocol_amendment is approved, corresponding ICF amendments must be issued.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: submission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.submission. Business justification: ICF amendments with 'regulatory_submission_required=true' must be filed as part of a regulatory submission.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: superseded_by_amendment_icf_amendment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the subsequent amendment that supersedes this one, if applicable. Null for the current active amendment. Enables full amendment lineage chain reconstruction for regulatory inspection.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; Veeva Vault eTMF; TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: susar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.safety_communication. Business justification: Safety-related ICF amendments are directly triggered by safety communications (e.g., SUSAR letters, urgent safety measures).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: tmf_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: ICF amendments are essential TMF documents (DIA TMF Reference Model). Regulatory inspectors verify amendments against TMF filings.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: affected_subject_population
attributes.description: Defines which subject population is required to undergo re-consent as a result of this amendment. Drives the re-consent workflow in Clinpal and determines the scope of CRA site monitoring activities.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.2; FDA Guidance on Informed Consent; OHRP; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: amendment_date
attributes.description: The principal real-world date on which the amendment was formally initiated or authored. Serves as the primary business event date for the amendment lifecycle.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: amendment_number
attributes.description: Externally-known sequential identifier for the amendment (e.g., AM-001, AM-002). Used in regulatory submissions, IRB/IEC correspondence, and TMF filing to uniquely reference the amendment within the study.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; FDA Guidance on Informed Consent; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: amendment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the ICF amendment. Tracks progression from initial drafting through IRB/IEC submission, approval or rejection, and eventual supersession by a subsequent amendment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3.1; 21 CFR Part 56; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 15

attributes.name: amendment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the nature of change driving the amendment. Safety updates require expedited IRB/IEC review; protocol changes may require full board review; administrative corrections may qualify for expedited review.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.2; FDA 21 CFR Part 50.25; OHRP Guidance on Amendments

attributes.name: capacity_assessment_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a subject capacity or competency assessment is required before re-consent can be obtained under this amendment. Relevant for vulnerable populations, pediatric studies, or subjects with cognitive impairment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.9; 21 CFR Part 50.55; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 31; OHRP

attributes.name: change_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the nature and rationale of the changes introduced by this amendment. Captures what was changed, why it was changed, and the impact on subject safety or study conduct.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; FDA Guidance on Informed Consent; OHRP

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this ICF amendment record was first created in the Databricks Silver Layer. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking per 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ principles; ICH E6(R2) Section 8

attributes.name: deviation_risk_level
attributes.description: Risk classification assigned to the amendment indicating the potential for protocol deviations if re-consent is not completed within the required timeframe. Informs monitoring prioritization in the source system
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.20; FDA Guidance on Oversight of Clinical Investigations; MasterControl CAPA

attributes.name: econsent_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the amended ICF will be deployed via the Clinpal eConsent platform. When True, triggers the eConsent build and validation workflow in Clinpal for the resulting ICF version.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Use of Electronic Informed Consent; ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11; Clinpal eConsent

attributes.name: gdpr_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether GDPR data privacy provisions apply to this amendment, typically for studies enrolling subjects in EU/EEA countries. When True, the amended ICF must include GDPR-compliant data processing disclosures.
attributes.references: GDPR Articles 6, 7, 9, 13, 14; EU CTR 536/2014; EMA

tag_set.value: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Applicable Flag

attributes.name: hipaa_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether HIPAA authorization provisions apply to this amendment, typically for studies enrolling subjects at U.S. sites. When True, the amended ICF must include a HIPAA-compliant authorization section.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Parts 160 and 164; FDA 21 CFR Part 50; OHRP

tag_set.value: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Applicable Flag

attributes.name: implementation_date
attributes.description: The date from which the amended ICF version becomes effective for use at clinical sites. Sites must not use the amended ICF prior to this date. Typically set to or after the IRB/IEC approval date.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code (optionally with ISO 3166-1 country subtag) of the amended ICF document (e.g., en-US, fr-FR, de-DE). Multi-language studies require separate amendment tracking per language version.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1; ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.6; GDPR Article 7; FDA Guidance on Informed Consent

attributes.name: lar_consent_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Legally Authorized Representative (LAR) Consent Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether consent from a Legally Authorized Representative (LAR) is applicable for this amendment, typically for subjects who lack decision-making capacity. Triggers LAR-specific consent workflow in Clinpal.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.9; 21 CFR Part 50.55; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 31; OHRP

tag_set.value: Legally Authorized Representative (LAR) Consent Applicable Flag

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, internal comments, or contextual information related to the amendment that does not fit into structured fields. Not intended for regulatory submission content.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: reconsent_deadline_date
attributes.description: The date by which all affected subjects must complete re-consent. Null when reconsent_required is False. Used to monitor site compliance and escalate overdue re-consent activities.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; FDA Guidance on Informed Consent; OHRP

attributes.name: reconsent_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether currently enrolled subjects are obligated to provide re-consent under this amendment. True triggers re-consent workflow initiation in Clinpal and site notification via the source system
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.2; 21 CFR Part 50.25; OHRP Guidance; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amendment must be submitted to a health authority (e.g., FDA, EMA) as part of an IND, CTA, or equivalent regulatory filing. True triggers a regulatory submission workflow in Veeva Vault.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312.30; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.8

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason provided by the IRB or IEC for rejecting or deferring the amendment. Populated only when irb_iec_decision is rejected or deferred. Required for CAPA tracking in MasterControl.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3.1; 21 CFR Part 56.109; MasterControl CAPA

attributes.name: requiring_authority
attributes.description: The regulatory authority, ethics committee, or organizational body that mandated or triggered this amendment. Supports regulatory inspection readiness by documenting the source of the amendment requirement.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 56; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2); MHRA; PMDA; TGA; Health Canada

attributes.name: reviewed_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the Principal Investigator (PI) or medical monitor who reviewed and approved the amendment content prior to IRB/IEC submission. Supports GCP audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 312; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: safety_related
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amendment was triggered by a safety finding, SUSAR, SAE signal, or DSMB/DMC recommendation. Safety-related amendments require expedited IRB/IEC review and may trigger immediate site notification.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.2; ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: site_applicability
attributes.description: Defines whether this amendment applies to all clinical sites globally, a specific subset of sites, or only sites within a particular country. Drives site notification and monitoring workflows in the source system
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; Oracle Siebel CTMS; FDA 21 CFR Part 50

attributes.name: sponsor_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the pharmaceutical or biotech sponsor formally approved the amendment content prior to IRB/IEC submission. Required for sponsor oversight documentation in the TMF.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.8; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this ICF amendment record was last modified in the Databricks Silver Layer. Supports change tracking, audit trail completeness, and ALCOA+ contemporaneous documentation requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ principles; ICH E6(R2) Section 8

domains.name: randomization
domains.description: Manages subject allocation algorithms, stratification factors, randomization codes, blinding integrity, and unblinding procedures. Integrated with eCRF and supply domains for kit assignment and treatment arm allocation via IRT/IVRS/RTSM systems.

products.name: rand_scheme
products.description: Master definition of a randomization scheme for a clinical study. Captures the allocation algorithm type (simple, block, stratified, minimization, adaptive), block sizes, allocation ratio, seed values, and scheme version.
products.reference: RTSM Randomization Scheme

attributes.name: rand_scheme_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the randomization scheme record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles for Clinical Trials; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: compliance_sop_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_sop. Business justification: GCP requires randomization scheme generation and validation to be governed by a specific compliance SOP. Regulatory inspectors verify SOP compliance for randomization procedures.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: ind_application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.ind_application. Business justification: A randomization scheme is designed and authorized under a specific IND application.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: protocol_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.protocol. Business justification: Randomization schemes are designed against a specific protocol version per ICH E9(R1) and GCP requirements.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study for which this randomization scheme is defined. Links the scheme to its parent protocol.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM TA Domain

attributes.name: tmf_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: The randomization scheme is an essential TMF document per ICH E6 and DIA Reference Model.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the randomization scheme was activated in the IRT/RTSM system and made available for subject allocation. Marks transition to 'active' status.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Clinical One; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: allocation_algorithm
attributes.description: The statistical randomization algorithm used to assign subjects to treatment arms. 'simple' = unrestricted random; 'block' = fixed block sizes; 'stratified_block' = blocks within strata; 'minimization' = dynamic balancing; 'adaptive' = response-adaptive
attributes.references: ICH E9 Section 2.3; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: allocation_ratio
attributes.description: Randomization allocation ratio; implements CDISC SDTM TS parameter RANDQT / trial design allocation ratio.
attributes.references: ICH E9; SAP; Oracle Clinical One RTSM; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the randomization scheme received formal biostatistics and QA approval, authorizing its use in the study. Marks transition from 'draft' to 'approved' status.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; MasterControl QMS

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or user identifier of the individual (QA or biostatistics lead) who formally approved the randomization scheme. Supports 21 CFR Part 11 electronic signature audit trail.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; MasterControl

attributes.name: blinding_type
attributes.description: Blinding type; implements CDISC SDTM TS parameter BLIND (TSVAL where TSPARMCD=BLIND).
attributes.references: ICH E9 Section 2.5; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Guidance on Blinding

attributes.name: block_size_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of permissible block sizes used in block or stratified-block randomization (e.g., '4,6,8'). Variable block sizes reduce predictability. Null for non-block algorithms.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Section 2.3; FDA Guidance on Randomization

attributes.name: cdisc_sdtm_domain
attributes.description: Target CDISC SDTM domain for randomization data (e.g., DM.ARM/ACTARM, TA); implements SDTM domain reference.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; FDA eCTD Submission Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this randomization scheme record was first created in the lakehouse. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements and 21 CFR Part 11 compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: generation_method_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the randomization list generation methodology, including algorithm parameters, SAS/R procedure used, and any special considerations. Included in the Randomization Plan and CSR.
attributes.references: ICH E9; CDISC ADaM; SAP

attributes.name: generation_software
attributes.description: Name and version of the software used to generate the randomization list (e.g., 'SAS 9.4', 'R 4.2.1', 'the source system 21.3'). Required for regulatory submission and reproducibility validation.
attributes.references: ICH E9; 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Guidance on Computerized Systems

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of 3-letter ISO country codes where this randomization scheme is applicable (e.g., 'USA,GBR,DEU'). Relevant for multi-regional trials with country-specific regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E9; EU CTR 536/2014; FDA IND; ISO 3166-1 alpha-3

attributes.name: irb_iec_approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a scheme amendment requires re-submission to the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC). Relevant when stratification factors or allocation ratios change.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 56; EU CTR 536/2014; OHRP

attributes.name: irt_scheme_reference
attributes.description: The scheme identifier or configuration reference as recorded in the IRT/RTSM system (e.g., the source system scheme ID or Medidata Rave RTSM list ID). Enables cross-system traceability.
attributes.references: Oracle Clinical One; Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: irt_system_name
attributes.description: Name of the IRT/IVRS/RTSM system used to execute this randomization scheme (e.g., 'the source system 'Medidata Rave RTSM', 'Almac IXRS'). Identifies the operational system of record for subject allocation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Guidance on IRT/IVRS; Oracle Clinical One; Medidata Rave

attributes.name: is_centralized
attributes.description: Indicates whether randomization is performed centrally via IRT/IVRS/RTSM (True) or locally at the site (False). Centralized randomization is the standard for GCP-compliant multi-center trials.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Guidance on IRT; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: is_stratified_by_site
attributes.description: Indicates whether randomization is stratified by investigative site. Site stratification is common in multi-center trials to ensure balance across sites.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Section 2.3; FDA Guidance on Randomization

attributes.name: is_variable_block
attributes.description: Indicates whether variable (random) block sizes are used rather than a fixed block size. Variable blocks reduce the ability to predict upcoming assignments and are preferred for double-blind studies.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Randomization

attributes.name: list_generation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the randomization list was generated using the specified software and seed. Required for audit trail and regulatory submission documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E9; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: minimization_objective_function
attributes.description: For minimization or covariate-adaptive algorithms, the mathematical objective function used to minimize imbalance across covariates (e.g., 'range', 'variance', 'weighted_range'). Null for non-minimization schemes.
attributes.references: ICH E9; Pocock & Simon (1975); FDA Adaptive Design Guidance

attributes.name: minimization_probability
attributes.description: For minimization algorithms, the probability (0.0–1.0) of assigning a subject to the arm that minimizes imbalance (e.g., 0.8000 = 80% biased coin). Null for non-minimization schemes.
attributes.references: ICH E9; Pocock & Simon (1975); FDA Adaptive Design Guidance

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, amendment rationale, or special instructions related to this randomization scheme. Not intended for structured data.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: random_seed
attributes.description: Numeric seed value used to initialize the pseudo-random number generator for reproducible list generation. Classified confidential to protect blinding integrity; disclosed only at database lock (DBL) or unblinding.
attributes.references: ICH E9; 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Guidance on Randomization; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this randomization scheme version has been included in a regulatory submission (IND, NDA, BLA, MAA, or eCTD package). Triggers additional change-control requirements.
attributes.references: FDA IND/NDA/BLA; EMA MAA; ICH CTD; eCTD

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the randomization scheme was retired or superseded. Null if the scheme is still active. Used for version lifecycle management and TMF archival.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; TMF Reference Model; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: sap_version_reference
attributes.description: Version identifier of the Statistical Analysis Plan (the source system) that specifies this randomization scheme. Ensures traceability between the scheme implementation and the approved statistical methodology.
attributes.references: ICH E9; CDISC ADaM; FDA SAP Guidance

attributes.name: scheme_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this randomization scheme within the RTSM/IRT system (e.g., the source system or Medidata Rave RTSM). Used as the business key for cross-system reference.
attributes.references: Oracle Clinical One RTSM; Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E9

attributes.name: scheme_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the randomization scheme (e.g., 'Phase III Stratified Block Randomization v2'). Used in reports, TMF documentation, and biostatistics deliverables.
attributes.references: ICH E9; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: scheme_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the randomization scheme. 'draft' = under development; 'approved' = biostatistics/QA sign-off obtained; 'active' = in use for subject allocation; 'suspended' = temporarily halted (e.g., DSMB hold); 'retired' = superseded or
attributes.references: ICH E9; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: scheme_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the randomization scheme (e.g., '1.0', '2.1'). Incremented when the scheme is amended post-approval. Supports audit trail and regulatory submission traceability.
attributes.references: ICH E9; 21 CFR Part 11; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: strata_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct strata defined by the combination of stratification factors. Used to validate that the randomization list covers all strata and to monitor enrollment balance.
attributes.references: ICH E9; SAP; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: stratification_factors
attributes.description: Semicolon-separated list of stratification factors used to define strata for stratified randomization (e.g., 'site;gender;disease_severity'). Defined in the protocol and the source system. Null for non-stratified schemes.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Section 2.3; CDISC SDTM; SAP

attributes.name: total_randomization_slots
attributes.description: Total number of randomization positions (slots) generated in the scheme list. Represents the maximum number of subjects that can be randomized under this scheme version.
attributes.references: ICH E9; Oracle Clinical One RTSM; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: treatment_arm_count
attributes.description: Number of treatment arms (including placebo/control) defined in this randomization scheme. Must align with the protocol and allocation ratio.
attributes.references: ICH E9; CDISC SDTM TA Domain; Protocol

attributes.name: unblinding_procedure
attributes.description: Defines the authorized unblinding procedure for this scheme. 'emergency_only' = individual subject emergency unblinding; 'dsmb_only' = unblinding restricted to DSMB/DMC; 'dbk_full' = full unblinding at database lock; 'partial_sponsor' = sponsor
attributes.references: ICH E9; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Guidance on Blinding; DSMB Charter

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this randomization scheme record. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and version control in the silver layer.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

products.name: rand_list
products.description: The generated randomization list produced from a randomization scheme. Stores the ordered sequence of treatment assignments, list version, generation timestamp, generation method, blinding level, and approval status.
products.reference: RTSM Randomization List

attributes.name: rand_list_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the randomization list record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles for Clinical Trials; CDISC SDTM IG

attributes.name: document_sop_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document_sop. Business justification: Randomization list generation and validation must follow a documented SOP per GCP requirements. Regulatory inspectors verify which SOP version governed each list's creation.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: epoch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.study_epoch. Business justification: Randomization lists are epoch-specific per CDISC SDTM TE domain mapping requirements. The epoch in which randomization occurs must be formally linked for SDTM submission datasets and
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: protocol_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.protocol. Business justification: Randomization lists are generated for a specific protocol version; when a protocol amendment changes allocation, a new list version is required.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: rand_scheme_id
attributes.description: Reference to the randomization scheme (algorithm configuration, block sizes, stratification factors) from which this list was generated.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles for Clinical Trials

attributes.name: regulatory_protocol_amendment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.protocol_amendment. Business justification: Protocol amendments that change randomization trigger generation of a new rand_list version.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study for which this randomization list was generated. Links the list to its parent protocol.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM IG

attributes.name: superseded_by_list_rand_list_id
attributes.description: Reference to the newer randomization list that supersedes this one. Null if this is the current active version. Supports version chain traceability.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: tmf_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: Randomization lists are essential TMF documents per DIA Reference Model (Zone 5, randomization section).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: activation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the randomization list was activated in the IRT/IVRS/RTSM system and made available for subject assignment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: allocated_slots
attributes.description: Number of randomization slots that have been assigned to subjects at the time of record. Used to monitor enrollment capacity and list utilization.
attributes.references: ICH E9; Oracle Clinical One RTSM module

attributes.name: allocation_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of subject allocation across treatment arms (e.g., '1:1', '2:1:1'). Defined in the protocol and the source system; must match the generated list structure.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles for Clinical Trials; SAP

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the randomization list was formally approved for use in the study by the authorized statistician or delegate. Required for regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.13; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: blinding_level

attributes.references: ICH E9; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.7; FDA Guidance on Blinding

attributes.name: block_size_sequence
attributes.description: Encoded representation of the block sizes used in permuted block randomization (e.g., '2,4,4,2'). Classified as confidential to protect blinding integrity during the study.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles for Clinical Trials; FDA Guidance on Randomization

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this randomization list record was first captured in the data platform. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: dsmb_access_granted

attributes.description: Indicates whether the Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) / Data Monitoring Committee (DMC) has been granted access to the unblinded version of this randomization list for interim safety reviews.

attributes.name: irt_list_type
attributes.description: Scope of the randomization list as configured in the IRT/IVRS/RTSM system — whether it applies globally across all sites, to specific sites, strata, or countries.

attributes.name: is_blinded
attributes.description: Indicates whether treatment assignments in this list are masked (True) or open-label (False). Drives access control and unblinding procedures in the IRT/IVRS/RTSM system.
attributes.references: ICH E9; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.7

attributes.name: is_stratified
attributes.description: Indicates whether this randomization list uses stratified randomization (True) or unstratified simple/block randomization (False).
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles for Clinical Trials

attributes.name: kit_assignment_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this randomization list is linked to investigational product kit assignment in the RTSM/supply chain module. When True, kit numbers are assigned at the point of randomization.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; Oracle Clinical One; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.13

attributes.name: list_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the randomization list, including any special conditions, amendments, or notes relevant to its use in the study.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: list_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique identifier or code for this randomization list as referenced in the IRT/IVRS/RTSM system and the Statistical Analysis Plan (the source system). Used for regulatory traceability.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs; CDISC SDTM IG

attributes.name: list_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the randomization list. Controls whether the list is available for subject assignment in the IRT/IVRS/RTSM system. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|active|superseded|retired — promote to reference product if
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; CDISC CDASH

attributes.name: list_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the randomization list (e.g., v1.0, v2.0). Incremented when the list is regenerated or amended, supporting audit trail and regulatory traceability.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.13; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, amendment rationale, or regulatory comments associated with this randomization list.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: randomization_seed
attributes.description: The random number generator seed value used to produce this list. Classified as confidential to protect blinding integrity. Required for reproducibility validation and regulatory inspection.

attributes.name: sap_reference
attributes.description: Document identifier or section reference in the Statistical Analysis Plan (the source system) that specifies the randomization methodology for this list. Ensures traceability to the approved statistical methodology.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Guidance on SAP; CDISC ADaM

attributes.name: source_system_list_reference
attributes.description: Native identifier of this randomization list in the originating IRT/IVRS/RTSM system (Medidata Rave RTSM or the source system Used for cross-system reconciliation.

attributes.name: stratification_factors
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of stratification factors applied when generating this randomization list (e.g., 'site, disease_severity, age_group'). Reflects the protocol-defined stratification variables.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles for Clinical Trials; CDISC SDTM IG

attributes.name: superseded_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this randomization list was superseded by a newer version. Null if the list is still active. Supports version lifecycle audit trail.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: total_slots
attributes.description: Total number of randomization positions (slots) in this list, representing the maximum number of subjects that can be assigned using this list.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles for Clinical Trials

attributes.name: treatment_arm_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct treatment arms (including placebo/control) covered by this randomization list. Validates alignment with the protocol-defined study design.

attributes.name: unblinding_procedure
attributes.description: Defined procedure type for unblinding this randomization list. Governs when and how treatment assignments may be revealed (e.g., emergency unblinding, post-DBL unblinding).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.7; ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Blinding

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this randomization list record was last modified in the data platform. Supports change tracking and audit trail.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Status of the User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and quality control validation performed on this randomization list prior to activation. Ensures the list meets protocol specifications before use.

attributes.name: validation_timestamp

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: randomization_algorithm

attributes.name: rtsm_system

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: comments

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: eligibility_confirmed

attributes.name: irt_system_name

attributes.name: is_unblinded

attributes.name: kit_number

attributes.name: randomization_date

attributes.name: randomization_method
attributes.description: The statistical randomization algorithm applied to generate this allocation (e.g., permuted block, minimization, stratified block). Defined in the Statistical Analysis Plan (the source system) and randomization specification document.

attributes.name: randomization_number
attributes.description: Subject randomization number; implements SDTM DM.SUBJID-linked randomization identifier; person-identifying.

attributes.name: randomization_status

attributes.name: randomization_timestamp

attributes.name: randomization_type

attributes.name: randomizing_user_role

attributes.name: rerandomization_reason

attributes.name: sequence_within_block

attributes.name: stratification_factor_1_value

attributes.name: stratification_factor_2_value

attributes.name: stratification_factor_3_value

attributes.name: subject_number

attributes.name: unblinding_reason

attributes.name: unblinding_timestamp

attributes.name: icf_version_impacted

attributes.name: implementation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the protocol amendment was operationally implemented at clinical sites, including updated procedures, training, and revised eCRF forms in Medidata Rave. Must be on or after all required regulatory and ethics approvals.

attributes.name: planned_implementation_date
attributes.description: Target date for operational implementation of the amendment at clinical sites, used for project planning and site readiness tracking in the source system
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Oracle Siebel CTMS; GCP

attributes.name: prior_approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amendment requires prior approval from the health authority before implementation (true for substantial amendments) versus notification-only (false for non-substantial/administrative amendments).
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014 Article 15; 21 CFR Part 312.30; EMA Guidance on Substantial Modifications

attributes.name: reconsent_required_flag

attributes.name: review_deadline_date
attributes.description: Calculated or mandated deadline by which the health authority must respond to the amendment submission per applicable regulations (e.g., 30-day FDA IND amendment review window, EMA assessment timeline). Used for escalation and follow-up tracking.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.30(b); EU CTR 536/2014 Article 15; EMA Procedural Guidance

attributes.name: safety_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the protocol amendment has a direct impact on subject safety, risk-benefit profile, or safety monitoring procedures. Triggers expedited regulatory review and DSMB/DMC notification requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3.3; 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GCP Guideline; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 15

attributes.name: site_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which clinical sites were formally notified of the approved protocol amendment and required to begin implementation, including updated training and revised procedures. Tracked in the source system
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.6; GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: sponsor_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the sponsor contact person for this protocol amendment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5; 21 CFR Part 312.23; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: subject_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the amendment affects subjects currently enrolled in the study, requiring re-consent, protocol deviation assessment, or updated procedures for ongoing participants.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50; OHRP Guidance; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the protocol amendment was formally submitted to the primary health authority (e.g., FDA, EMA, PMDA). Marks the start of the regulatory review clock.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.30; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 15; ICH E6(R2); EMA Submission Guidelines

attributes.name: submission_reference_number
attributes.description: Official reference number assigned by the health authority upon receipt of the amendment submission (e.g., FDA IND amendment serial number, EMA submission tracking number). Used for all subsequent regulatory correspondence.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.30; EU CTR 536/2014; EMA CTIS; FDA ESG

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this protocol amendment record, supporting audit trail and data lineage requirements per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2); Veeva Vault

attributes.name: urgent_safety_measure_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amendment was implemented as an urgent safety measure prior to regulatory approval, as permitted under GCP and EU CTR for immediate risk mitigation. Requires retrospective notification to health authorities.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3.3.8; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 54; EMA GCP Guideline

products.name: approval

attributes.name: study_id

attributes.name: submission_id

attributes.name: submission_sequence_id

attributes.name: tertiary_approval_health_authority_id
attributes.description: FK to regulatory.health_authority

attributes.name: tmf_document_id

attributes.name: agency_decision_date
attributes.description: The official date on which the health authority issued its approval decision or authorization. This is the principal real-world event date for the approval transaction, as recorded in the agency approval letter.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314.105; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: agency_decision_rationale
attributes.description: Summary of the health authority's stated rationale or basis for the approval decision, as documented in the approval letter, assessment report, or public review document. Captures key scientific and regulatory justification.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314.105; EMA European Public Assessment Report (EPAR); ICH E3

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the regulatory approval. Tracks whether the approval is active, conditionally approved (with post-marketing commitments), withdrawn by sponsor, suspended or revoked by the agency, or pending final decision.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314.150; EMA Regulation (EC) No 726/2004; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: approval_type
attributes.description: Classification of the regulatory approval or authorization received. Distinguishes between IND allowance (Investigational New Drug), NDA approval (New Drug Application), BLA approval (Biologics License Application), MAA approval (Marketing Authorization
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312/314/601; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; ICH M4 CTD

attributes.name: approved_dose
attributes.description: The approved dose or dose range as specified in the regulatory approval (e.g., '10 mg once daily', '200 mg/m² every 3 weeks'). Captures the label-approved dosing regimen for the approved indication and population.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 201.57; EMA Guideline on Summary of Product Characteristics; ICH E4

attributes.name: approved_indication
attributes.description: The specific disease, condition, or therapeutic indication for which the health authority has granted approval. Reflects the exact label language or CTA scope as approved (e.g., 'Treatment of moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis in adults').
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 201.57; EMA Guideline on Summary of Product Characteristics; ICH E3

attributes.name: approved_population
attributes.description: Description of the patient population covered by the approval, including age group, disease severity, prior treatment requirements, or other eligibility criteria as specified in the approved label or CTA (e.g., 'Adults ≥18 years with inadequate response
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 201.57; EMA Guideline on Summary of Product Characteristics; ICH E11

attributes.name: compliance_inspection_code
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.inspection. Business justification: Pre-approval inspections (PAIs) are a standard FDA/EMA step before granting marketing approval.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: conditions_of_approval
attributes.description: Narrative description of any conditions, restrictions, or requirements attached to the approval by the health authority (e.g., REMS requirements, restricted distribution, mandatory risk minimization measures, specific labeling requirements).
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314.520; EMA Regulation (EC) No 726/2004 Article 14; ICH E2E

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this regulatory approval record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; ALCOA+ Principles; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: dosage_form
attributes.description: The pharmaceutical dosage form approved by the health authority (e.g., tablet, capsule, injection, infusion, patch). Reflects the specific formulation covered by the approval as stated in the approved label.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 201.57; EMA Guideline on Summary of Product Characteristics; ICH Q8

attributes.name: drug_name
attributes.description: The International Nonproprietary Name (INN) or brand name of the drug, biologic, or investigational medicinal product covered by this approval. Denormalized for regulatory reporting and label management.
attributes.references: WHO INN Programme; FDA 21 CFR Part 201.10; EMA Guideline on Summary of Product Characteristics

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which the regulatory approval becomes legally effective and the sponsor may act upon it (e.g., commence the trial, market the product). May differ from the agency decision date for conditional or phased approvals.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314.105; EMA Regulation (EC) No 726/2004; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the regulatory approval expires or requires renewal (applicable to CTAs, annual IND renewals, and time-limited authorizations). Null for indefinite approvals such as standard NDA/BLA marketing authorizations.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312.33; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Description of the geographic territory or jurisdictions covered by this approval (e.g., 'United States', 'European Union - 27 Member States', 'Japan'). Supports multi-regional regulatory portfolio management.
attributes.references: EMA Regulation (EC) No 726/2004; FDA 21 CFR; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: inn_code
attributes.description: The WHO-assigned International Nonproprietary Name (INN) code or identifier for the active substance covered by this approval. Supports WHO-DD coding and cross-study drug identification.
attributes.references: WHO INN Programme; WHO Drug Dictionary (WHO-DD); ICH Q6A

attributes.name: inspection_readiness_status
attributes.description: Current inspection readiness status for this approval record, indicating whether all supporting documentation in the eTMF is complete and audit-ready for potential agency inspection. Supports GCP inspection preparedness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 8; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; MHRA GCP Inspectorate

attributes.name: irb_iec_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier of the corresponding IRB (Institutional Review Board) or IEC (Independent Ethics Committee) approval associated with this regulatory authorization. Supports ethics and regulatory approval alignment tracking.

attributes.references: EMA Regulation (EC) No 726/2004 Article 14(7); FDA 21 CFR Part 314.510 Accelerated Approval

attributes.name: is_renewal_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this approval requires periodic renewal or re-authorization (True) or is granted indefinitely (False). Relevant for CTAs, annual IND reports, and time-limited authorizations in certain jurisdictions.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312.33 (Annual IND Report); EMA EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: letter_date
attributes.description: The date printed on the official agency approval letter or decision notice. May differ from the agency decision date if the letter was issued after the formal decision was recorded.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314.105; EMA Regulation (EC) No 726/2004

attributes.name: letter_reference
attributes.description: Official reference number or document identifier of the agency approval letter or decision notice (e.g., FDA approval letter reference, EMA decision reference). Used to locate the source document in the eTMF or regulatory binder in Veeva Vault.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314.105; EMA Regulation (EC) No 726/2004; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: mah_name
attributes.description: Name of the Marketing Authorization Holder.
attributes.references: EMA Regulation (EC) No 726/2004; FDA 21 CFR Part 314.72; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional regulatory context, internal commentary, or supplementary information about this approval that does not fit into structured fields. Used by regulatory affairs teams for operational notes.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Externally-assigned unique identifier issued by the health authority for this approval (e.g., NDA 123456, EMA/H/C/004321, IND 12345). This is the official agency-assigned reference number used in all regulatory correspondence.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314.105; EMA Regulation (EC) No 726/2004

attributes.name: post_marketing_commitments
attributes.description: Description of post-marketing study commitments, confirmatory trials, or pharmacovigilance obligations required by the health authority as a condition of approval. Includes Phase IV studies, REMS, and risk management plans.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314.81; EMA Regulation (EC) No 726/2004; ICH E2E Pharmacovigilance Planning

attributes.name: protocol_amendment_version
attributes.description: The version of the study protocol or protocol amendment that was in effect at the time of this approval. Relevant for CTA authorizations and protocol amendment approvals to ensure the correct protocol version is linked.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.30; EMA EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: renewal_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the sponsor must submit a renewal application or annual report to maintain the validity of this approval. Null if renewal is not required. Critical for regulatory compliance tracking.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312.33; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; Health Canada Division 5

attributes.name: review_pathway
attributes.description: The regulatory review pathway or designation under which the application was reviewed and approved (e.g., Standard, Priority Review, Accelerated Approval, Breakthrough Therapy, Fast Track, Orphan Drug).
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312.82 (Fast Track); FDA FDASIA Section 902 (Breakthrough); FDA 21 CFR Part 316 (Orphan); EMA PRIME scheme

attributes.name: sponsor_name
attributes.description: Name of the sponsor organization for this approval.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312.23; EMA Regulation (EC) No 726/2004; ICH E6(R2) Section 5

attributes.name: therapeutic_area
attributes.description: The therapeutic area or disease category associated with the approved indication (e.g., Oncology, Cardiovascular, Immunology, Neurology, Infectious Disease). Used for portfolio analytics and regulatory strategy reporting.
attributes.references: MedDRA System Organ Class (SOC); ICH E3; CDISC Therapeutic Area Guidelines

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this regulatory approval record was most recently modified. Supports audit trail requirements and change tracking under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; ALCOA+ Principles; GDPR Article 5

products.name: ind_application

attributes.name: parent_application_id

attributes.name: study_id

attributes.name: amendment_count
attributes.description: The cumulative number of IND amendments (protocol amendments, information amendments, safety reports) submitted to the FDA under this IND. Tracks the volume of regulatory activity and dossier complexity.

attributes.name: annual_report_due_date
attributes.description: The next due date for the IND Annual Report submission to the FDA. Annual reports are required within 60 days of the anniversary of the IND effective date and must summarize clinical progress, safety data, and manufacturing updates.

attributes.name: application_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction in which this application is filed (e.g., USA for FDA, GBR for MHRA, JPN for PMDA). Enables multi-country regulatory portfolio analytics.

attributes.name: breakthrough_therapy_designation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the FDA has granted Breakthrough Therapy designation for the investigational product under this IND. Breakthrough Therapy designation provides intensive FDA guidance and rolling review for drugs showing substantial improvement over

attributes.name: clinical_hold_date
attributes.description: The date on which the FDA issued a clinical hold order on this IND, halting enrollment or dosing of subjects. Nullable for INDs not on clinical hold. Triggers mandatory sponsor response within 30 days.

attributes.name: clinical_hold_lifted_date
attributes.description: The date on which the FDA lifted the clinical hold and authorized resumption of clinical trials under this IND. Nullable for INDs that have never been on clinical hold or where the hold remains active.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.42; FDA Clinical Hold Regulations

attributes.name: clinical_hold_reason
attributes.description: Description of the FDA's stated reason for imposing a clinical hold on this IND. Captures the safety concern, protocol deficiency, or regulatory non-compliance issue cited by the agency. Nullable for INDs not on clinical hold.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.42; FDA Clinical Hold Regulations

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this IND application record was first created in the lakehouse data platform. Represents the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category for audit trail and data lineage purposes. Conforms to 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ Principles; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: dosage_form
attributes.description: The pharmaceutical dosage form of the investigational product (e.g., tablet, capsule, injection, infusion, patch). Captured from the IND CMC section and used for supply chain and regulatory tracking.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.23(a)(7); ICH Q8

attributes.name: drug_substance_name
attributes.description: International Nonproprietary Name (INN) or chemical name of the active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) covered under this IND. Used for regulatory cross-referencing and WHO-DD coding.

attributes.name: ectd_submission_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Common Technical Document (eCTD) Submission Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this IND application is submitted in eCTD format via the FDA Electronic Submissions Gateway. True indicates eCTD format; False indicates paper or non-eCTD electronic submission. FDA mandates eCTD for most IND submissions.
