attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the IND became effective and clinical trials were authorized to commence. Under 21 CFR Part 312.40, an IND becomes effective 30 days after FDA receipt unless FDA places a clinical hold.

attributes.name: equivalent_application_number
attributes.description: The application number assigned by a non-FDA regulatory agency for an equivalent authorization (e.g., EMA CTA number, MHRA CTA reference, PMDA CTN). Used to cross-reference the IND with parallel international submissions.

attributes.name: fast_track_designation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the FDA has granted Fast Track designation for the investigational product under this IND. Fast Track facilitates development and expedites review of drugs treating serious conditions with unmet medical need.

attributes.name: fda_application_receipt_date
attributes.description: The date on which the FDA officially acknowledged receipt of the IND application. Starts the 30-day review clock per 21 CFR Part 312.40. May differ from the initial submission date if there were transmission delays.

attributes.name: fda_division
attributes.description: The FDA Center and Division responsible for reviewing this IND application (e.g., CDER/Division of Oncology Products 1, CBER/Division of Vaccines). Determines the regulatory review team and applicable FDA guidance documents.
attributes.references: FDA CDER/CBER Organizational Structure; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: inactivation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the IND was placed into inactive status, either by sponsor notification or FDA action. Nullable for active INDs. Represents the EFFECTIVE_UNTIL boundary for the active IND period.

attributes.name: ind_number
attributes.description: Official IND number assigned by the FDA upon receipt of the IND application. This is the externally-known regulatory identifier used in all agency correspondence, safety reports, and annual reports.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.23; FDA IND Regulations

attributes.name: ind_serial_number_latest
attributes.description: The most recent serial number assigned to the latest IND submission sequence (original or amendment). IND submissions are numbered sequentially starting from 0000. Used to track the current version of the IND dossier in Veeva Vault eTMF.

attributes.name: ind_type
attributes.description: Classification of the IND application by its intended purpose. Commercial INDs are filed by pharmaceutical/biotech sponsors for drug development. Research INDs are filed by investigators for academic studies.

attributes.name: indication

attributes.name: initial_submission_date
attributes.description: The date on which the original IND application was first submitted to the FDA. This is the principal business event date for the IND lifecycle and triggers the 30-day FDA review clock per 21 CFR Part 312.40.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.40; FDA IND Regulations

attributes.name: investigational_product_code

attributes.name: investigational_product_name
attributes.description: The name of the investigational drug, biologic, or compound covered under this IND application. May be a code name, generic name, or proprietary name as designated by the sponsor.

attributes.name: last_annual_report_date

attributes.name: protocol_count

attributes.name: sponsor_contact_email

attributes.name: sponsor_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the sponsor contact person for this IND application.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.23(a)(1); GDPR Article 4; HIPAA

attributes.name: sponsor_name
attributes.description: Name of the sponsor organization for this IND application.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.23(a)(1); ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: sponsor_type
attributes.description: Classification of the sponsor organization type. Distinguishes between commercial pharmaceutical/biotech companies, academic institutions, government agencies, and Contract Research Organizations (CROs) acting as sponsor.

attributes.name: therapeutic_area

attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Veeva Vault; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: gcp_critical_document_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Good Clinical Practice (GCP) Critical Document Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the document is classified as a GCP essential document per ICH E6(R2) Section 8. Critical documents require mandatory workflow completion before study activities can proceed and are prioritized in inspection readiness reviews.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014

tag_set.value: Good Clinical Practice (GCP) Critical Document Flag

attributes.name: initiated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the document workflow instance was first created and launched in Veeva Vault. Serves as the principal business event timestamp for the workflow lifecycle and the start point for overall cycle time measurement.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Veeva Vault; ALCOA+

attributes.name: inspection_readiness_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this workflow and its associated document have been reviewed and confirmed as inspection-ready per GCP and regulatory authority standards. Supports pre-inspection TMF completeness assessments by FDA, EMA, MHRA, or other regulatory bodies.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; MHRA; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: instance_reference
attributes.description: Externally-known unique identifier assigned by Veeva Vault to this specific workflow instance. Used for cross-system traceability and audit trail correlation with the source eTMF system.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault Workflow API; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to this workflow instance, reflecting urgency of document review and approval. Critical priority is assigned to GCP essential documents, regulatory submissions with imminent deadlines, and safety-related documents.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; DIA TMF Reference Model; Veeva Vault Workflow Configuration

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the document being processed through this workflow is intended for regulatory submission (e.g., IND, NDA, BLA, MAA, eCTD). True triggers additional compliance checks and approval requirements per FDA/EMA submission standards.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; ICH CTD; eCTD; Veeva Vault Regulatory

attributes.name: rejection_count
attributes.description: Number of times the document has been rejected and returned for revision within this workflow instance. High rejection counts indicate document quality issues and are tracked for quality metrics and CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) analysis.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; MasterControl CAPA; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or categorized reason provided when a workflow step is rejected. Documents the specific deficiency identified by the reviewer, supporting document quality improvement and GCP audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.9; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: sla_breach_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the workflow or any of its steps has exceeded the defined Service Level Agreement (SLA) timeframe. True when step_completion_date or actual_completion_date exceeds the corresponding due date. Drives escalation and KPI reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Veeva Vault SLA Configuration; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: step_action_taken
attributes.description: The specific action performed by the assignee at the current or last completed workflow step. Captures the decision outcome (approved, rejected) or process action (delegated, escalated) for audit trail completeness.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.9; Veeva Vault; ALCOA+

attributes.name: step_assignee_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual assigned to the current workflow step. Captured at time of assignment for audit trail integrity per ALCOA+ (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate) requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: step_assignee_role
attributes.description: Business role responsible for completing the current workflow step (e.g., 'Principal Investigator (PI)', 'Clinical Research Associate (CRA)', 'Regulatory Affairs Manager', 'Quality Assurance (QA) Reviewer').
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: step_comment
attributes.description: Free-text comment or rationale provided by the step assignee when completing, rejecting, or escalating the workflow step. Supports GCP documentation requirements and provides context for rejection decisions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.9; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: step_completion_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the current or most recently completed workflow step was actioned and closed. Compared against step_due_date to determine SLA compliance and cycle time analytics.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: step_completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time at which the workflow step action was recorded in Veeva Vault. Provides sub-day granularity required for 21 CFR Part 11 electronic audit trail and time-stamped electronic signature records.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: step_due_date
attributes.description: Target completion date for the current workflow step as defined by the workflow SLA configuration. Used to calculate SLA breach status and trigger escalation notifications for overdue document reviews.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Veeva Vault SLA Configuration; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: target_completion_date
attributes.description: Overall target date by which the entire document workflow (all steps) must be completed. Derived from workflow SLA rules and used for inspection readiness tracking and TMF completeness KPI reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; DIA TMF Reference Model; Veeva Vault SLA

attributes.name: template_name
attributes.description: Name of the Veeva Vault workflow template used to instantiate this workflow (e.g., 'SOP Review and Approval', 'Regulatory Document Approval', 'ICF Review Workflow'). Identifies the standard process blueprint applied.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault Workflow Configuration; ICH E6(R2) GCP; MasterControl SOP

attributes.name: template_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the workflow template at the time this workflow instance was initiated. Ensures reproducibility and audit traceability when templates are updated over time.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.9; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: tmf_zone
attributes.description: DIA TMF Reference Model zone classification for the document being processed. Categorizes the document into the appropriate TMF structural zone to support inspection readiness and TMF completeness assessments.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: total_steps
attributes.description: Total number of steps defined in the workflow template for this workflow instance. Used in conjunction with current_step_sequence to calculate workflow completion percentage for inspection readiness dashboards.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault Workflow Configuration; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this document_workflow record was last modified in the Databricks Silver Layer. Tracks the most recent state change for incremental processing and audit trail completeness.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: workflow_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the document workflow instance within Veeva Vault. Tracks progression from initiation through review, approval decision, and terminal states. Supports GCP-compliant document control audit trails.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.9; 21 CFR Part 11; EU CTR 536/2014; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: workflow_type
attributes.description: Classification of the workflow by its primary business purpose within the document lifecycle. Distinguishes review-only workflows from approval workflows, distribution workflows, archival workflows, and amendment workflows.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Veeva Vault eTMF

products.name: signature
products.description: Records electronic signatures applied to controlled documents per 21 CFR Part 11 requirements. Captures signer identity, signer role (author, reviewer, approver, sponsor representative), signature date and timestamp, signature meaning (reviewed, approved
products.reference: 21 CFR Part 11; EU Annex 11; Veeva Vault eSignature

attributes.name: signature_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each electronic signature record applied to a controlled document. Primary key for the document_signature data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: principal_investigator_id
attributes.description: Reference to the delegation of authority record when the signer is acting on behalf of another party (e.g., a sub-investigator signing on behalf of the Principal Investigator). Supports sponsor oversight and GCP compliance verification.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) §4.2; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study (protocol) with which the signed document is associated. Enables study-level signature completeness reporting and TMF inspection readiness tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) §8; DIA TMF Reference Model Zone/Section/Artifact taxonomy

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational site associated with the signed document, where applicable (e.g., site-level ICF, site initiation documents). Supports site-level TMF completeness and inspection readiness metrics.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) §8.3; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: tmf_document_id
attributes.description: Reference to the controlled document record in the document master that this signature was applied to. Links the signature to its parent TMF/eTMF document.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model; Veeva Vault Document Object

attributes.name: version_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific version of the document at the time the signature was applied. Ensures the signature is bound to an immutable document version, satisfying 21 CFR Part 11 integrity requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); ICH E6(R2) §8

attributes.name: workflow_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document_workflow. Business justification: Electronic signatures are applied within the context of a document workflow step (review, approval, distribution).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: audit_hash
attributes.description: Cryptographic hash (e.g., SHA-256) of the signed document content and signature metadata at the time of signing. Provides tamper-evidence and integrity verification for the electronic signature record, satisfying 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(a) data integrity
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(a); NIST SP 800-57; FDA Guidance on Electronic Records

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments or notes entered by the signer at the time of signing. May capture the signer's attestation statement, conditional approval notes, or reviewer observations. Stored as part of the immutable signature audit trail.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.50; Veeva Vault eSignature Module

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System-generated timestamp when the signature request record was first created in the source system (Veeva Vault). Supports audit trail completeness and ALCOA+ compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); ALCOA+

attributes.name: device_identifier
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the device (workstation, tablet, or mobile device) used to apply the electronic signature. Supports forensic audit trail and 21 CFR Part 11 system access controls validation.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(d); FDA Guidance on Electronic Records

attributes.name: digital_certificate_serial
attributes.description: Serial number of the digital certificate used when the signature method is digital_certificate or smart_card. Enables certificate chain validation and revocation checking for PKI-based electronic signatures.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.200(b); X.509 Certificate Standard; NIST SP 800-57

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The deadline by which the signer must apply their electronic signature, as defined in the document workflow configuration. Used for SLA tracking, escalation triggering, and inspection readiness reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) §5.18; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: hash_algorithm
attributes.description: Cryptographic algorithm used to generate the audit hash for this signature record (e.g., SHA-256, SHA-512). Required to enable future hash verification and to document the cryptographic standard applied at the time of signing.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(a); NIST FIPS 180-4

attributes.name: inspection_readiness_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this signature record has been reviewed and confirmed as complete and compliant for regulatory inspection purposes. Used in TMF inspection readiness dashboards and GCP audit preparation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) §8; DIA TMF Reference Model; FDA GCP Inspection Guidance

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: IP address of the device from which the electronic signature was applied. Captured as part of the 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail to support identity verification and forensic investigation. May be considered PII under GDPR.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); GDPR Article 4(1); EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: is_regulatory_submission_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this signature is part of a document package intended for regulatory submission (e.g., IND, NDA, BLA, MAA, eCTD). When True, the signature record is subject to heightened integrity and retention requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH M4 CTD; FDA eCTD Guidance; EMA eCTD Guidance

attributes.name: last_reminder_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of the most recent automated reminder notification sent to the signer. Supports escalation management and overdue signature tracking.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault eSignature Workflow; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: locale
attributes.description: IETF BCP 47 locale code representing the language and regional settings active at the time of signing (e.g., en-US, de-DE, ja-JP). Relevant for multi-national trials to confirm the signer viewed the document in their preferred language.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 29; ICH E6(R2) §4.8

attributes.name: meaning
attributes.description: The legally defined meaning associated with the electronic signature, as required by 21 CFR Part 11. Specifies the intent of the signer (e.g., reviewed = content reviewed for accuracy; approved = authorized for release; acknowledged = receipt confirmed).
attributes.tags: standard_ref:21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Signature meaning

tag_set.key: standard_ref:21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Signature meaning

attributes.name: method
attributes.description: Authentication method used to apply the electronic signature. Determines the technical compliance pathway under 21 CFR Part 11 (biometric vs. non-biometric). Required for regulatory inspection to demonstrate identity verification rigor.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.200; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 25

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the electronic signature event, as assigned by Veeva Vault or the controlling eTMF system. Used for cross-system traceability and regulatory inspection referencing.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10; Veeva Vault eSignature Module

attributes.name: reminder_sent_count
attributes.description: Number of automated reminder notifications sent to the signer for a pending signature request. Used to track escalation activity and measure signature workflow efficiency in TMF completeness dashboards.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault eSignature Workflow; ICH E6(R2) §5.18

attributes.name: requested_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the signature request was initiated and sent to the signer. Used to calculate signature turnaround time and to track overdue signature tasks in inspection readiness dashboards.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault eSignature Workflow; ICH E6(R2) §5.18

attributes.name: signature_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the electronic signature record. Pending = awaiting signer action; Applied = successfully executed; Voided = invalidated due to document revision or administrative action; Superseded = replaced by a newer signature; Rejected =
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10; Veeva Vault Workflow Status

attributes.name: signature_type
attributes.description: Classification of the signature type per applicable regulatory framework. Electronic = standard 21 CFR Part 11 e-signature; Wet Ink Scanned = paper signature digitized; Advanced Electronic = eIDAS AES; Qualified Electronic = eIDAS QES with qualified
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; EU eIDAS Regulation 910/2014; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: signed_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (with timezone offset) at which the electronic signature was applied by the signer. This is the principal real-world event timestamp for the signature transaction.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); ALCOA+ (Contemporaneous); ICH E6(R2) §8

attributes.name: signer_full_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the individual who applied the electronic signature, captured at the time of signing. Stored as a point-in-time snapshot to preserve the audit trail even if the user record changes.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.50; GDPR Article 4; HIPAA §164.312

attributes.name: signer_organization
attributes.description: Name of the organization or company the signer represents at the time of signing (e.g., sponsor company name, CRO name, investigative site institution). Supports multi-party trial agreements and sponsor delegation tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) §5; 21 CFR Part 11 §11.50

attributes.name: signer_role
attributes.description: Functional role of the signer within the document workflow at the time of signing. Determines the legal weight and workflow position of the signature. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.50(a); DIA TMF Reference Model; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: signer_title
attributes.description: Professional title or job designation of the signer at the time of signing (e.g., Principal Investigator, Medical Monitor, Sponsor Representative, Biostatistician). Captured as a point-in-time snapshot for regulatory inspection readiness.

attributes.name: source_system_signature_reference
attributes.description: Native identifier of the signature record in the originating source system (e.g., Veeva Vault internal signature object ID). Enables bidirectional traceability between the Silver Layer and the operational system for reconciliation and audit.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10; Veeva Vault API

attributes.name: timezone
attributes.description: IANA timezone identifier representing the local timezone of the signer at the time of signing (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London). Required to accurately interpret the signed_timestamp in multi-national trial contexts and for regulatory inspection.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); IANA Time Zone Database; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: tmf_artifact_number
attributes.description: DIA TMF Reference Model artifact number identifying the document type being signed (e.g., 01.01.01 for Protocol, 06.02.01 for Informed Consent Form). Enables artifact-level signature completeness tracking.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.x; ICH E6(R2) §8

attributes.name: tmf_zone
attributes.description: DIA TMF Reference Model Zone classification of the document to which this signature belongs (e.g., Zone 01 - Trial Management, Zone 02 - Central Trial Documents, Zone 03 - Regulatory). Supports TMF completeness metrics and inspection readiness reporting.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.x; ICH E6(R2) §8

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System-generated timestamp of the most recent modification to the signature record (e.g., status change, void action). Required for audit trail completeness and change detection in the Silver Layer ETL pipeline.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); ALCOA+

attributes.name: void_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why the signature was voided or invalidated. Required when signature_status = 'voided' to maintain a complete and auditable record of signature lifecycle events per 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); ALCOA+ (Attributable)

attributes.name: voided_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the signature was voided or invalidated. Supports the complete lifecycle audit trail for the signature record and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); ALCOA+

attributes.name: workflow_step_name
attributes.description: Name of the document workflow step within which this signature was collected (e.g., 'Author Review', 'QA Approval', 'Sponsor Sign-Off'). Maps to the Veeva Vault workflow configuration and supports workflow analytics and bottleneck identification.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault Document Workflow; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: workflow_step_sequence
attributes.description: Numeric sequence position of this signature step within the overall document approval workflow. Enables ordered reconstruction of the full signature chain for regulatory inspection and audit trail review.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault Document Workflow; 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10

products.name: site_file

attributes.name: site_file_id

attributes.name: study_id

attributes.name: study_site_id

attributes.name: completeness_percentage

attributes.name: completeness_status

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: custodian_role

attributes.name: file_format
attributes.description: Indicates whether the site file is maintained electronically (eTMF via Veeva Vault), in paper form at the site, or as a hybrid of both. Drives inspection readiness procedures and retrieval workflows.

attributes.name: file_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned to this site file, used in regulatory correspondence, inspection readiness tracking, and eTMF cross-referencing. Typically generated by the CTMS or Veeva Vault.

attributes.name: file_type
attributes.description: Classification of the site file by its regulatory and operational purpose. ISF (Investigator Site File) is the primary site-level essential document collection; Regulatory Binder holds IRB/IEC submissions and approvals; Pharmacy Binder tracks

attributes.name: financial_disclosure_on_file
attributes.description: Indicates whether signed financial disclosure forms for the investigator and sub-investigators are present in the site file, as required by FDA regulations to identify potential conflicts of interest.

attributes.references: EMA GCP Inspection Classification; FDA Warning Letter Guidance; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: finding_date
attributes.description: The date on which the regulatory authority formally issued or documented this finding during the inspection. This is the principal real-world event date (TRANSACTION_HEADER: BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP at date granularity), distinct from the inspection start
attributes.references: FDA Form 483; EMA GCP Inspection Report; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: finding_description
attributes.description: Full narrative description of the inspection finding as documented by the regulatory authority, including the specific deficiency observed, the regulatory standard violated, and any factual basis cited (e.g., verbatim text from FDA Form 483 observation or
attributes.references: FDA Form 483; EMA GCP Inspection Report; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: finding_number
attributes.description: Externally-assigned sequential identifier for this finding within the inspection, as issued by the regulatory authority (e.g., FDA Form 483 observation number, EMA GCP inspection finding reference).
attributes.references: FDA Form 483; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: finding_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the inspection finding from issuance through resolution. 'Open' indicates the finding has been issued and awaits a formal response. 'Response_submitted' indicates the sponsor/CRO has submitted a written response.
attributes.references: FDA Warning Letter Guidance; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; ICH E6(R2) GCP; MasterControl CAPA

attributes.name: finding_title
attributes.description: Short, human-readable title or headline summarizing the nature of the inspection finding, as recorded in MasterControl. Used for executive dashboards and regulatory commitment registers.
attributes.references: MasterControl Quality Management; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: gcp_principle_violated
attributes.description: The specific ICH GCP principle or section that the finding determines was violated (e.g., 'ICH E6(R2) 4.8 - Informed Consent', 'ICH E6(R2) 5.18 - Monitoring', 'ICH E6(R2) 6.4 - Protocol Amendments').
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA GCP Inspection Classification; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure

attributes.name: inspector
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory inspector or lead inspector who identified and documented this finding. Recorded for correspondence and response addressing purposes. Classified as confidential as it identifies a government official in a regulatory context.
attributes.references: FDA GCP Inspection Program; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: record_owner
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual (typically a QA manager or Regulatory Affairs lead) responsible for managing the response and resolution of this inspection finding within the sponsor or CRO organization.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; MasterControl Quality Management; FDA GCP Inspection Program

attributes.name: regulatory_citation
attributes.description: Specific regulatory reference cited by the inspecting authority as the basis for the finding (e.g., '21 CFR 312.62(b)', 'ICH E6(R2) Section 4.9.0', 'EU CTR 536/2014 Article 47'). Critical for formal response drafting and legal review.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR; ICH E6(R2); EU CTR 536/2014; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; ISO 14155

attributes.name: repeat_finding
attributes.description: Indicates whether this finding is a recurrence of a previously identified deficiency at the same site or sponsor level. Repeat findings signal systemic quality failures and may trigger escalated regulatory enforcement action.
attributes.references: FDA Warning Letter Guidance; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: response_adequacy_assessment
attributes.description: The regulatory authority's assessment of whether the sponsor's formal response to the finding is adequate. 'Adequate' results in finding closure. 'Inadequate' or 'Partially_adequate' requires a supplemental response.
attributes.references: FDA Form 483 Response Guidance; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: response_due_date
attributes.description: Formal deadline by which the sponsor or CRO must submit a written response to the regulatory authority. For FDA Form 483 observations, this is typically 15 business days from the last day of inspection.
attributes.references: FDA Form 483 Response Guidance (15 business days); EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: response_submitted_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the formal written response to the inspection finding was submitted to the regulatory authority. Used to calculate response timeliness and compliance with regulatory deadlines.
attributes.references: FDA Form 483 Response Guidance; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the root cause to enable trend analysis across findings. 'Process' indicates a procedural gap; 'Training' indicates inadequate staff training; 'System' indicates an EDC, CTMS, or IT system failure; 'Communication' indicates a
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA CAPA Guidance; MasterControl; ISO 9001

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Documented root cause of the deficiency identified in the inspection finding, as determined through the CAPA investigation process. Supports systemic quality improvement and recurrence prevention.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA CAPA Guidance; MasterControl CAPA Module; ISO 9001

attributes.name: source
attributes.description: The type of regulatory document in which this finding was formally issued. 'Form_483' refers to FDA Inspectional Observations. 'Warning_letter' refers to an FDA Warning Letter. 'EIR' refers to an FDA Establishment Inspection Report.
attributes.references: FDA Form 483; FDA Warning Letter Program; FDA EIR; EMA GCP Inspection Report; MHRA GCP Guidance

attributes.name: sponsor_response_summary
attributes.description: Executive summary of the sponsor's or CRO's formal written response to the inspection finding, including the root cause identified, immediate corrective actions taken, and preventive measures committed.
attributes.references: FDA Form 483 Response Guidance; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: subject_safety_impact
attributes.description: Assessment of whether the finding has a direct or potential impact on subject safety. 'None' indicates no subject safety risk. 'Potential' indicates a theoretical risk that has not materialized.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 2; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014; OHRP Guidance

attributes.name: supplemental_response_due_date
attributes.description: Deadline for submission of a supplemental or follow-up response when the initial response was assessed as inadequate or partially adequate by the regulatory authority. Null if no supplemental response is required.
attributes.references: FDA Form 483 Response Guidance; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this inspection finding record. Supports audit trail requirements and change tracking under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: warning_letter_reference
attributes.description: Official reference number of the FDA Warning Letter or equivalent regulatory enforcement communication issued in connection with this finding. Populated only when escalation_status is 'warning_letter'.
attributes.references: FDA Warning Letter Program; FDA Enforcement Actions Database

products.name: capa
products.description: Master record for Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) initiated in response to audit findings, inspection findings, protocol deviations, QC failures, or self-identified quality issues.
products.reference: CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action — ICH Q10; 21 CFR Part 820; MasterControl)

attributes.name: capa_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the CAPA record. Primary key for the CAPA lifecycle master record sourced from MasterControl CAPA module.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ISO 14155; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: audit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the internal or external audit that generated the finding triggering this CAPA. Null if the CAPA was not initiated from an audit. Enables audit-to-CAPA traceability.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820; MasterControl Audit Module

attributes.name: bioanalytical_assay_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.bioanalytical_assay. Business justification: CAPAs are raised against bioanalytical assays requiring method revalidation, reagent lot changes, or ISR protocol revisions.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: compliance_sop_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.sop. Business justification: capa.sop_reference is a free-text string identifying the SOP associated with the CAPA. Replacing it with a FK to sop.sop_id enables structured linkage between CAPAs and the SOPs they address
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: health_authority_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the regulatory inspection record

attributes.name: lab_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.lab_facility. Business justification: CAPAs are raised against specific lab facilities following audit findings or quality events (e.g., LIMS validation gap, specimen handling SOP non-compliance).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: protocol_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.protocol. Business justification: CAPAs triggered by protocol deviations or audit findings are protocol-version specific. compliance_capa has study_id but no protocol_id.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the clinical study associated with this CAPA. Links the CAPA to the relevant study protocol for study-level quality tracking and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM; FDA IND Regulations 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the investigational site associated with this CAPA, if site-specific. Null for sponsor-level or cross-site CAPAs. Supports site-level quality performance analytics.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: tmf_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: CAPAs generate corrective documents (updated SOPs, revised procedures) that must be filed in the TMF. GCP requires CAPA documentation to be inspection-ready.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: actual_completion_date
attributes.description: Actual calendar date on which all corrective and preventive actions were completed and verified. Null until CAPA is closed. Used to calculate cycle time and on-time closure rate KPIs.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the CAPA plan was formally approved by the authorized QA approver in MasterControl. Marks the transition from initiation to active execution phase.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; FDA 21 CFR Part 820; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: capa_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the action is corrective (addressing an existing non-conformance), preventive (addressing a potential non-conformance), or both. Drives workflow routing in MasterControl.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; ISO 14155

attributes.name: closure_justification
attributes.description: Narrative justification provided by the responsible owner and QA approver at the time of CAPA closure, summarizing evidence that all actions were completed and the root cause was resolved. Required for regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module; ALCOA+

attributes.name: compliance_capa_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the CAPA record. Drives workflow routing, escalation triggers, and regulatory reporting. 'Overdue' is system-set when target completion date is passed without closure.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: corrective_action_plan
attributes.description: Detailed description of the corrective actions planned or implemented to address the identified root cause and prevent recurrence of the quality issue. Core CAPA deliverable per GCP requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; ISO 14155; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when the CAPA record was first created in the lakehouse silver layer. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: data_integrity_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the quality issue underlying this CAPA had or could have had an impact on clinical data integrity. Triggers data review, potential database query, and regulatory notification workflows.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Data Integrity Guidance; EMA Data Integrity Guidance; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: effectiveness_check_date
attributes.description: Planned or actual date on which the effectiveness of the implemented corrective and preventive actions will be or was verified. Required by GCP to confirm the CAPA resolved the root cause.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; ISO 14155; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: effectiveness_check_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the methodology and findings from the effectiveness check, including evidence reviewed and conclusions drawn. Supports regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module; ALCOA+

attributes.name: effectiveness_check_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the effectiveness verification assessment confirming whether the implemented CAPA actions successfully resolved the root cause and prevented recurrence. Drives CAPA closure or re-opening decisions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; ISO 14155; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: gcp_impact_assessment
attributes.description: Assessment of the impact of the underlying quality issue on GCP compliance and data integrity. Drives CAPA priority, escalation, and regulatory reporting decisions. Aligned with FDA and EMA GCP inspection classification standards.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA GCP Inspections; EMA GCP Inspections; MHRA GCP Inspections

attributes.name: immediate_action_taken
attributes.description: Description of any immediate containment or interim actions taken at the time of CAPA initiation to mitigate the impact of the quality issue before the full corrective action is implemented.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: initiation_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the CAPA was formally initiated and entered into MasterControl. Serves as the start of the CAPA lifecycle clock for overdue tracking and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; MasterControl CAPA Module; ALCOA+

attributes.name: mastercontrol_record_number
attributes.description: Native record identifier assigned by the MasterControl CAPA module. Used for source system traceability, data lineage, and reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational system of record.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: preventive_action_plan
attributes.description: Detailed description of the preventive actions planned to eliminate the potential for recurrence of similar quality issues across the organization or study portfolio.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; ISO 14155; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Risk-based priority level assigned to the CAPA, reflecting the severity and urgency of the underlying quality issue. Drives escalation timelines and resource allocation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820; ISO 14155; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: problem_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the quality issue, non-conformance, or finding that triggered the CAPA. Captures the 'what happened' narrative for audit trail and regulatory inspection purposes.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module; ALCOA+

attributes.name: recurrence_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this CAPA addresses a recurring quality issue that has been the subject of a prior CAPA. True signals a systemic quality problem requiring escalated management attention.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Reference Number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable CAPA reference number assigned by MasterControl upon initiation (e.g., CAPA-2024-00123). Used in audit trails, regulatory submissions, and sponsor communications.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; MasterControl CAPA Module; FDA 21 CFR Part 820

tag_set.value: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Reference Number

attributes.name: regulatory_reportable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this CAPA is associated with a finding that requires regulatory reporting to FDA, EMA, MHRA, or other health authority. Drives regulatory submission workflow in Veeva Vault.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Inspections; EU CTR 536/2014; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: responsible_department
attributes.description: Organizational department or functional area accountable for CAPA execution (e.g., Clinical Operations, Data Management, Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance). Used for departmental quality KPI reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: Standardized category classifying the root cause of the quality issue (e.g., training deficiency, process gap, system failure, communication breakdown, resource constraint). Used for trend analysis and systemic quality improvement.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; ISO 14155; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the identified root cause of the quality issue, as determined through root cause analysis (RCA). Supports regulatory inspection readiness and CAPA justification.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; EMA GCP Inspections; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: source_reference_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the originating record that triggered this CAPA (e.g., audit finding ID, inspection finding ID, protocol deviation ID, or QC failure ID). Enables traceability back to the root triggering event.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: source_type
attributes.description: Category of the triggering event that initiated the CAPA. Classifies whether the CAPA originated from an internal audit, regulatory inspection, protocol deviation, QC failure, self-identified quality issue, complaint, or safety signal.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; EMA GCP Inspections; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: sponsor_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the study sponsor was formally notified of this CAPA. Null if sponsor_notified_flag is False. Supports sponsor oversight audit trail.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: sponsor_notified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the study sponsor has been formally notified of this CAPA. Required for CRO-managed studies where sponsor oversight obligations apply per ICH E6(R2) GCP.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: subject_safety_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the quality issue underlying this CAPA had or could have had a direct impact on subject safety. Triggers expedited review and potential safety reporting obligations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014; ISO 14155

attributes.name: target_completion_date
attributes.description: Planned date by which all corrective and preventive actions must be completed and the CAPA closed. Used for overdue status calculation, escalation triggers, and sponsor/regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Short, descriptive title summarizing the quality issue or finding that triggered the CAPA. Used for identification in dashboards, reports, and audit-readiness reviews.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: training_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the corrective or preventive action includes a mandatory training component. When True, triggers training assignment workflow in MasterControl training management module.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820; MasterControl Training Management Module

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when the CAPA record was last modified in the lakehouse silver layer. Supports change tracking, audit trail integrity, and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.description: Reference to the associated CAPA record in MasterControl, if a corrective and preventive action has been initiated in response to this deviation.

attributes.name: compliance_sop_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_sop. Business justification: Protocol deviations frequently trigger mandatory retraining as corrective action.

attributes.name: dosing_regimen_id

attributes.name: eligibility_criterion_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.eligibility_criterion. Business justification: Eligibility criterion violations are a primary deviation category. ICH E3 CSR Section 10.2 requires listing deviations by the specific inclusion/exclusion criterion violated.

attributes.name: pk_sample_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.protocol. Business justification: Protocol deviations are violations of a specific protocol version. Direct FK to protocol enables deviation analysis by protocol version, supports CSR deviation summaries, and is required for

attributes.name: protocol_lab_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.protocol_lab_schedule. Business justification: Protocol deviations for missed or incorrect lab assessments are evaluated against the protocol lab schedule.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: sap_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to biostatistics.estimand. Business justification: ICH E9(R1) requires deviations to be assessed against estimand strategies (intercurrent events, missing data).

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.shipment. Business justification: Shipment failures (delayed delivery causing missed dose window, wrong kits shipped) are a documented category of protocol deviations.

attributes.name: specimen_collection_id

attributes.name: trial_subject_id
attributes.description: Reference to the study subject (patient) associated with this deviation, if applicable. Nullable for site-level or system-level deviations not tied to a specific subject.

attributes.name: visit_id

attributes.name: audit_readiness_status
attributes.description: Indicates the current audit readiness state of this deviation record, confirming that all required documentation, reporting, and CAPA activities are complete and the record is inspection-ready.

attributes.name: corrective_action_summary
attributes.description: Brief summary of the immediate corrective actions taken to address the deviation and prevent recurrence, prior to or independent of a formal CAPA. Captures site-level remediation steps.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; ALCOA+

attributes.name: data_integrity_impact

attributes.name: detected_by

attributes.name: deviation_category

attributes.name: deviation_description

attributes.name: deviation_ref_number

attributes.name: discovery_date
