attributes.name: include_in_csr_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Include in Clinical Study Report (CSR) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this deviation must be listed or summarized in the Clinical Study Report (CSR) per ICH E3 requirements. Major and important deviations are typically included.
attributes.references: ICH E3 Section 10.2; ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on CSR

tag_set.value: Include in Clinical Study Report (CSR) Flag

attributes.name: irb_iec_reported_date
attributes.description: The date on which the deviation was formally submitted to the IRB/IEC. Used to verify compliance with reporting timelines and to support audit readiness.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 56.108; ICH E6(R2) Section 3.3; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: irb_iec_reporting_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Reporting Required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this deviation must be reported to the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) per applicable regulations and the IRB/IEC-approved protocol.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 56.108; ICH E6(R2) Section 3.3; EU CTR 536/2014

tag_set.value: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Reporting Required

attributes.name: occurrence_date
attributes.description: The date on which the protocol deviation actually occurred (i.e., the date the protocol requirement was not met). This is the principal real-world event date per CDISC SDTM DVSTDTC.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DV Domain (DVSTDTC); ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: pi_notified_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Principal Investigator (PI) was formally notified of the deviation. Required for GCP compliance and site management accountability.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5; 21 CFR Part 312.53; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: protocol_requirement_ref
attributes.description: Specific section, clause, or criterion number within the study protocol that was deviated from (e.g., 'Section 5.3 Inclusion Criterion 2'). Enables precise traceability to the protocol document.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6; CDISC SDTM DV Domain (DVCAT); FDA Guidance on Protocol Deviations

attributes.name: protocol_version
attributes.description: Version of the study protocol that was in effect at the time the deviation occurred. Critical for determining which protocol requirements were applicable.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6; 21 CFR Part 312.23

attributes.name: regulatory_authority_reported_date
attributes.description: The date on which the deviation was formally submitted to the applicable regulatory authority (FDA, EMA, PMDA, etc.), where regulatory reporting was required.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA CT-3 Guidance; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.17; PMDA

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this deviation must be reported to a regulatory authority (e.g., FDA, EMA, PMDA) as part of IND safety reporting or clinical trial notification obligations.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA CT-3 Guidance; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.17

attributes.name: repeat_deviation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this deviation is a recurrence of a previously identified deviation of the same type at the same site or by the same subject. Used for trend analysis and escalation decisions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.20; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance; EMA Reflection Paper on QM

attributes.name: reported_date
attributes.description: The date on which the deviation was formally reported to the sponsor, IRB/IEC, or regulatory authority as required. Used to assess compliance with reporting timelines.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5.2; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 54

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the deviation was resolved and corrective actions were confirmed as complete. Marks the end of the active deviation lifecycle.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5; MasterControl; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: Categorized root cause of the deviation as determined during investigation. Common categories include: training_gap, communication_failure, process_gap, system_error, oversight, workload, protocol_complexity, subject_non_compliance.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.20; MasterControl CAPA Module; FDA CAPA Guidance

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative of the identified root cause of the protocol deviation, as documented during the investigation process. Supports CAPA development and trend analysis.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.20; MasterControl; FDA CAPA Guidance

attributes.name: source_system_record_number
attributes.description: The native record identifier from the originating source system (e.g., Medidata Rave deviation ID or the source system deviation record ID). Enables upstream reconciliation and audit trail.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.5

attributes.name: sponsor_reported_date
attributes.description: The date on which the deviation was formally communicated to the sponsor. Used to verify compliance with sponsor notification timelines per the Clinical Trial Agreement.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5.2; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: sponsor_reporting_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this deviation must be formally reported to the study sponsor per the Clinical Trial Agreement and sponsor SOPs.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5.2; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: subject_excluded_from_pp_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Subject Excluded from Per Protocol (PP) Population Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this deviation resulted in the exclusion of the subject from the Per Protocol (PP) analysis population, as determined by the biostatistics team per the Statistical Analysis Plan (the source system).
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; ICH E9(R1) Estimands; SAP; CDISC ADaM

tag_set.value: Subject Excluded from Per Protocol (PP) Population Flag

attributes.name: subject_impact_assessment
attributes.description: Assessment of whether the deviation had an impact on subject safety, rights, or well-being. Used to determine reporting obligations and CAPA urgency.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5; FDA Guidance on Protocol Deviations; EMA GCP Inspection Findings

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the protocol deviation record. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail and change tracking requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; ALCOA+

products.name: compliance_sop
products.description: Master record for Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) managed within the quality management system. Captures SOP number, title, version, effective date, expiry date, SOP owner (department/role), applicable process area, regulatory basis (GCP, GLP, GMP)
products.reference: SOP (Standard Operating Procedure — ICH E6 R2 Section 1.55; 21 CFR Part 11)

attributes.name: compliance_sop_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the Standard Operating Procedure record in the quality management system. Primary key for the sop data product.
attributes.references: MasterControl Document Control Module; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: superseded_sop_compliance_sop_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sop record that this version supersedes. Supports version lineage navigation and ensures the document control chain of custody is maintained for regulatory inspection.
attributes.references: MasterControl Document Control; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: applicable_roles
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of job roles or role groups required to be trained on and comply with this SOP (e.g., CRA, CRC, PI, QA Manager, Data Manager). Drives training assignment generation in MasterControl.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management; ICH E6(R2); GCP

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the SOP version received final authorized approval in MasterControl. Distinct from the effective date; the SOP may be approved before it becomes operationally binding to allow training completion.
attributes.references: MasterControl Document Control; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+

attributes.name: approver_name
attributes.description: Full name of the authorized signatory who approved the current version of the SOP. Typically a senior QA or functional head. Required for regulatory inspection readiness and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic signature compliance.
attributes.references: MasterControl Document Control; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: audit_finding_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier of the internal or external audit finding that prompted this SOP revision or creation. Supports traceability from audit observations to corrective document updates.
attributes.references: MasterControl Audit Management; ICH E6(R2); FDA GCP Inspection; ISO 19011

attributes.name: capa_reference_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Reference Number
attributes.description: Reference number of any CAPA record in MasterControl that triggered the creation or revision of this SOP version. Links SOP updates to root cause corrective actions identified through audits, inspections, or deviation investigations.
attributes.references: MasterControl CAPA Tracking; ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ISO 9001

tag_set.value: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Reference Number

attributes.name: change_control_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the change control record in MasterControl that authorized the creation or revision of this SOP version. Provides traceability from the SOP to the formal change management process.
attributes.references: MasterControl CAPA and Change Control; ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ISO 9001

attributes.name: confidentiality_level
attributes.description: Data classification level assigned to the SOP document content, governing who may access and distribute it. Aligns with the organization's information security policy and GDPR/HIPAA data handling requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ISO 27001

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the SOP record was first created in the quality management system. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2); MasterControl

attributes.name: deviation_classification_relevance
attributes.description: Indicates the severity classification of protocol deviations that non-compliance with this SOP would typically generate (critical, major, minor). Used by QA to pre-classify deviation risk and prioritize SOP compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA GCP; EMA GCP; CDISC CDASH; MasterControl

attributes.name: document_category
attributes.description: Functional category grouping for the SOP within the document management taxonomy (e.g., Quality Management, Clinical Operations, Data Management, Regulatory Affairs, Safety, Laboratory, Finance).
attributes.references: MasterControl Document Control; ICH E6(R2); ISO 9001

attributes.name: document_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the SOP document within the quality management system workflow. Controls whether the SOP is actionable for training and compliance purposes. 'approved' is the only status permitting operational use.
attributes.references: MasterControl Document Control Workflow; ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 11; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document within the quality management system hierarchy. SOPs define mandatory procedures; work instructions provide step-by-step task guidance; policies set organizational rules; guidance documents are advisory.
attributes.references: MasterControl Document Control; ICH E6(R2); ISO 9001

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the approved SOP version becomes operationally binding for all applicable staff and sites. Training must be completed by this date. Aligns with the ALCOA+ principle of contemporaneous documentation.
attributes.references: MasterControl Document Control; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: electronic_signature_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SOP requires electronic signatures for approval in compliance with FDA 21 CFR Part 11 and EU Annex 11 electronic records requirements. When True, wet signatures are not acceptable as the sole approval mechanism.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; EU Annex 11; ICH E6(R2); MasterControl

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the SOP version is scheduled to expire and must be reviewed, revised, or retired. Typically set to a fixed interval (e.g., 2–3 years) from the effective date per the organization's document control SOP.
attributes.references: MasterControl Document Control; ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: gdpr_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SOP governs processes that involve personal data subject to GDPR requirements (e.g., patient data handling, consent management, data subject rights). Drives GDPR compliance review during SOP periodic review.
attributes.references: GDPR Articles 5, 24, 25; EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2)

tag_set.value: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Applicable Flag

attributes.name: geographic_applicability
attributes.description: Countries or regions where this SOP is applicable, expressed as ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes or region labels (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU, GLOBAL). Relevant for multi-regional trials where regulatory requirements differ by jurisdiction.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP; MHRA; PMDA; Health Canada; TGA

attributes.name: hipaa_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SOP governs processes subject to HIPAA Privacy and Security Rules for U.S.-based studies involving protected health information (PHI). Relevant for studies conducted at U.S. sites.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Parts 160 and 164; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; ICH E6(R2)

tag_set.value: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Applicable Flag

attributes.name: inspection_readiness_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SOP has been reviewed and confirmed as current and compliant in preparation for a regulatory inspection (FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA). Set to True when QA has verified the SOP is up-to-date and all training is complete.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA GCP Inspection; EMA GCP Inspection; MHRA GCP Inspection; PMDA

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code of the SOP document (e.g., en, fr, de, ja). Supports multi-language document management for global trials and ensures site staff receive SOPs in the appropriate language.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1; ICH E6(R2); EU CTR 536/2014; GDPR

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the SOP record was most recently updated in the quality management system or the lakehouse Silver Layer. Supports change detection, incremental ETL processing, and audit trail completeness.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2); MasterControl

attributes.name: mastercontrol_doc_number
attributes.description: Native document identifier assigned by the MasterControl quality management system. Used for direct cross-reference and deep-linking back to the source system record for audit trail and change control purposes.
attributes.references: MasterControl Document Control; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: owner_department
attributes.description: Name of the organizational department accountable for authoring, maintaining, and periodically reviewing this SOP (e.g., Quality Assurance, Data Management, Regulatory Affairs). Determines the primary escalation path for SOP-related queries.
attributes.references: MasterControl Document Control; ICH E6(R2); ISO 9001

attributes.name: owner_role
attributes.description: Job role or title of the individual responsible for the SOP within the owning department (e.g., QA Manager, Director of Data Management). Used for accountability tracking and escalation in audit findings.
attributes.references: MasterControl Document Control; ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: parent_sop_number
attributes.description: SOP number of the higher-level or governing SOP under which this SOP sits in the document hierarchy (e.g., a site-specific SOP may reference a global SOP as its parent). Supports hierarchical document structure navigation.
attributes.references: MasterControl Document Control; ICH E6(R2); ISO 9001

attributes.name: process_area
attributes.description: Primary clinical trial business process area governed by this SOP (e.g., Study Protocol Design, Patient Recruitment, Adverse Event Reporting, Site Monitoring, Data Management, Regulatory Submission). Used for process-level compliance gap analysis.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; MasterControl

attributes.name: purpose_description
attributes.description: Brief statement of the business purpose and objective of the SOP, summarizing what process it governs and why it exists. Sourced from the SOP document's purpose/objective section.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); MasterControl Document Control; ISO 9001

attributes.name: qms_workflow_stage
attributes.description: Current stage of the SOP within the MasterControl quality management system workflow. More granular than document_status; tracks the specific workflow step the document is in during its lifecycle (e.g., authoring, peer review, QA review, approval
attributes.references: MasterControl Document Control Workflow; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: regulatory_basis
attributes.description: Primary regulatory practice standard(s) that this SOP is designed to satisfy: Good Clinical Practice (GCP), Good Laboratory Practice (GLP), Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP), or applicable combinations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; OECD GLP Principles; EU GMP Annex 11; FDA 21 CFR Parts 58, 210, 211

attributes.name: regulatory_references
attributes.description: Free-text or structured list of specific regulatory citations, guidelines, and standards that this SOP implements or references (e.g., ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18, FDA 21 CFR Part 312, EU CTR 536/2014 Article 47).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014; EMA GCP Guidelines; MHRA GCP

attributes.name: review_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date by which the SOP owner must initiate a periodic review to confirm continued applicability and accuracy. May precede the expiry date to allow time for revision and approval before expiry.
attributes.references: MasterControl Document Control; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: revision_summary
attributes.description: Brief narrative describing the nature and rationale of changes made in this version relative to the superseded version (e.g., 'Updated to reflect ICH E6(R3) requirements; added remote monitoring guidance'). Required for change control documentation.
attributes.references: MasterControl Document Control; ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: scope_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the scope and applicability of the SOP, including which studies, sites, roles, or geographies it applies to. Sourced from the SOP document's scope section. Critical for determining applicability during inspections.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); MasterControl Document Control; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: sop_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable document control number assigned to the SOP within MasterControl (e.g., QA-GCP-001). Serves as the business identifier used in audit trails, regulatory submissions, and training records.
attributes.references: MasterControl Document Control; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: sox_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SOP governs financial reporting or internal control processes subject to SOX compliance requirements (e.g., finance, procurement, project accounting SOPs). Relevant for publicly-listed sponsors and CROs.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302, 404; SAP S/4HANA Financial Controls; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: superseded_version_number
attributes.description: Version number of the immediately preceding SOP version that this current version replaces. Enables version lineage tracing and ensures retired versions are correctly linked in the document control audit trail.
attributes.references: MasterControl Document Control; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Full descriptive title of the SOP as it appears on the document cover page and in the quality management system. Used for search, display, and regulatory filing purposes.
attributes.references: MasterControl Document Control; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ISO 9001

attributes.name: training_completion_deadline_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days from the SOP effective date within which all applicable staff must complete the required training. Used by MasterControl to auto-calculate individual training due dates and trigger overdue notifications.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management; ICH E6(R2); GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: training_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether completion of a formal training event is mandatory for all applicable staff before they may operate under this SOP. When True, a training assignment must be created in MasterControl for each in-scope role upon SOP approval.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; GCP

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Current version identifier of the SOP document (e.g., 1.0, 2.1, 3.0). Incremented upon each approved revision cycle. Used to ensure staff are trained on and referencing the correct version.
attributes.references: MasterControl Document Control; ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 11

products.name: quality_event
products.description: Transactional record capturing quality events identified through QC reviews, self-inspections, routine quality monitoring, or proactive quality surveillance activities.
products.reference: Quality Event / Non-Conformance (ICH Q10; MasterControl)

attributes.name: quality_event_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the quality event record within the MasterControl quality management module. Serves as the primary key for all downstream references to this quality event.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; MasterControl QMS

attributes.name: adverse_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.adverse_event. Business justification: Quality events are routinely triggered by AE reporting failures (late submission, incorrect coding, missing causality).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: bioanalytical_assay_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.bioanalytical_assay. Business justification: Quality events are raised against bioanalytical assays (e.g., QC sample failure, calibration curve rejection, ISR failure exceeding acceptance criteria).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: capa_id
attributes.description: Reference to the formal CAPA record initiated in MasterControl as a result of this quality event. Populated only when capa_required is True and the CAPA has been formally opened. Null until CAPA is initiated.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA CAPA Guidance; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: compliance_sop_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.sop. Business justification: quality_event.affected_sop_number is a free-text string identifying the SOP implicated in the quality event.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: consent_subject_consent_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to subject.subject_consent. Business justification: Consent process failures (re-consent not obtained after protocol amendment, expired ICF version used) are a direct source of quality events.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: database_lock_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to biostatistics.database_lock_event. Business justification: Quality events arising from database lock failures (outstanding queries, failed QC checks, unauthorized lock) must reference the specific DBL event.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: deviation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to subject.subject_deviation. Business justification: Subject deviations are a primary source of quality events. quality_event already has protocol_deviation_id (compliance-domain classification) but not subject_deviation_id
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: dsmb_recommendation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.dsmb_recommendation. Business justification: DSMB recommendations (stopping rules triggered, protocol amendments required, informed consent updates) generate quality events in the QMS for implementation tracking.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: lab_panel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.lab_panel. Business justification: Quality events are raised against specific lab panels (e.g., reagent lot failure affecting entire panel, method drift detected across panel analytes).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: lab_result_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.lab_result. Business justification: Quality events are frequently triggered by laboratory data issues — systematic result errors, instrument failures, reagent lot problems. quality_event has affected_data_domain.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: manufacture_batch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.manufacture_batch. Business justification: Manufacturing batch failures, OOS results, and QP release holds are quality events under GMP.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: parent_event_quality_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to a prior quality event record that this event is a recurrence of, or a related parent event in a cluster of related quality issues. Populated when recurrence_flag is True or when events are grouped for systemic analysis.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; MasterControl QMS; FDA CAPA Guidance

attributes.name: pk_sample_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.pk_sample. Business justification: Quality events are raised against PK samples (e.g., insufficient volume, incorrect storage temperature, freeze-thaw cycle exceedance).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: principal_investigator_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to site.principal_investigator. Business justification: Quality events at sites require PI notification and response per GCP. PI accountability for data integrity, subject safety, and regulatory compliance tracking require direct PI
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: protocol_deviation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.protocol_deviation. Business justification: quality_event.deviation_reference_number is a free-text string referencing a related protocol deviation.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: reference_range_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.reference_range. Business justification: Quality events are raised when reference ranges are found incorrect, outdated, or misapplied (e.g., wrong sex-specific range applied, CTCAE grading threshold error).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: sdv_review_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to subject.sdv_review. Business justification: SDV review outcomes with high error rates or low coverage percentages are a direct trigger for quality events under risk-based monitoring frameworks.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: serious_adverse_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.serious_adverse_event. Business justification: Quality events are triggered by SAE reporting process failures (missed 15-day deadline, incorrect blinding status, incomplete narrative).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: signal_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.signal. Business justification: Safety signal detection triggers quality events in the QMS (e.g., signal requiring process review, risk minimization measure implementation).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: specimen_aliquot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.specimen_aliquot. Business justification: Quality events are raised against specific aliquots (e.g., temperature excursion in long-term storage, volume below minimum threshold, stability expiry breach).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: specimen_collection_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.specimen_collection. Business justification: Specimen collection quality failures (hemolysis, lipemia, inadequate volume) are formal quality events requiring CAPA.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: specimen_shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.specimen_shipment. Business justification: Temperature excursions during specimen shipment are a named quality event type in clinical trials. specimen_shipment has temperature_excursion_flag.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study affected by this quality event. Links the event to the specific protocol under which the quality issue was identified.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational site where the quality event was identified or originated. Null if the event is study-wide or sponsor/CRO-level rather than site-specific.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: subject_consent_consent_subject_consent_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to consent.subject_consent. Business justification: Quality events in clinical trials frequently arise from consent process failures (wrong ICF version used, consent obtained after procedures, missing signatures).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: tmf_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: Quality events (e.g., data integrity issues, GCP violations) reference specific TMF documents as the affected or corrective record.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: visit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to subject.subject_visit. Business justification: Quality events in clinical trials are frequently triggered by specific visit-level anomalies (missed assessments, out-of-window visits, data entry errors at visit).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: affected_data_domain
attributes.description: The CDISC SDTM or clinical data domain affected by the quality event (e.g., AE, CM, LB, VS, DM, DS, EX). Used for data management impact assessment, targeted re-monitoring, and SDTM submission quality review. Null if the event is not data-domain-specific.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: affected_process
attributes.description: The specific clinical trial business process or functional area impacted by the quality event (e.g., informed consent management, adverse event reporting, randomization, data entry, site monitoring, regulatory submission).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA GCP Guidance; MasterControl QMS

attributes.name: audit_readiness_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this quality event record has been reviewed and confirmed as complete and audit-ready for regulatory inspection or sponsor audit purposes. True: record is audit-ready.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA GCP Inspection Guidance; Veeva Vault eTMF; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: capa_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) has been determined to be required for this quality event. True: CAPA must be initiated in MasterControl. False: event can be resolved without formal CAPA.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.1; FDA CAPA Guidance; MasterControl CAPA Module

tag_set.value: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Required Flag

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the quality event record was first created in MasterControl. Supports 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail requirements and ALCOA+ attributability. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: data_integrity_impact
attributes.description: Indicates whether the quality event has compromised or potentially compromised the integrity of clinical trial data in the EDC or source documents. True: data integrity affected. False: no data integrity impact.
attributes.references: FDA Data Integrity Guidance 2018; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ Principles; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: error_count
attributes.description: Number of errors, discrepancies, or non-conformances identified within the QC sample reviewed. Used in conjunction with sample_size to compute error rate for quality trending and threshold monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC DMP Guidelines; MasterControl QMS

attributes.name: error_rate
attributes.description: Proportion of errors identified relative to the total sample size (error_count / sample_size). Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0250 = 2.50%). Used for quality threshold monitoring, KPI reporting, and CAPA escalation triggers.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Data Integrity Guidance; MasterControl QMS

attributes.name: event_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the quality event, including what was observed, where it occurred, and the potential impact on subject safety, data integrity, or regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ Principles; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: event_reference_number
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally-visible reference number assigned to the quality event upon creation in MasterControl. Used in audit trails, regulatory correspondence, and CAPA linkage. Format: QE-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; MasterControl QMS

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the quality event within the MasterControl workflow. Open: newly identified, awaiting triage. Under Review: QA/QC team actively investigating. Pending CAPA: CAPA determination made, awaiting CAPA initiation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; MasterControl QMS

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Classification of the quality event by its nature. Drives routing, escalation rules, and CAPA determination logic. Values: data_quality_issue (EDC/eCRF data errors), process_non_compliance (GCP/SOP deviation), system_failure (EDC, CTMS, or IRT system
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; MasterControl QMS

attributes.name: identification_source
attributes.description: The activity or mechanism through which the quality event was detected. Drives root cause analysis and process improvement analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.1; FDA GCP Inspection Guidance; MasterControl QMS

attributes.name: identified_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the quality event was first identified or detected. This is the principal real-world event date per ALCOA+ contemporaneous documentation requirements. Distinct from the record creation timestamp.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ Principles; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: immediate_action_taken
attributes.description: Description of any immediate containment or corrective actions taken at the time of quality event identification, prior to formal CAPA initiation. Examples: data query raised in EDC, site notified, process halted.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.1; FDA GCP Inspection Guidance; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: irb_iec_reportable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Reportable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this quality event must be reported to the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) overseeing the study. True: IRB/IEC notification required. False: not required.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 3.3; FDA 21 CFR Part 56; OHRP Regulations; EU CTR 536/2014

tag_set.value: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Reportable Flag

attributes.name: protocol_deviation_category
attributes.description: Classification of the quality event as a protocol deviation per ICH E6(R2) and sponsor requirements. Major: deviation that may affect subject safety or data integrity. Minor: deviation with minimal impact.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.5; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; EMA GCP Guideline

attributes.name: qc_outcome
attributes.description: Overall outcome of the QC review activity that generated this quality event. Pass: quality threshold met, no significant issues. Fail: quality threshold exceeded, formal action required.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC DMP Guidelines; MasterControl QMS

attributes.name: recurrence_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this quality event represents a recurrence of a previously identified and closed quality event of the same type at the same site or study. True: recurrence identified. False: first occurrence.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA CAPA Guidance; MasterControl QMS

attributes.name: regulatory_authority_notified
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory authority (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, TGA, Health Canada) notified of this quality event, if applicable. Null if regulatory_reportability is not_reportable. Supports regulatory submission tracking and inspection readiness.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GCP Guideline; ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: regulatory_reportability
attributes.description: Assessment of whether this quality event requires reporting to a regulatory authority (FDA, EMA, MHRA, etc.) or to the sponsor. Reportable: must be submitted to regulatory body. Not Reportable: no regulatory notification required.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GCP Guideline; ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: Date on which the quality event was formally resolved and closed in MasterControl. Populated when event_status transitions to closed. Used to calculate time-to-resolution KPIs and assess compliance with quality SLA targets.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; MasterControl QMS; FDA GCP Inspection Guidance

attributes.name: resolution_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of how the quality event was resolved, including actions taken, verification of effectiveness, and confirmation that the issue has been addressed.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; MasterControl QMS; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the QA reviewer formally assessed and triaged the quality event in MasterControl. Used to measure triage cycle time and compliance with internal quality SLA targets for event review.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.1; MasterControl QMS; FDA GCP Inspection Guidance

attributes.name: reviewed_by
attributes.description: Name or user identifier of the Quality Assurance (QA) professional who reviewed and assessed the quality event in MasterControl. Supports 21 CFR Part 11 electronic signature audit trail and GCP oversight accountability.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.1; 21 CFR Part 11; MasterControl QMS

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the root cause identified during quality event investigation. Used for systemic quality trending, SOP improvement prioritization, and CAPA effectiveness analysis.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA CAPA Guidance; ISO 9001 Root Cause Analysis

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative of the root cause identified through investigation of the quality event. Captured by the QA investigator following root cause analysis. Supports CAPA development and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA CAPA Guidance; MasterControl QMS

attributes.name: sample_size
attributes.description: Total number of records, data points, or items reviewed during the QC activity that identified this quality event. Used to calculate error rate and assess the statistical significance of the finding. Applicable when the event originates from a QC review.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC DMP Guidelines; MasterControl QMS

attributes.name: severity
attributes.description: Risk-based severity classification of the quality event per GCP quality standards. Critical: may impact subject safety or data integrity requiring immediate action. Major: significant GCP deviation with potential regulatory impact.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; EMA GCP Inspection Findings Classification; FDA Guidance on GCP Inspections

attributes.name: sponsor_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the study sponsor was formally notified of this quality event. Populated when sponsor_notified is True. Used to verify compliance with contractual and regulatory notification timelines.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.2; FDA GCP Guidance; Sponsor Quality Agreement

attributes.name: sponsor_notified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the study sponsor has been formally notified of this quality event. True: sponsor notification sent. False: sponsor not yet notified. Required for CRO-sponsor quality agreement compliance and sponsor oversight obligations under ICH
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.2; FDA GCP Guidance; Sponsor Quality Agreement

attributes.name: subject_safety_impact
attributes.description: Indicates whether the quality event has a direct or potential impact on the safety of enrolled study subjects. True: subject safety may be or has been affected. False: no subject safety impact identified.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.5; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GCP Guideline

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp of the most recent modification to the quality event record in MasterControl. Required for audit trail completeness under 21 CFR Part 11 and ICH E6(R2). Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: assessment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the risk assessment was formally conducted and documented. Represents the principal business event date for this record. Used for trend analysis and review frequency tracking.
attributes.references: ICH Q9; ICH E6(R2); FDA RBQM Guidance

attributes.name: assessment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the risk assessment record in MasterControl: draft (being authored), in_review (under QA/sponsor review), approved (formally accepted), active (monitoring in progress), closed (risk resolved or accepted), cancelled (assessment
attributes.references: MasterControl Workflow; ICH Q9; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: capa_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) record must be initiated as a result of this risk assessment. Typically set to True when residual risk rating is critical or high, or when identified gaps meet CAPA threshold criteria.

tag_set.value: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Required Flag

attributes.name: control_measures_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the existing or planned quality control and risk mitigation measures applied to reduce the identified risk (e.g., enhanced SDV, targeted monitoring, additional training, SOP updates, EDC edit checks). Sourced from MasterControl.
attributes.references: ICH Q9; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA RBQM Guidance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this risk assessment record was first created in the source system (MasterControl). Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ICH E6(R2) for electronic records.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: data_integrity_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the identified risk has a potential or actual impact on clinical data integrity (ALCOA+ principles: Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate). Triggers enhanced data review and potential database lock delay.
attributes.references: FDA Data Integrity Guidance; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2); MHRA GXP Data Integrity Guidance

attributes.name: gcp_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the identified risk has a direct impact on Good Clinical Practice (GCP) compliance. Drives escalation to QA leadership and potential regulatory notification obligations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Guideline

attributes.name: identified_gaps
attributes.description: Narrative description of quality gaps, process deficiencies, or compliance vulnerabilities identified during the risk assessment (e.g., missing SDV documentation, incomplete ICF versions, delayed SAE reporting).
attributes.references: ICH Q9; ICH E6(R2); FDA RBQM Guidance; EMA GCP Guideline

attributes.name: inherent_detectability_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (typically 1–5) representing the ability to detect the risk before it causes harm, prior to control measures. Used in FMEA-style risk scoring (Risk Priority Number = Likelihood × Impact × Detectability).
attributes.references: ICH Q9 FMEA Methodology; FDA RBQM Guidance

attributes.name: inherent_impact_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (typically 1–5) representing the severity of impact on patient safety, data integrity, or regulatory compliance if the risk materializes before controls are applied. Component of the inherent risk score calculation.
attributes.references: ICH Q9; FDA RBQM Guidance; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: inherent_likelihood_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (typically 1–5) representing the probability of the risk occurring before any control measures are applied. Component of the inherent risk score calculation per ICH Q9 risk estimation methodology.
attributes.references: ICH Q9; FDA RBQM Guidance

attributes.name: inherent_risk_rating
attributes.description: Qualitative risk rating derived from the inherent risk score before controls: critical, high, medium, or low. Used for risk prioritization, escalation thresholds, and sponsor/QA reporting dashboards.
attributes.references: ICH Q9; FDA RBQM Guidance; EMA GCP Guideline

attributes.name: inherent_risk_score
attributes.description: Composite numeric risk score calculated before control measures are applied, typically derived from likelihood, impact, and detectability scores (e.g., product or weighted sum). Establishes the baseline risk level for prioritization.
attributes.references: ICH Q9; FDA RBQM Guidance; EMA Reflection Paper on RBQM

attributes.name: inspection_readiness_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this risk assessment was conducted specifically in preparation for a regulatory inspection (FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, or sponsor audit). Enables filtering of inspection-readiness assessments for pre-inspection reporting.
attributes.references: FDA Inspection Guidance; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: mastercontrol_record_number
attributes.description: The native record identifier assigned by MasterControl (the system of record for this data product) to the risk assessment document. Enables direct traceability back to the source system for audit and reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: MasterControl Document Control; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of this risk assessment, based on the defined review frequency. Supports proactive risk monitoring and inspection readiness. Calculated from assessment_date and review_frequency_days.
attributes.references: ICH Q9; FDA RBQM Guidance; EMA Reflection Paper on RBQM

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique reference number assigned to the risk assessment record in MasterControl (e.g., RA-2024-00123). Used for cross-system traceability, audit trails, and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: MasterControl Document Control; ICH Q9; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: The primary regulatory authority whose standards and guidelines govern this risk assessment (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, TGA, Health Canada). Determines applicable GCP framework and reporting obligations.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Guideline; ICH E6(R2); MHRA GCP Guidance

attributes.name: remediation_plan
attributes.description: Documented plan for addressing identified gaps and reducing residual risk, including specific actions, responsible parties, and target timelines. Distinct from CAPA (which is a formal corrective/preventive action record); this is the risk-level
attributes.references: ICH Q9; FDA RBQM Guidance; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: remediation_status
attributes.description: Current status of remediation activities for identified gaps: not_started, in_progress, completed, or overdue. Supports inspection readiness dashboards and QA oversight reporting.
attributes.references: ICH Q9; FDA RBQM Guidance; MasterControl Workflow

attributes.name: remediation_target_date
attributes.description: Target completion date for the remediation actions identified in the risk assessment. Used for tracking remediation progress and escalation when overdue.
attributes.references: ICH Q9; FDA RBQM Guidance; MasterControl CAPA Tracking

attributes.name: residual_detectability_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (typically 1–5) representing the ability to detect the risk after control measures are in place. Component of the residual risk score calculation.
attributes.references: ICH Q9 FMEA Methodology; FDA RBQM Guidance

attributes.name: residual_impact_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (typically 1–5) representing the severity of impact after control measures have been applied. Used to calculate the residual risk score.
attributes.references: ICH Q9; FDA RBQM Guidance

attributes.name: residual_likelihood_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (typically 1–5) representing the probability of the risk occurring after control measures have been applied. Used to calculate the residual risk score.
attributes.references: ICH Q9; FDA RBQM Guidance

attributes.name: residual_risk_rating
attributes.description: Qualitative risk rating after control measures are applied: critical, high, medium, or low. Drives risk acceptance decisions, escalation to DSMB/DMC, and CAPA initiation. A residual rating of critical or high typically triggers mandatory CAPA.
attributes.references: ICH Q9; FDA RBQM Guidance; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: residual_risk_score
attributes.description: Composite numeric risk score calculated after control measures are applied. Represents the remaining risk exposure. Compared against risk acceptance thresholds to determine if further mitigation is required.
attributes.references: ICH Q9; FDA RBQM Guidance; EMA Reflection Paper on RBQM

attributes.name: review_frequency_days
attributes.description: Defined interval in calendar days between periodic re-assessments of this risk (e.g., 30, 60, 90, 180 days). Drives scheduling of next_review_date and ensures ongoing risk monitoring per ICH Q9 principles.
attributes.references: ICH Q9; FDA RBQM Guidance

attributes.name: risk_acceptance_decision
attributes.description: Formal decision on whether the residual risk level is acceptable: accepted (risk within tolerance), not_accepted (requires further mitigation or CAPA), or conditionally_accepted (accepted with defined monitoring conditions).
attributes.references: ICH Q9; FDA RBQM Guidance; EMA GCP Guideline

attributes.name: risk_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the risk domain being assessed: data_integrity (ALCOA+ violations, EDC issues), patient_safety (adverse event under-reporting, protocol deviations), regulatory_compliance (GCP, ICH, FDA/EMA non-compliance), or operational
attributes.references: ICH Q9; ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Guideline

attributes.name: risk_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the identified risk, including the potential failure mode, root cause hypothesis, and potential impact on study quality, patient safety, or regulatory compliance. Sourced from MasterControl risk assessment form.
attributes.references: ICH Q9; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA RBQM Guidance

attributes.name: risk_owner_department
attributes.description: Organizational department of the risk owner (e.g., Quality Assurance, Data Management, Clinical Operations, Regulatory Affairs). Used for departmental risk reporting and workload analysis.
attributes.references: ICH Q9; MasterControl Workflow

attributes.name: risk_subcategory
attributes.description: More granular classification within the risk category (e.g., 'Source Data Verification', 'Informed Consent Process', 'SAE Reporting Timeliness', 'Protocol Deviation Management'). Enables detailed risk trending and root cause analysis.
attributes.references: ICH Q9; CDISC RBQM Framework; FDA RBQM Guidance

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Defines the level at which the risk assessment was conducted: study-level (entire protocol), site-level (specific investigational site), process-level (e.g., data management, consent), system-level (e.g., EDC, CTMS), or inspection-readiness
attributes.references: ICH Q9; FDA RBQM Guidance; EMA Reflection Paper on Risk-Based Quality Management

attributes.name: sponsor_notified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the study sponsor has been formally notified of this risk assessment and its findings, as required by the Clinical Trial Agreement and GCP obligations. Relevant for high/critical risk ratings.

attributes.name: subject_safety_impact_flag

attributes.description: Descriptive title summarizing the subject and scope of the risk assessment (e.g., 'Site-Level GCP Compliance Risk Assessment – Site 1042 Q3 2024'). Used for identification and reporting.

attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); GDPR Article 5

attributes.description: The date on which the sponsor or PI confirmed that all IRB/IEC-stipulated conditions for a conditional approval were satisfied, enabling the study to proceed.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3.1.2; 21 CFR Part 56.109

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this ethics approval record was first created in the system, conforming to ALCOA+ (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate) data integrity principles.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.5.3; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: ctms_record_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS) Record ID
attributes.description: Record identifier in the source system where this ethics approval is tracked for site activation and monitoring workflows.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Oracle Siebel CTMS

tag_set.value: Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS) Record ID

attributes.name: decision_date
attributes.description: The date on which the IRB/IEC formally issued its approval decision. This is the principal real-world event date for this transaction.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3.1.2; 21 CFR Part 56.115(a)(2); EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: disapproval_reason
attributes.description: Free-text reason provided by the IRB/IEC when the submission was disapproved or deferred. Null for approved submissions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3.1.2; 21 CFR Part 56.109(c); EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which the ethics approval is binding and the study or amendment may commence at the site. May differ from decision_date if conditions must be met first.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.4.1; 21 CFR Part 56; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 8

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the ethics approval expires and must be renewed for the study to continue. Null for approvals with no defined expiry. Drives renewal workflow triggers.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3.1.4; 21 CFR Part 56.109(e); EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: gdpr_applicable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether GDPR data protection requirements apply to this ethics approval, relevant for studies conducted in EU/EEA jurisdictions.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 9; EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2)

tag_set.value: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Applicable Flag

attributes.name: hipaa_applicable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether HIPAA privacy rule requirements apply to this ethics approval, relevant for studies conducted in the United States.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR Part 164; 21 CFR Part 56; OHRP

tag_set.value: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Applicable Flag

attributes.name: icf_approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the specific ICF version was approved by the IRB/IEC. May differ from the overall protocol decision_date when ICF and protocol are reviewed separately.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.2; 21 CFR Part 50.25; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 29

attributes.name: icf_version_approved
attributes.description: Version identifier of the Informed Consent Form (ICF) that was reviewed and approved as part of this ethics submission. Null if the submission did not include an ICF.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 29

attributes.name: irb_iec_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the IRB or IEC that issued this approval. Retained as a denormalized reference for reporting and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3; 21 CFR Part 56.103; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 4

tag_set.value: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Name

attributes.name: irb_iec_registration_number
attributes.description: Official registration or accreditation number of the IRB/IEC as assigned by the relevant regulatory authority (e.g., FDA OHRP registration number, EMA ethics committee identifier).
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 56.106; OHRP; EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: pi_name
attributes.description: Full name of the Principal Investigator (PI) named on the ethics approval. Retained as a denormalized field for regulatory correspondence and inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.1; 21 CFR Part 312.53; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: protocol_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the study protocol document that was reviewed and approved. Enables tracking of which protocol version holds active ethics approval.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6.1; CDISC SDTM IG

attributes.name: quorum_met_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required quorum of IRB/IEC members was present at the review meeting, as required for a valid approval decision.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 56.108(c); ICH E6(R2) Section 3.2

attributes.name: regulatory_authority_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory authority was notified of the IRB/IEC approval decision. Null if regulatory_authority_notified_flag is False.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.66; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 8

attributes.name: regulatory_authority_notified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the relevant regulatory authority (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA) was notified of the IRB/IEC approval decision as required by applicable regulations.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.66; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 8; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: renewal_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which a renewal submission must be received by the IRB/IEC to maintain continuous approval. Typically calculated from expiry_date minus the committee's required lead time.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3.1.4; 21 CFR Part 56.109(e)

attributes.name: review_meeting_date
attributes.description: The date of the IRB/IEC board meeting at which this submission was formally reviewed and voted upon.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3.1; 21 CFR Part 56.108

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: The date on which the sponsor or Principal Investigator (PI) submitted the protocol, amendment, or ICF to the IRB/IEC for review.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.4; 21 CFR Part 56.108; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: submission_type
attributes.description: Classifies the type of submission reviewed by the IRB/IEC: initial protocol review, protocol amendment, annual renewal, safety report, Informed Consent Form (ICF) revision, or other.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3.1; 21 CFR Part 56.109; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this ethics approval record. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements per ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.5.3; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: veeva_vault_document_number
attributes.description: Unique document identifier in Veeva Vault eTMF where the original signed ethics approval letter is archived. Supports 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 8.2.3; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: vote_abstain_count
attributes.description: Number of IRB/IEC board members who abstained from voting at the review meeting.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 56.108(c); ICH E6(R2) Section 3.2

attributes.name: vote_against_count
attributes.description: Number of IRB/IEC board members who voted against approval at the review meeting.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 56.108(c); ICH E6(R2) Section 3.2

attributes.name: vote_in_favor_count
attributes.description: Number of IRB/IEC board members who voted in favor of approval at the review meeting. Supports audit trail and quorum verification.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 56.108(c); ICH E6(R2) Section 3.2

attributes.name: vulnerable_population_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the approved study involves vulnerable populations (e.g., minors, pregnant women, prisoners, cognitively impaired individuals) requiring additional IRB/IEC safeguards.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.12; 21 CFR Part 56.111(b); EU CTR 536/2014 Article 32

attributes.name: waiver_of_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the IRB/IEC granted a waiver or alteration of the informed consent requirement as part of this approval.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 50.24; 45 CFR Part 46.116(c); ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.15

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_mvm`.`_metrics`.`biostatistics_analysis_population`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Strategic view of analysis populations, supporting enrollment monitoring and primary cohort definition."
  source: "`clinical_trials_mvm`.`biostatistics`.`analysis_population`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "analysis_month"
      display_name: "Analysis Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', created_timestamp)
      comment: "Month when the analysis population record was created"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "total_populations"
      display_name: "Total Analysis Populations"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Count of analysis population definitions"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "sum_subjects_at_dbl"
      display_name: "Sum Subjects at DBL"
      expr: SUM(CAST(subject_count_at_dbl AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total subjects counted at database lock across populations"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "avg_subjects_interim"
      display_name: "Average Subjects at Interim"
      expr: AVG(CAST(subject_count_interim AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Mean number of subjects available at interim analyses"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "count_primary_flag"
      display_name: "Primary Population Flag Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN primary_population_flag THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of populations marked as primary"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "pct_primary_populations"
      display_name: "Pct Primary Populations"
      expr: (AGG(`count_primary_flag`) / NULLIF(AGG(`total_populations`), 0))
      comment: "Proportion of analysis populations designated as primary"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Strategic view of analysis populations, supporting enrollment monitoring and primary cohort definition.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_mvm`.`_metrics`.`biostatistics_database_lock_event`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Database lock event metrics tracking lock cycle time, query resolution efficiency, and data quality readiness for regulatory submissions."
  source: "`clinical_trials_mvm`.`biostatistics`.`database_lock_event`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "Lock Type"
      display_name: "Lock Type"
      expr: lock_type
      comment: "Type of database lock (interim, final, safety update)"
    - name: "Lock Status"
      display_name: "Lock Status"
      expr: lock_status
      comment: "Current status of the lock event"
    - name: "Lock Scope"
      display_name: "Lock Scope"
      expr: lock_scope
      comment: "Scope of the lock (full study, site subset, interim cohort)"
    - name: "Analysis Type"
      display_name: "Analysis Type"
      expr: analysis_type
      comment: "Type of analysis the lock supports (efficacy, safety, interim)"
    - name: "Lock Year"
      display_name: "Lock Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', actual_lock_date)
      comment: "Year the database was locked"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Lock Quarter"
      display_name: "Lock Quarter"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('quarter', actual_lock_date)
      comment: "Quarter the database was locked"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Lock Month"
      display_name: "Lock Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', actual_lock_date)
      comment: "Month the database was locked"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Total Lock Events"
      display_name: "Total Lock Events"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT database_lock_event_id)
      comment: "Total number of database lock events"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Subjects Locked"
      display_name: "Total Subjects Locked"
      expr: SUM(CAST(subjects_locked_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total number of subjects locked across all events"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Avg Subjects Per Lock"
      display_name: "Avg Subjects Per Lock"
      expr: AVG(CAST(subjects_locked_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average number of subjects locked per event"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "Total Outstanding Queries"
      display_name: "Total Outstanding Queries"
      expr: SUM(CAST(outstanding_query_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total outstanding queries at lock time across all events"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Avg Outstanding Queries Per Lock"
      display_name: "Avg Outstanding Queries"
      expr: AVG(CAST(outstanding_query_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average outstanding queries per lock event (data quality indicator)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "Lock Cycle Time Days"
      display_name: "Lock Cycle Time (Days)"
      expr: AVG(DATEDIFF(actual_lock_date, planned_lock_date))
      comment: "Average days between planned and actual lock date (schedule adherence)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "On-Time Lock Rate Pct"
      display_name: "On-Time Lock Rate %"
      expr: 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN actual_lock_date <= planned_lock_date THEN database_lock_event_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT database_lock_event_id), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of locks completed on or before planned date"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Coding Complete Rate Pct"
      display_name: "Coding Complete Rate %"
      expr: 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN coding_complete = TRUE THEN database_lock_event_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT database_lock_event_id), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of locks with medical coding complete"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "SDV Complete Rate Pct"
      display_name: "SDV Complete Rate %"
      expr: 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sdv_complete = TRUE THEN database_lock_event_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT database_lock_event_id), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of locks with source data verification complete"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Database lock event metrics tracking lock cycle time, query resolution efficiency, and data quality readiness for regulatory submissions.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_mvm`.`_metrics`.`biostatistics_interim_analysis`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Key performance indicators for interim analyses, supporting monitoring of statistical thresholds and stopping decisions."
  source: "`clinical_trials_mvm`.`biostatistics`.`interim_analysis`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "analysis_month"
      display_name: "Analysis Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', actual_analysis_date)
      comment: "Month of the interim analysis date (UTC)"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "total_interim_analyses"
      display_name: "Total Interim Analyses"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Count of interim analyses performed"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "avg_alpha_allocated"
      display_name: "Average Alpha Allocated"
      expr: AVG(CAST(alpha_allocated AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Mean alpha allocated across interim analyses"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "total_stopping_triggered"
      display_name: "Stopping Rule Triggered Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN stopping_rule_triggered THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of interim analyses where a stopping rule was triggered"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "pct_stopping_triggered"
      display_name: "Pct Stopping Rule Triggered"
      expr: (AGG(`total_stopping_triggered`) / NULLIF(AGG(`total_interim_analyses`), 0))
      comment: "Proportion of interim analyses that triggered a stopping rule"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Key performance indicators for interim analyses, supporting monitoring of statistical thresholds and stopping decisions.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_mvm`.`_metrics`.`biostatistics_sample_size_calc`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Metrics that evaluate the design assumptions and scale of planned clinical studies."
  source: "`clinical_trials_mvm`.`biostatistics`.`sample_size_calc`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "study_id"
      display_name: "Study Id"
      expr: study_id
      comment: "Identifier of the study linked to the calculation"
  measures:
    - name: "total_calculations"
      display_name: "Total Sample Size Calculations"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Count of sample size calculation records"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "sum_planned_sample_size"
      display_name: "Sum Planned Sample Size"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_sample_size AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Aggregate planned sample size across calculations"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "avg_power"
      display_name: "Average Power"
      expr: AVG(CAST(power AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Mean statistical power used in calculations"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "avg_effect_size"
      display_name: "Average Effect Size"
      expr: AVG(CAST(effect_size AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Mean effect size assumed in calculations"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "count_non_inferiority"
      display_name: "Non-Inferiority Calculations Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN non_inferiority_margin IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of calculations that include a non‑inferiority margin"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "pct_non_inferiority"
      display_name: "Pct Non-Inferiority Calculations"
      expr: (AGG(`count_non_inferiority`) / NULLIF(AGG(`total_calculations`), 0))
      comment: "Proportion of calculations that are for non‑inferiority trials"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Metrics that evaluate the design assumptions and scale of planned clinical studies.
