CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_mvm`.`_metrics`.`biostatistics_sap`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Statistical Analysis Plan metrics tracking SAP version control, amendment frequency, regulatory alignment, and approval cycle time."
  source: "`clinical_trials_mvm`.`biostatistics`.`sap`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "Version Status"
      display_name: "Version Status"
      expr: version_status
      comment: "Status of the SAP version (draft, final, superseded)"
    - name: "Analysis Type"
      display_name: "Analysis Type"
      expr: analysis_type
      comment: "Type of analysis the SAP covers (primary, interim, final)"
    - name: "Blinding Status"
      display_name: "Blinding Status"
      expr: blinding_status
      comment: "Blinding status of the SAP (blinded, unblinded)"
    - name: "DSMB Review Required"
      display_name: "DSMB Review Required"
      expr: CASE WHEN dsmb_review_required = TRUE THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END
      comment: "Whether DSMB review is required for this SAP"
    - name: "Approval Year"
      display_name: "Approval Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', approval_date)
      comment: "Year the SAP was approved"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Approval Quarter"
      display_name: "Approval Quarter"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('quarter', approval_date)
      comment: "Quarter the SAP was approved"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Total SAPs"
      display_name: "Total SAPs"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT sap_id)
      comment: "Total number of Statistical Analysis Plans"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Avg Amendment Count"
      display_name: "Avg Amendment Count"
      expr: AVG(CAST(amendment_number AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average number of amendments per SAP (change control indicator)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "Avg Interim Analysis Count"
      display_name: "Avg Interim Analysis Count"
      expr: AVG(CAST(interim_analysis_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average number of planned interim analyses per SAP"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "Avg Sample Size"
      display_name: "Avg Sample Size"
      expr: AVG(CAST(sample_size AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average planned sample size across SAPs"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "Avg Power Percent"
      display_name: "Avg Power %"
      expr: AVG(CAST(power_percent AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average statistical power percentage across SAPs"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Significance Level"
      display_name: "Avg Significance Level"
      expr: AVG(CAST(significance_level AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average significance level (alpha) across SAPs"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 4
    - name: "Current Version Rate Pct"
      display_name: "Current Version Rate %"
      expr: 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_current_version = TRUE THEN sap_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT sap_id), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of SAPs that are current versions"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "DSMB Review Required Rate Pct"
      display_name: "DSMB Review Required Rate %"
      expr: 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN dsmb_review_required = TRUE THEN sap_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT sap_id), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of SAPs requiring DSMB review"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Statistical Analysis Plan metrics tracking SAP version control, amendment frequency, regulatory alignment, and approval cycle time.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_mvm`.`_metrics`.`biostatistics_tlf_output`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "TLF output production metrics tracking programming productivity, QC cycle time, approval rates, and discrepancy resolution efficiency."
  source: "`clinical_trials_mvm`.`biostatistics`.`tlf_output`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "Output Type"
      display_name: "Output Type"
      expr: output_type
      comment: "Type of output (table, listing, figure)"
    - name: "Output Category"
      display_name: "Output Category"
      expr: output_category
      comment: "Category of output (efficacy, safety, demographics, disposition)"
    - name: "Analysis Type"
      display_name: "Analysis Type"
      expr: analysis_type
      comment: "Type of analysis the output supports"
    - name: "QC Status"
      display_name: "QC Status"
      expr: qc_status
      comment: "Quality control status of the output"
    - name: "Approval Status"
      display_name: "Approval Status"
      expr: approval_status
      comment: "Approval status of the output"
    - name: "Blinding Status"
      display_name: "Blinding Status"
      expr: blinding_status
      comment: "Blinding status of the output (blinded, unblinded)"
    - name: "Production Year"
      display_name: "Production Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', production_run_timestamp)
      comment: "Year the output was produced"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Production Quarter"
      display_name: "Production Quarter"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('quarter', production_run_timestamp)
      comment: "Quarter the output was produced"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Production Month"
      display_name: "Production Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', production_run_timestamp)
      comment: "Month the output was produced"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Total TLF Outputs"
      display_name: "Total TLF Outputs"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT tlf_output_id)
      comment: "Total number of TLF outputs produced"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Outputs CM"
      display_name: "Outputs (Current Month)"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT tlf_output_id)
      comment: "TLF outputs produced in current month"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
      window:
        - order: Production Month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
    - name: "Outputs PM"
      display_name: "Outputs (Prior Month)"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT tlf_output_id)
      comment: "TLF outputs produced in prior month"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
      window:
        - order: Production Month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
          offset: -1 month
    - name: "Output Growth MoM Pct"
      display_name: "Output Growth MoM %"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Month-over-month growth rate in TLF output production"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Discrepancies"
      display_name: "Total Discrepancies"
      expr: SUM(CAST(discrepancy_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total number of discrepancies identified across all outputs"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Avg Discrepancies Per Output"
      display_name: "Avg Discrepancies Per Output"
      expr: AVG(CAST(discrepancy_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average number of discrepancies per output (quality indicator)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "QC Cycle Time Hours"
      display_name: "QC Cycle Time (Hours)"
      expr: AVG((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(qc_completion_timestamp) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(production_run_timestamp)) / 3600.0)
      comment: "Average hours from production to QC completion"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "Approval Cycle Time Hours"
      display_name: "Approval Cycle Time (Hours)"
      expr: AVG((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(approval_timestamp) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(qc_completion_timestamp)) / 3600.0)
      comment: "Average hours from QC completion to approval"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "First Pass QC Rate Pct"
      display_name: "First Pass QC Rate %"
      expr: 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN discrepancy_count = 0 THEN tlf_output_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT tlf_output_id), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of outputs with zero discrepancies (first-pass quality)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Final Version Rate Pct"
      display_name: "Final Version Rate %"
      expr: 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_final_version = TRUE THEN tlf_output_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT tlf_output_id), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of outputs marked as final version"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: TLF output production metrics tracking programming productivity, QC cycle time, approval rates, and discrepancy resolution efficiency.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_mvm`.`_metrics`.`compliance_ethics_submission`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Ethics committee submission and approval metrics tracking submission cycle time, approval rates, and regulatory compliance across IRB/IEC submissions."
  source: "`clinical_trials_mvm`.`compliance`.`ethics_submission`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "Submission Type"
      display_name: "Submission Type"

      comment: "Type of ethics submission (initial, amendment, continuing review, SAE report)"
    - name: "Submission Category"
      display_name: "Submission Category"
      expr: submission_category
      comment: "Category of the submission"
    - name: "Submission Status"
      display_name: "Submission Status"
      expr: submission_status
      comment: "Current status of the submission (submitted, under review, approved, rejected)"
    - name: "Decision Outcome"
      display_name: "Decision Outcome"
      expr: decision_outcome
      comment: "Final decision outcome (approved, approved with conditions, deferred, rejected)"
    - name: "Review Type"
      display_name: "Review Type"
      expr: review_type
      comment: "Type of review (full board, expedited, exempt)"
    - name: "Submission Country"
      display_name: "Submission Country"
      expr: submission_country
      comment: "Country where the submission was made"
    - name: "Regulatory Authority"
      display_name: "Regulatory Authority"
      expr: regulatory_authority
      comment: "Regulatory authority overseeing the submission"
    - name: "Submission Year"
      display_name: "Submission Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', submission_date)
      comment: "Year the submission was made"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Submission Quarter"
      display_name: "Submission Quarter"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('quarter', submission_date)
      comment: "Quarter the submission was made"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Submission Month"
      display_name: "Submission Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', submission_date)
      comment: "Month the submission was made"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Total Submissions"
      display_name: "Total Submissions"
      expr: COUNT(ethics_submission_id)
      comment: "Total number of ethics committee submissions"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Approval Rate"
      display_name: "Approval Rate"
      expr: 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN decision_outcome IN ('Approved', 'Approved with conditions') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN decision_outcome IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of submissions approved (with or without conditions)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "First-Pass Approval Rate"
      display_name: "First-Pass Approval Rate"
      expr: 100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN decision_outcome = 'Approved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN decision_outcome IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of submissions approved without conditions on first review"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Days to Decision"
      display_name: "Avg Days to Decision"
      expr: AVG(DATEDIFF(decision_date, submission_date))
      comment: "Average number of days from submission to decision"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "Avg Days to Response"
      display_name: "Avg Days to Response"
      expr: AVG(DATEDIFF(response_submitted_date, submission_date))
      comment: "Average number of days from submission to response submission"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "On-Time Response Rate"
      display_name: "On-Time Response Rate"
      expr: 100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN response_submitted_date <= response_due_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN response_submitted_date IS NOT NULL AND response_due_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of responses submitted on or before due date"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Waiver Granted Rate"
      display_name: "Waiver Granted Rate"
      expr: 100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN waiver_granted = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(ethics_submission_id), 0)
      comment: "Percentage of submissions granted a waiver"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Ethics committee submission and approval metrics tracking submission cycle time, approval rates, and regulatory compliance across IRB/IEC submissions.

        leading_zeros: true

        type: number

          type: all

        decimal_places:

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_mvm`.`_metrics`.`laboratory_result_turnaround`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Turnaround and quality metrics for laboratory results"
  source: "`clinical_trials_mvm`.`laboratory`.`lab_result`"
  joins:
    - name: dim_laboratory_lab_facility
      source: "`clinical_trials_mvm`.`laboratory`.`lab_facility`"
      'on': source.lab_facility_id = dim_laboratory_lab_facility.lab_facility_id
      rely:
        at_most_one_match: true
    - name: dim_laboratory_lab_panel
      source: "`clinical_trials_mvm`.`laboratory`.`lab_panel`"
      'on': source.lab_panel_id = dim_laboratory_lab_panel.lab_panel_id
      rely:
        at_most_one_match: true
  dimensions:
    - name: "lab_facility_name"
      display_name: "Lab Facility Name"
      expr: dim_laboratory_lab_facility.facility_name
      comment: "Name of the lab facility performing the analysis"
    - name: "lab_panel_name"
      display_name: "Lab Panel Name"
      expr: dim_laboratory_lab_panel.panel_name
      comment: "Name of the lab panel associated with the result"
    - name: "result_status"
      display_name: "Result Status"
      expr: result_status
      comment: "Current status of the lab result"
    - name: "result_unit"
      display_name: "Result Unit"
      expr: result_unit
      comment: "Measurement unit of the result"
    - name: "collection_date"
      display_name: "Collection Date"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('day', collection_datetime)
      comment: "Date the specimen was collected"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "result_reported_date"
      display_name: "Result Reported Date"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('day', result_reported_datetime)
      comment: "Date the result was reported"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "total_results"
      display_name: "Total Results"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of lab results"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "avg_turnaround_hours"
      display_name: "Average Turnaround Hours"
      expr: AVG((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(result_reported_datetime) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(collection_datetime)) / 3600.0)
      comment: "Average time from specimen collection to result reporting (hours)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "critical_value_count"
      display_name: "Critical Value Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN critical_value_flag THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of results flagged as critical"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "critical_value_rate"
      display_name: "Critical Value Rate"
      expr: (AGG(`critical_value_count`) / NULLIF(AGG(`total_results`),0))
      comment: "Proportion of results that are critical"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "out_of_range_count"
      display_name: "Out‑of‑Range Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN out_of_range_flag THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of results outside the normal range"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "out_of_range_rate"
      display_name: "Out‑of‑Range Rate"
      expr: (AGG(`out_of_range_count`) / NULLIF(AGG(`total_results`),0))
      comment: "Proportion of results out of range"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Turnaround and quality metrics for laboratory results

      expr: analysis_population
      comment: "Analysis population designation for this arm (ITT, PP, safety)"
  measures:
    - name: "Total Treatment Arms"
      display_name: "Total Treatment Arms"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of treatment arms defined across all studies"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Active Treatment Arms"
      display_name: "Active Treatment Arms"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN arm_status = 'active' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of treatment arms currently active for enrollment"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Suspended Treatment Arms"
      display_name: "Suspended Treatment Arms"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN arm_status = 'suspended' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of treatment arms temporarily suspended from enrollment"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Planned Enrollment"
      display_name: "Total Planned Enrollment"
      expr: SUM(CAST(planned_subject_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of planned subject counts across all treatment arms"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Min Enrollment"
      display_name: "Total Min Enrollment"
      expr: SUM(CAST(min_subject_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of minimum required subject counts across all treatment arms"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Max Enrollment"
      display_name: "Total Max Enrollment"
      expr: SUM(CAST(max_subject_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of maximum allowed subject counts across all treatment arms"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Avg Planned Enrollment Per Arm"
      display_name: "Avg Planned Enrollment Per Arm"
      expr: AVG(CAST(planned_subject_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average planned enrollment per treatment arm, indicating study size and complexity"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "Avg Target Allocation Pct"
      display_name: "Avg Target Allocation (%)"
      expr: AVG(CAST(target_allocation_pct AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average target allocation percentage across treatment arms, should balance to 100% within study"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Allocation Ratio Numerator"
      display_name: "Avg Allocation Ratio Numerator"
      expr: AVG(CAST(allocation_ratio_numerator AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average allocation ratio numerator across treatment arms"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Allocation Ratio Denominator"
      display_name: "Avg Allocation Ratio Denominator"
      expr: AVG(CAST(allocation_ratio_denominator AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average allocation ratio denominator across treatment arms"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Control Arms Count"
      display_name: "Control Arms Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_control_arm = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of control arms across all studies"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Experimental Arms Count"
      display_name: "Experimental Arms Count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_control_arm = FALSE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of experimental (non-control) arms across all studies"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Avg Washout Period Days"
      display_name: "Avg Washout Period (Days)"
      expr: AVG(CAST(washout_period_days AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average washout period in days across treatment arms with crossover designs"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
$$
metric_views.description: Treatment arm allocation and balance KPIs tracking planned vs actual enrollment, allocation ratios, and arm-level performance across studies.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_mvm`.`_metrics`.`regulatory_submission`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Core regulatory submission metrics tracking submission volume, cycle times, approval rates, and agency performance across therapeutic areas and submission types"
  source: "`clinical_trials_mvm`.`regulatory`.`submission`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "Submission Type"
      display_name: "Submission Type"
      expr: submission_type
      comment: "Type of regulatory submission (IND, NDA, BLA, MAA, amendment, etc.)"
    - name: "Submission Status"
      display_name: "Submission Status"
      expr: submission_status
      comment: "Current status of the submission (submitted, under review, approved, rejected, withdrawn)"
    - name: "Therapeutic Area"
      display_name: "Therapeutic Area"
      expr: therapeutic_area
      comment: "Therapeutic area or disease category for the submission"
    - name: "Agency Country"
      display_name: "Agency Country"
      expr: agency_country_code
      comment: "Country code of the regulatory agency receiving the submission"
    - name: "Submission Category"
      display_name: "Submission Category"
      expr: submission_category
      comment: "Category classification of the submission"
    - name: "Is Expedited"
      display_name: "Expedited Review"
      expr: is_expedited
      comment: "Flag indicating whether the submission received expedited review status"
    - name: "Submission Year"
      display_name: "Submission Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', submission_date)
      comment: "Year of submission date for annual trending"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Submission Quarter"
      display_name: "Submission Quarter"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('quarter', submission_date)
      comment: "Quarter of submission date for quarterly trending"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Submission Month"
      display_name: "Submission Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', submission_date)
      comment: "Month of submission date for monthly trending"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Agency Action Year"
      display_name: "Agency Action Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', agency_action_date)
      comment: "Year of agency action date for decision trending"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Total Submissions"
      display_name: "Total Submissions"
      expr: COUNT(submission_id)
      comment: "Total count of regulatory submissions"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Approved Submissions"
      display_name: "Approved Submissions"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN agency_decision = 'Approved' THEN submission_id END)
      comment: "Count of submissions that received agency approval"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Approval Rate"
      display_name: "Approval Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN agency_decision = 'Approved' THEN submission_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN agency_decision IS NOT NULL THEN submission_id END), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of submissions that received approval out of all decided submissions"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Review Cycle Days"
      display_name: "Avg Review Cycle (Days)"
      expr: AVG(DATEDIFF(agency_action_date, submission_date))
      comment: "Average number of days from submission to agency action decision"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "Expedited Submissions"
      display_name: "Expedited Submissions"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_expedited = TRUE THEN submission_id END)
      comment: "Count of submissions granted expedited review status"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Expedited Rate"
      display_name: "Expedited Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN is_expedited = TRUE THEN submission_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(submission_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of submissions receiving expedited review designation"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Resubmissions"
      display_name: "Resubmissions"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_resubmission = TRUE THEN submission_id END)
      comment: "Count of submissions that are resubmissions of prior applications"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Resubmission Rate"
      display_name: "Resubmission Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN is_resubmission = TRUE THEN submission_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(submission_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of submissions that are resubmissions indicating prior rejection or withdrawal"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Core regulatory submission metrics tracking submission volume, cycle times, approval rates, and agency performance across therapeutic areas and submission types

AS $$

  comment: "Data Safety Monitoring Board review KPIs tracking meeting frequency, recommendations, stopping rules, and study continuation decisions"
  source: "`clinical_trials_mvm`.`safety`.`dsmb_review`"
  dimensions:

      display_name: "Study ID"
      expr: study_id
      comment: "Unique identifier for the clinical study"
    - name: "Clinical Program ID"
      display_name: "Program ID"
      expr: clinical_program_id
      comment: "Unique identifier for the clinical development program"
    - name: "Review Status"

      expr: review_status
      comment: "Current status of the DSMB review"
    - name: "Meeting Type"
      display_name: "Meeting Type"
      expr: meeting_type
      comment: "Type of DSMB meeting (interim, ad-hoc, final, etc.)"
    - name: "Recommendation"
      display_name: "Recommendation"
      expr: recommendation
      comment: "DSMB recommendation outcome (continue, modify, stop, etc.)"
    - name: "Stopping Rule Triggered"
      display_name: "Stopping Rule"
      expr: stopping_rule_triggered
      comment: "Flag indicating whether a pre-defined stopping rule was triggered"
    - name: "Protocol Amendment Required"
      display_name: "Amendment Required"
      expr: protocol_amendment_required
      comment: "Flag indicating whether DSMB recommended a protocol amendment"
    - name: "Safety Signal Identified"
      display_name: "Signal Identified"
      expr: safety_signal_identified
      comment: "Flag indicating whether DSMB identified a new safety signal"
    - name: "Meeting Year"
      display_name: "Meeting Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', meeting_date)

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_mvm`.`_metrics`.`safety_icsr`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Individual Case Safety Report KPIs tracking regulatory submission timeliness, acknowledgement rates, and SUSAR reporting compliance"
  source: "`clinical_trials_mvm`.`safety`.`icsr`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "Study ID"
      display_name: "Study"
      expr: study_id
      comment: "Study identifier for study-specific ICSR tracking"
    - name: "Health Authority ID"
      display_name: "Health Authority"
      expr: health_authority_id
      comment: "Health authority identifier for authority-specific submission tracking"
    - name: "Submission Status"
      display_name: "Submission Status"
      expr: submission_status
      comment: "Current status of the ICSR submission (draft, submitted, acknowledged, rejected)"
    - name: "Report Type"
      display_name: "Report Type"
      expr: report_type
      comment: "Type of ICSR report (initial, follow-up, final)"
    - name: "Submission Method"
      display_name: "Submission Method"
      expr: submission_method
      comment: "Method used for ICSR submission (E2B, gateway, portal)"
    - name: "Is SUSAR"
      display_name: "SUSAR Flag"
      expr: is_susar
      comment: "Boolean flag indicating whether the ICSR is for a SUSAR"
    - name: "Is Fatal"
      display_name: "Fatal Flag"
      expr: is_fatal
      comment: "Boolean flag indicating whether the case resulted in death"
    - name: "Is Life Threatening"
      display_name: "Life-Threatening Flag"
      expr: is_life_threatening
      comment: "Boolean flag indicating whether the case was life-threatening"
    - name: "Is On Time"
      display_name: "On-Time Flag"
      expr: is_on_time
      comment: "Boolean flag indicating whether submission met regulatory deadline"
    - name: "DSMB Notified"
      display_name: "DSMB Notified"
      expr: dsmb_notified
      comment: "Boolean flag indicating whether DSMB was notified of the case"
    - name: "IRB IEC Notified"
      display_name: "IRB/IEC Notified"
      expr: irb_iec_notified
      comment: "Boolean flag indicating whether IRB/IEC was notified of the case"
    - name: "Is Current Version"
      display_name: "Current Version"
      expr: is_current_version
      comment: "Boolean flag indicating whether this is the current version of the ICSR"
    - name: "MedDRA SOC"
      display_name: "SOC Code"
      expr: meddra_soc_code
      comment: "MedDRA System Organ Class code for therapeutic area grouping"
    - name: "MedDRA PT"
      display_name: "PT Code"
      expr: meddra_pt_code
      comment: "MedDRA Preferred Term code for standardized case classification"
    - name: "Submission Month"
      display_name: "Submission Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', submission_date)
      comment: "Month bucket of submission date for temporal trend analysis"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Awareness Month"
      display_name: "Awareness Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', awareness_date)
      comment: "Month bucket of awareness date for reporting timeline tracking"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Total ICSR Count"
      display_name: "Total ICSRs"
      expr: COUNT(icsr_id)
      comment: "Total number of Individual Case Safety Reports submitted"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 0
    - name: "SUSAR ICSR Count"
      display_name: "SUSAR ICSRs"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_susar = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of ICSRs for SUSARs requiring expedited reporting"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 0
    - name: "Fatal ICSR Count"
      display_name: "Fatal ICSRs"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_fatal = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of ICSRs for fatal cases, highest severity outcome"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 0
    - name: "Life Threatening ICSR Count"
      display_name: "Life-Threatening ICSRs"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_life_threatening = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of ICSRs for life-threatening cases requiring immediate attention"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 0
    - name: "On Time Submission Count"
      display_name: "On-Time Submissions"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_on_time = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of ICSRs submitted within regulatory deadline"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 0
    - name: "Acknowledged ICSR Count"
      display_name: "Acknowledged ICSRs"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN acknowledgement_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of ICSRs acknowledged by health authority"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 0
    - name: "Rejected ICSR Count"
      display_name: "Rejected ICSRs"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN submission_status = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of ICSRs rejected by health authority, quality indicator"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 0
    - name: "On Time Submission Rate"
      display_name: "On-Time %"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_on_time = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(icsr_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of ICSRs submitted on time, key regulatory compliance metric"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Acknowledgement Rate"
      display_name: "Acknowledgement %"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN acknowledgement_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(icsr_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of ICSRs acknowledged by health authority, measures submission quality"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Rejection Rate"
      display_name: "Rejection %"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN submission_status = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(icsr_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of ICSRs rejected, inverse quality indicator"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "SUSAR Rate"
      display_name: "SUSAR %"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_susar = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(icsr_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of ICSRs for SUSARs, key safety signal indicator"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Fatal Case Rate"
      display_name: "Fatality %"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_fatal = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(icsr_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of ICSRs for fatal cases, highest severity metric"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Days to Submission"
      display_name: "Avg Days to Submission"
      expr: AVG(CAST(CAST(DATEDIFF(submission_date, awareness_date) AS DOUBLE) AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average days from awareness to submission, measures reporting efficiency"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "Avg Days to Acknowledgement"
      display_name: "Avg Days to Acknowledgement"
      expr: AVG(CAST(DATEDIFF(acknowledgement_date, submission_date) AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average days from submission to health authority acknowledgement"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "Distinct Subjects in ICSRs"
      display_name: "Subjects with ICSRs"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT trial_subject_id)
      comment: "Number of unique subjects with ICSRs submitted"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 0
$$
metric_views.description: Individual Case Safety Report KPIs tracking regulatory submission timeliness, acknowledgement rates, and SUSAR reporting compliance

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_mvm`.`_metrics`.`safety_susar`

AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "SUSAR-specific KPIs tracking expedited reporting compliance, causality assessment, and regulatory submission performance"
  source: "`clinical_trials_mvm`.`safety`.`susar`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "Study ID"

      expr: study_id

    - name: "CTCAE Grade"

        type: date

        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true

      comment: "Month of sponsor awareness of the SUSAR"

        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:

      display_name: "Total SUSARs"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total count of Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reactions"

        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all

      display_name: "Subjects with SUSARs"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT trial_subject_id)
      comment: "Count of unique subjects experiencing at least one SUSAR"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Fatal SUSARs"
      display_name: "Fatal SUSARs"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN fatal_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of SUSARs with fatal outcome"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Fatality Rate"
      display_name: "Fatality Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN fatal_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)

        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2

        type: number

          type: all
    - name: "DSMB Notified"

        decimal_places:

    - name: "IRB Notified"

      format:

        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "7-Day Deadline Breaches"

    - name: "15-Day Deadline Breaches"

        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all

      expr: AVG(CAST(DATEDIFF(awareness_date, onset_date) AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average number of days from SUSAR onset to sponsor awareness"

        decimal_places:
          type: all

  source: "`clinical_trials_mvm`.`study`.`study`"
  dimensions:

      display_name: "Study Phase"
      expr: development_phase
      comment: "Development phase of the study (Phase I, II, III, IV)"

      display_name: "Study Status"
      expr: study_status
      comment: "Current operational status of the study"
    - name: "Study Type"

      expr: study_type
      comment: "Type of clinical study (interventional, observational, etc.)"

    - name: "Actual Start Year"
      display_name: "Start Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', actual_start_date)
      comment: "Year the study actually started"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Actual Start Quarter"
      display_name: "Start Quarter"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('quarter', actual_start_date)

      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Actual Start Month"
      display_name: "Start Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', actual_start_date)
      comment: "Month the study actually started"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Study Count"
      display_name: "Study Count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of studies in the portfolio"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Target Enrollment"
      display_name: "Total Target Enrollment"
      expr: SUM(CAST(target_enrollment AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of target enrollment across all studies"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Actual Enrollment"

      expr: SUM(CAST(actual_enrollment AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of actual enrollment achieved across all studies"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Enrollment Achievement Rate"
      display_name: "Enrollment Achievement %"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(actual_enrollment AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(target_enrollment AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of target enrollment achieved across the portfolio"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Planned Sites"

      expr: SUM(CAST(planned_site_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of planned site count across all studies"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Planned Countries"
      display_name: "Total Planned Countries"
      expr: SUM(CAST(planned_country_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of planned country count across all studies"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Avg Sites Per Study"
      display_name: "Avg Sites Per Study"
      expr: AVG(CAST(planned_site_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average number of planned sites per study"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "Avg Target Enrollment Per Study"

      expr: AVG(CAST(target_enrollment AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average target enrollment per study"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "Studies With Actual Start"
      display_name: "Studies Started"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN actual_start_date IS NOT NULL THEN study_id END)

      format:

        decimal_places:
          type: all

    - name: "Safety Population Flag"

    - name: "PP Population Flag"

    - name: "Protocol Deviation Flag"

    - name: "Enrollment Year"

      format:
        type: date

    - name: "Enrollment Quarter"

    - name: "Enrollment Month"

    - name: "Screen Failure Reason"

    - name: "Completed Subjects"

    - name: "Withdrawn Subjects"

    - name: "Screen Failed Subjects"

        type: number
        decimal_places:

    - name: "ITT Population Count"
      display_name: "ITT Population"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN itt_flag = TRUE THEN trial_subject_id END)
      comment: "Number of subjects in Intent-to-Treat analysis population"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Safety Population Count"
      display_name: "Safety Population"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN safety_population_flag = TRUE THEN trial_subject_id END)
      comment: "Number of subjects in Safety analysis population"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "PP Population Count"
      display_name: "PP Population"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pp_flag = TRUE THEN trial_subject_id END)
      comment: "Number of subjects in Per-Protocol analysis population"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Subjects with SAE"
      display_name: "Subjects with SAE"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN serious_adverse_event_flag = TRUE THEN trial_subject_id END)
      comment: "Number of subjects who experienced at least one serious adverse event"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Subjects with Protocol Deviation"

      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Avg Age at Enrollment"
      display_name: "Avg Age at Enrollment"

      comment: "Average age of subjects at enrollment in years"

        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "Median Age at Enrollment"

      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
$$

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_mvm`.`_metrics`.`supply_destruction_record`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "IMP destruction and waste management KPIs for regulatory compliance and cost control"
  source: "`clinical_trials_mvm`.`supply`.`destruction_record`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "Destruction Status"
      display_name: "Destruction Status"
      expr: destruction_status
      comment: "Current status of the destruction record (pending, completed, certified)"
    - name: "Destruction Reason"
      display_name: "Destruction Reason"
      expr: destruction_reason
      comment: "Reason for destruction (expired, damaged, protocol deviation, study closure)"
    - name: "Destruction Method"
      display_name: "Destruction Method"
      expr: destruction_method
      comment: "Method used for destruction (incineration, chemical, landfill)"
    - name: "Blinded Destruction"
      display_name: "Blinded Destruction"
      expr: CASE WHEN is_blinded_destruction THEN 'Blinded' ELSE 'Unblinded' END
      comment: "Whether destruction was performed under blinded conditions"
    - name: "Cold Chain Maintained"
      display_name: "Cold Chain Maintained"
      expr: CASE WHEN cold_chain_maintained THEN 'Maintained' ELSE 'Broken' END
      comment: "Whether cold chain was maintained until destruction"
    - name: "Temperature Excursion Noted"
      display_name: "Temperature Excursion Noted"
      expr: CASE WHEN temperature_excursion_noted THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END
      comment: "Whether temperature excursion was noted prior to destruction"
    - name: "Regulatory Notification Required"
      display_name: "Regulatory Notification Required"
      expr: CASE WHEN regulatory_notification_required THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END
      comment: "Whether regulatory notification is required for this destruction"
    - name: "Reconciliation Status"
      display_name: "Reconciliation Status"
      expr: reconciliation_status
      comment: "Status of accountability reconciliation for destroyed items"
    - name: "Destruction Year"
      display_name: "Destruction Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', destruction_date)
      comment: "Year of destruction"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Destruction Quarter"
      display_name: "Destruction Quarter"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('quarter', destruction_date)
      comment: "Quarter of destruction"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Destruction Month"
      display_name: "Destruction Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', destruction_date)
      comment: "Month of destruction"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Total Destruction Records"
      display_name: "Total Destruction Records"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of destruction records"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Qty Destroyed"
      display_name: "Total Qty Destroyed"
      expr: SUM(CAST(quantity_destroyed AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total quantity of IMP destroyed (waste and cost KPI)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Kits Destroyed"
      display_name: "Total Kits Destroyed"
      expr: SUM(CAST(kit_count_destroyed AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total number of kits destroyed"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Weight Destroyed Kg"
      display_name: "Total Weight Destroyed (kg)"
      expr: SUM(CAST(weight_destroyed_kg AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total weight of IMP destroyed in kilograms (environmental impact indicator)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Expiry Destruction Rate"
      display_name: "Expiry Destruction Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN destruction_reason = 'Expired' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of destructions due to expiry (waste management KPI)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Damage Destruction Rate"
      display_name: "Damage Destruction Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN destruction_reason = 'Damaged' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of destructions due to damage (quality and handling KPI)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Regulatory Notification Rate"
      display_name: "Regulatory Notification Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN regulatory_notification_required THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of destructions requiring regulatory notification (compliance indicator)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Reconciliation Completed Rate"
      display_name: "Reconciliation Completed Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN reconciliation_status = 'Completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of destructions with completed accountability reconciliation"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Certificate Issued Rate"
      display_name: "Certificate Issued Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN certificate_of_destruction_ref IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of destructions with issued certificate (documentation compliance KPI)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Blinded Destruction Rate"
      display_name: "Blinded Destruction Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_blinded_destruction THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of destructions performed under blinded conditions (trial integrity KPI)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Temperature Excursion Noted Rate"
      display_name: "Temperature Excursion Noted Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN temperature_excursion_noted THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of destructions where temperature excursion was noted (quality indicator)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Kits Per Destruction"
      display_name: "Avg Kits Per Destruction"
      expr: AVG(CAST(kit_count_destroyed AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average number of kits destroyed per destruction event"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "Avg Time To Certificate Days"
      display_name: "Avg Time To Certificate (days)"
      expr: AVG(CAST(DATEDIFF(certificate_issue_date, destruction_date) AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average number of days from destruction to certificate issuance (process efficiency KPI)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
$$
metric_views.description: IMP destruction and waste management KPIs for regulatory compliance and cost control

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_mvm`.`_metrics`.`supply_dispensing_efficiency`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Dispensing volume and return KPIs for clinical trial kits"
  source: "`clinical_trials_mvm`.`supply`.`dispensing_record`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "study_id"
      display_name: "Study Id"
      expr: study_id
      comment: "Study identifier associated with the dispensing event"
    - name: "kit_definition_id"
      display_name: "Kit Definition Id"
      expr: kit_definition_id
      comment: "Kit definition identifier for the dispensed product"
    - name: "dispensing_year"
      display_name: "Dispensing Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', dispensing_date)
      comment: "Year of dispensing"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "dispensing_month"
      display_name: "Dispensing Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', dispensing_date)
      comment: "Month of dispensing"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "total_quantity_dispensed"
      display_name: "Total Quantity Dispensed"
      expr: SUM(CAST(quantity_dispensed AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total units of investigational product dispensed to subjects"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "total_quantity_returned"
      display_name: "Total Quantity Returned"
      expr: SUM(CAST(quantity_returned AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total units returned from subjects back to inventory"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "return_rate"
      display_name: "Return Rate"
      expr: (AGG(`total_quantity_returned`) / NULLIF(AGG(`total_quantity_dispensed`), 0))

      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "avg_dose_amount"
      display_name: "Average Dose Amount"
      expr: AVG(CAST(dose_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average dose amount administered per dispensing event"

        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$

    - name: "Dispensing Status"

    - name: "Temperature Excursion Flag"
      display_name: "Temperature Excursion"
      expr: CASE WHEN temperature_excursion_flag THEN 'Excursion' ELSE 'Compliant' END
      comment: "Whether a temperature excursion was noted during dispensing"
    - name: "Dispensing Year"
      display_name: "Dispensing Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', dispensing_date)
      comment: "Year of dispensing"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Dispensing Quarter"
      display_name: "Dispensing Quarter"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('quarter', dispensing_date)
      comment: "Quarter of dispensing"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Dispensing Month"
      display_name: "Dispensing Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', dispensing_date)
      comment: "Month of dispensing"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Total Dispensing Events"

      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of dispensing events"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Quantity Dispensed"
      display_name: "Total Quantity Dispensed"
      expr: SUM(CAST(quantity_dispensed AS DOUBLE))

        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Quantity Returned"

      comment: "Total quantity of IMP returned by subjects"

        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Subject Compliance Pct"

        type: percentage
        decimal_places:

        type: percentage
        decimal_places:

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_mvm`.`_metrics`.`supply_manufacture_batch`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$

  comment: "Manufacturing batch KPIs: batch size, available quantity, release status, recall rate, quarantine rate, and destruction metrics for investigational medicinal product manufacturing quality and inventory management."
  source: "`clinical_trials_mvm`.`supply`.`manufacture_batch`"
  dimensions:

      expr: release_status
      comment: "Release status of the batch (e.g., Released, Pending, Rejected)"
    - name: "Blinding Type"
      display_name: "Blinding Type"
      expr: blinding_type
      comment: "Blinding type for the batch (e.g., Open-label, Single-blind, Double-blind)"
    - name: "Dosage Form"
      display_name: "Dosage Form"
      expr: dosage_form
      comment: "Dosage form of the manufactured product (e.g., Tablet, Capsule, Injection)"
    - name: "Packaging Configuration"
      display_name: "Packaging Configuration"
      expr: packaging_configuration
      comment: "Packaging configuration for the batch (e.g., Blister, Bottle, Vial)"
    - name: "Manufacturing Site Country"
      display_name: "Manufacturing Site Country"
      expr: manufacturing_site_country
      comment: "Country of the manufacturing site"
    - name: "Is Comparator"
      display_name: "Is Comparator"

      comment: "Indicates whether the batch is a comparator product"
    - name: "Is Placebo"
      display_name: "Is Placebo"
      expr: is_placebo
      comment: "Indicates whether the batch is a placebo"
    - name: "Recall Flag"
      display_name: "Recall Flag"
      expr: recall_flag
      comment: "Indicates whether the batch has been recalled"
    - name: "Manufacture Year"
      display_name: "Manufacture Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', manufacture_date)
      comment: "Year of batch manufacture"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Manufacture Quarter"
      display_name: "Manufacture Quarter"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('quarter', manufacture_date)
      comment: "Quarter of batch manufacture"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Manufacture Month"
      display_name: "Manufacture Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', manufacture_date)
      comment: "Month of batch manufacture"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Expiry Year"
      display_name: "Expiry Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', expiry_date)
      comment: "Year of batch expiry"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Release Year"
      display_name: "Release Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', release_date)
      comment: "Year of batch release"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Manufacture Batch Count"
      display_name: "Manufacture Batch Count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of manufacturing batches"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Batch Size"
      display_name: "Total Batch Size"
      expr: SUM(CAST(batch_size AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of batch size across all manufacturing batches"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Avg Batch Size"
      display_name: "Avg Batch Size"
      expr: AVG(CAST(batch_size AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average batch size across manufacturing batches"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Total Available Quantity"
      display_name: "Total Available Quantity"
      expr: SUM(CAST(available_quantity AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of available quantity across all manufacturing batches"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
      window:
        - order: Manufacture Month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
    - name: "Total Quarantine Quantity"
      display_name: "Total Quarantine Quantity"
      expr: SUM(CAST(quarantine_quantity AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of quarantine quantity across all manufacturing batches"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
      window:
        - order: Manufacture Month
          range: current
          semiadditive: last
    - name: "Total Destroyed Quantity"
      display_name: "Total Destroyed Quantity"
      expr: SUM(CAST(destroyed_quantity AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of destroyed quantity across all manufacturing batches"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Batch Release Rate"
      display_name: "Batch Release Rate %"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN release_status = 'Released' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of manufacturing batches that have been released"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Batch Recall Rate"
      display_name: "Batch Recall Rate %"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN recall_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of manufacturing batches that have been recalled"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Quarantine Rate"
      display_name: "Quarantine Rate %"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(quarantine_quantity AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(batch_size AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of batch size that is quarantined"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Destruction Rate"
      display_name: "Destruction Rate %"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(destroyed_quantity AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(batch_size AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of batch size that has been destroyed"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Availability Rate"
      display_name: "Availability Rate %"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(available_quantity AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(batch_size AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of batch size that is available for use"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Shelf Life Months"
      display_name: "Avg Shelf Life Months"
      expr: AVG(CAST(shelf_life_months AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average shelf life in months across manufacturing batches"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Units Per Kit"
      display_name: "Avg Units Per Kit"
      expr: AVG(CAST(units_per_kit AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average units per kit across manufacturing batches"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Manufacturing batch KPIs: batch size, available quantity, release status, recall rate, quarantine rate, and destruction metrics for investigational medicinal product manufacturing quality and inventory management.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_mvm`.`_metrics`.`supply_resupply_order`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Site resupply order and fulfillment KPIs for trial supply chain responsiveness and efficiency"
  source: "`clinical_trials_mvm`.`supply`.`resupply_order`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "Order Status"
      display_name: "Order Status"
      expr: order_status
      comment: "Current status of the resupply order (pending, approved, shipped, delivered, cancelled)"
    - name: "Trigger Type"
      display_name: "Trigger Type"
      expr: trigger_type
      comment: "Type of trigger that initiated the order (automatic, manual, emergency)"
    - name: "Urgency Level"
      display_name: "Urgency Level"
      expr: urgency_level
      comment: "Urgency level of the resupply order (routine, urgent, emergency)"
    - name: "Blinding Level"
      display_name: "Blinding Level"
      expr: blinding_level
      comment: "Blinding level for the resupply (single, double, open-label)"
    - name: "Cold Chain Required"
      display_name: "Cold Chain Required"
      expr: CASE WHEN cold_chain_required THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END
      comment: "Whether cold chain is required for this resupply"
    - name: "Emergency Override"
      display_name: "Emergency Override"
      expr: CASE WHEN is_emergency_override THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END
      comment: "Whether this is an emergency override order"
    - name: "Accountability Reconciled"
      display_name: "Accountability Reconciled"
      expr: CASE WHEN accountability_reconciled THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END
      comment: "Whether accountability has been reconciled for this order"
    - name: "Order Year"
      display_name: "Order Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', CAST(order_date AS DATE))
      comment: "Year when order was placed"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Order Quarter"
      display_name: "Order Quarter"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CAST(order_date AS DATE))
      comment: "Quarter when order was placed"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Order Month"
      display_name: "Order Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(order_date AS DATE))
      comment: "Month when order was placed"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Total Resupply Orders"
      display_name: "Total Resupply Orders"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of resupply orders"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Qty Requested"
      display_name: "Total Qty Requested"
      expr: SUM(CAST(quantity_requested AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total quantity requested across all resupply orders"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Qty Approved"
      display_name: "Total Qty Approved"
      expr: SUM(CAST(quantity_approved AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total quantity approved for resupply"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Qty Shipped"
      display_name: "Total Qty Shipped"
      expr: SUM(CAST(quantity_shipped AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total quantity actually shipped"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Approval Rate"
      display_name: "Approval Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(quantity_approved AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(quantity_requested AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of requested quantity that was approved (demand fulfillment KPI)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Fulfillment Rate"
      display_name: "Fulfillment Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(quantity_shipped AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(quantity_approved AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of approved quantity that was shipped (supply chain efficiency KPI)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Emergency Order Rate"
      display_name: "Emergency Order Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_emergency_override THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of orders that are emergency overrides (planning effectiveness indicator)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Fulfillment Lead Time Days"
      display_name: "Avg Fulfillment Lead Time (days)"
      expr: AVG(CAST(DATEDIFF(actual_delivery_date, order_date) AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average number of days from order to delivery (supply chain responsiveness KPI)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "Avg Approval Lead Time Days"
      display_name: "Avg Approval Lead Time (days)"
      expr: AVG(CAST(DATEDIFF(approval_date, order_date) AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average number of days from order to approval"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "On-Time Fulfillment Rate"
      display_name: "On-Time Fulfillment Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN actual_delivery_date <= expected_fulfillment_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN actual_delivery_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of orders fulfilled on or before expected date (service level KPI)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Cancellation Rate"
      display_name: "Cancellation Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN order_status = 'Cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of resupply orders that were cancelled"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Accountability Reconciled Rate"
      display_name: "Accountability Reconciled Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN accountability_reconciled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of resupply orders with completed accountability reconciliation"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Stock At Trigger"
      display_name: "Avg Stock At Trigger"
      expr: AVG(CAST(stock_at_trigger AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average stock level when resupply was triggered (reorder point optimization KPI)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
$$
metric_views.description: Site resupply order and fulfillment KPIs for trial supply chain responsiveness and efficiency

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_mvm`.`_metrics`.`supply_shipment`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Shipment logistics and cold-chain compliance KPIs for investigational medicinal product distribution"
  source: "`clinical_trials_mvm`.`supply`.`shipment`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "Shipment Status"
      display_name: "Shipment Status"
      expr: shipment_status
      comment: "Current status of the shipment (in-transit, delivered, quarantined, etc.)"
    - name: "Shipment Type"
      display_name: "Shipment Type"
      expr: shipment_type
      comment: "Type of shipment (initial supply, resupply, return, emergency)"
    - name: "Direction"
      display_name: "Direction"
      expr: direction
      comment: "Shipment direction (inbound, outbound, inter-depot)"
    - name: "Destination Node Type"
      display_name: "Destination Node Type"
      expr: destination_node_type
      comment: "Type of destination (site, depot, sponsor, vendor)"
    - name: "Origin Node Type"
      display_name: "Origin Node Type"
      expr: origin_node_type
      comment: "Type of origin (site, depot, sponsor, vendor)"
    - name: "Cold Chain Required"
      display_name: "Customs Clearance Required"
      expr: CASE WHEN customs_clearance_required THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END
      comment: "Whether customs clearance is required for this shipment"
    - name: "Temperature Excursion Flag"
      display_name: "Temperature Excursion"
      expr: CASE WHEN temperature_excursion_flag THEN 'Excursion' ELSE 'Compliant' END
      comment: "Whether a temperature excursion was detected during shipment"
    - name: "Dispatch Year"
      display_name: "Dispatch Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', dispatch_date)
      comment: "Year of shipment dispatch"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Dispatch Quarter"
      display_name: "Dispatch Quarter"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('quarter', dispatch_date)
      comment: "Quarter of shipment dispatch"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Dispatch Month"
      display_name: "Dispatch Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', dispatch_date)
      comment: "Month of shipment dispatch"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Delivery Year"
      display_name: "Delivery Year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', actual_delivery_date)
      comment: "Year of actual delivery"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
    - name: "Delivery Month"
      display_name: "Delivery Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', actual_delivery_date)
      comment: "Month of actual delivery"
      format:
        type: date
        date_format: year_month_day
        leading_zeros: true
  measures:
    - name: "Total Shipments"
      display_name: "Total Shipments"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of shipments"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Total Kits Shipped"
      display_name: "Total Kits Shipped"
      expr: SUM(CAST(kit_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total number of IMP kits shipped across all shipments"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: all
    - name: "Avg Kits Per Shipment"
      display_name: "Avg Kits Per Shipment"
      expr: AVG(CAST(kit_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average number of kits per shipment"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "Temperature Excursion Rate"
      display_name: "Temperature Excursion Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN temperature_excursion_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of shipments with temperature excursions (critical cold-chain compliance KPI)"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Quarantine Rate"
      display_name: "Quarantine Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN quarantine_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of shipments placed in quarantine upon receipt"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Transit Days"
      display_name: "Avg Transit Days"
      expr: AVG(CAST(DATEDIFF(actual_delivery_date, dispatch_date) AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average number of days from dispatch to actual delivery"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "On-Time Delivery Rate"
      display_name: "On-Time Delivery Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN actual_delivery_date <= expected_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN actual_delivery_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of shipments delivered on or before expected delivery date"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
    - name: "Avg Excursion Duration Minutes"
      display_name: "Avg Excursion Duration (min)"
      expr: AVG(CAST(excursion_duration_minutes AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average duration of temperature excursions in minutes (for shipments with excursions)"
      format:
        type: number
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 1
    - name: "Customs Clearance Required Pct"
      display_name: "Customs Clearance Required %"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN customs_clearance_required THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of shipments requiring customs clearance"
      format:
        type: percentage
        decimal_places:
          type: exact
          places: 2
$$
metric_views.description: Shipment logistics and cold-chain compliance KPIs for investigational medicinal product distribution
